numenera.power.flameblade.blocked_reason: It adds damage to an ordinary weapon.

numenera.power.fire-tendrils.name: Fire Tendrils

effect.summary: Grows three fire tendrils that can make separate attacks.

numenera.power.fire-tendrils.cost_or_limit: 5 Intellect points; lasts up to ten minutes; each tendril deals 4 damage when used to attack.
numenera.power.fire-tendrils.who_may: Characters with Bears a Halo of Fire
numenera.power.fire-tendrils.combines: Creates up to three attacks, each rolled separately.
numenera.power.fire-tendrils.blocked_reason: It permits multiple simultaneous attacks from distinct tendrils.

numenera.power.fire-servant.name: Fire Servant

effect.summary: Creates a fire automaton that follows commands or a simple programmed instruction.

numenera.power.fire-servant.cost_or_limit: 6 Intellect points; lasts ten minutes; level 5; deals one extra fire damage; commands require an action and long-range proximity.
numenera.power.fire-servant.go_wrong: Without new commands, it continues its previous command.
numenera.power.fire-servant.who_may: Characters with Bears a Halo of Fire
numenera.power.fire-servant.combines: Can be given a simple programmed action.
numenera.power.fire-servant.mechanism: Creates and directs a temporary automaton.
numenera.power.fire-servant.blocked_reason: The effect creates a persistent autonomous creature-like servant.

numenera.power.archer.name: Archer

effect.summary: Lets the archer spend Speed or Intellect points to increase bow damage.

numenera.power.archer.cost_or_limit: Effort can be paid from either Pool; each level adds 3 damage to a successful bow attack.

numenera.power.fletcher.name: Fletcher

effect.summary: Trains the character to make arrows.

numenera.power.fletcher.combines: Later Master Fletcher improves this skill.

numenera.power.covering-fire.name: Covering Fire

effect.summary: An extra arrow makes the target's attacks and special abilities harder.

numenera.power.covering-fire.cost_or_limit: 1 Speed point; requires a bow attack and an additional arrow in the same round.
numenera.power.covering-fire.combines: Applied to the target of a bow attack.
numenera.power.covering-fire.blocked_reason: It changes a target's task difficulty.

numenera.power.bowyer.name: Bowyer

effect.summary: Trains the character to make bows.

numenera.power.bowyer.combines: Later Master Bowyer improves this skill.

effect.summary: Trains the character in using bows.
Makes the character especially skilled at making arrows.

numenera.power.quick-shot.name: Quick Shot

effect.summary: A high natural bow attack roll permits an immediate second bow attack.

numenera.power.quick-shot.cost_or_limit: Requires a natural roll of 17 or higher; reuses the first attack's Effort and bonuses.
numenera.power.quick-shot.combines: The additional attack uses the first attack's modifiers.
numenera.power.quick-shot.blocked_reason: It grants an ordinary attack on a specified roll.

effect.summary: Makes the character especially skilled at making bows.
Makes the character especially skilled at using bows.

numenera.power.powerful-shot.name: Powerful Shot

effect.summary: Adds damage to a bow attack.

numenera.power.powerful-shot.cost_or_limit: 2 Might points, in addition to Speed points spent; adds 3 damage.

numenera.power.commands-mental-powers.name: Commands Mental Powers

effect.summary: Grants a suite of psychic abilities and specialized mental esoteries.

numenera.power.commands-mental-powers.cost_or_limit: Specific abilities have individual costs and limits.
numenera.power.commands-mental-powers.go_wrong: Psychics may attract jealousy, hostility, or predatory beings.
numenera.power.commands-mental-powers.mind: Enables telepathy, thought reading, sensory sharing, and mind control.
numenera.power.commands-mental-powers.who_may: Characters choosing this focus, including nanos, glaives, or Jacks
numenera.power.commands-mental-powers.combines: Automatically trains Mind Control or Mind Reading esoteries the character has.
numenera.power.commands-mental-powers.blocked_reason: The focus includes compelled control of another creature's actions.

numenera.power.beast-companion.name: Beast Companion

effect.summary: A level 2 creature accompanies and obeys its owner.

numenera.power.beast-companion.cost_or_limit: Companion is no larger than the character; if it dies, a replacement can be found after 1d6 days of hunting.
numenera.power.beast-companion.mechanism: A creature companion is created or acquired.
numenera.power.beast-companion.blocked_reason: The ability establishes an enduring companion creature, which the basic effect grammar cannot provide.

numenera.power.communication.name: Communication

effect.summary: Exchanges basic concepts with a creature unable to speak or understand speech.

numenera.power.communication.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; only simple concepts and questions.
numenera.power.communication.blocked_reason: A basic information effect can represent conveying and receiving simple concepts.

numenera.power.mount.name: Mount

effect.summary: A level 3 creature serves as a mount and follows instructions.

numenera.power.mount.cost_or_limit: If it dies, a replacement can be found after 3d6 days of hunting.
numenera.power.mount.mechanism: A creature mount is acquired and serves its rider.
numenera.power.mount.blocked_reason: The ability establishes an enduring creature mount, which the basic effect grammar cannot provide.

numenera.power.beast-eyes.name: Beast Eyes

effect.summary: Perceives through the companion’s senses.

numenera.power.beast-eyes.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; companion must be within one mile; lasts up to ten minutes.
numenera.power.beast-eyes.blocked_reason: The effect routes sensory input from one creature to another, requiring a linked-power mechanism.

numenera.power.improved-companion.name: Improved Companion

effect.summary: Raises the beast companion to level 4, improving its target number, health, and damage.

numenera.power.improved-companion.cost_or_limit: Applies to the character’s beast companion.
numenera.power.improved-companion.blocked_reason: A level and statistic increase is a straightforward alteration.

numenera.power.beast-call.name: Beast Call

effect.summary: Calls small native animals or one level 4 beast to assist.

numenera.power.beast-call.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; requires focus and an action each turn to direct; creatures must be native and able to reach the character.
numenera.power.beast-call.go_wrong: Does not work in an unreachable location.
numenera.power.beast-call.where_from: Native animals arrive under their own power.
numenera.power.beast-call.mechanism: Calls creatures from the local environment
numenera.power.beast-call.blocked_reason: The ability summons or gathers creatures to the user’s aid.

numenera.power.hover.name: Hover

effect.summary: Allows a user or another person to hover; other uses require modification.

numenera.power.hover.cost_or_limit: Modifying its use may require extra points or a roll
numenera.power.hover.go_wrong: A roll of 1 can cause GM intrusion
numenera.power.hover.who_may: A nano who knows the esotery is given as an example
numenera.power.hover.combines: Can be modified to affect a friend or used offensively at added difficulty

numenera.power.gravity-cleave.name: Gravity Cleave

effect.summary: Deals 6 damage by shifting gravity across parts of a target.

numenera.power.gravity-cleave.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; target must be within short range.
numenera.power.gravity-cleave.blocked_reason: A damaging force effect can represent the attack.

numenera.power.flight.name: Flight

effect.summary: Enables flight for the user and touched creatures.

numenera.power.flight.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 or more Intellect points; lasts one hour; each Effort level affects another creature; others must remain in sight or fall.
numenera.power.flight.go_wrong: An affected creature falls if it leaves the user’s sight.
numenera.power.flight.combines: Effort extends the number of creatures affected.
numenera.power.flight.blocked_reason: Flight and movement can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.minor-illusion.name: Minor Illusion

effect.summary: Creates a moving image of a creature or object, with sound.

numenera.power.minor-illusion.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Intellect point; image fits a 10-foot cube, lasts ten minutes, and vanishes if the user leaves immediate range; changes require concentration.
numenera.power.minor-illusion.go_wrong: Image has no smell and cannot leave its defined area.
numenera.power.minor-illusion.mind: Can mislead observers, but does not directly change minds.
numenera.power.minor-illusion.blocked_reason: The basic grammar has no mechanism for creating deceptive sensory illusions.

numenera.power.disguise.name: Disguise

effect.summary: Makes the user appear to be a similar-sized person or thing.

numenera.power.disguise.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 or more Intellect points; lasts up to an hour; additional points disguise other creatures, which must stay in sight.
numenera.power.disguise.go_wrong: Other disguised creatures lose the disguise if they leave sight.
numenera.power.disguise.combines: Additional Intellect points extend disguise to others.
numenera.power.disguise.blocked_reason: Changing apparent identity and appearance requires an illusion or form-changing capability.

numenera.power.major-illusion.name: Major Illusion

effect.summary: Creates a complex, moving scene with sound and smell.

numenera.power.major-illusion.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; scene fits a 100-foot cube, lasts ten minutes, and vanishes if the user leaves immediate range.
numenera.power.major-illusion.mind: Can fool observers but does not directly change minds.
numenera.power.major-illusion.combines: User can direct changes without concentration.
numenera.power.major-illusion.blocked_reason: The basic grammar cannot create a complex, deceptive sensory scene.

numenera.power.illusory-selves.name: Illusory Selves

effect.summary: Creates four independently directed holographic doubles.

numenera.power.illusory-selves.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; duplicates last one minute and vanish or freeze when struck.
numenera.power.illusory-selves.go_wrong: A violent strike makes a duplicate disappear or freeze.
numenera.power.illusory-selves.blocked_reason: The basic grammar cannot create independently acting holographic doubles.

numenera.power.terrifying-image.name: Terrifying Image

effect.summary: Shows chosen creatures frightening images, causing those affected to flee.

numenera.power.terrifying-image.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Intellect points; chosen creatures are within long range; requires a successful Intellect attack; lasts one minute.
numenera.power.terrifying-image.go_wrong: A failed attack leaves the target unaffected.
numenera.power.terrifying-image.mind: Telepathically identifies fears and induces terror.
numenera.power.terrifying-image.blocked_reason: The ability uses telepathy to induce a strong emotional response and compel flight.

numenera.power.grandiose-illusion.name: Grandiose Illusion

effect.summary: Creates a vast, complex scene with sound and smell that can act logically.

numenera.power.grandiose-illusion.cost_or_limit: Costs 8 Intellect points; user must be within and able to see the one-mile cube; lasts an hour or longer with concentration.
numenera.power.grandiose-illusion.mind: Can deceive observers but does not directly alter minds.
numenera.power.grandiose-illusion.combines: Images act logically when the user is not watching.
numenera.power.grandiose-illusion.blocked_reason: The basic grammar cannot produce a vast, detailed illusion with autonomous behavior.

numenera.power.crafter.name: Crafter

effect.summary: Trains the character to craft two kinds of items.

numenera.power.crafter.combines: Master Crafter adds further trained kinds or specialization.
numenera.power.crafter.blocked_reason: A skill benefit is compatible with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.tinkerer.name: Tinkerer

effect.summary: Raises the level of artifacts in the character’s possession for that character.

numenera.power.tinkerer.cost_or_limit: Requires at least one day of tinkering; bonus applies only to the owner.
numenera.power.tinkerer.combines: Affects all artifacts in the character’s possession.
numenera.power.tinkerer.blocked_reason: The ability changes how items function and tracks an owner-specific item state.

numenera.power.quick-work.name: Quick Work

effect.summary: Improves one use or one minute of an artifact’s function.

numenera.power.quick-work.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 or more Intellect points; use must occur within one minute; four additional points increase the improvement.
numenera.power.quick-work.go_wrong: Improvement expires if unused within a minute.
numenera.power.quick-work.combines: Can improve an artifact by one or two levels.
numenera.power.quick-work.blocked_reason: The effect modifies an artifact’s level and functioning for a limited window.

numenera.power.master-crafter.name: Master Crafter

effect.summary: Adds training in two item kinds or specialization in two already-trained kinds.

numenera.power.master-crafter.blocked_reason: A skill benefit is compatible with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.cyphersmith.name: Cyphersmith

effect.summary: Improves cyphers and can convert one cypher into another of the same type.

numenera.power.cyphersmith.cost_or_limit: Cyphers used function one level higher; conversion requires a week, appropriate supplies, and a logical result.
numenera.power.cyphersmith.go_wrong: Conversion may not produce an implausible type of item.
numenera.power.cyphersmith.combines: New cypher must retain the original anoetic or occultic type.
numenera.power.cyphersmith.blocked_reason: The ability alters cypher function and transforms one cypher into another.

numenera.power.innovator.name: Innovator

effect.summary: Modifies an artifact to give it different or better abilities.

numenera.power.innovator.cost_or_limit: Treats the artifact as one level lower; takes half the normal time.
numenera.power.innovator.blocked_reason: The ability changes an item’s abilities, requiring item-specific state and rules.

numenera.power.inventor.name: Inventor

effect.summary: Creates new artifacts more efficiently.

numenera.power.inventor.cost_or_limit: Takes half the time and half the normal XP, treating artifacts as two levels lower.
numenera.power.inventor.blocked_reason: Creating new artifacts requires an item-construction mechanism beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.move-metal.name: Move Metal

effect.summary: Exerts limited force to move or push metal objects.

numenera.power.move-metal.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Intellect point; works within short range for one round; cannot affect the user’s body or finely wield weapons.
numenera.power.move-metal.go_wrong: Limited control and speed; usually not an attack.
numenera.power.move-metal.combines: Diamagnetism extends it to nonmetallic objects.
numenera.power.move-metal.blocked_reason: Moving objects with force is supported by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.repel-metal.name: Repel Metal

effect.summary: Improves defense against attacks that use metal.

numenera.power.repel-metal.cost_or_limit: Applies to Speed defense tasks against metal-based attacks.
numenera.power.repel-metal.go_wrong: Does not cover attacks that do not use metal.
numenera.power.repel-metal.combines: Diamagnetism extends protection to all attacks.
numenera.power.repel-metal.blocked_reason: A defensive bonus against a defined attack type can be represented.

numenera.power.destroy-metal.name: Destroy Metal

effect.summary: Tears apart a metal object no larger than half the user’s size.

numenera.power.destroy-metal.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; object must be visible and within short range; task difficulty is reduced by three steps.
numenera.power.destroy-metal.combines: Command Metal can use this ability’s destructive effect.
numenera.power.destroy-metal.blocked_reason: Breaking a specified object is a straightforward transformation or damage effect.

numenera.power.magnetic-field.name: Magnetic Field

effect.summary: Pulls incoming ranged metallic projectiles to the ground, protecting the user.

numenera.power.magnetic-field.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; lasts one round; requires awareness of the attack.
numenera.power.magnetic-field.blocked_reason: A surrounding field intercepts a class of incoming attacks.

numenera.power.command-metal.name: Command Metal

effect.summary: Reshapes, fuses, destroys, moves, or weaponizes metal objects.

numenera.power.command-metal.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; objects must be visible and within short range, with total mass no greater than the user; attack deals 7 damage.
numenera.power.command-metal.go_wrong: Crafted shapes are crude without relevant skills.
numenera.power.command-metal.combines: Can use Destroy Metal’s effect; can fuse objects and move the result.
numenera.power.command-metal.blocked_reason: The listed object movement and transformation effects fit the basic grammar.

numenera.power.diamagnetism.name: Diamagnetism

effect.summary: Makes a nonmetallic object respond to the user’s other magnetic abilities.

numenera.power.diamagnetism.cost_or_limit: Object must be within short range.
numenera.power.diamagnetism.combines: Extends Move Metal, Repel Metal, and related abilities to nonmetal objects.
numenera.power.diamagnetism.blocked_reason: It changes which targets other abilities can affect, requiring interaction between powers.

numenera.power.levity.name: Levity

effect.summary: Improves social interactions except coercion or intimidation and helps companions recover.

numenera.power.levity.go_wrong: Does not assist coercion or intimidation.
numenera.power.levity.blocked_reason: The ability changes others’ mood and social disposition.

numenera.power.inspiration.name: Inspiration

effect.summary: Allies who hear the user gain a recovery roll, a free action, and an asset to that action.

numenera.power.inspiration.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Intellect points; affects allies within short range.
numenera.power.inspiration.combines: The recovery roll does not count against normal recovery rolls.
numenera.power.inspiration.blocked_reason: It affects multiple allies within a range.

numenera.power.knowledge.name: Knowledge

effect.summary: Provides training in two areas of knowledge.

numenera.power.knowledge.cost_or_limit: Areas are chosen by the character.
numenera.power.knowledge.blocked_reason: A skill benefit is compatible with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.calm.name: Calm

effect.summary: Prevents a living foe from attacking for one round.

numenera.power.calm.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; uses performance or art.
numenera.power.calm.mind: Quells the foe’s urge to attack.
numenera.power.calm.blocked_reason: The effect alters a living foe’s intent and prevents an action.

numenera.power.able-assistance.name: Able Assistance

effect.summary: Always reduces a task’s difficulty when helping someone.

numenera.power.able-assistance.blocked_reason: A task difficulty adjustment is directly representable.

numenera.power.master-entertainer.name: Master Entertainer

effect.summary: Improves Inspiration so friends reduce task difficulty by two steps.

numenera.power.master-entertainer.cost_or_limit: Requires the Inspiration ability and eligible friends.
numenera.power.master-entertainer.blocked_reason: A task difficulty adjustment is directly representable.

numenera.power.walk-through-walls.name: Walk Through Walls

effect.summary: Slowly passes the user through physical barriers.

numenera.power.walk-through-walls.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; movement is 1 inch per round, at least one round per barrier; cannot cross energy barriers or act or perceive while inside.
numenera.power.walk-through-walls.go_wrong: Energy barriers stop the user; the user cannot act or perceive while passing through.
numenera.power.walk-through-walls.who_may: Characters who choose this tier 3 phase ability.
numenera.power.walk-through-walls.blocked_reason: The ability phases the user's body through physical barriers.

numenera.power.defensive-phasing.name: Defensive Phasing

effect.summary: Makes some attacks pass through the user and improves Speed defense.

numenera.power.defensive-phasing.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; lasts ten minutes; worn armor provides no benefit.
numenera.power.defensive-phasing.go_wrong: Armor benefits are lost while phased.
numenera.power.defensive-phasing.blocked_reason: The ability changes the user’s phase state so attacks pass through.

numenera.power.phased-attack.name: Phased Attack

effect.summary: Makes an attack ignore the target’s armor.

numenera.power.phased-attack.cost_or_limit: Applies to the character’s attack on this turn.
numenera.power.phased-attack.blocked_reason: An attack that bypasses armor can be represented as a force effect.

numenera.power.ghost.name: Ghost

effect.summary: Enables stealth and faster movement through solid barriers, with perception while phased.

numenera.power.ghost.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; lasts ten minutes; cannot pass energy barriers; movement through matter is one foot per round.
numenera.power.ghost.blocked_reason: The ability changes phase state and allows passage through solid matter.

numenera.power.untouchable.name: Untouchable

effect.summary: Makes the user unable to affect or be affected by normal matter or energy.

numenera.power.untouchable.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Intellect points; lasts one minute; mental attacks and special transdimensional effects can still affect the user.
numenera.power.untouchable.go_wrong: User also cannot attack, touch, or otherwise affect anything.
numenera.power.untouchable.blocked_reason: The user’s phase state changes to exclude ordinary matter and energy.

numenera.power.enhanced-phased-attack.name: Enhanced Phased Attack

effect.summary: Ignores armor and deals 5 additional damage by disrupting the foe’s vitals.

numenera.power.enhanced-phased-attack.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; works like Phased Attack.
numenera.power.enhanced-phased-attack.blocked_reason: The attack and its added damage fit the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.trained-explorer.name: Trained Explorer

effect.summary: Trains the character in searching, listening, climbing, balancing, and jumping.

numenera.power.trained-explorer.blocked_reason: Skill training is compatible with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.eyes-adjusted.name: Eyes Adjusted

effect.summary: Improves vision in extremely dim light and allows sight in darkness as if dimly lit.

numenera.power.eyes-adjusted.combines: Dark Explorer removes penalties for acting in darkness.
numenera.power.eyes-adjusted.blocked_reason: Enhanced visual sensing can be represented.

numenera.power.slippery-customer.name: Slippery Customer

effect.summary: Trains escape, contortion, and light-or-no-armor Speed defense.

numenera.power.slippery-customer.cost_or_limit: Applies to the listed tasks and defense while wearing light armor or none.
numenera.power.slippery-customer.blocked_reason: Skill and defense bonuses fit the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.resilient.name: Resilient

effect.summary: Adds one Armor and trains the character in Might defense.

numenera.power.resilient.who_may: Lives on the Road focus characters
numenera.power.resilient.blocked_reason: The benefits can be represented as basic defensive effects.

numenera.power.dark-explorer.name: Dark Explorer

effect.summary: Removes penalties in dim light or cramped spaces and trains stealth in dimness or darkness.

numenera.power.dark-explorer.cost_or_limit: Full darkness benefits build on Eyes Adjusted.
numenera.power.dark-explorer.combines: Eyes Adjusted enables action without penalty in total darkness.
numenera.power.dark-explorer.blocked_reason: The benefits are skill and task modifiers.

numenera.power.blinding-attack.name: Blinding Attack

effect.summary: Uses a light source in a melee attack to blind a target.

numenera.power.blinding-attack.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Speed points; requires a light source and a successful attack; causes no damage; blindness lasts one minute.
numenera.power.blinding-attack.go_wrong: A failed attack does not blind the target.
numenera.power.blinding-attack.blocked_reason: Blinding a target is a sensory effect that can be represented with the basic grammar.

numenera.power.attack-flourish.name: Attack Flourish

effect.summary: Impresses visible creatures within short range, giving each a bonus to its next roll.

numenera.power.attack-flourish.blocked_reason: A bonus to a future roll is directly representable.

numenera.power.quick-block.name: Quick Block

effect.summary: Improves Speed defense while using a light or medium weapon.

numenera.power.quick-block.cost_or_limit: Requires a light or medium weapon.
numenera.power.quick-block.go_wrong: Cannot be used while using Block for Another.
numenera.power.quick-block.combines: Cannot combine with Block for Another.
numenera.power.quick-block.blocked_reason: A conditional defense bonus is supported.

numenera.power.acrobatic-attack.name: Acrobatic Attack

effect.summary: Improves an attack’s difficulty through an acrobatic leap.

numenera.power.acrobatic-attack.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Speed points; unavailable if armor reduces Speed; a natural 17 or 18 can yield a minor effect instead of extra damage.
numenera.power.acrobatic-attack.go_wrong: Cannot be used when armor reduces Speed.
numenera.power.acrobatic-attack.blocked_reason: An attack difficulty adjustment is directly representable.

numenera.power.mobile-fighter.name: Mobile Fighter

effect.summary: Moves around obstacles as part of an attack without difficulty.

numenera.power.mobile-fighter.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Speed points; unavailable if armor reduces Speed.
numenera.power.mobile-fighter.go_wrong: Cannot be used when armor reduces Speed.
numenera.power.mobile-fighter.combines: Movement occurs as part of an attack.
numenera.power.mobile-fighter.blocked_reason: Movement during an attack is supported by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.block-for-another.name: Block for Another

effect.summary: Improves an ally’s Speed defense against attacks.

numenera.power.block-for-another.cost_or_limit: Requires a light or medium weapon and an ally within immediate range; cannot be used with Quick Block.
numenera.power.block-for-another.blocked_reason: A defensive bonus applied to a nearby ally is supported.

numenera.power.agile-wit.name: Agile Wit

effect.summary: Allows Speed tasks to use Intellect and spend Intellect points instead.

numenera.power.agile-wit.cost_or_limit: If Effort is used, Intellect Edge applies when spending Intellect points.
numenera.power.agile-wit.mechanism: Changes task stat and resource pool
numenera.power.agile-wit.blocked_reason: A task-stat substitution is representable as a rules alteration.

numenera.power.telekinesis.name: Telekinesis

effect.summary: It moves objects subject to approximately the real-world weight limit.

numenera.power.telekinesis.cost_or_limit: The datasphere’s apparent weight limits movement to what the effect could move in reality.
numenera.power.telekinesis.combines: The datasphere emulates weight despite objects being essentially weightless.
numenera.power.telekinesis.blocked_reason: The weight limitation can be applied to a basic movement effect.

numenera.power.enhance-strength.name: Enhance Strength

effect.summary: A nearby follower aids the user’s brute-force tasks.

numenera.power.enhance-strength.cost_or_limit: Follower from Nucleus of a Horde must be nearby and working with the user.
numenera.power.enhance-strength.who_may: A character with Nucleus of a Horde and this ability.
numenera.power.enhance-strength.where_from: Martial training and cooperation with the follower.
numenera.power.enhance-strength.combines: Follower grants an asset even if strength tasks are not their listed modifications.
numenera.power.enhance-strength.blocked_reason: This is a conditional asset bonus.

numenera.power.apportation.name: Apportation

effect.summary: Calls a piece of physical equipment to the user.

numenera.power.apportation.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; cannot take an item held by another creature; random item option is limited to once daily.
numenera.power.apportation.go_wrong: Randomly called item may be worthless junk; has a 10 percent chance of being a cypher or artifact.
numenera.power.apportation.combines: Item may be selected from standard equipment or generated randomly.

numenera.power.connection-with-an-organi.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.connection-with-an-organi.combines: The chosen organization and the GM determine relevant information access.

numenera.power.goad.name: Goad

effect.summary: After a successful attack, eases others’ Speed defenses against the attacked creature’s attacks until next round ends.

numenera.power.goad.cost_or_limit: Costs two Might points; requires a successful attack.
numenera.power.goad.who_may: Characters with Acts Without Consequence who select the option
numenera.power.goad.combines: Benefits other characters defending against the attacked creature.
numenera.power.goad.blocked_reason: The effect alters how other characters defend against a target’s attacks.

numenera.power.powerful-rhetoric.name: Powerful Rhetoric

effect.summary: A spoken label changes how a target is socially regarded and can aid or hinder social actions or defenses.

numenera.power.powerful-rhetoric.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Intellect point after at least a minute of conversation; the label lasts until changed or convincingly challenged.
numenera.power.powerful-rhetoric.go_wrong: A convincing defense or revised rhetoric ends the label’s influence.
numenera.power.powerful-rhetoric.mind: The speaker’s conviction and the target’s doubt also affect them.
numenera.power.powerful-rhetoric.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.powerful-rhetoric.combines: The effect depends on the chosen label: friend, fool, or enemy.

numenera.power.understanding.name: Understanding

effect.summary: Studying a creature or object grants an asset on the user’s next interaction with it.

numenera.power.understanding.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Intellect point; requires observing or studying the subject.
numenera.power.understanding.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.understanding.combines: The asset applies to the next interaction with the studied subject.

numenera.power.calm-stranger.name: Calm Stranger

effect.summary: Keeps an intelligent creature calm while the user focuses on it and it is not threatened.

numenera.power.calm-stranger.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 or more Intellect points; additional Effort can include allied creatures; target must see the user.
numenera.power.calm-stranger.go_wrong: Ends if the user stops focusing, or if the target is attacked or otherwise threatened.
numenera.power.calm-stranger.mind: Calms the target without requiring shared language.
numenera.power.calm-stranger.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.calm-stranger.combines: Effort can extend the effect to allies of the initial target.
numenera.power.calm-stranger.blocked_reason: It maintains a controlled emotional state for as long as the user focuses.

numenera.power.cloud-personal-memories.name: Cloud Personal Memories

effect.summary: On success, erases up to five minutes of a target’s recent memories.

numenera.power.cloud-personal-memories.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; requires at least a round of interaction or study and a successful task.
numenera.power.cloud-personal-memories.mind: Removes recent memories and requires reading how the target’s mind works.
numenera.power.cloud-personal-memories.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.cloud-personal-memories.blocked_reason: The effect directly erases a defined period of a creature’s memories.

numenera.power.disincentivize.name: Disincentivize

effect.summary: Hinders chosen targets’ actions for one round with speech they understand.

numenera.power.disincentivize.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Intellect point; targets must be within short range and understand the user.
numenera.power.disincentivize.go_wrong: The hindrance lasts only one round.
numenera.power.disincentivize.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.disincentivize.combines: May affect any number of chosen targets in range.

numenera.power.gather-intelligence.name: Gather Intelligence

effect.summary: By asking around in a populated place, obtains useful facts and a working sense of its layout.

numenera.power.gather-intelligence.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points and takes about an hour; requires a group of people nearby.
numenera.power.gather-intelligence.go_wrong: Information gathered is limited to what can be learned by asking around.
numenera.power.gather-intelligence.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.gather-intelligence.combines: Can answer a specific question or collect general facts.

numenera.power.inspire-action.name: Inspire Action

effect.summary: An ally who understands the user may immediately perform the instructed action as an additional action.

numenera.power.inspire-action.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; ally must see and easily understand the user and choose to follow the instruction.
numenera.power.inspire-action.go_wrong: The ally receives no additional action if they do not choose the specified action.
numenera.power.inspire-action.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.inspire-action.combines: Does not prevent the ally from taking their normal turn action.

numenera.power.quick-wits.name: Quick Wits

effect.summary: Allows Intellect costs for tasks to be paid from the Speed Pool instead.

numenera.power.quick-wits.cost_or_limit: Applies to tasks that would normally cost points from the Intellect Pool.
numenera.power.quick-wits.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.quick-wits.combines: Uses Speed Pool points in place of Intellect Pool points.

numenera.power.break-the-line.name: Break the Line

effect.summary: Disrupts a group’s benefit from coordinated action for up to a minute.

numenera.power.break-the-line.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; targets must be gaining a benefit from working together.
numenera.power.break-the-line.go_wrong: The effect ends after a minute or when affected foes spend a round resetting.
numenera.power.break-the-line.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.break-the-line.combines: Targets can regain their advantage by reassessing and resetting.
numenera.power.break-the-line.blocked_reason: It removes a benefit generated by another group effect or coordinated mechanism.

numenera.power.improved-follower.name: Improved Follower

effect.summary: Provides a level 3 follower, optionally upgrading an existing level 2 follower and adding another level 2 follower.

numenera.power.improved-follower.cost_or_limit: Choose a new level 3 follower, or upgrade an existing level 2 follower and gain a new level 2 follower.
numenera.power.improved-follower.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.improved-follower.combines: Can improve a follower previously gained through Follower.

numenera.power.informer.name: Informer

effect.summary: A contact in an allied community reports notable events from their location.

numenera.power.informer.cost_or_limit: Requires an informer within an allied community.
numenera.power.informer.go_wrong: Reports depend on the informer’s available means.
numenera.power.informer.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.informer.combines: Informer can be a secret or known contact.

numenera.power.lead-by-inquiry.name: Lead by Inquiry

effect.summary: After 28 hours together, allies gain training in perception-related tasks while remaining with the user.

numenera.power.lead-by-inquiry.cost_or_limit: Requires 28 hours together; leaving for more than 28 hours requires another 28 hours to restore the benefit.
numenera.power.lead-by-inquiry.go_wrong: Benefit ends when the user leaves the allies’ company.
numenera.power.lead-by-inquiry.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.lead-by-inquiry.combines: Returns if the user rejoins within 28 hours.

numenera.power.oratory.name: Oratory

effect.summary: Persuades a nonhostile, understanding group to take one reasonable action in the next round.

numenera.power.oratory.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; targets must be intelligent, able to understand the user, and nonhostile.
numenera.power.oratory.go_wrong: Cannot reasonably compel actions that are dangerous or wildly out of character.
numenera.power.oratory.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.oratory.combines: Applies to a group of creatures.
numenera.power.oratory.blocked_reason: It persuades multiple creatures to perform a specified action on a deadline.

numenera.power.perfect-stranger.name: Perfect Stranger

effect.summary: Alters appearance and manner so even familiar observers do not recognize the user.

numenera.power.perfect-stranger.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; lasts an hour or while the disguise is maintained; identity-related tasks gain free Effort.
numenera.power.perfect-stranger.mind: Changes posture and speech but does not state a mental effect.
numenera.power.perfect-stranger.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.perfect-stranger.combines: A small clothing alteration supports the disguise.

numenera.power.crowd-protection.name: Crowd Protection

effect.summary: An allied crowd shields the user and makes attacks against them harder for about a minute.

numenera.power.crowd-protection.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; requires an allied community or horde and a crowd near the user.
numenera.power.crowd-protection.go_wrong: Protection ends after about a minute, when the crowd disperses.
numenera.power.crowd-protection.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.crowd-protection.combines: The crowd moves with the user and can be exhorted to attack nearby enemies for 1 damage each.
numenera.power.crowd-protection.blocked_reason: A coordinated crowd creates a mobile protective formation and area attack.

numenera.power.envoy.name: Envoy

effect.summary: Convinces a community resident to carry a message or parcel to a reachable destination and report back.

numenera.power.envoy.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; requires studying or interacting with a resident of an allied community for a round.
numenera.power.envoy.go_wrong: The envoy may report failure to complete the delivery.
numenera.power.envoy.mind: Persuades the target to act as a messenger.
numenera.power.envoy.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.envoy.combines: The parcel may be physical; travel time may take hours to months.
numenera.power.envoy.blocked_reason: The power recruits a target to carry out a task and return with a report.

numenera.power.exile-from-community.name: Exile From Community

effect.summary: Persuades a target to leave an allied community temporarily or permanently.

numenera.power.exile-from-community.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; requires studying the target for a round in an allied community.
numenera.power.exile-from-community.go_wrong: The task is eased if most community members already regard the target as troublesome.
numenera.power.exile-from-community.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.exile-from-community.combines: Community opinion can ease the attempt.
numenera.power.exile-from-community.blocked_reason: It attempts to make a target leave a community for a chosen duration.

numenera.power.spur-effort.name: Spur Effort

effect.summary: Lets a nearby ally apply one free level of Effort to a task on their next turn.

numenera.power.spur-effort.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; ally must be within immediate range and apply Effort next turn.
numenera.power.spur-effort.go_wrong: Benefit expires if the ally does not use Effort on that turn.
numenera.power.spur-effort.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.spur-effort.combines: Adds a free Effort level to Effort the ally chooses to apply.

numenera.power.strategize.name: Strategize

effect.summary: A group that plans together gains one free Effort level for one task during the plan’s execution.

numenera.power.strategize.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Intellect points; requires ten minutes of planning and the benefit expires after 28 hours.
numenera.power.strategize.go_wrong: The benefit applies only to a concrete, executable plan.
numenera.power.strategize.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.strategize.combines: The user and participating allies receive the benefit.

numenera.power.unseen-among-the-people.name: Unseen Among the People

effect.summary: Residents of an allied community help the user pass as unimportant and unseen for ten hours.

numenera.power.unseen-among-the-people.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 or more Intellect points; requires an allied community and local knowledge; hiding in an unallied community costs additional Effort per rank.
numenera.power.unseen-among-the-people.go_wrong: Revealing actions end the effect until the user takes an action to hide again.
numenera.power.unseen-among-the-people.mind: None stated; locals assist the user’s concealment.
numenera.power.unseen-among-the-people.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.unseen-among-the-people.combines: While active, grants specialization in stealth and Speed defense; at least three allies can help substitute in some settings.

numenera.power.discipline-of-watchfulnes.name: Discipline of Watchfulness

effect.summary: After 28 hours together, allies gain free Effort on initiative tasks while they remain with the user.

numenera.power.discipline-of-watchfulnes.cost_or_limit: Costs 7 Intellect points; requires 28 hours with the allies.
numenera.power.discipline-of-watchfulnes.go_wrong: Benefit ends if the user leaves, and resumes if they return.
numenera.power.discipline-of-watchfulnes.who_may: An Arkus who selects this precept.
numenera.power.discipline-of-watchfulnes.combines: Benefit continues while the allies remain in the user’s company.

numenera.power.raise-a-champion.name: Raise a Champion

effect.summary: Calls a level 5 community member to serve for one minute.

numenera.power.raise-a-champion.cost_or_limit: Costs 7 Intellect points; requires an allied community or horde and a minute to prepare.
numenera.power.raise-a-champion.combines: The champion follows the user’s directions without requiring their actions.
numenera.power.raise-a-champion.blocked_reason: It creates and directs an NPC, a summon-like effect beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.rouse-to-violence.name: Rouse to Violence

effect.summary: Incites a crowd to kill a visible low-level target.

numenera.power.rouse-to-violence.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 or more Intellect points; requires an allied community or horde. Effort can raise the target level limit.
numenera.power.rouse-to-violence.mind: Drives residents into a killing frenzy.
numenera.power.rouse-to-violence.combines: Effort can increase the maximum target level.
numenera.power.rouse-to-violence.mechanism: Area-wide emotional compulsion and crowd violence.
numenera.power.rouse-to-violence.blocked_reason: It affects a crowd across an area and induces a frenzy.

numenera.power.suggestion.name: Suggestion

effect.summary: Prompts a nearby creature to perform a plausible action for up to a minute.

numenera.power.suggestion.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 or more Intellect points; target must be level 2 or lower unless Effort raises the limit; the suggestion must fit its nature or duty.
numenera.power.suggestion.mind: The target remembers obeying and may be persuaded it acted willingly.
numenera.power.suggestion.combines: Effort can raise the maximum target level.
numenera.power.suggestion.mechanism: Temporary suggestion affecting a target’s choices.
numenera.power.suggestion.blocked_reason: It changes a creature’s behavior and leaves a memory of the effect.

numenera.power.divide-and-conquer.name: Divide and Conquer

effect.summary: Enables the user and a prepared deputy to handle two tasks at once.

numenera.power.divide-and-conquer.cost_or_limit: Costs 7 Intellect points; deputy needs at least a round of briefing; lasts up to a minute for regular actions.
numenera.power.divide-and-conquer.who_may: A character with this precept and a follower or deputy.
numenera.power.divide-and-conquer.combines: The deputy’s special-ability costs come from the user’s Pools.
numenera.power.divide-and-conquer.mechanism: Delegated action and parallel task resolution.
numenera.power.divide-and-conquer.blocked_reason: The effect can be represented as an additional task or action.

numenera.power.healing-power-of-words.name: Healing Power of Words

effect.summary: Restores Might or Speed Pool points while the user keeps speaking.

numenera.power.healing-power-of-words.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Intellect points; requires studying or interacting for a round and a level 3 task; cannot exceed the normal Pool maximum.
numenera.power.healing-power-of-words.go_wrong: Healing stops if the target spends from the Pool.
numenera.power.healing-power-of-words.combines: The user chooses a recovery amount or a restored total; recovery occurs one point per round.

numenera.power.infer-thoughts.name: Infer Thoughts

effect.summary: Infers visible target’s surface thoughts for up to a minute while seeing and hearing it.

numenera.power.infer-thoughts.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; requires a round of interaction or study and line of sight.
numenera.power.infer-thoughts.mind: Reads surface thoughts without the target’s consent.
numenera.power.infer-thoughts.combines: Continued sensing requires sight and hearing.
numenera.power.infer-thoughts.blocked_reason: It reveals another creature’s thoughts, a form of divination.

numenera.power.knowing-the-unknown.name: Knowing the Unknown

effect.summary: Taps an external information source to answer a question.

numenera.power.knowing-the-unknown.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Intellect points; requires an allied community or horde. Knowledge of the future is impossible; obscure past knowledge is difficult.
numenera.power.knowing-the-unknown.where_from: An information source beyond the user, while in an allied community or horde.
numenera.power.knowing-the-unknown.combines: The GM sets difficulty according to obscurity.
numenera.power.knowing-the-unknown.mechanism: Information acquisition with a difficulty limit.
numenera.power.knowing-the-unknown.blocked_reason: It grants otherwise unavailable knowledge through an external source.

numenera.power.coax-the-crowd.name: Coax the Crowd

effect.summary: Persuades a large nearby group to change a belief and take long-term action.

numenera.power.coax-the-crowd.cost_or_limit: Costs 7 Intellect points; takes ten minutes and fails if seriously interrupted.
numenera.power.coax-the-crowd.go_wrong: Serious interruption automatically defeats the attempt.
numenera.power.coax-the-crowd.mind: Changes the group’s belief and motivation.
numenera.power.coax-the-crowd.mechanism: Group persuasion with lasting behavioral consequences.
numenera.power.coax-the-crowd.blocked_reason: It changes the beliefs and actions of a large group across an area.

numenera.power.extra-community-action.name: Extra Community Action

effect.summary: Lets a community take two actions in the time normally needed for one.

numenera.power.extra-community-action.cost_or_limit: Costs 9 Intellect points; takes an hour; applies during conflict between communities.
numenera.power.extra-community-action.where_from: A community the user can fire up.
numenera.power.extra-community-action.combines: Can support damage or another community action.
numenera.power.extra-community-action.blocked_reason: It grants an additional community task.

numenera.power.assume-control.name: Assume Control

effect.summary: Controls a studied creature’s actions for ten minutes.

numenera.power.assume-control.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 or more Intellect points; target is normally level 2 or lower; Effort raises the level limit.
numenera.power.assume-control.go_wrong: The target remembers the control afterward, and the relationship may worsen.
numenera.power.assume-control.mind: The target acts as if it wants to fulfill the user’s desire.
numenera.power.assume-control.who_may: A sixth-tier Arkus with this precept.
numenera.power.assume-control.where_from: A creature studied or interacted with for at least a round.
numenera.power.assume-control.combines: Effort increases the maximum target level; specific instructions use an action.
numenera.power.assume-control.blocked_reason: It overrides another creature’s agency for an extended duration.

numenera.power.recruit-deputy.name: Recruit Deputy

effect.summary: Grants a level 4 follower, or advances one follower and grants another.

numenera.power.recruit-deputy.combines: Alternatively advances a level 3 follower to level 4 and grants a new level 3 follower.
numenera.power.recruit-deputy.blocked_reason: It adds followers as game entities.

numenera.power.pet.name: Pet

effect.summary: A well-cared-for pet grants an asset to tasks for peace of mind, comfort, or resisting loneliness.

numenera.power.pet.cost_or_limit: A pet usually grants no modifications; one that does must come from a follower-granting ability.
numenera.power.pet.mind: Provides comfort and helps resist loneliness.
numenera.power.pet.who_may: Any PC may potentially gain a pet.
numenera.power.pet.combines: A follower-granting ability can provide a pet with modifications.
numenera.power.pet.blocked_reason: The benefit can be represented as an asset.

numenera.power.sway-horde.name: Sway Horde

effect.summary: Turns a horde toward dispersal or another target, or raises a cohesive horde from a community.

numenera.power.sway-horde.cost_or_limit: Costs 12 or more Intellect points; takes an hour; a raised horde lasts up to three days or until destroyed; Effort can raise its rank.
numenera.power.sway-horde.mind: Can influence a horde’s course of action.
numenera.power.sway-horde.where_from: A horde or a village-or-larger community with enough able-bodied adults.
numenera.power.sway-horde.combines: The raised horde’s level equals the source community’s rank.
numenera.power.sway-horde.blocked_reason: It influences or creates a group entity at community scale.

numenera.power.take-command.name: Take Command

effect.summary: A willing character’s next attack is eased and deals 3 extra damage on a hit, or another task is eased.

numenera.power.take-command.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; target must choose to listen.
numenera.power.take-command.combines: An alternative non-attack task receives a free level of Effort.
numenera.power.take-command.blocked_reason: It modifies the target’s next task.

numenera.power.will-of-a-leader.name: Will of a Leader

effect.summary: Allies nearby and the user gain +1 Edge to one chosen stat for an hour.

numenera.power.will-of-a-leader.cost_or_limit: Costs 9 Intellect points; affects allies within immediate range.
numenera.power.will-of-a-leader.blocked_reason: It grants a sustained bonus to multiple nearby allies.

numenera.power.community-builder.name: Community Builder

effect.summary: Adds 3 infrastructure to a community while the Wright is present and personally working for it.

numenera.power.community-builder.cost_or_limit: Requires presence and active personal work on behalf of the community.
numenera.power.community-builder.where_from: A community the Wright is helping.
numenera.power.community-builder.blocked_reason: It applies a numeric bonus to a community stat.

numenera.power.always-tinkering.name: Always Tinkering

effect.summary: Creates a random, fragile cypher two levels below normal, minimum level 1.

numenera.power.always-tinkering.cost_or_limit: Requires tools, materials, fewer cyphers than the carrying limit, and an hour; the cypher cannot be given to another person without falling apart.
numenera.power.always-tinkering.go_wrong: Temperamental and fragile; unusable by another holder.
numenera.power.always-tinkering.combines: Uses only 1 iotum unit and 1 parts point if those are the materials used.
numenera.power.always-tinkering.blocked_reason: It creates a cypher with a holder restriction and fragility.

numenera.power.additional-numenera-plans.name: Additional Numenera Plans

effect.summary: Grants two additional numenera plans.

numenera.power.additional-numenera-plans.who_may: A Wright choosing an inspired technique.
numenera.power.additional-numenera-plans.blocked_reason: It adds crafting plans to the character.

numenera.power.deconstruct.name: Deconstruct

effect.summary: Studies a numenera source to improve salvage and yield one additional iotum result.

numenera.power.deconstruct.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; takes ten minutes; the source must contain salvageable iotum for the extra yield.
numenera.power.deconstruct.where_from: A numenera object or structure being studied.
numenera.power.deconstruct.combines: Grants an asset to the salvage task and an additional iotum-table roll.
numenera.power.deconstruct.mechanism: Salvage analysis and extra resource yield.
numenera.power.deconstruct.blocked_reason: It modifies a salvage task and its result.

numenera.power.extra-use.name: Extra Use

effect.summary: Attempts to gain another use from an installation or artifact without depletion.

numenera.power.extra-use.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; task difficulty equals item level; crafted items grant an asset. A cypher attempt is hindered.
numenera.power.extra-use.go_wrong: Failure triggers normal depletion; a failed cypher attempt destroys it.
numenera.power.extra-use.combines: Can be used on the Wright’s own crafted installation or artifact for an asset.
numenera.power.extra-use.blocked_reason: It changes whether a powered item depletes or is destroyed.

numenera.power.natural-crafter.name: Natural Crafter

effect.summary: Commonplace objects and structures made by the Wright count as one level higher.

numenera.power.natural-crafter.cost_or_limit: Applies to commonplace crafted objects and structures.
numenera.power.natural-crafter.blocked_reason: It changes the level assigned to crafted objects.

numenera.power.right-tool-for-the-job.name: Right Tool for the Job

effect.summary: Shapes iotum into a temporary device that grants an asset to one predetermined physical noncombat task.

numenera.power.right-tool-for-the-job.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Intellect point and at least 1 iotum unit; lasts about a minute or until used; using it destroys the iotum.
numenera.power.right-tool-for-the-job.go_wrong: The iotum is consumed when used.
numenera.power.right-tool-for-the-job.combines: The task must be identified ahead of time.
numenera.power.right-tool-for-the-job.mechanism: Temporary task-assistance device made from a consumed resource.
numenera.power.right-tool-for-the-job.blocked_reason: It makes an item carry an effect and consumes the item on use.

numenera.power.scan-for-iotum.name: Scan for Iotum

effect.summary: Scans a nearby 10-foot cube to determine whether its contents include iotum and aids initial salvage tasks.

numenera.power.scan-for-iotum.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; difficulty equals the scanned source level; some materials and energy fields resist or prevent scanning.
numenera.power.scan-for-iotum.go_wrong: Resistant materials or fields may prevent the scan.
numenera.power.scan-for-iotum.combines: Grants an asset to initial salvage tasks in the scanned area; does not locate a specific iotum type.
numenera.power.scan-for-iotum.blocked_reason: It senses hidden iotum in objects and structures.

numenera.power.scramble-machine.name: Scramble Machine

effect.summary: Stops a nearby machine for one round, or hinders its actions or its user’s actions for a minute.

numenera.power.scramble-machine.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; machine must be within short range.
numenera.power.scramble-machine.combines: Can target machine function or hinder its use.
numenera.power.scramble-machine.blocked_reason: It temporarily blocks a machine’s operation.

numenera.power.trained-in-armor.name: Trained in Armor

effect.summary: Reduces armor’s Speed Effort cost by 1 and allows extended use without tiring.

numenera.power.trained-in-armor.cost_or_limit: Can wear any armor; choosing it at the start grants armor of the user’s choice.
numenera.power.trained-in-armor.blocked_reason: It modifies the cost and drawbacks of armor.

numenera.power.trigger-iotum-ray.name: Trigger Iotum Ray

numenera.power.numenera-adaptation.name: Numenera Adaptation

effect.summary: Provides 2 Armor against attacks from numenera devices, automatons, and mechanisms.

numenera.power.numenera-adaptation.cost_or_limit: Only applies to attacks from numenera devices, automatons, or other mechanisms.
numenera.power.numenera-adaptation.combines: Works even against attacks that normally ignore Armor.
numenera.power.numenera-adaptation.blocked_reason: It is a numeric defensive benefit against a defined source.

numenera.power.vigilant.name: Vigilant

effect.summary: Prevents an attack or effect from dazing or stunning the user.

numenera.power.vigilant.combines: Triggers when an attack or effect would daze or stun.
numenera.power.vigilant.blocked_reason: It blocks unspecified attacks or effects based on the condition they would cause.

numenera.power.inspire-coordinated-actio.name: Inspire Coordinated Actions

effect.summary: Instructs allies who understand and choose to comply to take one shared additional action immediately.

numenera.power.inspire-coordinated-actio.cost_or_limit: Costs 9 Intellect; allies must see and easily understand the user.
numenera.power.inspire-coordinated-actio.go_wrong: Allies may decline to take the instructed action.
numenera.power.inspire-coordinated-actio.mind: None stated; it gives instructions but does not compel compliance.
numenera.power.inspire-coordinated-actio.who_may: A sixth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.inspire-coordinated-actio.combines: Does not replace allies’ normal actions.
numenera.power.inspire-coordinated-actio.blocked_reason: It grants an additional action to willing allies.

numenera.power.mastery-with-attacks.name: Mastery With Attacks

effect.summary: Improves an already-trained weapon-attack type to specialized.

numenera.power.mastery-with-attacks.cost_or_limit: Choose one attack type in which the Delve is trained.
numenera.power.mastery-with-attacks.who_may: A sixth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.mastery-with-attacks.combines: Requires training, which can be gained through Skill With Attacks.
numenera.power.mastery-with-attacks.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward change to the user’s skill level.

numenera.power.negate-danger.name: Negate Danger

effect.summary: Permanently negates a potential danger tied to one nearby creature or object.

numenera.power.negate-danger.cost_or_limit: Costs 7 Intellect; target must be within immediate distance.
numenera.power.negate-danger.who_may: A sixth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.negate-danger.combines: Can target a weapon, device, natural ability, or trap.
numenera.power.negate-danger.blocked_reason: It permanently negates varied danger sources without specifying their mechanics.

numenera.power.subtle-steps.name: Subtle Steps

effect.summary: Makes movement silent when moving no more than a short distance.

numenera.power.subtle-steps.who_may: A sixth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.subtle-steps.combines: Works regardless of the surface crossed.
numenera.power.subtle-steps.blocked_reason: It suppresses the user’s movement sounds over a limited distance.

numenera.power.refine-iotum.name: Refine Iotum

effect.summary: Improves follow-up searches for a specific iotum variety after an initial discovery.

numenera.power.refine-iotum.cost_or_limit: Requires an initial salvage discovery and at least one Effort; maximum six Effort levels.
numenera.power.refine-iotum.combines: Grants one free Effort level on follow-up attempts.
numenera.power.refine-iotum.blocked_reason: It modifies the effort available to a subsequent search.

numenera.power.concussion.name: Concussion

effect.summary: Uses iotum to fashion a device that explodes for concussive damage.

numenera.power.concussion.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect and at least one unit of iotum; damages everything within short range for 5, or 1 on a failed attack. The device lasts about a minute and is destroyed when used.
numenera.power.concussion.go_wrong: A failed attack still causes 1 damage in the area.
numenera.power.concussion.who_may: A fifth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.concussion.combines: Can be thrown up to long range or set on a short timer.
numenera.power.concussion.blocked_reason: The ability creates an item that stores a delayed area attack and is destroyed on use.

numenera.power.free-to-move.name: Free to Move

effect.summary: Ignores movement penalties, passes through spaces large enough for the user’s head, and gains extra effort to escape restraints.

numenera.power.free-to-move.cost_or_limit: The passage specifies no resource cost.
numenera.power.free-to-move.who_may: A fifth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.free-to-move.combines: Grants three free Effort levels on tasks to break free of bonds, grips, or similar impediments.
numenera.power.free-to-move.blocked_reason: The movement and escape benefits are directly representable.

numenera.power.group-friendship.name: Group Friendship

effect.summary: Makes a sentient creature regard the user and designated nearby companions positively, as potential friends.

numenera.power.group-friendship.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect; affects up to ten designated companions within immediate distance.
numenera.power.group-friendship.mind: Changes the target’s attitude but does not state that it controls the target.
numenera.power.group-friendship.who_may: A fifth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.group-friendship.combines: Can include the user and up to ten other creatures.
numenera.power.group-friendship.blocked_reason: It changes a sentient creature’s disposition toward a group.

numenera.power.hard-to-kill.name: Hard to Kill

effect.summary: Allows the user to reroll a defense task.

numenera.power.hard-to-kill.who_may: A fifth-tier Delve who selects this lore.
numenera.power.hard-to-kill.combines: Reroll applies to a defense task.

numenera.power.not-dead-yet.name: Not Dead Yet

effect.summary: When death would occur, leaves the user unconscious briefly, restores stat pools, and brings them back impaired.

numenera.power.not-dead-yet.cost_or_limit: The user dies permanently if they die again before a ten-hour recovery roll; impaired state lasts until resting ten hours, or becomes impaired rather than debilitated with Delve’s Fortitude.
numenera.power.not-dead-yet.go_wrong: A second death before recovery is final.
numenera.power.not-dead-yet.who_may: A Delve who selects this ability.
numenera.power.not-dead-yet.combines: Delve’s Fortitude reduces the resulting severity.
numenera.power.not-dead-yet.blocked_reason: It reverses a normally fatal state and defines when a later death becomes final.

numenera.power.share-defense.name: Share Defense

effect.summary: Lets a nearby ally use the Delve’s defense skill when it is better than their own.

numenera.power.share-defense.cost_or_limit: Ally must be within short range; Delve must be more skilled in that defense type.
numenera.power.share-defense.who_may: A Delve who selects this ability.
numenera.power.share-defense.combines: Applies to an ally’s defense task.
numenera.power.share-defense.blocked_reason: It temporarily lets another character use the Delve’s skill.

numenera.power.community-fixer.name: Community Fixer

effect.summary: Raises a present community’s health or infrastructure rank by one while the Jack actively works for it.

numenera.power.community-fixer.cost_or_limit: Jack must be present and personally working for the community.
numenera.power.community-fixer.go_wrong: Benefit does not apply without the required presence and work.
numenera.power.community-fixer.who_may: A first-tier Jack using the community rules.
numenera.power.community-fixer.combines: Choose health or infrastructure for each community action.
numenera.power.community-fixer.blocked_reason: It modifies a community statistic under the setting’s community rules.

numenera.power.improved-community-fixer.name: Improved Community Fixer

effect.summary: Keeps a community’s health or infrastructure one rank higher through past work.

numenera.power.improved-community-fixer.cost_or_limit: The previously modified statistic stays active until the Jack returns and changes it.
numenera.power.improved-community-fixer.who_may: A third-tier Jack using the community rules.
numenera.power.improved-community-fixer.combines: Continues the Community Fixer benefit without ongoing presence.
numenera.power.improved-community-fixer.blocked_reason: It persistently modifies a community statistic.

numenera.power.community-scholar.name: Community Scholar

effect.summary: Raises a present community’s health and infrastructure by one while the Nano actively works for it.

numenera.power.community-scholar.cost_or_limit: Nano must be present and personally working for the community.
numenera.power.community-scholar.go_wrong: Benefit does not apply without the required presence and work.
numenera.power.community-scholar.who_may: A first-tier Nano using the community rules.
numenera.power.community-scholar.blocked_reason: It modifies community statistics under the setting’s community rules.

numenera.power.improved-community-schola.name: Improved Community Scholar

effect.summary: Keeps a community’s health and infrastructure one rank higher through past work.

numenera.power.improved-community-schola.cost_or_limit: The benefit continues without presence and persists until changed by later action.
numenera.power.improved-community-schola.who_may: A third-tier Nano using the community rules.

numenera.power.community-defender.name: Community Defender

effect.summary: Raises a present community’s effective damage-inflicting rank by one while the Glaive actively defends it.

numenera.power.community-defender.cost_or_limit: Glaive must be present and personally working for the community.
numenera.power.community-defender.go_wrong: Benefit does not apply without the required presence and work.
numenera.power.community-defender.who_may: A first-tier Glaive using the community rules.
numenera.power.community-defender.combines: Affects the community’s effective rank for damage inflicted.
numenera.power.community-defender.blocked_reason: It modifies a community statistic under the setting’s community rules.

numenera.power.improved-community-defend.name: Improved Community Defender

effect.summary: Keeps a community’s effective damage-inflicting rank one higher through past defense.

numenera.power.improved-community-defend.cost_or_limit: Benefit continues without the Glaive’s ongoing presence.
numenera.power.improved-community-defend.who_may: A third-tier Glaive using the community rules.
numenera.power.improved-community-defend.blocked_reason: It persistently modifies a community statistic.

numenera.power.rampaging-beast-horde.name: Rampaging Beast Horde

effect.summary: Lets the Glaive take community actions as a rank 3 rampaging beast horde for an hour.

numenera.power.rampaging-beast-horde.cost_or_limit: Costs 12 Might; each allied player character who joins and spends 12 Pool points extends duration by an hour. Damage reduces Might, shared evenly among assisting allies.
numenera.power.rampaging-beast-horde.go_wrong: Damage suffered drains the user’s Might Pool, or the assisting allies’ Pools as well.
numenera.power.rampaging-beast-horde.who_may: A sixth-tier Glaive choosing this ability.
numenera.power.rampaging-beast-horde.combines: Can retain horde status while briefly taking character actions; allies can extend duration and share damage.
numenera.power.rampaging-beast-horde.blocked_reason: It changes the character into a horde for community actions and defines damage across the group.

numenera.power.adaptable.name: Adaptable

effect.summary: Adds two points to a chosen Pool, which can be reassigned after each ten-hour recovery.

numenera.power.adaptable.cost_or_limit: Only one Pool receives the bonus at a time.
numenera.power.adaptable.mind: Describes flexibility in adapting to physical and mental changes.
numenera.power.adaptable.who_may: A character choosing the Adaptable descriptor.
numenera.power.adaptable.combines: Also grants training in pleasant social interactions and overcoming or ignoring deprivation, sorrow, pain, and ongoing conditions.
numenera.power.adaptable.mechanism: Flexible stat bonus and skill training
numenera.power.adaptable.blocked_reason: The listed benefits are stat and skill modifications.

numenera.power.beneficent.name: Beneficent

effect.summary: Improves recovery rolls for allies who have spent the preceding day with the character.

numenera.power.beneficent.cost_or_limit: Allies gain one point to recovery rolls; the character also benefits if at least one other ally does.
numenera.power.beneficent.who_may: A character choosing the Beneficent descriptor.
numenera.power.beneficent.combines: Also grants an Intellect bonus and training in social, trust-building, and reassurance tasks.
numenera.power.beneficent.blocked_reason: It grants a numerical bonus to recovery rolls.

numenera.power.committed.name: Committed

effect.summary: Once between recovery rolls, gains an asset on similar actions involving the same task.

numenera.power.committed.cost_or_limit: Once per ten-hour recovery interval; the task must be the same, not merely similar.
numenera.power.committed.mind: Represents unwavering dedication to a chosen cause or task.
numenera.power.committed.who_may: A character choosing the Committed descriptor.
numenera.power.committed.combines: Also grants Might and training in enduring mental and physical trials.
numenera.power.committed.blocked_reason: It grants a bounded task advantage and a listed social hindrance.

numenera.power.civic-minded.name: Civic-Minded

effect.summary: Raises the health of the community where the character lives by one.

numenera.power.civic-minded.cost_or_limit: Applies to the community the character currently lives in.
numenera.power.civic-minded.who_may: A character choosing the Civic descriptor.
numenera.power.civic-minded.combines: Also provides training and benefits for community aid and knowledge tasks.

numenera.power.confident-outlook.name: Confident Outlook

effect.summary: Grants training in one non-attack, non-defense task for ten minutes.

numenera.power.confident-outlook.cost_or_limit: Once per rest; refreshes after a recovery roll.
numenera.power.confident-outlook.who_may: A character choosing the Confident descriptor.
numenera.power.confident-outlook.combines: Cannot apply to attacks or defense.
numenera.power.confident-outlook.blocked_reason: It temporarily changes proficiency for a chosen task.

numenera.power.failure-has-its-consequen.name: Failure Has Its Consequence

effect.summary: Causes a GM intrusion on a d20 result of 1 or 2.

numenera.power.failure-has-its-consequen.go_wrong: The chance of an intrusion is higher than usual.
numenera.power.failure-has-its-consequen.who_may: A character choosing the Confident descriptor.
numenera.power.failure-has-its-consequen.combines: Uses the game’s GM intrusion mechanism.
numenera.power.failure-has-its-consequen.blocked_reason: It invokes an external GM intrusion instead of a direct effect-grammar outcome.

numenera.power.quick-study.name: Quick Study

effect.summary: After a round of studying the subject and learning its facts, gives an asset to the next noncombat action.

numenera.power.quick-study.go_wrong: Without time to study, a response to a GM intrusion is hindered.
numenera.power.quick-study.who_may: A character choosing the Empirical descriptor.
numenera.power.quick-study.combines: The asset applies to the next noncombat action.
numenera.power.quick-study.blocked_reason: It grants a task asset after a defined preparation step.

numenera.power.getting-the-word.name: Getting the Word

effect.summary: Gleans general rumors, gossip, or opinions after an hour among a large group.

numenera.power.getting-the-word.cost_or_limit: Requires an hour within a large group of people.
numenera.power.getting-the-word.who_may: A character choosing the Gregarious descriptor.
numenera.power.getting-the-word.blocked_reason: It extracts rumors and opinions from a crowd through social exposure.

numenera.power.hero-s-complication.name: Hero’s Complication

effect.summary: Lets the GM introduce an intrusion as though the character rolled a 1, and sometimes turns it to the character’s advantage.

numenera.power.hero-s-complication.cost_or_limit: GM may use it without awarding XP; every other such intrusion works to the character’s advantage.
numenera.power.hero-s-complication.go_wrong: The complication can create a danger or setback.
numenera.power.hero-s-complication.who_may: A character choosing the Heroic descriptor.
numenera.power.hero-s-complication.combines: The GM and player determine the compensating advantage.
numenera.power.hero-s-complication.blocked_reason: It creates GM-controlled complications and conditional narrative advantages.

numenera.power.imaginative-solution.name: Imaginative Solution

effect.summary: Adds a free level of Effort to an Intellect task when the user applies Effort.

numenera.power.imaginative-solution.cost_or_limit: Once, refreshing after a ten-hour recovery roll.
numenera.power.imaginative-solution.who_may: A character choosing the Imaginative or Industrious descriptor.
numenera.power.imaginative-solution.combines: Requires the user to apply at least one level of Effort to an Intellect task.
numenera.power.imaginative-solution.blocked_reason: It adds a bounded task-effort bonus.

numenera.power.ready-for-what-s-next.name: Ready for What’s Next

effect.summary: Adds one point to recovery rolls.

numenera.power.ready-for-what-s-next.who_may: A character choosing the Industrious descriptor.
numenera.power.ready-for-what-s-next.blocked_reason: It grants a numerical bonus to recovery rolls.

numenera.power.community-action.name: Community action

effect.summary: A referenced game procedure for communities.

numenera.power.community-action.combines: Used by Rampaging Beast Horde and other community abilities.
numenera.power.community-action.blocked_reason: This is a referenced game procedure, not an entity of the requested kinds.

numenera.power.intuitive.name: INTUITIVE

effect.summary: Provides intuition-themed character benefits, including an ability to act out of turn.

numenera.power.intuitive.cost_or_limit: Acting out of turn hinders the character’s next regular action; usable once per recovery roll.
numenera.power.intuitive.mechanism: Extra action with a recovery-based use limit

numenera.power.know-what-to-do.name: Know What to Do

effect.summary: Lets the character act immediately even when it is not their turn.

numenera.power.know-what-to-do.cost_or_limit: Once per recovery roll; the next regular action is hindered.
numenera.power.know-what-to-do.go_wrong: The next regular action is hindered.

effect.summary: Improves resilience and recovery, with benefits to positive social tasks.

numenera.power.threatening.name: Threatening

effect.summary: Raises Might, Intellect, or both Pools.

numenera.power.threatening.cost_or_limit: Choose one of the listed Pool increases.
numenera.power.threatening.who_may: Characters with the descriptor whose benefits continue from the preceding page

numenera.power.threaten.name: Threaten

effect.summary: Makes nearby foes hesitate and hinders their next actions.

numenera.power.threaten.cost_or_limit: Once per recovery roll; affects foes within immediate distance.
numenera.power.threaten.who_may: Characters with the descriptor whose benefits continue from the preceding page

numenera.power.menace.name: Menace

effect.summary: Makes one nearby foe spend its next action moving away.

numenera.power.menace.cost_or_limit: Once per recovery roll; one foe within immediate range.
numenera.power.menace.who_may: Characters with the descriptor whose benefits continue from the preceding page

numenera.power.loyal.name: LOYAL

effect.summary: Provides benefits for aiding allies and supporting their attacks or defenses.

numenera.power.loyal.cost_or_limit: Some benefits are usable once per recovery roll.
numenera.power.loyal.mind: Makes it difficult to recognize disloyalty in others.
numenera.power.loyal.combines: Can trigger when helping a creature make or avoid a combat attack.

numenera.power.devoted.name: Devoted

effect.summary: Allows an immediate restricted action to move a willing injured ally or attempt to heal them.

numenera.power.devoted.cost_or_limit: Triggers when a nearby ally descends one step on the damage track; action is restricted.
numenera.power.devoted.combines: Can instead be used for a healing task.

numenera.power.faithful.name: Faithful

effect.summary: Regains one point in a Pool after helping a creature make or avoid a combat attack.

numenera.power.faithful.cost_or_limit: Once per recovery roll; the help can succeed or fail.
numenera.power.faithful.combines: Triggered by helping a creature in combat.

numenera.power.lawful.name: LAWFUL

effect.summary: Provides bonuses for understanding local law, but hinders tasks while breaking the law.

numenera.power.lawful.cost_or_limit: Intellect tasks are hindered during lawbreaking activity.
numenera.power.lawful.mind: Strong adherence to a code can hinder lawful-breaking activity.
numenera.power.lawful.combines: The code may be personal or associated with an organization.

numenera.power.nurturing.name: NURTURING

effect.summary: Improves recovery rolls for allies who have spent the previous day with the character.

numenera.power.nurturing.cost_or_limit: At least one other ally must receive the benefit for the character to receive it too.
numenera.power.nurturing.who_may: Characters with this descriptor and qualifying allies
numenera.power.nurturing.combines: Affects allies who spent the last day with the character.

numenera.power.obsessive.name: OBSESSIVE

effect.summary: Focuses the character on a chosen concept, improving related tasks while hindering unrelated ones.

numenera.power.obsessive.cost_or_limit: Choose one concept at the beginning of each day; unrelated tasks are hindered.
numenera.power.obsessive.mind: The character becomes preoccupied with the chosen concept.
numenera.power.obsessive.combines: Benefits depend on player and GM agreement about relevance.

numenera.power.your-obsession.name: Your Obsession

effect.summary: Sets the character’s focus for the day on one chosen concept.

numenera.power.your-obsession.cost_or_limit: Selected at the start of each day; focus does not mean ignoring unrelated matters.
numenera.power.your-obsession.go_wrong: Unrelated tasks are hindered by Preoccupied.
