numenera.power.your-obsession.mind: Creates daily preoccupation with a chosen subject.

numenera.power.enthralled.name: Enthralled

effect.summary: Provides an asset on a noncombat task directly related to the current obsession.

numenera.power.enthralled.cost_or_limit: Only for directly related noncombat tasks.
numenera.power.enthralled.combines: Depends on player and GM agreement about relevance.

numenera.power.preoccupied.name: Preoccupied

effect.summary: Hinders tasks unrelated to the current obsession.

numenera.power.preoccupied.cost_or_limit: Applies when a task is not related to the chosen concept.
numenera.power.preoccupied.mind: The character is inattentive to unrelated matters.
numenera.power.preoccupied.combines: Depends on player and GM agreement about relevance.

numenera.power.meddlesome.name: MEDDLESOME

effect.summary: Trains the character in perception, detecting falsehoods, stealth, and recalling known details.

numenera.power.meddlesome.cost_or_limit: Recall benefit concerns a topic previously heard or read about.

numenera.power.organized.name: ORGANIZED

effect.summary: Improves planning and perception and grants an extra free action in an organized place or while following an unchanged plan.

numenera.power.organized.cost_or_limit: Extra action once; refreshes after a ten-hour recovery roll; location needs ten minutes of organizing.
numenera.power.organized.go_wrong: Intellect defense tasks are hindered in messy or chaotic places.
numenera.power.organized.combines: Requires an organized location or a plan that has not diverged.

numenera.power.optimistic.name: OPTIMISTIC

effect.summary: Improves Intellect defenses and allows a free Effort level when immediately retrying a failed noncombat task.

numenera.power.optimistic.cost_or_limit: The retry must occur the very next round.
numenera.power.optimistic.combines: Applies to a retry of the failed task.

numenera.power.shrugs-off-disappointment.name: Shrugs Off Disappointment

effect.summary: Grants a free Effort level when immediately retrying a failed noncombat task.

numenera.power.shrugs-off-disappointment.cost_or_limit: Must retry the same task the next round.
numenera.power.shrugs-off-disappointment.combines: Reduces the normal requirement to spend Effort on a retry.

numenera.power.prepared.name: PREPARED

effect.summary: Improves initiative and the use of tools on noncombat tasks.

numenera.power.prepared.go_wrong: The first action after being surprised or attacked before acting is hindered.
numenera.power.prepared.combines: Tool benefits depend on whether a tool already grants an asset.

numenera.power.tool-aficionado.name: Tool Aficionado

effect.summary: Grants an asset when using a tool on a noncombat task, and an extra asset if the tool already grants one.

numenera.power.tool-aficionado.cost_or_limit: Applies to noncombat tasks using a tool.
numenera.power.tool-aficionado.combines: An additional asset stacks with an asset the tool provides.

numenera.power.passionate.name: PASSIONATE

effect.summary: Improves movement skills, attack damage when angered, and actions justified by the character’s passion.

numenera.power.passionate.cost_or_limit: Fire Inside is usable once per recovery roll.
numenera.power.passionate.go_wrong: Tasks requiring restraint or subtlety are hindered.
numenera.power.passionate.mind: The character has difficulty controlling their temper.
numenera.power.passionate.combines: An action must be justifiable by the character’s passion for Fire Inside.
numenera.power.passionate.mechanism: Conditional task asset and damage bonus

numenera.power.fever.name: Fever

effect.summary: Adds one damage to every attack when the character is angered.

numenera.power.fever.cost_or_limit: Requires the character to be angered.

numenera.power.fire-inside.name: Fire Inside

effect.summary: Grants an asset to an action justified by the character’s passion.

numenera.power.fire-inside.combines: The action must be justified by the character’s passion.

numenera.power.persevering.name: PERSEVERING

effect.summary: Improves endurance and grants an asset to one action after receiving a GM intrusion.

numenera.power.persevering.cost_or_limit: The response action must occur within one minute.
numenera.power.persevering.combines: Triggers from a GM intrusion caused by a roll or the GM.

numenera.power.irrepressible-reaction.name: Irrepressible Reaction

effect.summary: Grants an asset to one action taken in response to a GM intrusion.

numenera.power.irrepressible-reaction.cost_or_limit: The action must be taken within the following minute.

numenera.power.risk-taking.name: RISK-TAKING

effect.summary: Allows one automatic success on a task, accompanied by a GM intrusion.

numenera.power.risk-taking.cost_or_limit: Task difficulty must be level 6 or lower; once per ten-hour recovery roll.
numenera.power.risk-taking.go_wrong: Triggers a GM intrusion without negating success.
numenera.power.risk-taking.combines: The intrusion qualifies or complicates the successful task.

numenera.power.pressing-your-luck.name: Pressing Your Luck

effect.summary: Automatically succeeds at a task while triggering a GM intrusion.

numenera.power.pressing-your-luck.cost_or_limit: Difficulty 6 or less; once per ten-hour recovery roll.
numenera.power.pressing-your-luck.go_wrong: The GM intrusion adds a complication but does not undo success.
numenera.power.pressing-your-luck.combines: The GM intrusion qualifies the success.

numenera.power.protective.name: PROTECTIVE

effect.summary: Improves perception and healing, and provides extra Armor when drawing an attack onto oneself.

numenera.power.protective.cost_or_limit: Extra Armor applies once per recovery roll.
numenera.power.protective.combines: The attack must be successfully redirected to the character.

numenera.power.step-in-front.name: Step in Front

effect.summary: Provides two extra Armor against an attack redirected to the character.

numenera.power.step-in-front.cost_or_limit: Once per recovery roll; requires successfully drawing the attack away from its original target.
numenera.power.step-in-front.combines: Works with drawing the attack onto oneself.

numenera.power.relentless.name: RELENTLESS

effect.summary: Allows the character to recall a relevant objective fact they could have learned in the past.

numenera.power.relentless.combines: The fact must be logically accessible from past experience.

numenera.power.survivor-s-intuition.name: Survivor’s Intuition

effect.summary: Recalls a relevant objective fact that the character could logically have encountered before.

numenera.power.survivor-s-intuition.combines: The fact must be pertinent and plausibly learned earlier.

numenera.power.berserk.name: Berserk

effect.summary: Makes stopping a fight a difficulty-two Intellect task, risking an attack on a nearby ally if no foes remain.

numenera.power.berserk.cost_or_limit: Difficulty two Intellect task to stop fighting.
numenera.power.berserk.go_wrong: If unable to stop when foes are gone, attacks the nearest ally within short range.
numenera.power.berserk.mind: The character has trouble ending combat.
numenera.power.berserk.who_may: Characters with the descriptor whose benefits continue from the preceding page
numenera.power.berserk.combines: The attack on an ally occurs if no foes remain and stopping fails.
numenera.power.berserk.blocked_reason: The rule requires a forced mental compulsion to keep fighting.

effect.summary: Improves Intellect defenses and resistance to fear, intimidation, and panic.

numenera.power.vicious.name: VICIOUS

effect.summary: Improves creature tracking and adds two damage to attacks.

numenera.power.vicious.cost_or_limit: Tracking is eased when the creature wronged the character.
numenera.power.vicious.mind: The character experiences cruel, hateful glee in violence.
numenera.power.vicious.mechanism: Attack damage bonus and tracking skill

numenera.power.absorbs-energy.name: ABSORBS ENERGY

effect.summary: Absorbs kinetic energy from impacts, stores it, and can later release or apply it.

numenera.power.absorbs-energy.cost_or_limit: Initially stores at most one energy point and must use it before absorbing another.
numenera.power.absorbs-energy.go_wrong: Energy can bleed off as harmless light; predators or unintended objects may be drained, as GM intrusions.
numenera.power.absorbs-energy.who_may: Characters choosing this focus; Glaives and Wrights are noted as likely users.
numenera.power.absorbs-energy.combines: Energy can fuel attacks, craftwork, objects, and later abilities; some PCs may be immune to released energy.
numenera.power.absorbs-energy.blocked_reason: Energized objects carry stored damage that triggers on touch, requiring rules for powers bound to items.

numenera.power.absorb-kinetic-energy.name: Absorb Kinetic Energy

effect.summary: Negates one damage from a physical attack or impact and stores it as energy.

numenera.power.absorb-kinetic-energy.cost_or_limit: Stores no more than one point at this tier; further hits still negate one point but shed excess as light.
numenera.power.absorb-kinetic-energy.go_wrong: Stored energy can bleed away with a harmless flare.
numenera.power.absorb-kinetic-energy.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus
numenera.power.absorb-kinetic-energy.combines: Stored energy can be spent on Release Energy or other focus abilities.

numenera.power.release-energy.name: Release Energy

effect.summary: Fires a blast at one foe at long range for four damage, spending one stored energy point.

numenera.power.release-energy.cost_or_limit: One stored point; without it, costs one Might point instead.
numenera.power.release-energy.go_wrong: Using it without stored energy costs the user Might.
numenera.power.release-energy.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus
numenera.power.release-energy.combines: Can replace io during numenera crafting, at one damage point per io unit.

numenera.power.energize-object.name: Energize Object

effect.summary: Puts stored energy into an object, causing it to deal three extra damage when touched by someone other than the user.

numenera.power.energize-object.cost_or_limit: Only one energized object can be carried at a time.
numenera.power.energize-object.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus
numenera.power.energize-object.combines: Can be applied to a weapon or its ammunition; damage is additional to the weapon’s own damage.
numenera.power.energize-object.mechanism: Stored power bound to an item and triggered by contact
numenera.power.energize-object.blocked_reason: The effect is stored in an item and automatically triggers on a specified contact.

numenera.power.absorb-pure-energy.name: Absorb Pure Energy

effect.summary: Allows absorption of pure-energy attacks and contacted energy conduits.

numenera.power.absorb-pure-energy.cost_or_limit: Does not increase storage capacity; with Improved Absorb Kinetic Energy, other energy sources can yield two damage points.
numenera.power.absorb-pure-energy.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus who choose this option
numenera.power.absorb-pure-energy.combines: Can be selected instead of Improved Absorb Kinetic Energy.

numenera.power.improved-absorb-kinetic-e.name: Improved Absorb Kinetic Energy

effect.summary: Absorbs two damage from physical impacts and stores up to two energy points.

numenera.power.improved-absorb-kinetic-e.cost_or_limit: Energy can still be released only one point at a time.
numenera.power.improved-absorb-kinetic-e.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus who choose this option
numenera.power.improved-absorb-kinetic-e.combines: Can combine with Absorb Pure Energy to absorb more from other energy sources.

numenera.power.overcharge-energy.name: Overcharge Energy

effect.summary: Adds two damage to Release Energy.

numenera.power.overcharge-energy.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus

numenera.power.energize-creature.name: Energize Creature

effect.summary: Gives a nearby creature the user’s energy-absorption ability for an hour.

numenera.power.energize-creature.cost_or_limit: Costs at least six Might points; each Effort level adds one target; recipients cannot release excess energy as a blast.
numenera.power.energize-creature.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus
numenera.power.energize-creature.combines: Also duplicates Absorb Pure Energy or Improved Absorb Kinetic Energy if possessed.
numenera.power.energize-creature.blocked_reason: The ability grants another creature the user’s power for a defined duration.

numenera.power.danger-sense.name: Danger Sense

effect.summary: Eases initiative tasks.

numenera.power.danger-sense.cost_or_limit: Costs one Speed point each time used.
numenera.power.danger-sense.who_may: A character may choose to learn it instead of a type ability.
numenera.power.danger-sense.combines: Can replace an ability granted by the character’s type.

numenera.power.slip-into-shadow.name: Slip Into Shadow

effect.summary: Allows the user to hide from selected observers by slipping into nearby cover or out of sight.

numenera.power.slip-into-shadow.cost_or_limit: Costs two or more Intellect points; each Effort level adds one adjacent target.
numenera.power.slip-into-shadow.combines: Targets must be next to each other; a particular PC may be able to track the user despite this ability.

effect.summary: Trains the character in deception, stealth, or disguise.

numenera.power.get-away.name: Get Away

effect.summary: After acting, moves the character a short distance or behind nearby cover.

numenera.power.get-away.combines: Movement follows the character’s action on their turn.

numenera.power.uncanny-luck.name: Uncanny Luck

effect.summary: A successful task can yield an extra effect based on a second roll.

numenera.power.uncanny-luck.cost_or_limit: Costs four Speed points; the second roll must exceed the first for a minor effect, or match it for a major effect.
numenera.power.uncanny-luck.combines: If another similar ability is held, the user can choose an effect or a free tier-one-to-three ability activation.

numenera.power.no-fate.name: No Fate

effect.summary: Changes a failed task’s die result to a natural twenty.

numenera.power.no-fate.cost_or_limit: Once per ten-hour recovery roll; cannot change a natural one unless paired with Twist of Fate or a similar ability.
numenera.power.no-fate.go_wrong: The new result may still fail if difficulty exceeds six.
numenera.power.no-fate.who_may: Characters with Acts Without Consequence who select the option
numenera.power.no-fate.combines: The natural-one restriction is lifted by Twist of Fate or a similar ability.

numenera.power.twist-of-fate.name: Twist of Fate

effect.summary: Reroll a die result of 1 and use the new result.

numenera.power.twist-of-fate.go_wrong: The new result must be used, even if it is another 1.
numenera.power.twist-of-fate.blocked_reason: It changes a die result through a reroll.

numenera.power.adjures-the-leviathan.name: Adjures the Leviathan

effect.summary: Its dataform may be surrounded by a leviathan silhouette and strange forms.

numenera.power.adjures-the-leviathan.combines: The appearance is a cosmetic expression of the focus.
numenera.power.adjures-the-leviathan.blocked_reason: The passage does not describe the leviathan’s operative role.

numenera.power.adjure-creature.name: Adjure Creature

effect.summary: For one minute, commands a qualifying creature to do simple tasks or prevents a small group from acting while focus is maintained.

numenera.power.adjure-creature.cost_or_limit: Costs two or more Intellect points; default maximum level is two; Effort raises the limit; each restrained creature can try to escape each round.
numenera.power.adjure-creature.go_wrong: Creatures can attempt to escape control every round.
numenera.power.adjure-creature.mind: Imposes commands or temporarily suppresses actions.
numenera.power.adjure-creature.combines: Targets must be living, nonhumanoid, short range, and motivated by hunger for flesh; group restraint requires full attention.
numenera.power.adjure-creature.blocked_reason: The ability controls creature actions and prevents them from acting.

numenera.power.become-the-leviathan.name: Become the Leviathan

effect.summary: Become a much larger monstrous form with stronger melee attacks and temporary Might.

numenera.power.become-the-leviathan.cost_or_limit: Costs 9+ Intellect points; lasts one minute; Effort can increase size and temporary Might.
numenera.power.become-the-leviathan.go_wrong: Speed defense is hindered; reverting causes exhaustion, damage-track loss, and a ten-hour recovery wait before reuse.
numenera.power.become-the-leviathan.combines: Menagerie is the alternative tier 6 choice.
numenera.power.become-the-leviathan.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not support changing a character’s form and granting its associated combat benefits.

numenera.power.menagerie.name: Menagerie

effect.summary: Raises the number of creatures held with Capture Creature to four.

numenera.power.menagerie.cost_or_limit: Requires the tier 2 Capture Creature ability.
numenera.power.menagerie.blocked_reason: The ability can run as a limit on the number of followers.

numenera.power.augments-flesh-with-graft.name: Augments Flesh With Grafts

effect.summary: Its dataform may show graft sockets, mixed creature parts, and orbiting cyphers.

numenera.power.augments-flesh-with-graft.combines: The appearance is a cosmetic expression of the focus.
numenera.power.augments-flesh-with-graft.blocked_reason: The focus suggests body modification, but this passage only gives dataform appearance ideas.

numenera.power.ninth-world-bestiary-know.name: Ninth World Bestiary Knowledge

effect.summary: Recognizes flesh-eating non-humanoid creatures and knows their weaknesses and behavior.

numenera.power.ninth-world-bestiary-know.cost_or_limit: Training applies to lore about flesh-eating, non-humanoid creatures.
numenera.power.ninth-world-bestiary-know.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.ninth-world-bestiary-know.blocked_reason: The effect is knowledge and training rather than an unsupported supernatural operation.

numenera.power.capture-creature.name: Capture Creature

effect.summary: Captures a low-level creature, which becomes tame and follows the character.

numenera.power.capture-creature.cost_or_limit: Target must be level 1 or 2; initially permits one captured creature, with special follower modifications.
numenera.power.capture-creature.mind: The creature becomes tame in the character’s presence.
numenera.power.capture-creature.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.capture-creature.combines: Capture capacity is increased by Duo and Menagerie; can be used by Enrage Creature and Lash of the Tamer.
numenera.power.capture-creature.blocked_reason: Making a creature tame and a follower requires a mind-binding or behavioral-control capability.

numenera.power.enrage-creature.name: Enrage Creature

effect.summary: Sends a captured creature into a rage, increasing its temporary level and damage for up to one minute.

numenera.power.enrage-creature.cost_or_limit: Costs 3+ Intellect points; Effort increases level and damage, to level 10.
numenera.power.enrage-creature.go_wrong: The creature dies or is enfeebled for several days after the effect.
numenera.power.enrage-creature.mind: Triggers a bone-ripping rage in the creature.
numenera.power.enrage-creature.combines: Requires a creature captured with Capture Creature.
numenera.power.enrage-creature.mechanism: Behavioral alteration with temporary combat enhancement
numenera.power.enrage-creature.blocked_reason: The ability directly alters a creature’s behavior and imposes a rage state.

numenera.power.vigor-of-the-leviathan.name: Vigor of the Leviathan

effect.summary: Grants one additional one-action recovery roll each day.

numenera.power.vigor-of-the-leviathan.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.vigor-of-the-leviathan.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a daily recovery benefit.

numenera.power.duo.name: Duo

effect.summary: Allows two captured creatures and raises the capture level limit to 3.

numenera.power.duo.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.duo.blocked_reason: The ability can run as limits on follower count and target level.

numenera.power.lash-of-the-tamer.name: Lash of the Tamer

effect.summary: Gives a captured creature an immediate action, or attempts to grant one to another nearby creature.

numenera.power.lash-of-the-tamer.cost_or_limit: Costs 4+ Intellect points; target is within short range.
numenera.power.lash-of-the-tamer.who_may: Characters with captured creatures; the alternative can target any creature in range.
numenera.power.lash-of-the-tamer.combines: Uses captured creatures from Capture Creature.
numenera.power.lash-of-the-tamer.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a temporary action grant.

numenera.power.autodoctor.name: Autodoctor

effect.summary: Grants training in healing, surgery, and enduring pain, including self-surgery while conscious.

numenera.power.autodoctor.cost_or_limit: Training benefit; surgery itself takes time.
numenera.power.autodoctor.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.autodoctor.blocked_reason: The stated effect is training and does not require an unsupported operation.

numenera.power.surgical-graft.name: Surgical Graft

effect.summary: Surgically connects a cypher or creature ability to the character’s body for natural, covert use.

numenera.power.surgical-graft.cost_or_limit: Grafted cyphers still count toward the cypher limit and deplete on 1 in 1d10; surgery takes an hour. Creature grafts require a surgery roll.
numenera.power.surgical-graft.go_wrong: Failed creature graft surgery ruins the body part; grafts can be depleted.
numenera.power.surgical-graft.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.surgical-graft.combines: Graft effects can be augmented and recharged; artifacts can later be fused.
numenera.power.surgical-graft.mechanism: Power bound to a body graft
numenera.power.surgical-graft.blocked_reason: The graft carries another power and has a cypher-limit and depletion rule.

numenera.power.augment-graft.name: Augment Graft

effect.summary: Increases the level of a grafted cypher when it is activated.

numenera.power.augment-graft.cost_or_limit: Costs 2+ Intellect points; cannot raise the graft above level 10; Effort raises it one level per level applied.
numenera.power.augment-graft.combines: A Jack with Augment Cypher gains a free Effort level on this task.
numenera.power.augment-graft.mechanism: Modify level of a graft-bound power
numenera.power.augment-graft.blocked_reason: The effect changes the level of a power carried by a grafted item.

numenera.power.artifact-fusion.name: Artifact Fusion

effect.summary: Surgically grafts an artifact to the body so it functions one level higher.

numenera.power.artifact-fusion.cost_or_limit: Requires surgical grafting; artifact functions as one level higher.
numenera.power.artifact-fusion.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.artifact-fusion.mechanism: Artifact carried by body and level enhancement
numenera.power.artifact-fusion.blocked_reason: The ability binds an artifact’s function to the character and modifies its level.

numenera.power.additional-cypher.name: Additional Cypher

effect.summary: Raises the number of cyphers the character can bear by one.

numenera.power.additional-cypher.cost_or_limit: Increases the cypher limit by one.
numenera.power.additional-cypher.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.additional-cypher.combines: Applies to grafted and ungrafted cyphers.
numenera.power.additional-cypher.blocked_reason: The effect can run as an increased carrying limit.

numenera.power.faster-grafting.name: Faster Grafting

effect.summary: Improves surgical tasks and reduces graft installation or removal to one minute.

numenera.power.faster-grafting.cost_or_limit: Surgical graft changes take one minute rather than an hour.
numenera.power.faster-grafting.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.faster-grafting.combines: Applies to adding and removing grafts.
numenera.power.faster-grafting.blocked_reason: The effect is a skill benefit and a procedure-time reduction.

numenera.power.defensive-augmentation.name: Defensive Augmentation

effect.summary: Grants training in Might and Speed defense.

numenera.power.defensive-augmentation.cost_or_limit: Training applies to Might and Speed defense tasks.
numenera.power.defensive-augmentation.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.defensive-augmentation.blocked_reason: The ability can run as training in defense tasks.

numenera.power.transhuman-organs.name: Transhuman Organs

effect.summary: After major organ replacement surgery, adds five points to each stat Pool.

numenera.power.transhuman-organs.who_may: Characters with Augments Flesh With Grafts
numenera.power.transhuman-organs.combines: Replaces or upgrades most internal organs.
numenera.power.transhuman-organs.blocked_reason: The ability replaces major body systems and grants permanent physical changes.

numenera.power.battles-automatons.name: Battles Automatons

effect.summary: Specializes the character in finding and fighting automatons and animate machines.

numenera.power.battles-automatons.cost_or_limit: Some effects distinguish machine targets from living biological targets.
numenera.power.battles-automatons.go_wrong: Automatons may retaliate or explode, as noted in possible complications.
numenera.power.battles-automatons.who_may: Often Glaives, particularly quick and nimble ones.
numenera.power.battles-automatons.combines: Machine-specific abilities and damage modifiers interact with machine or biological targets.
numenera.power.battles-automatons.blocked_reason: Several abilities change effectiveness according to whether a target is a machine or biological being.

numenera.power.machine-vulnerabilities.name: Machine Vulnerabilities

effect.summary: Adds three damage against automatons and animate machines.

numenera.power.machine-vulnerabilities.cost_or_limit: Bonus applies against automatons and animate machines.
numenera.power.machine-vulnerabilities.combines: Machine classification determines whether the bonus applies.
numenera.power.machine-vulnerabilities.blocked_reason: The damage bonus depends on identifying and classifying machine targets.

numenera.power.defense-against-automaton.name: Defense Against Automatons

effect.summary: Eases defense tasks against automatons and machines.

numenera.power.defense-against-automaton.cost_or_limit: Only applies against automaton and machine foes.
numenera.power.defense-against-automaton.combines: Target must qualify as an automaton or machine.
numenera.power.defense-against-automaton.blocked_reason: The benefit is conditional on the target being a machine.

numenera.power.machine-hunting.name: Machine Hunting

effect.summary: Grants training to track or find machines and in stealth tasks.

numenera.power.machine-hunting.cost_or_limit: Training applies to machine-finding tasks and all stealth tasks.
numenera.power.machine-hunting.blocked_reason: The ability provides training rather than a special sensory effect.

numenera.power.disable-mechanisms.name: Disable Mechanisms

effect.summary: Disrupts one automaton function, hindering its tasks, slowing it, stopping its actions, or reducing its damage.

numenera.power.disable-mechanisms.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Speed points; must touch the automaton; lasts one minute except the one-round no-action option.
numenera.power.disable-mechanisms.combines: Drain Power applies all four listed conditions at once.
numenera.power.disable-mechanisms.blocked_reason: The effect alters a target’s operating functions and requires machine-specific targeting.

numenera.power.automaton-fighter.name: Automaton Fighter

effect.summary: Grants training in attacks and defense against automatons and intelligent machines.

numenera.power.automaton-fighter.combines: Requires classifying the opponent as an automaton or intelligent machine.
numenera.power.automaton-fighter.blocked_reason: The benefit depends on a target’s machine classification.

numenera.power.pierce-metal-hides.name: Pierce Metal Hides

effect.summary: Ignores two points of armor on an automaton.

numenera.power.pierce-metal-hides.blocked_reason: The armor reduction depends on identifying an automaton target.

numenera.power.blind-machine.name: Blind Machine

effect.summary: Disables a machine’s sensors until repaired, effectively blinding it.

numenera.power.blind-machine.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Speed points; requires touch or a ranged strike that deals no damage.
numenera.power.blind-machine.go_wrong: The machine remains blind until repaired.
numenera.power.blind-machine.combines: May be delivered by touch or ranged attack.
numenera.power.blind-machine.blocked_reason: The effect selectively disables a machine’s sensory systems.

numenera.power.deactivate-mechanisms.name: Deactivate Mechanisms

effect.summary: A successful follow-up roll deactivates a low-level machine for one minute.

numenera.power.deactivate-mechanisms.cost_or_limit: Costs 5+ Speed points; melee strike deals no damage; base target limit is level 3; Effort raises the level limit or duration.
numenera.power.deactivate-mechanisms.go_wrong: The effect fails if the attack or follow-up Speed roll fails.
numenera.power.deactivate-mechanisms.combines: Scramble Machine or Disable Machine grants a free Effort level when Effort is applied.
numenera.power.deactivate-mechanisms.blocked_reason: The effect shuts down a machine and includes machine-specific target and duration rules.

numenera.power.force-fall.name: Force Fall

effect.summary: Uses a force-field shield to absorb a fall and grants extra armor against its damage.

numenera.power.force-fall.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Speed point; only applies when falling.
numenera.power.force-fall.who_may: Characters who replace a tier 1 type ability with this option
numenera.power.force-fall.blocked_reason: The effect can run as conditional protection against fall damage.

numenera.power.brandishes-an-exotic-shie.name: Brandishes an Exotic Shield

effect.summary: Its dataform may make its shield oversized, fused to the body, or duplicated.

numenera.power.brandishes-an-exotic-shie.combines: The appearance is a cosmetic expression of the focus.
numenera.power.brandishes-an-exotic-shie.blocked_reason: Only cosmetic appearance suggestions are provided.

numenera.power.force-field-shield.name: Force Field Shield

effect.summary: Manifests a hand-held plane of force usable as a shield or light melee weapon.

numenera.power.force-field-shield.cost_or_limit: Requires a free hand; dissipates while the user is unconscious or asleep; dual attacks are hindered.
numenera.power.force-field-shield.go_wrong: The shield may malfunction or be taken by a foe.
numenera.power.force-field-shield.mind: Manifesting and dismissing it takes only a thought.
numenera.power.force-field-shield.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield
numenera.power.force-field-shield.combines: Can be used by Force Bash, Enveloping Shield, and later shield abilities.
numenera.power.force-field-shield.blocked_reason: The ability manifests a sustained force field.

numenera.power.force-bash.name: Force Bash

effect.summary: A shield melee strike deals reduced damage and dazes the target for one round.

numenera.power.force-bash.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Might point; damage is one point below normal.
numenera.power.force-bash.mind: Target is dazed and its tasks are hindered for one round.
numenera.power.force-bash.combines: Uses the force shield as a melee weapon.
numenera.power.force-bash.blocked_reason: The effect can run as an attack and one-round hindrance.

numenera.power.enveloping-shield.name: Enveloping Shield

effect.summary: Surrounds the holder with force and grants one point of armor.

numenera.power.enveloping-shield.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield
numenera.power.enveloping-shield.blocked_reason: The ability surrounds the character with a force field.

numenera.power.healing-pulse.name: Healing Pulse

effect.summary: Chosen nearby targets receive the immediate benefits of a recovery roll.

numenera.power.healing-pulse.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; excludes ten-hour recovery; recipients mark off the recovery use; spent daily recoveries grant no benefit.
numenera.power.healing-pulse.go_wrong: No benefit for PCs who have already used their relevant daily recoveries.
numenera.power.healing-pulse.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield; selected targets in immediate range
numenera.power.healing-pulse.combines: Can be used while Force Wall is active; NPCs recover health equal to level.
numenera.power.healing-pulse.blocked_reason: The effect heals multiple chosen targets in an area and consumes their recovery resources.

numenera.power.throw-force-shield.name: Throw Force Shield

effect.summary: Throws the shield to short range as a light ranged weapon, then reforms it in the user’s grasp.

numenera.power.throw-force-shield.cost_or_limit: Range is short; shield dissipates and reforms whether it hits or misses.
numenera.power.throw-force-shield.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield
numenera.power.throw-force-shield.combines: Can be exchanged for Healing Pulse if Bouncing Shield is selected later.
numenera.power.throw-force-shield.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a ranged attack followed by item return.

numenera.power.energized-shield.name: Energized Shield

effect.summary: Adds three damage whenever the shield is used as a melee or ranged weapon.

numenera.power.energized-shield.cost_or_limit: Applies when the shield is used as a weapon.
numenera.power.energized-shield.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield
numenera.power.energized-shield.combines: Enhances attacks made using the force shield.
numenera.power.energized-shield.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a conditional damage bonus.

numenera.power.force-wall.name: Force Wall

effect.summary: Expands the shield into an immobile plane of force up to twenty feet square.

numenera.power.force-wall.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; lasts up to one hour or until the shield is taken back; limits use of other focus abilities.
numenera.power.force-wall.go_wrong: The wall ends when the shield is reclaimed.
numenera.power.force-wall.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield
numenera.power.force-wall.combines: Only Healing Pulse can be used as another focus ability while the wall remains.
numenera.power.force-wall.blocked_reason: The effect creates a sustained area force field.

numenera.power.bouncing-shield.name: Bouncing Shield

effect.summary: A thrown shield can attack up to two additional nearby targets after its first target.

numenera.power.bouncing-shield.cost_or_limit: Targets must be within short range; modifiers to the first attack affect all targets.
numenera.power.bouncing-shield.go_wrong: Shield reforms whether all attacks hit or miss.
numenera.power.bouncing-shield.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield
numenera.power.bouncing-shield.combines: Can replace Throw Force Shield with Healing Pulse as the earlier tier 3 choice.
numenera.power.bouncing-shield.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a series of linked attacks.

numenera.power.shield-burst.name: Shield Burst

effect.summary: A successful shield attack releases an explosion that damages nearby targets.

numenera.power.shield-burst.cost_or_limit: Adds two damage to the target and everything within immediate range; Effort for extra damage adds only two per level; melee use spares the user and creatures behind them; ranged use dissipates the shield until it reforms.
numenera.power.shield-burst.who_may: Characters with Brandishes an Exotic Shield
numenera.power.shield-burst.combines: Can be used with melee or ranged shield attacks.
numenera.power.shield-burst.blocked_reason: The effect damages multiple targets within an area.

numenera.power.breaks-down-walls.name: Breaks Down Walls

effect.summary: Uses enhanced physical ability to smash walls, weapons, restraints, devices, and other objects.

numenera.power.breaks-down-walls.cost_or_limit: Breaking objects uses Might tasks and the object damage track; some effects cause damage to the breaker.
numenera.power.breaks-down-walls.go_wrong: Failed or successful wall-breaking can injure the character; collapses may endanger allies or trap the character.
numenera.power.breaks-down-walls.mind: Destruction may intimidate foes into surrender.
numenera.power.breaks-down-walls.combines: Interacts with object hardness, force fields, automaton targets, and object damage rules.
numenera.power.breaks-down-walls.blocked_reason: The core effects can run through object damage and physical task rules.

numenera.power.breaker.name: Breaker

effect.summary: Grants training in damaging objects to break, pierce, or demolish them.

numenera.power.breaker.cost_or_limit: Object damage follows the object damage track; hardness changes effective level.
numenera.power.breaker.combines: Uses the object damage track and Might tasks.
numenera.power.breaker.blocked_reason: The effect uses the stated object damage procedure.

numenera.power.hard-as-synthsteel.name: Hard as Synthsteel

effect.summary: The character’s hands and body become as hard as the object they are trying to break.

numenera.power.hard-as-synthsteel.cost_or_limit: Only applies to breaking objects; does not work against force fields without Force to Reckon With.
numenera.power.hard-as-synthsteel.combines: Force to Reckon With extends it to force fields.
numenera.power.hard-as-synthsteel.blocked_reason: The ability changes the body’s material hardness.

numenera.power.field-of-destruction.name: Field of Destruction

effect.summary: Gains one armor point for a minute after damaging an object.

numenera.power.field-of-destruction.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Might points; triggers when an object descends on its damage track.
numenera.power.field-of-destruction.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a triggered armor bonus.

numenera.power.break-through.name: Break Through

effect.summary: Moves a short distance and smashes a body-sized opening through a wall.

numenera.power.break-through.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Might points; wall difficulty equals its level; each six inches of thickness hinders the attempt by one step.
numenera.power.break-through.go_wrong: Failure causes four damage; success still causes one damage; force fields are excluded absent Force to Reckon With.
numenera.power.break-through.combines: Can be enhanced by a type ability that allows movement and an action; Force to Reckon With permits force-field breaches.
numenera.power.break-through.blocked_reason: The effect can run as movement, a Might task, and object damage.

numenera.power.force-to-reckon-with.name: Force to Reckon With

effect.summary: Allows the character to break through force fields and energy barriers like physical walls.

numenera.power.force-to-reckon-with.cost_or_limit: Applies to force fields and energy barriers.
numenera.power.force-to-reckon-with.combines: Enables Break Through and Hard as Synthsteel to affect force fields.
numenera.power.force-to-reckon-with.blocked_reason: Breaking force fields requires an explicit interaction with area barriers.

numenera.power.jump-attack.name: Jump Attack

effect.summary: Leaps as part of a melee attack, dealing extra damage and knocking a hit foe prone.

numenera.power.jump-attack.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Might points; base jump task difficulty 4; Effort can increase jump height and damage.
numenera.power.jump-attack.go_wrong: On a failed jump the attack is still made but gains no extra damage or knockdown.
numenera.power.jump-attack.combines: A Glaive ability of the same name lowers the jump difficulty to 2.
numenera.power.jump-attack.blocked_reason: The effect can run as movement and an attack with conditional damage and knockdown.

numenera.power.break-the-ranks.name: Break the Ranks

effect.summary: Moves a short distance and attacks up to four foes along the route.

numenera.power.break-the-ranks.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Speed points; targets must lie along the path.
numenera.power.break-the-ranks.combines: Movement-and-action type abilities grant an asset to the attacks.
numenera.power.break-the-ranks.blocked_reason: The effect can run as movement and sequential attacks.

numenera.power.destroyer.name: Destroyer

effect.summary: A successful Might task immediately destroys an object instead of moving it down one damage step.

numenera.power.destroyer.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Might points; requires a successful Might task to damage the object.
numenera.power.destroyer.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a change to the object damage result.

numenera.power.builds-tomorrow.name: Builds Tomorrow

effect.summary: Specializes the character in planning, crafting, and customizing installations or other creations.

numenera.power.builds-tomorrow.cost_or_limit: Plans and crafting require appropriate resources and crafting time; some customizations cost XP or deplete.
numenera.power.builds-tomorrow.go_wrong: Customized features may be discovered, misused, or depleted.
numenera.power.builds-tomorrow.who_may: Any character; Wrights gain further crafting options.
numenera.power.builds-tomorrow.combines: Works with plans, iotum, crafting, and the customization tables.
numenera.power.builds-tomorrow.blocked_reason: The focus creates and customizes objects that carry separate powers, depletion, and repair rules.

numenera.power.seeds-of-a-plan.name: Seeds of a Plan

effect.summary: Provides two plans for objects up to level three plus character tier, with two more plans at each tier advance.

numenera.power.seeds-of-a-plan.cost_or_limit: Plan level is limited by character tier.
numenera.power.seeds-of-a-plan.blocked_reason: The effect grants knowledge of construction plans.

numenera.power.starting-iotum.name: Starting Iotum

effect.summary: Provides enough iotum to build one planned installation or cypher.

numenera.power.starting-iotum.cost_or_limit: Sufficient for one installation or cypher for which the character has a plan.
numenera.power.starting-iotum.combines: Requires a relevant plan and crafting.
numenera.power.starting-iotum.blocked_reason: The effect grants resources for crafting.

numenera.power.customize-creation.name: Customize Creation

effect.summary: Adds one chosen customization-table function to a crafted installation.

numenera.power.customize-creation.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 XP; applies only to installations; one option per installation; customization takes normal crafting time.
numenera.power.customize-creation.go_wrong: Customization effects may deplete; repairs cost XP and days.
numenera.power.customize-creation.combines: Uses the Builds Tomorrow Customization Table.
numenera.power.customize-creation.blocked_reason: The ability adds a separately functioning power to an installation, with depletion and repair rules.

numenera.power.improvised-repair.name: Improvised Repair

effect.summary: Temporarily restores a depleted object or structure’s ability to operate.

numenera.power.improvised-repair.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; takes a few rounds; can benefit a given object only once before actual repair is needed.
numenera.power.improvised-repair.go_wrong: Provides only temporary use; the object cannot benefit from this ability again.
numenera.power.improvised-repair.combines: Artifacts gain a new 1-in-6 depletion chance; installations gain 1d6 days of operation.
numenera.power.improvised-repair.blocked_reason: The effect restores an item’s depleted function and modifies its depletion state.

numenera.power.fast-builder.name: Fast Builder

effect.summary: Reduces the assessed difficulty of crafting a complex object or structure by one.

numenera.power.fast-builder.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a task difficulty adjustment.

numenera.power.dual-customization.name: Dual Customization

effect.summary: Adds a second customization-table function to a creation.

numenera.power.dual-customization.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 XP; costs an additional 2 XP for the extra customization; excludes cyphers.
numenera.power.dual-customization.go_wrong: Customization effects may deplete and require paid repair.
numenera.power.dual-customization.combines: Can customize artifacts, installations, vehicles, and automatons using the deluxe options.
numenera.power.dual-customization.blocked_reason: The ability adds powers to objects that retain separate operation, depletion, and repair rules.

numenera.power.improved.name: Improved

effect.summary: Raises the completed installation’s level by one, up to level 10.

numenera.power.improved.cost_or_limit: Does not increase build time; each installation can take this option once.
numenera.power.improved.who_may: Installations customized by a character with Customize Creation
numenera.power.improved.combines: Can be repaired after a customization effect depletes for 2 XP and days equal to object level.
numenera.power.improved.blocked_reason: The option modifies an installation’s level as an item property.

numenera.power.concealed.name: Concealed

effect.summary: Makes an installation harder to see or recognize, hindering discovery tasks by two steps.

numenera.power.concealed.who_may: Installations customized by a character with Customize Creation
numenera.power.concealed.combines: Can be applied to disguising an installation as another structure or object.
numenera.power.concealed.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a penalty to detection tasks.

numenera.power.door-and-chamber.name: Door and Chamber

effect.summary: Adds a door or hatch and a small interior space to an installation.

numenera.power.door-and-chamber.cost_or_limit: Space is up to immediate distance across; small installations grow to contain it; access may be restricted to the builder.
numenera.power.door-and-chamber.go_wrong: Others can force a restricted door.
numenera.power.door-and-chamber.who_may: Installations customized by a character with Customize Creation
numenera.power.door-and-chamber.combines: Adds physical space to an installation.
numenera.power.door-and-chamber.blocked_reason: The option creates interior space within an installation, including capacity and access rules.

numenera.power.intelligence.name: Intelligence

effect.summary: Gives an installation awareness of its immediate surroundings, speech, interaction, and a specific knowledge skill.

numenera.power.intelligence.cost_or_limit: Skill functions like one modification of a level 2 follower.
numenera.power.intelligence.mind: The installation gains intelligence and can speak and interact.
numenera.power.intelligence.who_may: Installations customized by a character with Customize Creation
numenera.power.intelligence.blocked_reason: The option creates an intelligent, communicating mind within an installation.

numenera.power.guarding.name: Guarding

effect.summary: Surveils the area within about a mile for an hour and eases initiative for informed allies.

numenera.power.guarding.cost_or_limit: Requires an action to activate; depletion is 1 in 1d20 per use, separate from other depletion.
numenera.power.guarding.who_may: Installations customized by a character with Customize Creation
numenera.power.guarding.combines: Can raise a community’s effective rank against stealthy hordes by one.
numenera.power.guarding.blocked_reason: The function senses a broad area and supplies information about its surroundings.

numenera.power.acquisition.name: Acquisition

effect.summary: Retrieves a visible object no larger than a five-foot cube from within a mile and places it near the user.

numenera.power.acquisition.cost_or_limit: Requires an action; protected or held objects require a successful acquisition task; depletion is 1 in 1d20.
numenera.power.acquisition.go_wrong: May fail against protected objects or deplete after use.
numenera.power.acquisition.combines: Installation level is compared to the creature’s level when the object is held.
numenera.power.acquisition.blocked_reason: The option remotely removes and relocates objects, including objects held by creatures.

numenera.power.healing.name: Healing

effect.summary: Improves a nearby creature’s damage-track state or grants a recovery-roll bonus during rest.

numenera.power.healing.cost_or_limit: Requires an action and touch or a mechanical tendril; depletion is 1 in 1d20 per use.
numenera.power.healing.who_may: Creatures designated by the installation’s user
numenera.power.healing.combines: During rest, a PC receives +3 to a recovery roll; impaired or debilitated targets improve one step.
numenera.power.healing.blocked_reason: The effect can run as healing and recovery benefits.

numenera.power.alliance.name: Alliance

effect.summary: Produces a level 4 automaton that follows the activator’s instructions for up to an hour.

numenera.power.alliance.cost_or_limit: Requires an action; automaton must return to the installation for at least an hour; depletion is 1 in 1d12; small installations must contain it.
numenera.power.alliance.go_wrong: The effect may deplete; the automaton’s active period ends after an hour.
numenera.power.alliance.mind: The automaton follows the triggering user’s instructions.
numenera.power.alliance.combines: The installation must be large enough to house a resident automaton.
numenera.power.alliance.blocked_reason: The option produces a creature-like automaton that follows instructions and later returns to its installation.

numenera.power.enhanced.name: Enhanced

effect.summary: Raises a completed object or structure two levels, up to level 10.

numenera.power.enhanced.cost_or_limit: Does not increase build time; each object or structure can take this option once.
numenera.power.enhanced.who_may: Objects or structures receiving deluxe customization
numenera.power.enhanced.combines: Can be repaired after a customization effect depletes for 2 XP and days equal to object level.
numenera.power.enhanced.blocked_reason: The option modifies the level of a customized object or structure.

numenera.power.improbability-field.name: Improbability Field

effect.summary: Lets a nearby creature turn a failed roll into a natural 20.

numenera.power.improbability-field.cost_or_limit: Target must be within short range and call for aid during their action; depletion is 1 in 1d10 per use; a natural 20 may still fail at high difficulty.
numenera.power.improbability-field.who_may: One creature within short range of the object or structure
numenera.power.improbability-field.combines: Can affect attacks and defense rolls as well as other tasks.
numenera.power.improbability-field.blocked_reason: The effect can run as a conditional replacement of a failed roll.

numenera.power.extend-awareness.name: Extend Awareness

effect.summary: Links the user’s mind to nearby installations and machines to observe general activity across three miles.

numenera.power.extend-awareness.cost_or_limit: Requires an action and continued attention; lasts up to an hour; covert activity and activity inside structures are excluded; depletion is 1 in 1d20.
numenera.power.extend-awareness.go_wrong: May deplete after use; awareness ends when the user does anything else.
numenera.power.extend-awareness.mind: Links the user’s mind to nearby machines and installations.
numenera.power.extend-awareness.who_may: A user of the customized object or structure
numenera.power.extend-awareness.combines: Uses nearby installations and machines as the awareness network.
numenera.power.extend-awareness.blocked_reason: The function remotely gathers information over a broad area through linked machines.

numenera.power.transport.name: Transport

effect.summary: Instantly relocates a visible creature within very long range to another visible area.

numenera.power.transport.cost_or_limit: Destination must be visible and cannot be inside a creature or object; depletion is 1 in 1d10 per use.
numenera.power.transport.who_may: A user of the customized object or structure
numenera.power.transport.combines: The target must be visible within very long range.
numenera.power.transport.blocked_reason: The effect can run as instant relocation with a destination restriction.

numenera.power.concealing-cloak.name: Concealing Cloak

effect.summary: Bends light around a nearby target for ten minutes, improving stealth and Speed defense.

numenera.power.concealing-cloak.cost_or_limit: Target within short range; ends if the target reveals its presence or position; depletion is 1 in 1d20.
numenera.power.concealing-cloak.go_wrong: The effect ends if the target attacks, uses an ability, moves a large object, or otherwise reveals itself; may deplete.
numenera.power.concealing-cloak.who_may: A user of the customized object or structure
numenera.power.concealing-cloak.combines: Grants specialization in stealth and Speed defense while active.
numenera.power.concealing-cloak.blocked_reason: The effect can run as concealment with a defined duration and ending conditions.

numenera.power.illuminate-the-horde.name: Illuminate the Horde

effect.summary: Marks most visible members of a nearby horde with a bright vertical beam for about an hour.

numenera.power.illuminate-the-horde.cost_or_limit: Horde must be visible and within a mile; depletion is 1 in 1d10 per use.
numenera.power.illuminate-the-horde.who_may: A user of the customized object or structure
numenera.power.illuminate-the-horde.combines: Other hordes or communities gain +1 effective rank when attacking the marked horde.
numenera.power.illuminate-the-horde.blocked_reason: The effect marks most members of a horde and changes group-level interactions.

numenera.power.grow-a-champion.name: Grow a Champion

effect.summary: Grows a creature to thirty feet for an hour, granting temporary Might and easier movement tasks.

numenera.power.grow-a-champion.cost_or_limit: Depletion is 1 in 1d10 per use; the target gains ten temporary Might points and +1 Might Edge.
numenera.power.grow-a-champion.who_may: A creature targeted by a user of the customized object or structure
numenera.power.grow-a-champion.combines: May count as a rank 2 rampaging horde when appropriate.
numenera.power.grow-a-champion.blocked_reason: The effect changes a creature’s size and form while granting related capabilities.

numenera.power.deluxe-custom-options.name: Deluxe Custom Options

effect.summary: Adds a customization to a crafted object or structure.

numenera.power.deluxe-custom-options.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 XP; cannot customize cyphers; takes the project’s normal crafting time.
numenera.power.deluxe-custom-options.combines: Uses the Builds Tomorrow Customization Table or Deluxe Custom Options Table.
numenera.power.deluxe-custom-options.blocked_reason: The added working can be modeled as an ordinary item customization.

numenera.power.triple-customization.name: Triple Customization

effect.summary: Adds a third customization to an object or structure.

numenera.power.triple-customization.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 XP; requires Customize Creation and Dual Customization; cannot customize cyphers; takes normal project time.
numenera.power.triple-customization.who_may: A character with the required customization abilities.
numenera.power.triple-customization.combines: Customize Creation and Dual Customization; uses the Builds Tomorrow Customization Table.
numenera.power.triple-customization.blocked_reason: This is an ordinary added item customization.

numenera.power.ribbons-of-dark-matter.name: Ribbons of Dark Matter

effect.summary: Creates a field of dark ribbons that hinders tasks and slows creatures leaving it.

numenera.power.ribbons-of-dark-matter.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; lasts up to one minute; area is no larger than immediate distance across and within long range; can be dismissed as an action.
numenera.power.ribbons-of-dark-matter.go_wrong: The dark matter may skulk away as a GM intrusion.
numenera.power.ribbons-of-dark-matter.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.ribbons-of-dark-matter.where_from: Dark matter condensed from void spaces or a transdimensional pocket.
numenera.power.ribbons-of-dark-matter.blocked_reason: The effect applies hindrance and movement restriction throughout a persistent area.

numenera.power.dark-matter-structure.name: Dark Matter Structure

effect.summary: Forms dark matter into a large, complex, matte-black structure.

numenera.power.dark-matter-structure.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; up to ten 10-foot cubes; level 6; lasts 28 hours; only one can remain solid at a time.
numenera.power.dark-matter-structure.go_wrong: The dark matter may skulk away as a GM intrusion.
numenera.power.dark-matter-structure.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.dark-matter-structure.where_from: Dark matter condensed from the void.
numenera.power.dark-matter-structure.combines: The structure may provide a community an infrastructure or Armor benefit while it lasts.
numenera.power.dark-matter-structure.blocked_reason: A structure with a duration and level can be represented as a created thing.

numenera.power.embrace-the-night.name: Embrace the Night

effect.summary: A controlled dark-matter creature attacks foes, damaging and stunning them through tendrils in their eyes and brain.

numenera.power.embrace-the-night.cost_or_limit: Costs 7 or more Intellect points; attacks each round against targets within long range; created creature disperses after about a minute.
numenera.power.embrace-the-night.mind: The target takes Intellect damage and loses its next turn when stunned.
numenera.power.embrace-the-night.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.embrace-the-night.where_from: Dark matter condensed into a creature-like facade.
numenera.power.embrace-the-night.combines: Can instead perform other actions while visible and mentally controlled by the user.
numenera.power.embrace-the-night.blocked_reason: The user mentally controls a created creature to perform actions.

numenera.power.void-wings.name: Void Wings

effect.summary: Dark-matter ribbons lift the user into flight for one round.

numenera.power.void-wings.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; flight lasts one round.
numenera.power.void-wings.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.void-wings.blocked_reason: This is a short-duration movement effect.

numenera.power.dark-matter-shroud.name: Dark Matter Shroud

effect.summary: A dark-matter shroud improves defense and harms creatures that touch or strike the user in melee.

numenera.power.dark-matter-shroud.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; lasts up to one minute; grants +1 Armor.
numenera.power.dark-matter-shroud.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.dark-matter-shroud.blocked_reason: The shroud continuously protects its user and damages attackers on contact.

numenera.power.dark-matter-strike.name: Dark Matter Strike

effect.summary: Dark matter entangles a target’s limbs, holding it in place and easing the user’s attack.

numenera.power.dark-matter-strike.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; target must be within long range.
numenera.power.dark-matter-strike.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.dark-matter-strike.where_from: Dark matter condensed around the target.
numenera.power.dark-matter-strike.combines: Works with any kind of attack.
numenera.power.dark-matter-strike.blocked_reason: A binding effect on a single target fits the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.dark-matter-shell.name: Dark Matter Shell

effect.summary: A dark shell aids sneaking, improves Armor, and supplies extra Effort on physical tasks.

numenera.power.dark-matter-shell.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; lasts one minute; free Effort applies when the user spends Effort on a physical task.
numenera.power.dark-matter-shell.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.dark-matter-shell.where_from: Dark matter condensed around the user.
numenera.power.dark-matter-shell.combines: Works with the user’s physical tasks and Effort.
numenera.power.dark-matter-shell.blocked_reason: The ability changes the user’s appearance into a dark silhouette while the shell persists.

numenera.power.windwracked-traveler.name: Windwracked Traveler

effect.summary: A dark-matter wing carries the user through the air, potentially carrying touched passengers.

numenera.power.windwracked-traveler.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 or more Intellect points; lasts up to an hour; each Effort level adds an hour or one passenger; passengers must stay relatively still.
numenera.power.windwracked-traveler.go_wrong: Passengers who move too much may fall.
numenera.power.windwracked-traveler.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.windwracked-traveler.where_from: A wide wing condensed from dark matter.
numenera.power.windwracked-traveler.combines: Can carry touched creatures of the user’s size or smaller.
numenera.power.windwracked-traveler.blocked_reason: The effect is movement with a defined duration and passenger limit.

numenera.power.fortified-position.name: Fortified Position

effect.summary: Improves Armor and Might defense while the user stays near their previous position.

numenera.power.fortified-position.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Might points; lasts one minute; requires staying within immediate distance of the position from the prior turn.
numenera.power.fortified-position.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.fortified-position.blocked_reason: A temporary self-defense bonus is representable.

numenera.power.rally-to-me.name: Rally to Me

effect.summary: Allies who answer the call gain an asset on a suggested attack or defense task.

numenera.power.rally-to-me.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; allies must be within very long range and approach within immediate distance within a few rounds; benefit lasts an hour.
numenera.power.rally-to-me.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.rally-to-me.where_from: A call, horn, or other signal.
numenera.power.rally-to-me.combines: Trained defenders gain additional assets when called within earshot.
numenera.power.rally-to-me.blocked_reason: The effect grants allies a task bonus.

numenera.power.mind-for-might.name: Mind for Might

effect.summary: Lets the user pay Intellect costs from Might, or Might costs from Intellect.

numenera.power.mind-for-might.cost_or_limit: Applies to tasks that would normally spend points from either pool.
numenera.power.mind-for-might.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.mind-for-might.combines: Swaps which pool pays an ability or task cost.

numenera.power.fortification-builder.name: Fortification Builder

numenera.power.fortification-builder.combines: Applies to commonplace or numenera fortifications.

numenera.power.train-defenders.name: Train Defenders

effect.summary: Establishes a troop of followers trained to defend an allied community.

numenera.power.train-defenders.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.train-defenders.where_from: Training performed in an allied community or horde.
numenera.power.train-defenders.combines: Rally to Me grants them an additional defensive asset when used within earshot.
numenera.power.train-defenders.blocked_reason: The rules for followers can represent the trained defenders.

numenera.power.living-buttress.name: Living Buttress

effect.summary: Increases the user’s Might Pool by five.

numenera.power.living-buttress.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.living-buttress.blocked_reason: A pool increase is a basic character statistic change.

numenera.power.reinforcing-field.name: Reinforcing Field

effect.summary: Reinforces an object or structure against damage and destruction.

numenera.power.reinforcing-field.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.reinforcing-field.where_from: A force field infused into the target.
numenera.power.reinforcing-field.combines: Can affect an object or structure.
numenera.power.reinforcing-field.blocked_reason: The field reinforces an object for a sustained period.

numenera.power.warding-shield.name: Warding Shield

effect.summary: Provides +1 Armor while the user holds a shield.

numenera.power.warding-shield.blocked_reason: This is a conditional Armor bonus.

numenera.power.generate-force-field.name: Generate Force Field

effect.summary: Creates six contiguous solid-force planes as a barrier.

numenera.power.generate-force-field.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.generate-force-field.combines: Planes must be contiguous and conform to available space.
numenera.power.generate-force-field.blocked_reason: The ability creates a persistent, positioned multi-plane barrier.

numenera.power.rout-horde.name: Rout Horde

effect.summary: Attempts to make a horde retreat and reconsider its attack.

numenera.power.rout-horde.cost_or_limit: Costs 9 or more Intellect points; affects a horde up to rank 2 for an hour; Effort increases maximum rank.

numenera.power.rout-horde.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.rout-horde.where_from: A display of energy, force, and shaking earth.
numenera.power.rout-horde.blocked_reason: The effect can be represented as forced movement and a temporary change in behavior.

numenera.power.courageous.name: Courageous

effect.summary: Trains the user in Intellect defense and initiative tasks.

numenera.power.courageous.who_may: A character with this focus ability.

numenera.power.resuscitate.name: Resuscitate

effect.summary: Restores a damaged character by one step, and can revive a recently dead, intact character after a successful healing task.

numenera.power.resuscitate.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.resuscitate.combines: Can be used on living characters up to two damage-track steps down or recently dead characters.
numenera.power.resuscitate.blocked_reason: It can restore a character after death, a state transition not covered by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.power.true-defender.name: True Defender

effect.summary: Extends Devoted Defender’s benefits to as many as three chosen characters.

numenera.power.true-defender.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Might or Intellect points; choosing one character instead specializes the user in the relevant tasks.
numenera.power.true-defender.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.true-defender.combines: Functions as Devoted Defender, with up to three recipients.
numenera.power.true-defender.blocked_reason: The effect distributes a defense and training benefit to selected targets.

numenera.power.devoted-defender.name: Devoted Defender

effect.summary: Trains the user in tasks for finding, healing, interacting with, and protecting a chosen ward.

numenera.power.devoted-defender.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Might or Intellect points; user can have one ward at a time; must see the chosen character.
numenera.power.devoted-defender.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.devoted-defender.combines: Dual Wards allows two wards; True Defender can extend its benefits.
numenera.power.devoted-defender.blocked_reason: A chosen ward and related task bonuses are representable.

numenera.power.insight.name: Insight

effect.summary: Helps discern motives, general nature, and whether someone seems innocent.

numenera.power.insight.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.insight.blocked_reason: The ability senses hidden motives and innocence.

numenera.power.dual-wards.name: Dual Wards

effect.summary: Allows the user to maintain Devoted Defender benefits for two wards.

numenera.power.dual-wards.cost_or_limit: The wards must stay within immediate distance of each other; if separated, only one keeps the benefit until they reunite.
numenera.power.dual-wards.go_wrong: Separation temporarily removes the benefit from one ward.
numenera.power.dual-wards.who_may: A character with Devoted Defender and this ability.
numenera.power.dual-wards.combines: Can select both wards in one action for one cost.
numenera.power.dual-wards.blocked_reason: The ability links task benefits to two selected characters.

numenera.power.true-guardian.name: True Guardian

effect.summary: Improves nearby allies’ defense tasks while the user stands guard.

numenera.power.true-guardian.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Might or Intellect points; lasts until the end of the user’s next turn; allies must be within immediate range.
numenera.power.true-guardian.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.true-guardian.combines: Triggered by standing guard as an action.
numenera.power.true-guardian.blocked_reason: The benefit applies to multiple nearby allies for a limited time.

numenera.power.combat-challenge.name: Combat Challenge

effect.summary: Eases tasks that draw attacks toward the user instead of someone else.

numenera.power.combat-challenge.cost_or_limit: Applies to tasks drawing an attack to the user and away from another character.
numenera.power.combat-challenge.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.combat-challenge.blocked_reason: This is a conditional task-difficulty modifier.

numenera.power.willing-sacrifice.name: Willing Sacrifice

effect.summary: Redirects attacks meant for another to the user and reduces the damage taken.

numenera.power.willing-sacrifice.cost_or_limit: Damage is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1; multiple attacks can be taken in a round if meant for one target.
numenera.power.willing-sacrifice.go_wrong: The user is struck by attacks meant for another character.
numenera.power.willing-sacrifice.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.willing-sacrifice.combines: Works with taking an attack for another character.
numenera.power.willing-sacrifice.blocked_reason: The attack is redirected and its damage adjusted.

numenera.power.taunt-foe.name: Taunt Foe

effect.summary: Combines an attack with an attempt to draw a foe’s attack toward the user.

numenera.power.taunt-foe.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Might or Intellect points; defenses against the resulting attack are hindered one step instead of two.
numenera.power.taunt-foe.go_wrong: A determined foe may not be drawn to the user.
numenera.power.taunt-foe.mind: May use an Intellect action to influence a foe into attacking the user.
numenera.power.taunt-foe.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.taunt-foe.combines: Can be used as part of drawing an attack.
numenera.power.taunt-foe.blocked_reason: The foe’s targeting choice is altered by the user’s influence.

numenera.power.noble-s-courage.name: Noble’s Courage

effect.summary: Neutralizes a negative mental effect affecting the user.

numenera.power.noble-s-courage.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 or more Intellect points; counters effects up to level 4, with Effort increasing the maximum level; lasts up to a minute or until the next attack while under active attack.
numenera.power.noble-s-courage.mind: Prevents or suppresses a negative mental effect on the user.
numenera.power.noble-s-courage.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.noble-s-courage.combines: Effort raises the level of effect it can neutralize.
numenera.power.noble-s-courage.blocked_reason: The ability blocks a mental effect on its user.

numenera.power.privileged-nobility.name: Privileged Nobility

effect.summary: Provides access to elite social venues and training in persuasion.

numenera.power.privileged-nobility.cost_or_limit: Social privileges depend on being recognized.
numenera.power.privileged-nobility.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.privileged-nobility.blocked_reason: Social access and persuasion training are representable.

numenera.power.servant.name: Servant

effect.summary: Provides a level 2 follower who serves as a personal assistant.

numenera.power.servant.cost_or_limit: May be swapped for an ability from the character’s type; follower has one serving-related modification; requests must be reasonable.
numenera.power.servant.who_may: A noble who chooses to swap a type ability for this one.
numenera.power.servant.combines: A later retinue can add more personal assistants.
numenera.power.servant.blocked_reason: The follower’s assistance is represented through ordinary follower rules.

numenera.power.trained-interlocutor.name: Trained Interlocutor

effect.summary: Trains the user in all interaction tasks.

numenera.power.trained-interlocutor.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.trained-interlocutor.where_from: Practice in conversation and social influence.
numenera.power.trained-interlocutor.blocked_reason: This is a general task-training benefit.

numenera.power.asserting-your-privilege.name: Asserting Your Privilege

effect.summary: A verbal harangue prevents a foe who can hear it from acting for one round and hinders its next action.

numenera.power.asserting-your-privilege.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; target must hear the user; whether the attempt succeeds or fails, its next action is hindered.

numenera.power.asserting-your-privilege.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.asserting-your-privilege.where_from: The user’s noble privilege and forceful speech.

numenera.power.retinue.name: Retinue

effect.summary: Adds four level 2 personal-assistant followers and lets them aid the user in crowds or danger.

numenera.power.retinue.cost_or_limit: One follower needs an assistant-related modification; they provide defense assets in physical violence and may hold a foe’s attention on command.

numenera.power.font-of-inspiration.name: Font of Inspiration

numenera.power.font-of-inspiration.who_may: A character with this focus ability.
numenera.power.font-of-inspiration.blocked_reason: This grants a temporary task benefit.

numenera.power.mind-of-a-ruler.name: Mind of a Ruler

numenera.power.crystal-lens.who_may: A character with the crystalline body.
numenera.power.crystal-lens.where_from: Energy surging through the user’s crystal body.

numenera.power.resonant-quake.combines: Move Mountains reduces the cost of both abilities by 3 points.

numenera.power.return-to-the-obelisk.where_from: The user’s ability to transfer through crystals.
numenera.power.return-to-the-obelisk.combines: Can use a crystal obelisk as an exit if known.

numenera.power.trained-excavator.name: Trained Excavator

numenera.power.fellow-explorer.name: Fellow Explorer

numenera.power.fellow-explorer.who_may: A character with the Explores Yesterday focus.
numenera.power.fellow-explorer.blocked_reason: A follower and its modifications are representable.

numenera.power.got-a-feeling.name: Got a Feeling

effect.summary: Extends the user’s senses across a region and answers a simple question about it.

numenera.power.got-a-feeling.go_wrong: No information is received if the queried fact is outside the area.
numenera.power.got-a-feeling.who_may: A character with the Explores Yesterday focus.
numenera.power.got-a-feeling.combines: The user asks the GM one simple, general question.

numenera.power.maneuvering-adept.name: Maneuvering Adept

numenera.power.maneuvering-adept.cost_or_limit: Requires at least one level of Effort on climbing, jumping, balancing, or similar tasks.

numenera.power.maneuvering-adept.combines: Stacks with the Effort applied to the task as described.

numenera.power.incredible-recovery.name: Incredible Recovery

numenera.power.incredible-recovery.combines: Can choose recovery or condition removal.
numenera.power.incredible-recovery.blocked_reason: This restores vitality or ends an ongoing condition.

numenera.power.quick-hands.name: Quick Hands

effect.summary: Allows one extra attack each round with a chosen weapon.

numenera.power.quick-hands.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Speed points; choose a weapon type; separate attack rolls are made, but attacks count as one action and share Effort limits.
numenera.power.quick-hands.who_may: A character with the Explores Yesterday focus.
numenera.power.quick-hands.combines: Weapon Master may apply to the same weapon; attack modifiers apply to both attacks.

numenera.power.growing-horde.who_may: A character with the Fights With a Horde focus.

numenera.power.advance-rank.combines: Also applies to Rampaging Beast Horde.

numenera.power.charging-horde.combines: The group acts like one creature during the charge.
