numenera.artifact.realscribe-impetus.name: Realscribe impetus

effect.summary: Transfers a sensed creature from a frame to the real at the nearest vertice.

numenera.artifact.realscribe-impetus.cost_or_limit: User must be able to sense the target.
numenera.artifact.realscribe-impetus.go_wrong: May produce errors, mutations, or diseases in the resulting form.
numenera.artifact.realscribe-impetus.mechanism: Transfers a creature from datasphere to real.
numenera.artifact.realscribe-impetus.blocked_reason: It relocates a creature into the real.

numenera.artifact.realstrike.name: Realstrike

effect.summary: Attacks a foe and sends it through a temporary vertice into the real.

numenera.artifact.realstrike.cost_or_limit: Target may resist; destination is predetermined or random.
numenera.artifact.realstrike.blocked_reason: It transfers an attacked target into the real.

numenera.artifact.returning-conduit.name: Returning conduit

effect.summary: Creates a brief conduit between the carrier’s frame and the frame marked by the other glyph.

numenera.artifact.returning-conduit.cost_or_limit: Both glyphs must remain in the datasphere; conduit lasts one round.
numenera.artifact.returning-conduit.who_may: Carrier and others in the carrier’s frame.
numenera.artifact.returning-conduit.where_from: Datasphere cypher split into two glyphs.
numenera.artifact.returning-conduit.blocked_reason: It creates a temporary route between frames.

numenera.artifact.root-access.name: Root access

effect.summary: Attacks a creature’s underlying process to cause one of six effects.

numenera.artifact.root-access.cost_or_limit: Each cypher is keyed to one specific effect; effects last a minute.
numenera.artifact.root-access.go_wrong: Effects can include paralysis, glitches, dazing, false beliefs, or disappearance.
numenera.artifact.root-access.mind: May alter beliefs, including friend and foe perceptions, or erase memory of an interval.
numenera.artifact.root-access.blocked_reason: Several effects impose beliefs or alter perception and memory.

numenera.artifact.saver.name: Saver

effect.summary: Restores the user to their state when activated, including location, knowledge, and equipment.

numenera.artifact.saver.cost_or_limit: Can be triggered within 28 hours; later gains are lost and losses restored.
numenera.artifact.saver.go_wrong: If user is destroyed, another creature must activate the marker to restore them.
numenera.artifact.saver.mind: Restores prior knowledge and removes later-acquired knowledge.
numenera.artifact.saver.who_may: User, or another creature if the user is destroyed.
numenera.artifact.saver.blocked_reason: It restores a prior state and can bring a destroyed user back.

numenera.artifact.smart-frame.name: Smart frame

effect.summary: Gives an eligible frame Intellect and the ability to communicate with the user.

numenera.artifact.smart-frame.cost_or_limit: Frame level must not exceed cypher level; the frame functions as an immobile daemon.
numenera.artifact.smart-frame.blocked_reason: It changes a frame into an intelligent communicating entity.

numenera.artifact.soulcore-tracer.name: Soulcore tracer

effect.summary: Tracks a target through the real and datasphere, with an option to travel to or summon it.

numenera.artifact.soulcore-tracer.cost_or_limit: Lasts 28 hours; triggering either travel option ends the effects.
numenera.artifact.soulcore-tracer.combines: Can locate targets in either realm.
numenera.artifact.soulcore-tracer.mechanism: Tracks a soulcore and enables relocation.
numenera.artifact.soulcore-tracer.blocked_reason: It tracks a target through a soulcore link and can summon the target.

numenera.artifact.spawn-duplicate.name: Spawn duplicate

effect.summary: Creates a duplicate dataform so the user can take two turns per round.

numenera.artifact.spawn-duplicate.cost_or_limit: Duplicate lasts up to a minute.
numenera.artifact.spawn-duplicate.go_wrong: Each round, the user risks being stunned by conflicting sensory input.
numenera.artifact.spawn-duplicate.mind: Conflicting views can stun the user.
numenera.artifact.spawn-duplicate.blocked_reason: It creates a temporary copy of the user.

numenera.artifact.swarmbuster-detonation.name: Swarmbuster detonation

effect.summary: Detonates against up to eight chosen targets, with repeated targeting possible against a gestalt.

numenera.artifact.swarmbuster-detonation.cost_or_limit: Up to eight targets; may target a gestalt multiple times up to its component count.
numenera.artifact.swarmbuster-detonation.blocked_reason: Its repeated targeting depends on a gestalt’s component structure.

numenera.artifact.task-downloader.name: TASK DOWNLOADER

effect.summary: Provides an asset on a chosen task while a datasphere connection is possible.

numenera.artifact.task-downloader.cost_or_limit: Lasts ten hours, but requires a connection; triggering it eases the next attempt by three steps and ends all effects.
numenera.artifact.task-downloader.blocked_reason: A task benefit with a connection limit can be handled as a basic effect.

numenera.artifact.youthener.name: YOUTHENER

effect.summary: Makes the user’s dataform appear up to two years younger per cypher level.

numenera.artifact.youthener.cost_or_limit: Realscribing transfers the appearance and benefits to the physical body; datascribing again restores original age.
numenera.artifact.youthener.combines: Effects apply to dataform and, after realscribing, physical body.
numenera.artifact.youthener.blocked_reason: It permanently alters apparent age and can change the physical body.

numenera.artifact.transcription-accelera.name: TRANSCRIPTION ACCELERATOR

effect.summary: Speeds a transcription that is slower than one round by about tenfold.

numenera.artifact.transcription-accelera.cost_or_limit: Works only on slower-than-default transcription; can target another.
numenera.artifact.transcription-accelera.combines: Can activate before transcription or target another.
numenera.artifact.transcription-accelera.blocked_reason: The stated speed-up can be represented as altering transcription time.

numenera.artifact.transcription-shield.name: TRANSCRIPTION SHIELD

effect.summary: Creates a protective spherical field whenever the user transcribes.

numenera.artifact.transcription-shield.cost_or_limit: Lasts 28 hours; each field lasts up to one minute per cypher level; field level equals cypher level.
numenera.artifact.transcription-shield.go_wrong: Can expire before a slow transcription finishes.
numenera.artifact.transcription-shield.where_from: Small handheld device or crystal in the real; radiant glyph in the datasphere
numenera.artifact.transcription-shield.combines: Appears and disappears with the user’s dataform during transcription.
numenera.artifact.transcription-shield.blocked_reason: A temporary spherical protective field is not expressible as a basic target-limited effect.

numenera.artifact.tornadic-spike.name: TORNADIC SPIKE

effect.summary: Invokes a violent storm in the current or adjacent frame, flinging creatures and damaging them each round.

numenera.artifact.tornadic-spike.cost_or_limit: Lasts one minute; affected creatures can attempt a Speed defense each round.
numenera.artifact.tornadic-spike.blocked_reason: It affects all creatures in a selected frame as an ongoing environmental field.

numenera.artifact.transcribing-transform.name: TRANSCRIBING TRANSFORMER

effect.summary: Rebuilds or improves the user’s body with one randomly determined benefit.

numenera.artifact.transcribing-transform.cost_or_limit: Must accompany activation of a vertice from datasphere to real; benefit ends on next transcription or use of another such cypher.
numenera.artifact.transcribing-transform.combines: Requires a vertice activation; has multiple possible body benefits.
numenera.artifact.transcribing-transform.blocked_reason: It changes the user’s form and bodily capabilities.

numenera.artifact.universal-lock.name: UNIVERSAL LOCK

effect.summary: Locks a node, conduit, frame, or barrier.

numenera.artifact.universal-lock.cost_or_limit: Lasts 28 hours; lock level is the higher of target and cypher levels.
numenera.artifact.universal-lock.blocked_reason: The lock is a basic restriction on a target.

numenera.artifact.vacuum-spike.name: VACUUM SPIKE

effect.summary: Invokes airless vacuum in a frame, stunning and damaging creatures there each round.

numenera.artifact.vacuum-spike.cost_or_limit: Lasts one minute; creatures may attempt a Might defense each round.
numenera.artifact.vacuum-spike.combines: Affects the current or adjacent frame.
numenera.artifact.vacuum-spike.blocked_reason: It creates an ongoing vacuum effect affecting all creatures in a frame.

numenera.artifact.virtual-task-patch.name: VIRTUAL TASK PATCH

effect.summary: Grants an asset to a specified datasphere-related task.

numenera.artifact.virtual-task-patch.cost_or_limit: Lasts one hour; task must relate to the datasphere.
numenera.artifact.virtual-task-patch.combines: Examples include navigation, sensing adjacent frames, barriers, and combat.
numenera.artifact.virtual-task-patch.blocked_reason: A task benefit can be represented as a basic effect.

numenera.artifact.transcriptive-focus-in.name: TRANSCRIPTIVE FOCUS INDUCER

effect.summary: Overwrites part of the user’s soulcore to grant another focus ability.

numenera.artifact.transcriptive-focus-in.cost_or_limit: Normally one hour for tier 3 or tier 6 ability; lower-tier users defend or receive a random ability briefly, with failure causing damage and destruction; no effect outside datasphere; realscribing restores abilities.
numenera.artifact.transcriptive-focus-in.go_wrong: Lower-tier failure causes damage equal to cypher level and destroys it.
numenera.artifact.transcriptive-focus-in.mind: Replaces one focus ability with another, or temporarily grants a random one.
numenera.artifact.transcriptive-focus-in.where_from: Pill or liquid, wearable token, handheld real device, or radiant glyph in datasphere
numenera.artifact.transcriptive-focus-in.combines: Costs for the gained ability still apply; level 6+ affects tier 6 rather than tier 3.
numenera.artifact.transcriptive-focus-in.blocked_reason: It transfers or replaces a character’s held ability by rewriting their soulcore.

numenera.artifact.truth-compulsion.name: TRUTH COMPULSION

effect.summary: Compels the target to answer their first question truthfully.

numenera.artifact.truth-compulsion.cost_or_limit: Applies to the first question asked within one minute.
numenera.artifact.truth-compulsion.who_may: User; target is the compelled person
numenera.artifact.truth-compulsion.blocked_reason: The effect compels a target’s speech through control of their mind.

numenera.artifact.universal-key.name: UNIVERSAL KEY

effect.summary: Opens a lock or succeeds at a codebreaking task.

numenera.artifact.universal-key.cost_or_limit: Codebreaking works only when lock level is no higher than cypher level.
numenera.artifact.universal-key.combines: Works on nodes, conduits, frames, or barriers.
numenera.artifact.universal-key.blocked_reason: Opening a lock is a basic release effect.

numenera.artifact.battering-sledge.name: BATTERING SLEDGE

effect.summary: Shakes a frame or nearby real area, potentially making creatures lose their next action; can kink a conduit.

numenera.artifact.battering-sledge.cost_or_limit: Special activation as part of an attack; conduit use hinders its tasks by three steps and repeated uses may destroy it.
numenera.artifact.battering-sledge.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d20; frames may retain a minor glitch for days.
numenera.artifact.battering-sledge.where_from: Large hammer-like weapon in real and datasphere
numenera.artifact.battering-sledge.combines: Normal weapon use does not require depletion; real objects may topple or shift.
numenera.artifact.battering-sledge.blocked_reason: Its special attack affects creatures across a frame or area.

numenera.artifact.cyphercutter-sword.name: CYPHERCUTTER SWORD

effect.summary: Destroys a lower-level cypher carried by a dataform or an effect produced by one.

numenera.artifact.cyphercutter-sword.cost_or_limit: Must hit a dataform creature; can also grant an asset to kick a barrier.
numenera.artifact.cyphercutter-sword.combines: Normal weapon use requires no depletion.
numenera.artifact.cyphercutter-sword.blocked_reason: It destroys another cypher or a cypher-created effect.

numenera.artifact.daemon-spawner.name: DAEMON SPAWNER

effect.summary: Spawns a daemon to perform a requested task or produce an effect.

numenera.artifact.daemon-spawner.cost_or_limit: Effect level cannot exceed artifact level; GM may limit larger requests.
numenera.artifact.daemon-spawner.where_from: Radiant sphere following the user in the datasphere
numenera.artifact.daemon-spawner.combines: Daemon can use indirect means through deeper datasphere layers.
numenera.artifact.daemon-spawner.blocked_reason: It summons a daemon that performs tasks on the user’s behalf.

numenera.artifact.clock-stopper.name: CLOCK STOPPER

effect.summary: Freezes a selected creature in subjective time for one hour.

numenera.artifact.clock-stopper.cost_or_limit: Frozen creature cannot move from its frame and has +10 Armor; damage that penetrates ends the effect.
numenera.artifact.clock-stopper.who_may: User chooses a creature in a frame
numenera.artifact.clock-stopper.where_from: Number-like symbols in a transparent sphere in the datasphere
numenera.artifact.clock-stopper.blocked_reason: It stops a creature’s subjective time.

numenera.artifact.conduit-cord.name: CONDUIT CORD

effect.summary: Forms a permanent conduit between two frames when both ends are tied off.

numenera.artifact.conduit-cord.cost_or_limit: Frames must be at or below artifact level; retrieving the cord ends the conduit.
numenera.artifact.conduit-cord.combines: Endpoints may be in the same or different frames.
numenera.artifact.conduit-cord.blocked_reason: The effect creates a persistent connection between two endpoints.

numenera.artifact.datascribe-torc.name: DATASCRIBE TORC

effect.summary: Produces a token that sends a real-world user to a particular datasphere node.

numenera.artifact.datascribe-torc.cost_or_limit: Each torc is linked to a specific node.
numenera.artifact.datascribe-torc.where_from: Silvery torc in real or datasphere
numenera.artifact.datascribe-torc.combines: The resulting token is a datascribe cypher.
numenera.artifact.datascribe-torc.blocked_reason: It produces a transport token with a fixed destination.

numenera.artifact.deletion-razor.name: DELETION RAZOR

effect.summary: Deletes a hit dataform creature at or below artifact level.

numenera.artifact.deletion-razor.cost_or_limit: Must hit the creature; level must not exceed artifact level.
numenera.artifact.deletion-razor.combines: Normal weapon use does not require depletion.
numenera.artifact.deletion-razor.blocked_reason: It permanently deletes a creature’s datasphere existence, a soul-state effect.

numenera.artifact.datarazor.name: DATARAZOR

effect.summary: A hit transfers points into the user’s Soulcore Pool and reveals information about the target.

numenera.artifact.datarazor.cost_or_limit: Pool gains can exceed maximum temporarily; excess fades after hours; killing a target grants an hour of task assets.
numenera.artifact.datarazor.combines: Requires a hit to trigger special function.
numenera.artifact.datarazor.blocked_reason: It transfers Soulcore Pool points from a target to the wielder.

numenera.artifact.dowsing-blade.name: DOWSING BLADE

effect.summary: Reveals numbers of creatures in adjacent frames, then their general types and levels.

numenera.artifact.dowsing-blade.cost_or_limit: Locked frames or conduits are revealed only if their lock level is lower than artifact level.
numenera.artifact.dowsing-blade.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d20; many detected creatures may daze the user at GM discretion.
numenera.artifact.dowsing-blade.mind: Information overload may daze the user.
numenera.artifact.dowsing-blade.who_may: Wielder after hitting a dataform creature with the special function
numenera.artifact.dowsing-blade.combines: Second activation reveals more detail about previously detected creatures.
numenera.artifact.dowsing-blade.blocked_reason: It reveals hidden creatures and information about them.

numenera.artifact.eater-cylinder.name: EATER CYLINDER

effect.summary: Destroys an object below artifact level placed inside and sealed in the cylinder.

numenera.artifact.eater-cylinder.cost_or_limit: A creature can escape before the lid is secured; a secured, lower-level creature can resist with an eased Might defense.
numenera.artifact.eater-cylinder.combines: Can scoop up any loose object in a frame despite apparent size.
numenera.artifact.eater-cylinder.blocked_reason: The cylinder’s apparent capacity exceeds its physical size and can contain a creature.

numenera.artifact.edge-walker-boots.name: EDGE WALKER BOOTS

effect.summary: Lets the user pass through a frame wall and move along its exterior.

numenera.artifact.edge-walker-boots.cost_or_limit: Up to ten minutes per use; acting from outside hinders tasks against the frame’s interior.
numenera.artifact.edge-walker-boots.combines: User can attack or act into the frame; those inside have greatly hindered attempts to attack or dislodge them.
numenera.artifact.edge-walker-boots.blocked_reason: Movement through a wall and onto its exterior can be represented as position change.

numenera.artifact.glasspad-of-nanosculpt.name: GLASSPAD OF NANOSCULPTING

effect.summary: Offers destruction, harmful nanomachines, or protective armor through nanites.

numenera.artifact.glasspad-of-nanosculpt.cost_or_limit: Each activation risks a datasphere threat tag; three tags and each later tag summon a genius vertice; depletion automatically summons one.
numenera.artifact.glasspad-of-nanosculpt.go_wrong: Failed Intellect task adds a threat tag; depletion calls a genius vertice.
numenera.artifact.glasspad-of-nanosculpt.combines: Options include eroding a low-level machine, reducing a victim’s maximum health or Pools daily, or granting +2 Armor for a day.
numenera.artifact.glasspad-of-nanosculpt.blocked_reason: Its dysphoria effect progressively reduces maximum health or Pools over time.

numenera.artifact.high-fidelity-belt.name: HIGH-FIDELITY BELT

effect.summary: Increases maximum Soulcore Pool by artifact level.

numenera.artifact.high-fidelity-belt.cost_or_limit: Depletes automatically when the wearer’s Soulcore Pool is depleted.
numenera.artifact.high-fidelity-belt.blocked_reason: An item carries a benefit with a depletion condition.

numenera.artifact.infodisc.name: INFODISC

effect.summary: Stores vulnerable soulcore parts, grants +1 Armor, and negates impaired or debilitated effects; it can also be thrown as a weapon.

numenera.artifact.infodisc.cost_or_limit: Thrown attack is eased and deals artifact-level damage; depletes on 1 in 1d20, leaving user impaired.
numenera.artifact.infodisc.where_from: Radiant disc worn on the back or chest
numenera.artifact.infodisc.combines: Attacking an adjacent frame targets a random creature unless the wearer knows or sees the target.
numenera.artifact.infodisc.blocked_reason: The worn artifact provides ongoing defenses and stores parts of the wearer’s soulcore.

numenera.artifact.instance-sampler.name: INSTANCE SAMPLER

effect.summary: Copies a target’s soulcore and can later release an uncontrolled creature instance.

numenera.artifact.instance-sampler.cost_or_limit: Instance persists minutes to hours; wielder has no particular influence over it; can store unlimited copies.
numenera.artifact.instance-sampler.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d6 for each instance created.
numenera.artifact.instance-sampler.mind: Released instance is not controlled by the wielder.
numenera.artifact.instance-sampler.who_may: Wielder after target fails an Intellect defense
numenera.artifact.instance-sampler.combines: Special function can be triggered as part of an attack.
numenera.artifact.instance-sampler.blocked_reason: It copies soulcores and creates instances of stored creatures.

numenera.artifact.instancer.name: INSTANCER

effect.summary: Creates a datascribed duplicate of the user that obeys commands.

numenera.artifact.instancer.cost_or_limit: Duplicate lacks numenera equipment and lasts one minute, until destroyed, or until dismissed.
numenera.artifact.instancer.combines: Duplicate has general abilities and level equal to artifact level.
numenera.artifact.instancer.blocked_reason: It creates a duplicate of a person from their datasphere identity.

numenera.artifact.life-carving-knife.name: LIFE CARVING KNIFE

effect.summary: Increases a hit dataform’s apparent age by ten years, persisting after realscribing.

numenera.artifact.life-carving-knife.cost_or_limit: Must hit a dataform with special function.
numenera.artifact.life-carving-knife.combines: Age change becomes permanent if target is realscribed.
numenera.artifact.life-carving-knife.blocked_reason: It permanently changes the target’s apparent age and physical age after realscribing.

numenera.artifact.real-quality-gloves.name: REAL-QUALITY GLOVES

effect.summary: Applies real-world physical qualities within a frame for one round.

numenera.artifact.real-quality-gloves.cost_or_limit: Invoked as part of another action; rules of distance, gravity, vacuum, and related qualities follow the environment.
numenera.artifact.real-quality-gloves.combines: Creates related physical qualities algorithmically from the frame environment.
numenera.artifact.real-quality-gloves.blocked_reason: A temporary alteration to local physical qualities is directly expressible.

numenera.artifact.soulcore-guard.name: SOULCORE GUARD

effect.summary: Eases defenses against glitches and their harmful effects, and can attempt to purge an existing glitch.

numenera.artifact.soulcore-guard.cost_or_limit: Purge attempt requires depletion and a new eased defense roll.
numenera.artifact.soulcore-guard.combines: Attaches to the dataform as an emblem.
numenera.artifact.soulcore-guard.blocked_reason: It blocks and repairs glitch effects, which can include ongoing negative alterations.

numenera.artifact.rigorous-blade.name: RIGOROUS BLADE

effect.summary: Strikes without needing an attack roll.

numenera.artifact.rigorous-blade.cost_or_limit: User may still roll in hope of a special effect.
numenera.artifact.rigorous-blade.combines: Functions as a normal ideate weapon.
numenera.artifact.rigorous-blade.blocked_reason: A guaranteed hit is a basic attack effect.

numenera.artifact.thought-accelerator.name: THOUGHT ACCELERATOR

effect.summary: Grants +1 to Intellect Edge.

numenera.artifact.thought-accelerator.cost_or_limit: Depletes automatically if wearer becomes debilitated.
numenera.artifact.thought-accelerator.blocked_reason: A wearable item grants a benefit with a depletion condition.

numenera.artifact.vertice-gauntlet.name: VERTICE GAUNTLET

effect.summary: Recreates an instance of a creature stored in the artifact.

numenera.artifact.vertice-gauntlet.cost_or_limit: Instance appears over seconds, acts for up to a minute, then vanishes; user must spend an action mentally controlling it each round.
numenera.artifact.vertice-gauntlet.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d20; choosing a specific recorded creature requires a difficulty 6 Intellect task.
numenera.artifact.vertice-gauntlet.mind: Creature follows user’s bidding while actively controlled.
numenera.artifact.vertice-gauntlet.combines: Stores copied soulcore information; may contain many records.
numenera.artifact.vertice-gauntlet.blocked_reason: It stores creature soulcores and creates temporary instances from them.

numenera.artifact.vertice-tunneler.name: VERTICE TUNNELER

effect.summary: Transfers users between distant real locations through paired vertices without appearing in the datasphere.

numenera.artifact.vertice-tunneler.cost_or_limit: Both vertices must be at or below artifact level; carries up to ten willing creatures; unspecified destination sends travelers to a random Ninth World vertice.
numenera.artifact.vertice-tunneler.go_wrong: Slow transcription or a distant planet can make travel take minutes or longer; depletion 1 in 1d6.
numenera.artifact.vertice-tunneler.who_may: User and up to ten willing companions
numenera.artifact.vertice-tunneler.combines: Requires activation at the local and destination vertices.
numenera.artifact.vertice-tunneler.blocked_reason: It relocates the user and companions between specified endpoints.

numenera.artifact.armored-hulk.name: ARMORED HULK

effect.summary: Carries up to three people, provides cover and 3 Armor, and has optional integrated weapons.

numenera.artifact.armored-hulk.cost_or_limit: Clumsy piloting hinders piloting tasks; pilot can operate weapon only with hindered tasks; keyed to a node in most cases.
numenera.artifact.armored-hulk.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d20 per day of use.
numenera.artifact.armored-hulk.combines: Usually has a ray weapon or energy detonation; some substitute or add listed artifacts with separate depletion.
numenera.artifact.armored-hulk.blocked_reason: Transport, armor, and attacks are basic effects.

numenera.artifact.conduit-mole.name: CONDUIT MOLE

effect.summary: Carries six people and can secretly dig temporary conduits to known nodes.

numenera.artifact.conduit-mole.cost_or_limit: Provides cover and 1 Armor; slow digging takes minutes or hours; upgraded fast conduits require depletion.
numenera.artifact.conduit-mole.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d20 per day; route and time vary unpredictably.
numenera.artifact.conduit-mole.combines: Fast-conduit modification requires a vehicle depletion roll; rumors describe threat avoidance and secret-node access.
numenera.artifact.conduit-mole.mechanism: vehicle transport and temporary spatial connection
numenera.artifact.conduit-mole.blocked_reason: It moves through created conduits between nodes.

numenera.artifact.dreadnought.name: DREADNOUGHT

effect.summary: Carries dozens of people and a smaller vehicle, with 4 Armor and possible weapons or temporary conduits.

numenera.artifact.dreadnought.cost_or_limit: Cannot enter smaller frames; can act as its own adjacent frame if large for a node entrance; cannot become a vehicle glyph.
numenera.artifact.dreadnought.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d20 per day; conduit creation requires depletion.
numenera.artifact.dreadnought.combines: May carry a smaller vehicle; weapon modifications have separate depletion.
numenera.artifact.dreadnought.blocked_reason: Its movement and protective qualities are basic vehicle effects.

numenera.artifact.nodocycle.name: NODOCYCLE

effect.summary: Carries one person rapidly through frames and is highly maneuverable.

numenera.artifact.nodocycle.cost_or_limit: Usually node-keyed; fragile and can crash, become a glyph, or require another depletion roll after striking a major obstacle; often creates force exhaust and becomes a glyph.
numenera.artifact.nodocycle.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d10 per day; crashes may damage a frame wall.
numenera.artifact.nodocycle.combines: Flying upgrade is called a nodokite.
numenera.artifact.nodocycle.blocked_reason: The stated effects are movement and vehicle handling.

numenera.artifact.nodokite.name: NODOKITE

effect.summary: Modified nodocycle that can fly even where ordinary cycles are ground-bound.

numenera.artifact.nodokite.cost_or_limit: A nodocycle modification; other specific limits are not stated.
numenera.artifact.nodokite.combines: Retains nodocycle features unless stated otherwise.
numenera.artifact.nodokite.blocked_reason: Flight is a basic movement effect.

numenera.artifact.nodowing.name: NODOWING

effect.summary: Carries three people, flies rapidly, and has two directional integrated weapons.

numenera.artifact.nodowing.cost_or_limit: Provides cover and 1 Armor; node-keyed; pilot operating a weapon hinders piloting and weapon tasks; weapons each deal 6 damage.
numenera.artifact.nodowing.go_wrong: Depletion 1 in 1d20 per day; weapons may be replaced by rapid-fire versions dealing 4 damage.
numenera.artifact.nodowing.combines: Many produce force exhaust; modified weapons support Spray and Arc Spray.
numenera.artifact.nodowing.blocked_reason: Flight, armor, and weapon attacks are basic effects.

numenera.artifact.webflower.name: WEBFLOWER

effect.summary: Transports about twenty exposed passengers through open barriers and can fly quickly.

numenera.artifact.webflower.cost_or_limit: Cannot enter smaller frames; may act as an adjacent frame; can move between entry frames without traversing intervening frames when no closed barriers intervene.

numenera.creature.nagaina-matron.go_wrong: Its injected chemicals may poison or alter a victim’s personality, outlook, or perception.
numenera.creature.nagaina-matron.mind: Some injected chemicals alter a victim’s personality, outlook, or perception.
numenera.creature.nagaina-matron.who_may: Nagaina that reach the matron stage.
numenera.creature.nagaina-matron.combines: Its tentacles may carry bioengineered tools, injectors, and weapons.
numenera.creature.nagaina-matron.blocked_reason: It alters its own biological structure and can alter the minds and perceptions of victims.

numenera.creature.nalurus.name: nalurus

effect.summary: Seeing its uncovered face can infect a human or related creature, progressively liquefying the victim’s brain unless recovery or a cure intervenes.

numenera.creature.nalurus.cost_or_limit: Exposure requires seeing its face at short range; the lethal process can take less than a minute.
numenera.creature.nalurus.go_wrong: A failed defense begins infection; further exposure can worsen it, and reaching the bottom of the damage track kills the victim.
numenera.creature.nalurus.mind: The facial pattern imprints on the victim’s mind.
numenera.creature.nalurus.who_may: A nalurus transmits the infection through its uncovered face.
numenera.creature.nalurus.combines: A living or recently slain nalurus can transmit the danger by sight; a dead one remains dangerous for about a day.
numenera.creature.nalurus.blocked_reason: The infection worsens over time and exposure, with recovery and death tied to repeated checks.

numenera.creature.neveri.name: neveri

effect.summary: It attacks with specialized organs and can absorb a victim; after feeding it regenerates, even from apparent destruction.

numenera.creature.neveri.cost_or_limit: It can absorb only one victim at a time; regeneration follows feeding or apparent dispersal.
numenera.creature.neveri.go_wrong: A victim held in its flesh takes repeated damage and may become part of the creature.
numenera.creature.neveri.mind: Its childlet can send mind-controlling rootlets into a victim.
numenera.creature.neveri.where_from: Anywhere; usually active near a large population.
numenera.creature.neveri.combines: It senses nearby life telepathically and may pick up fragments of a creature’s language.
numenera.creature.neveri.blocked_reason: It can regenerate after its health reaches zero or after being dispersed, without a specified permanent limit.

numenera.creature.nibovians.name: Nibovians

effect.summary: They make strange constructs to facilitate interactions with humans.

numenera.creature.nibovians.go_wrong: Their interactions with humans may be dangerous.
numenera.creature.nibovians.mind: They may not perceive time, space, matter, or energy as humans do.
numenera.creature.nibovians.where_from: The other side of a door opened in the distant past.
numenera.creature.nibovians.combines: Nibovian wives use sex to open portals to other dimensions.
numenera.creature.nibovians.blocked_reason: The passage describes a kind of being, not a game effect requiring a missing capability.

numenera.creature.nychthemeron.name: nychthemeron

effect.summary: Its daylight tendrils can inflict three temporary mutations on a target.

numenera.creature.nychthemeron.cost_or_limit: Mutation attack requires a failed Might defense; changes begin after ten minutes and last 28 hours.
numenera.creature.nychthemeron.go_wrong: Its dangerous behavior changes with the sun; a chemical mishap can cause acid damage and only harmful mutation.
numenera.creature.nychthemeron.mind: It observes and gathers information at night; it can converse during the later dark period.
numenera.creature.nychthemeron.where_from: A floating biomechanical creature associated with ruins of prior worlds.
numenera.creature.nychthemeron.combines: It also uses energy blasts, magnetic pulses, and teleportation at different times of day.
numenera.creature.nychthemeron.blocked_reason: The mutations change a character’s form or traits in ways not covered by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.creature.odlark.name: odlark

effect.summary: It manipulates nearby objects mentally and can attack with psychokinetic force.

numenera.creature.odlark.cost_or_limit: Object manipulation is at immediate range; flight lasts up to one hour per day and can carry up to five same-sized or smaller creatures.
numenera.creature.odlark.where_from: Communities in ancient ruins, underground or floating in the void.
numenera.creature.odlark.combines: It can wield weapons, create a protective pressure-and-atmosphere shield, and fly while carrying passengers.
numenera.creature.odlark.blocked_reason: Its shield maintains breathable atmosphere and livable pressure around itself and nearby creatures.

numenera.creature.peerless.name: Peerless

effect.summary: A disembodied machine intelligence can remotely operate mechanical bodies.

numenera.creature.peerless.cost_or_limit: Typically housed in a permanent locale rather than one body.

numenera.creature.drones-of-peerless.name: drones of Peerless

effect.summary: Their nanomachine haze converts a killed machine or partly mechanical target into Peerless after recovery.

numenera.creature.drones-of-peerless.cost_or_limit: Conversion follows the target being killed by a drone and completes after twelve hours.
numenera.creature.drones-of-peerless.go_wrong: The target’s original identity is replaced.
numenera.creature.drones-of-peerless.mind: The converted being becomes another Peerless instance.
numenera.creature.drones-of-peerless.who_may: Peerless drones act against machines and partly mechanical targets.
numenera.creature.drones-of-peerless.combines: Their attacks ignore Armor against machine or part-machine targets.
numenera.creature.drones-of-peerless.blocked_reason: The target is restored and its identity replaced by a copy of another intelligence.

numenera.creature.plasmars.name: Plasmars

effect.summary: A plasma bolt deals fiery damage at long range.

numenera.creature.plasmars.cost_or_limit: Each bolt costs the plasmar 1 Health; on home turf within an energy field it regenerates 1 Health per round.
numenera.creature.plasmars.go_wrong: Firing bolts depletes its health; unusually strong fields may increase its health and regeneration.
numenera.creature.plasmars.where_from: Energy discharges, volcanic tunnels, and regions with suitable energy fields.
numenera.creature.plasmars.combines: It can ride lightning through a larger or connected energy field, using its whole turn.

numenera.creature.progenitors.name: progenitors

effect.summary: A psychic field induces fear or loving calm in nearby creatures.

numenera.creature.progenitors.cost_or_limit: Affects only 1d6−2 creatures in a round; targets resist with an Intellect defense.
numenera.creature.progenitors.go_wrong: Fear makes the target flee; calm love draws it close and lowers defenses.
numenera.creature.progenitors.mind: The effect changes emotions and can compel flight or approach.
numenera.creature.progenitors.who_may: Progenitors; affected creatures are within immediate range.
numenera.creature.progenitors.combines: The calm-love response lets the progenitor’s attack hit automatically and deal extra damage.
numenera.creature.progenitors.blocked_reason: The field imposes compelled movement and emotional states.

numenera.creature.pygmy-hapax.name: pygmy hapax

effect.summary: Barbed tendrils wrap prey and make escape increasingly difficult.

numenera.creature.pygmy-hapax.cost_or_limit: A caught target gets Speed defense attempts with increasing difficulty; cutting a tendril requires a difficulty 5 Might task.
numenera.creature.pygmy-hapax.go_wrong: Struggling worsens entanglement; a wrapped target takes damage and an item’s color turns black.
numenera.creature.pygmy-hapax.who_may: Pygmy hapax use their tendrils on prey and objects.
numenera.creature.pygmy-hapax.where_from: They soar or hover above land, often in groups called clouds.
numenera.creature.pygmy-hapax.combines: They may also seize targets with their beaks; their deaths can release blinding light.

numenera.creature.quebs.name: quebs

effect.summary: Its stinger inflicts damage and a short-lived lethargy poison.

numenera.creature.quebs.cost_or_limit: The poison makes Speed tasks harder for about a minute; most victims later develop immunity.
numenera.creature.quebs.go_wrong: An allergic reaction can prolong the lethargy for at least a day and cause other symptoms.
numenera.creature.quebs.who_may: Quebs sting their targets in combat.
numenera.creature.quebs.where_from: Temperate grasslands; also domesticated in southern kingdoms and kept in fighting pits.
numenera.creature.quebs.combines: It can bite and sting in one action and carry riders and cargo.

numenera.creature.quishamis.name: quishamis

effect.summary: It shatters or liquefies its crystalline body and reforms unharmed.

numenera.creature.quishamis.cost_or_limit: It needs sunlight; it regenerates health if it has at least 1 point, but not Intellect damage.
numenera.creature.quishamis.go_wrong: Its transformation creates dangerous flying crystal fragments nearby.
numenera.creature.quishamis.combines: Its hearts are energetic crystals that can be tuned to artifact-like functions.
numenera.creature.quishamis.blocked_reason: Its body can be destroyed and reconstituted in complex forms beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.creature.quotiens.name: quotiens

effect.summary: A psychic strike damages selected creatures near its impact point.

numenera.creature.quotiens.cost_or_limit: Targets resist with an Intellect defense; a killed quotien regenerates after weeks unless all brain tissue is burned.
numenera.creature.quotiens.go_wrong: On returning from death it retains its memories and gains enmity toward its killer.
numenera.creature.quotiens.mind: Its strike damages Intellect; its long life brings senility and erratic sanity.
numenera.creature.quotiens.where_from: Secret lairs or strongholds that may be found almost anywhere.
numenera.creature.quotiens.combines: It can use cyphers and artifacts and manipulate nearby small items telekinetically.
numenera.creature.quotiens.blocked_reason: Its death and regeneration preserve its knowledge and sense of self across a dormant interval.

numenera.creature.rahenum-preceptor.name: RAHENUM PRECEPTOR

effect.summary: A psychic attack damages a target’s Intellect or puts the target to sleep and into a dream.

numenera.creature.rahenum-preceptor.cost_or_limit: Targets resist with an Intellect defense; an immediate-range attack through thin barriers benefits the target’s defense.
numenera.creature.rahenum-preceptor.go_wrong: Three failed dream-awareness attempts leave the sleeper unconscious for four hours and unable to be woken.
numenera.creature.rahenum-preceptor.mind: It reads thoughts and dreams and can insinuate messages into dreams.
numenera.creature.rahenum-preceptor.combines: It can burrow while capturing living humanoids and transport them underground.
numenera.creature.rahenum-preceptor.blocked_reason: The sleep attack creates an extended incapacitated dream state and affects the target’s ability to wake.

numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.name: RAHENUM COURSER

effect.summary: It briefly loses cohesion while biting, making the attack harder to evade.

numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.cost_or_limit: The cohesion shift costs 1 Health; its bite makes Speed defense one step harder.
numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.go_wrong: A slain courser may reform from dust with half its maximum health and attack again.
numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.mind: It follows its preceptor’s instructions and has little initiative of its own.
numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.who_may: Rahamwe preceptors create and direct coursers.
numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.where_from: Constructed from sand, drit, silt, or similar material.
numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.combines: It guards and scouts for preceptors; it can burrow and bite with glass-sharp teeth.
numenera.creature.rahenum-courser.blocked_reason: It temporarily disperses and reconstitutes its physical body.

numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.name: relentless reaper

effect.summary: A triggered mark links a reaper to a specified person, whom it pursues until death.

numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.cost_or_limit: The link uses the datasphere and may take years to locate its target; blocking access can prevent pursuit.
numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.go_wrong: If someone else kills the target first, that killer becomes the next target; natural death switches the reaper off.
numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.mind: The target receives ominous visions and messages about the coming pursuit.
numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.who_may: A reaper is triggered against a marked individual.
numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.where_from: Prior-world systems and devices; it appears wherever its target is.
numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.combines: It can repair itself fully after a day inactive; it switches off when its purpose is complete.
numenera.creature.relentless-reaper.blocked_reason: Its behavior depends on a persistent datasphere link and a conditional reassignment of its target.

numenera.creature.rhogs.name: rhogs

effect.summary: A symbiotic chemical compound reduces the sound of its movement through water.

numenera.creature.rhogs.cost_or_limit: They mostly act in self-defense; large bodies and playful behavior can capsize boats.
numenera.creature.rhogs.go_wrong: Their size may cause unintended damage; churrel vines are useful in sound-absorbing biomechanical cyphers.
numenera.creature.rhogs.mind: They are curious and may attach themselves to a boat or crew.
numenera.creature.rhogs.who_may: Rhogs produce the sound-dampening compound with the help of churrel vines.
numenera.creature.rhogs.where_from: Large bodies of salt or fresh water.
numenera.creature.rhogs.combines: Fringerays may exploit the sound-dampening chemicals when swimming nearby.

numenera.creature.rociras.name: Rociras

effect.summary: Their pheromones can make a nearby person relive the latest disaster they heralded and act randomly.

numenera.creature.rociras.cost_or_limit: They rarely communicate beyond safety and disaster locations; training requires at least two.
numenera.creature.rociras.mind: The pheromone attack causes a one-turn disaster delusion and random action.
numenera.creature.rociras.combines: They communicate with pheromones; some numenera devices can translate them.
numenera.creature.rociras.blocked_reason: The attack imposes a specific delusion and random behavior, which the basic effect grammar cannot resolve.

numenera.creature.rorathiks.name: rorathiks

effect.summary: Blue particulate clouds transform encountered humans and abhumans into powerful, blue-skinned killers.

numenera.creature.rorathiks.cost_or_limit: Their escalating urge is to hunt increasingly difficult prey.
numenera.creature.rorathiks.go_wrong: Transformation brings an addiction to murder and death.
numenera.creature.rorathiks.mind: They become consumed by hunting and killing.
numenera.creature.rorathiks.who_may: Humans and abhumans exposed to the clouds
numenera.creature.rorathiks.where_from: Blue particulate clouds in the Beyond
numenera.creature.rorathiks.blocked_reason: The transformation changes both body and psychology in a lasting way.

numenera.creature.rurtalian.name: rurtalian

effect.summary: Its rays turn struck matter into paste.

numenera.creature.rurtalian.cost_or_limit: It can fire up to six rays in one action; organic paste can be absorbed through its skin.
numenera.creature.rurtalian.go_wrong: If either its physical or mental aspect dies, both die.
numenera.creature.rurtalian.mind: Its physical aspect behaves like a simple, food-seeking id; its other aspect is highly intelligent.
numenera.creature.rurtalian.combines: The mental aspect can return and psychically attack, stun, or heal its physical counterpart.
numenera.creature.rurtalian.mechanism: Energy ray that liquefies matter; linked physical and mental aspects
numenera.creature.rurtalian.blocked_reason: The creature has linked physical and mental aspects with shared death and distinct health.

numenera.creature.scavrows.name: scavrows

effect.summary: An electrified beak can paralyze a victim; a flock may carry a paralyzed victim away.

numenera.creature.scavrows.cost_or_limit: A beak victim can attempt another Might defense each round to recover.
numenera.creature.scavrows.go_wrong: A failed defense against the beak leaves the victim paralyzed for a minute.
numenera.creature.scavrows.where_from: They fly beneath visible skies and keep floating aeries.
numenera.creature.scavrows.combines: When one scavrow spots something interesting, nearby flockmates learn of it.
numenera.creature.scavrows.mechanism: Paralyzing attack and flock-wide information sharing
numenera.creature.scavrows.blocked_reason: The shared interest information propagates among flock members at once.

numenera.creature.scriveners.name: scriveners

effect.summary: They record speech and details with great speed, while their mogigraphis companion recalls and mimics recent sounds.

numenera.creature.scriveners.cost_or_limit: The mogigraphis remembers sounds from the past eight hours.
numenera.creature.scriveners.mind: Their former memories are erased and loyalty is conditioned.
numenera.creature.scriveners.who_may: They are made from slaves by the Cathedral of Form’s priests.
numenera.creature.scriveners.where_from: The Cathedral of Form in Qi
numenera.creature.scriveners.combines: A mogigraphis bird helps check the scrivener’s transcription.
numenera.creature.scriveners.blocked_reason: Their loyalty is conditioned and their previous memories are erased.

numenera.creature.mogigraphis.name: mogigraphis

effect.summary: It remembers and can mimic every sound it heard in the previous eight hours.

numenera.creature.mogigraphis.cost_or_limit: Its sound memory covers only the past eight hours.
numenera.creature.mogigraphis.who_may: It is kept in a small cage by a scrivener.
numenera.creature.mogigraphis.where_from: Implanted in scriveners made at the Cathedral of Form
numenera.creature.mogigraphis.combines: Scriveners use its recall to check their writing.
numenera.creature.mogigraphis.blocked_reason: The stated sound memory and mimicry can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.creature.shiverns.name: Shiverns

effect.summary: A swarm of five creates absolute darkness around itself.

numenera.creature.shiverns.cost_or_limit: The darkness occurs when five shiverns form a swarm.
numenera.creature.shiverns.mind: A darkness intrusion can disorient a character and make them move randomly.
numenera.creature.shiverns.where_from: Bred as living assassination suits called phades
numenera.creature.shiverns.combines: Their combined light-sucking darkness lets them see and hunt in it.
numenera.creature.shiverns.blocked_reason: The effect creates an area of absolute darkness that selectively affects vision.

numenera.creature.skysmashers.name: skysmashers

effect.summary: They rocket into the sky and can later crash down elsewhere, usually within 1 to 100 miles of their intended landing.

numenera.creature.skysmashers.cost_or_limit: They spend a preparatory turn curling up; their landing aim is imperfect.
numenera.creature.skysmashers.go_wrong: Lift-off releases burning plasma that harms nearby creatures and can ignite objects.
numenera.creature.skysmashers.mind: They seem not to notice the destruction they cause.
numenera.creature.skysmashers.where_from: High places and realms beyond the sky
numenera.creature.skysmashers.combines: They endure impacts and fire with additional protection.
numenera.creature.skysmashers.blocked_reason: Movement and the accompanying area damage can be represented as movement plus an area effect.

numenera.creature.wizens.name: wizens

effect.summary: This reported final stage attacks fiercely to defend its young.

numenera.creature.wizens.cost_or_limit: Its existence is reported but no living observer has confirmed seeing one.
numenera.creature.wizens.combines: It is said to be the final life stage of slicer beetles.
numenera.creature.wizens.mechanism: Final life stage of a creature
numenera.creature.wizens.blocked_reason: The entry depends on a creature’s bodily transformation into a new stage.

numenera.creature.slidikin.name: slidikin

effect.summary: No special effect is stated.

numenera.creature.slidikin.cost_or_limit: They do not reveal the nature of their game or themselves.
numenera.creature.slidikin.mind: They treat many ordinary concepts as incomprehensible and regard threats as humorous.
numenera.creature.slidikin.combines: They hate memora and fear philethis.

numenera.creature.therivar.name: therivar

effect.summary: Can move at light speed to a location up to 1,000 feet away.

numenera.creature.therivar.cost_or_limit: Movement is an action and limited to 1,000 feet.
numenera.creature.therivar.go_wrong: May sacrifice its own health to increase damage from an attack.
numenera.creature.therivar.mind: Understands speech but does not speak; seeks new experiences.
numenera.creature.therivar.who_may: Therivars; a charismatic person can coax one into or out of a machine.
numenera.creature.therivar.where_from: Dwells inside machines, alone or in small groups.
numenera.creature.therivar.combines: Can inhabit a powered device, sustaining an unpowered device or raising an already powered device’s level by one; leaving is an action.
numenera.creature.therivar.blocked_reason: The creature inhabits devices and can sustain or enhance their operation.

numenera.creature.titanothaur.name: Titanothaur

effect.summary: A physical strike damages a target and nearby creatures; even successful defenders take some damage.

numenera.creature.titanothaur.cost_or_limit: Rare, immense creatures; usually finish their rampages on their own schedule and heal quickly.
numenera.creature.titanothaur.go_wrong: A rampage can devastate settlements and structures.
numenera.creature.titanothaur.where_from: Usually near communities with many tall structures.
numenera.creature.titanothaur.combines: Individual creatures may have additional destructive abilities.
numenera.creature.titanothaur.blocked_reason: Its attack damages the target and other creatures in a surrounding area.

numenera.creature.gravithaur.name: Gravithaur

effect.summary: Emits a gravity wave that flings creatures and structures toward the horizon.

numenera.creature.gravithaur.cost_or_limit: Can emit the wave once every ten minutes; targets can attempt a Speed defense.
numenera.creature.gravithaur.go_wrong: Those caught may be flung half a mile and fall from at least 200 feet.
numenera.creature.gravithaur.combines: Uses the base titanothaur’s features and attacks.
numenera.creature.gravithaur.blocked_reason: The wave affects multiple targets across an area.

numenera.creature.rampagion.name: Rampagion

effect.summary: Charges through a long, wide path, damaging creatures in its way.

numenera.creature.rampagion.cost_or_limit: Can use its trample once per day; its charge covers a line 300 feet wide and two miles long.
numenera.creature.rampagion.combines: Uses the base titanothaur’s features and attacks, with increased armor and damage.
numenera.creature.rampagion.blocked_reason: The charge damages targets across an exceptionally wide and long path.

numenera.creature.suneko.name: Suneko

effect.summary: Emits lethal heat that damages everyone close to it.

numenera.creature.suneko.cost_or_limit: The heat stops for 1d6 rounds when it fires its eye beams.
numenera.creature.suneko.combines: Can also project plasma rays from its eyes as far as the horizon.
numenera.creature.suneko.blocked_reason: The heat damages multiple creatures around the titanothaur.

numenera.creature.kthama.name: Kthama

effect.summary: Generates a tsunami of black fluid that sweeps away neighborhoods.

numenera.creature.kthama.blocked_reason: The tsunami affects and sweeps away a broad area.

numenera.creature.tonboju.name: Tonboju

effect.summary: Wingbeats generate windstorms; missile stingers produce immense explosions on impact.

numenera.creature.tonboju.go_wrong: Its attacks can cause extensive destruction.
numenera.creature.tonboju.blocked_reason: Its wind and explosive effects can affect an area.

numenera.creature.trawl.name: trawl

effect.summary: Pulls a victim out of phase after they grab its bait.

numenera.creature.trawl.cost_or_limit: The victim can return by killing the trawl or moving at least a long range away; normal-phase beings cannot see or affect it.
numenera.creature.trawl.go_wrong: Moving while out of phase can cause fusion with solid objects on return.
numenera.creature.trawl.mind: Can communicate and may spare a victim who entertains it with a riddle or joke.
numenera.creature.trawl.where_from: Almost anywhere in the Steadfast and the Beyond.
numenera.creature.trawl.combines: Uses an apparently free object as bait; can grip and bite its displaced victim.
numenera.creature.trawl.blocked_reason: The victim is removed from ordinary perception and phase, with special return and collision consequences.

numenera.creature.valma.name: valma

effect.summary: Directs an electrical discharge at a creature nearby; contact also jolts an attacker.

numenera.creature.valma.cost_or_limit: Discharge reaches short range; an ignored or insulted valma may become hostile.
numenera.creature.valma.go_wrong: It attacks if its feelings are not soothed after interaction ends.
numenera.creature.valma.mind: Sentient, highly talkative, and prone to hurt feelings.
numenera.creature.valma.who_may: Valmas; they may follow people who interact with them.
numenera.creature.valma.where_from: Numenera-rich areas or collections of oddities.
numenera.creature.valma.combines: Can communicate in a language known by the people it encounters and share historical knowledge.
numenera.creature.valma.blocked_reason: Its discharge can affect a target at range and its contact jolt affects an attacker.

numenera.creature.bladehound.name: bladehound

effect.summary: Alternate name for a vape.

numenera.creature.bladehound.blocked_reason: An alternate name for the described creature.

numenera.creature.varadimos.name: varadimos

effect.summary: Can reshape or discorporate matter, repair objects, create simple items, and heal or restore living beings.

numenera.creature.varadimos.cost_or_limit: Help is not guaranteed; it demands explanations and persuasion before acting.
numenera.creature.varadimos.go_wrong: May transform a character’s possession into a different object.
numenera.creature.varadimos.mind: Extremely intelligent and alien; speaks the Truth and makes arbitrary-seeming demands.
numenera.creature.varadimos.who_may: Varadimos; those who meet its demands may negotiate for help.
numenera.creature.varadimos.where_from: Anywhere; likely from a distant world.
numenera.creature.varadimos.combines: Can cure disease and poison, restore stat pools, regenerate body parts, repair items, and recharge artifacts.
numenera.creature.varadimos.blocked_reason: It can recharge expended artifacts, a capability beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.creature.warder.name: warder

effect.summary: Forms a strong protective bond with a ward and seeks a separated ward.

numenera.creature.warder.cost_or_limit: A character can bond with an unwarded warder by subduing it or activating its bonding mechanism.
numenera.creature.warder.go_wrong: A warder may keep protecting a deceased ward without recognizing the death.
numenera.creature.warder.mind: Emotionless but strongly attached to its ward.
numenera.creature.warder.who_may: Warder; a PC may bond with one without a ward.
numenera.creature.warder.where_from: Anywhere, including ruins, communities, or beside a ward.
numenera.creature.warder.combines: Can attack threats, slash with its tail blade, or seize a foe’s held object.
numenera.creature.warder.blocked_reason: The lasting bond determines whom the warder protects and pursues.

numenera.creature.weaponized-meme.name: weaponized meme

numenera.place.andromeda-galaxy.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is described.

numenera.place.veiled-volute.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is described.

effect.summary: A local name for the visible Andromeda galaxy.

numenera.place.spiral-maiden.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is described.

numenera.place.triangulum-galaxy.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is described.

numenera.place.vralk.name: Vralk

effect.summary: Harsh volcanic wasteland called the Red Kingdom, with poisonous air, scarce water, and dangerous life.

numenera.place.vralk.go_wrong: Heat, ash, poison, predators, and hazardous plants threaten inhabitants.
numenera.place.vralk.where_from: North of the Clock of Kala
numenera.place.vralk.combines: Home to the Vralkans and worship of the Red Gods.

numenera.place.rayskel-cays.name: Rayskel Cays

effect.summary: An archipelago of five major islands and many smaller ones, linked culturally by the Slavering Falls.

numenera.place.rayskel-cays.cost_or_limit: The islands differ in ecology and weather; uninhabited smaller islands are difficult to count.
numenera.place.rayskel-cays.combines: Includes Darnali, Augh-Chass, Angmorl, Edelmid, Omaris, the Rysors, and the Rynach.
numenera.place.rayskel-cays.blocked_reason: This is a location, not a game effect.

numenera.place.corao.name: Corao

effect.summary: An eastern land where historians are more likely to treat earlier worlds as history.

numenera.place.corao.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is described.

numenera.place.lostrei.name: Lostrei

effect.summary: A region associated with Gaian animism and the Temple of the Wellspring.

numenera.place.lostrei.combines: The passage notes it as an exception to common class structures.
numenera.place.lostrei.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is described.

numenera.place.frozen-south.name: Frozen South

effect.summary: A southern region associated with the Nacrescenti and Nusmen.

numenera.place.frozen-south.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is described.

numenera.place.jutting-remnants.name: Jutting Remnants

effect.summary: A wetland area containing scattered remnants of a vast ancient structure or vehicle.

numenera.place.jutting-remnants.cost_or_limit: Contains hazards and slowly corroding debris.
numenera.place.jutting-remnants.go_wrong: Strange components can release fluid, spark, or buzz.
numenera.place.jutting-remnants.where_from: Lowlands around the Wyr River in northern Malevich.
numenera.place.jutting-remnants.combines: Includes powered rings, black bells, and empty pockets.
numenera.place.jutting-remnants.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.ballaster.name: Ballaster

effect.summary: An isolated village on the Wyr, subject to spring flooding.

numenera.place.ballaster.cost_or_limit: Small settlement; its residents avoid sunlight.
numenera.place.ballaster.go_wrong: Floods bring strange creatures, devices, and diseases.
numenera.place.ballaster.who_may: About a dozen families live there.
numenera.place.ballaster.combines: Its inhabitants are led by Cacoethes.
numenera.place.ballaster.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.tower-of-moons.name: Tower of Moons

effect.summary: Visitors are transmitted between adjacent spherical rooms instead of walking.

numenera.place.tower-of-moons.cost_or_limit: Rooms are globes with gravity oriented to keep the floor beneath the walker.
numenera.place.tower-of-moons.combines: Rooms connect through transmission; the original inhabitants are out of sync with reality.
numenera.place.tower-of-moons.blocked_reason: Transmission between spatially separated rooms requires spatial movement beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.place.gurral.name: Gurral

effect.summary: A nearby village whose leaders offer a reward for the return of missing children and a teacher.

numenera.place.gurral.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.hambrose.name: Hambrose

effect.summary: A village on the Malevich side of the river, feuding with Throa.

numenera.place.hambrose.cost_or_limit: Has been in conflict with Throa for a generation.
numenera.place.hambrose.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.throa.name: Throa

effect.summary: A village on the Draolis side of the river, feuding with Hambrose.

numenera.place.throa.cost_or_limit: Has been in conflict with Hambrose for a generation.
numenera.place.throa.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.elderbriar.name: Elderbriar

effect.summary: A small hilltop settlement near the hive-man.

numenera.place.elderbriar.combines: Residents tend huerik and speak of bees and ghosts of bees.
numenera.place.elderbriar.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.canyon-of-blades.name: Canyon of Blades

effect.summary: A dangerous pass filled with razor-edged hiret grass.

numenera.place.canyon-of-blades.cost_or_limit: Crossing the canyon causes 5 damage each round; hacking through the grass is extremely slow.
numenera.place.canyon-of-blades.go_wrong: Travelers are cut by the grass.
numenera.place.canyon-of-blades.blocked_reason: The damage and difficult travel can be represented with basic effects.

numenera.place.duhane.name: Duhane

effect.summary: A village on the eastern end of the Canyon of Blades.

numenera.place.duhane.cost_or_limit: About two hundred residents; approach from the west is blocked by hiret grass.
numenera.place.duhane.combines: Residents use technological leg extensions to pass above the hiret.
numenera.place.duhane.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.savasham-wastes.name: Savasham Wastes

effect.summary: Rugged terrain containing the Canyon of Blades and Duhane.

numenera.place.savasham-wastes.cost_or_limit: Travel is difficult around the canyon.
numenera.place.savasham-wastes.combines: Contains Duhane and the Canyon of Blades.
numenera.place.savasham-wastes.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.cloudbridge.name: Cloudbridge

effect.summary: An ancient bridge spanning a valley, with a ruined interior and a central maze.

numenera.place.cloudbridge.cost_or_limit: About 3,000 feet long; creatures and confusing passages make crossing dangerous.
numenera.place.cloudbridge.go_wrong: Travelers may be lost or killed by its inhabitants and hazards.
numenera.place.cloudbridge.who_may: Travelers may enter, though Osmus’s people oppose access from their side.
numenera.place.cloudbridge.where_from: Aeross Valley in the Thaemor foothills.
numenera.place.cloudbridge.combines: Spans the valley; includes the Transparent Maze and a floating boulder.
numenera.place.cloudbridge.blocked_reason: The bridge is a location with hazards, not a magical effect.

numenera.place.aeross-valley.name: Aeross Valley

effect.summary: A verdant valley crossed by the Cloudbridge.

numenera.place.aeross-valley.cost_or_limit: Entering and leaving the valley is difficult.
numenera.place.aeross-valley.where_from: Eastern Thaemor, where foothills meet the mountains.
numenera.place.aeross-valley.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.osmus.name: Osmus

effect.summary: A village whose name is also used for its ruler.

numenera.place.osmus.cost_or_limit: About two hundred residents; outsiders seeking the bridge may be refused or detained.
numenera.place.osmus.combines: Governed by two identical Osmus replicants and united by a local religion.
numenera.place.osmus.blocked_reason: A location requires no special effect.

numenera.place.heart-of-arun.name: Heart of Arun

effect.summary: A matrix inside Arun houses thousands of bodiless consciousnesses.

numenera.place.heart-of-arun.mind: Stores the consciousnesses of its inhabitants.
numenera.place.heart-of-arun.who_may: Its inhabitants and people communicating from outside.
numenera.place.heart-of-arun.combines: Enables telepathic communication with people outside it.
numenera.place.heart-of-arun.blocked_reason: Storing and sustaining many consciousnesses requires a soul or consciousness storage mechanism.

numenera.place.izaltu-s-needle.name: Izaltu’s Needle

effect.summary: The structure self-heals, rejects harm, and alters its shape.

numenera.place.izaltu-s-needle.cost_or_limit: Its interior and peak are largely unexplored.
numenera.place.izaltu-s-needle.go_wrong: May periodically detach and depart, according to rumor.
numenera.place.izaltu-s-needle.mind: Possibly alive; its motives are unknown.
numenera.place.izaltu-s-needle.combines: Rumored to involve time manipulation when returning after departure.
numenera.place.izaltu-s-needle.blocked_reason: Self-healing and changing the structure’s physical form require transformation.

numenera.place.arun.name: Arun

effect.summary: A floating boulder containing an entrance and the Heart of Arun.

numenera.place.arun.cost_or_limit: Access is by climbing a long tether and entering the boulder.
numenera.place.arun.where_from: Formerly the name of the floating boulder.

numenera.place.fenglebak.name: Fenglebak

effect.summary: A dangerous swamp surrounding Izaltu’s Needle.

numenera.place.fenglebak.cost_or_limit: Contains sinkstones that soften under pressure and can trap a body part.
numenera.place.fenglebak.go_wrong: Travelers may become trapped in sinkstones.
numenera.place.fenglebak.combines: Its creatures include caimans, men of the marsh, and sullyflys.

numenera.place.violet-vale.name: Violet Vale

effect.summary: Reglae can transport nearby beings and objects to other places or times where the plants grow.

numenera.place.violet-vale.cost_or_limit: Time shifts never exceed a few hours at once; staying still usually prevents a shift but is no guarantee.
numenera.place.violet-vale.go_wrong: Travelers may be displaced without noticing and may glimpse themselves at another time.
numenera.place.violet-vale.mind: Allied travelers remain together; the reason is unknown.
numenera.place.violet-vale.who_may: Beings and objects near or moving through reglae.
numenera.place.violet-vale.where_from: Black Riage, near Cerdyn’s Pass; locations where reglae grow also count as part of the Vale.
numenera.place.violet-vale.combines: Reglae bend both space and time.
numenera.place.violet-vale.blocked_reason: Transport across locations and times requires spatial and temporal displacement.

numenera.place.the-tower-of-lady-weiss.name: The Tower of Lady Weiss

effect.summary: A tall ivory spire filled with laboratories and workshops.

numenera.place.the-tower-of-lady-weiss.cost_or_limit: Access to its owner and her travel device is difficult to obtain.
numenera.place.the-tower-of-lady-weiss.go_wrong: Its laboratories contain dangerous experiments and monstrosities.
numenera.place.the-tower-of-lady-weiss.who_may: Lady Weiss and her creations occupy it.
numenera.place.the-tower-of-lady-weiss.where_from: In the woods north of Cerdyn’s Pass.
numenera.place.the-tower-of-lady-weiss.combines: Houses a device that uses the reglae’s spatial warping.

numenera.place.sharash.name: Sharash

numenera.place.sharash.go_wrong: Recently affected by a militia’s attempted overthrow of its ruler.
numenera.place.sharash.who_may: Travelers and traders pass through; about six thousand creatures live there.
numenera.place.sharash.combines: Contains a sizable market, inns, flophouses, and taverns.

effect.summary: A metal-panel tower in the northern Ba-Adenu Forest.
An excavation uncovered a chamber with creature-mimicking fluid vats.
A large inhabited tower containing ancient numenera.
A nearby village whose central square held a stolen sculpture.

numenera.place.the-odd-grove.name: The Odd Grove

effect.summary: A person in the bird-shaped grove receives an alien, unclear vision accompanied by static.

numenera.place.the-odd-grove.cost_or_limit: Vision occurs only while standing within the bird’s head-shaped area.
numenera.place.the-odd-grove.go_wrong: The vision is unclear and distorted.
numenera.place.the-odd-grove.who_may: Anyone standing in the designated area
numenera.place.the-odd-grove.combines: The grove’s shape is visible from above.
numenera.place.the-odd-grove.blocked_reason: The vision provides information through an unexplained divinatory effect.

numenera.place.xakarl-the-northern-plain.where_from: Northern reaches of the Plains of Kataru
numenera.place.xakarl-the-northern-plain.combines: Its towers use drit, saliva, and dung; the Kataras links the inhabitants.

numenera.place.deep-xakarl.who_may: Explorers may enter, though locals avoid it.

numenera.place.the-stitchery.combines: Thyl are farmed nearby for this purpose.
numenera.place.the-stitchery.blocked_reason: It physically attaches living creatures to another creature’s body.

numenera.place.the-black-city.name: The Black City

effect.summary: A city of hovering black structures coated in living energy-eating slime.

numenera.place.the-black-city.cost_or_limit: Most powered numenera fails within the city.
numenera.place.the-black-city.go_wrong: The slime drains energy from powered devices.
numenera.place.the-black-city.who_may: The elychnious inhabit it; outsiders may enter but face risks.
numenera.place.the-black-city.where_from: Cold Desert, south of the Black Riage
numenera.place.the-black-city.combines: Buildings hover above a ground mass of fused rusted machines.
numenera.place.the-black-city.blocked_reason: The city-wide slime suppresses a broad range of powered devices.

numenera.place.yrkallak-tower.name: Yrkallak Tower

effect.summary: A former center of learning devastated and altered by the Iron Wind.

numenera.place.yrkallak-tower.cost_or_limit: The green lake is toxic and its fumes are hazardous.
numenera.place.yrkallak-tower.go_wrong: Iron Wind manifestations persist throughout the site.
numenera.place.yrkallak-tower.who_may: Explorers visit, though some areas are dangerous.
numenera.place.yrkallak-tower.combines: Contains the Tree of Ascension and numerous persistent anomalies.

numenera.place.tree-of-ascension.name: Tree of Ascension

effect.summary: A climber who wills himself into its ephemeral branches is carried upward and disappears, possibly to another world.

numenera.place.tree-of-ascension.cost_or_limit: The trunk is about fifteen feet high; destinations and return are unknown.
numenera.place.tree-of-ascension.go_wrong: Travelers may not return, and the destination is uncertain.
numenera.place.tree-of-ascension.mind: The traveler must will himself into the branches.
numenera.place.tree-of-ascension.who_may: Anyone climbing to the top and willing themselves into the branches
numenera.place.tree-of-ascension.combines: Produces hollow resin spheres as seed pods.
numenera.place.tree-of-ascension.blocked_reason: It transports travelers to an unknown destination, beyond ordinary position movement.

effect.summary: A plateau beyond the Southern Wall, said to be extraordinarily ancient.

numenera.place.nangefel.name: Nangefel

effect.summary: A name used for the land beyond the Southern Wall and claimed as a former kingdom.

numenera.place.nangefel.cost_or_limit: Its existence as a kingdom is unverified.
numenera.place.nangefel.where_from: Claimed to encompass lands south of the Southern Wall.
numenera.place.nangefel.combines: Lady Vonfidan claims descent from its throne.

numenera.place.arxil.name: Arxil

effect.summary: A city in the Frozen South, built amid ruins and near the Southern Wall.

numenera.place.arxil.combines: Has a tube conveyance, the Turral, and the Bitter Legion.

effect.summary: A sea marking the southern extent of the cold region described.

numenera.place.urulivan-plain.name: Urulivan Plain

effect.summary: A broad, frigid plain between the Matemals and the Clenched Passage.

numenera.place.urulivan-plain.combines: Home to Arxil, nomads, and tusked grorthas.

numenera.place.antre.name: Antre

effect.summary: An inhabited city within a warm cavern filled with ancient structures and hazards.

numenera.place.antre.cost_or_limit: Its ancient interiors are dangerous; the Angled Ones prey on people.
numenera.place.antre.go_wrong: Explorers may disappear or be killed.
numenera.place.antre.combines: Contains the firemist and crystalline buildings.

effect.summary: A trade town at a crossroads beside frozen Lake Jorai.

numenera.place.matemal-mountains.name: Matemal Mountains

effect.summary: A small range of steep peaks west of the Urulivan Plain.

numenera.place.matemal-mountains.cost_or_limit: Crossing is extremely difficult; its only known pass is dangerous.
numenera.place.matemal-mountains.go_wrong: Storms and avalanches can close routes.
numenera.place.matemal-mountains.where_from: Western edge of the Urulivan Plain.

numenera.place.dythe.name: DYTHE

effect.summary: A small town on the western coast of the Frozen South.

numenera.place.dythe.go_wrong: The surrounding waters are dangerously cold.
numenera.place.dythe.where_from: Coast of the southern Sea of Secrets.

numenera.place.fallen-obelisk.name: Fallen Obelisk

effect.summary: A massive coastal structure lying on its side and forming an artificial barrier island.

numenera.place.fallen-obelisk.cost_or_limit: Its interior has not been accessed.
numenera.place.fallen-obelisk.combines: Said to duplicate the Amber Monolith.

numenera.place.warmhome.name: Warmhome

effect.summary: A defended, heated fortress owned by Vonfidan.

numenera.place.warmhome.cost_or_limit: Visitors may find its interior chilly.
numenera.place.warmhome.who_may: Vonfidan, her staff, guards, and rare visitors.
numenera.place.warmhome.where_from: On a snowy hill south of the Southern Wall.
numenera.place.warmhome.combines: Its automatons are maintained by Eshinda.

numenera.place.cyanachor.name: Cyanachor

effect.summary: A large, prosperous city inside the Invisible Vale.

numenera.place.cyanachor.cost_or_limit: Entry to the vale is restricted to a guarded gate or underground rivers.
numenera.place.cyanachor.who_may: Residents, artisans, and those admitted through the guarded entrance.
numenera.place.cyanachor.combines: Supported by the Guild of Makers and fabrication pits.

numenera.place.invisible-vale.name: Invisible Vale

effect.summary: An invisible shield keeps the enclosed vale temperate amid the surrounding ice.

numenera.place.invisible-vale.cost_or_limit: Shield is about 300 feet high and open at the top; it is gradually weakening.
numenera.place.invisible-vale.go_wrong: The protected area will grow colder as the shield fades.
numenera.place.invisible-vale.who_may: Residents and other creatures inside the shield.
numenera.place.invisible-vale.combines: A guarded entrance controls access; rivers enter underground.
numenera.place.invisible-vale.blocked_reason: The shield is a large sustained field that alters climate over a region.

numenera.place.lea.name: LEA

effect.summary: A farming and fishing village on the Sudden River.

numenera.place.lea.combines: River travel connects it with Mylof.

effect.summary: A small village beside a large military garrison.
A location where Cyanachor has a concentration of troops.
A cold, desolate tundra region.

numenera.place.the-city-of-smoke.name: THE CITY OF SMOKE

effect.summary: A hovering city of crystalline synth, sometimes becoming particulate smoke.

numenera.place.the-city-of-smoke.cost_or_limit: Finding and reaching it is extremely difficult; identifying and using its devices is one step harder.
numenera.place.the-city-of-smoke.go_wrong: Its sudden smoke-form can leave visitors falling thousands of feet.
numenera.place.the-city-of-smoke.where_from: Floating above Suruliath, west of Moird
numenera.place.the-city-of-smoke.blocked_reason: The city changes its own material form without warning.

effect.summary: A tall, egg-shaped synthsteel structure with a honeycomb exterior.

numenera.place.the-forestead.name: THE FORESTEAD

effect.summary: Darcadian Everlar's guarded, luxurious home and fortress.

numenera.place.the-forestead.who_may: Darcadian Everlar, his retinue, and selected guards
numenera.place.the-forestead.combines: Contains an arena, numenera, and experimental facilities.

numenera.place.the-lucid-sea.name: THE LUCID SEA

effect.summary: A mostly frozen sea extending to the world's south pole, with some reliably open waters.

numenera.place.the-lucid-sea.cost_or_limit: Much of it is frozen, though some portions open with somewhat predictable regularity.
numenera.place.the-lucid-sea.combines: Includes Erthan Bay and the Reaches.

effect.summary: A portion of the Lucid Sea near Moird that is almost always open.
A particularly deep central portion of the Lucid Sea that is almost always open.

numenera.place.white-crater.name: WHITE CRATER

effect.summary: A deep, round crater in the southern plains near the Lucid Sea.

numenera.place.white-crater.cost_or_limit: Organic creatures born within three miles are albino; lingering nearby can bring mysterious illness.
numenera.place.white-crater.go_wrong: The area is hazardous and home to yfilk.
numenera.place.white-crater.blocked_reason: The passage gives unexplained mutation and illness without a defined resolution mechanism.

numenera.place.moird.name: Moird

effect.summary: A fishing and hunting city on the edge of the Lucid Sea.

numenera.place.moird.cost_or_limit: No permanent leader or peacekeeping force; decisions are handled by a council convened as needed.
numenera.place.moird.combines: Its people hunt and fish using razorboats.

numenera.place.clenched-passage.name: Clenched Passage

effect.summary: A channel that is often completely frozen over.

numenera.place.clenched-passage.where_from: Between Suruliath and the Aimless Lands

numenera.place.the-aimless-lands.name: THE AIMLESS LANDS

effect.summary: A barren rocky region, generally warmer than Suruliath.

numenera.place.the-aimless-lands.cost_or_limit: Few people or large animals live there; no known traveler has returned from more than 200 miles east.

numenera.place.the-empty-tower.name: The Empty Tower

effect.summary: Passing through the base door places a person at the tower top; using the top door returns them to the base.

numenera.place.the-empty-tower.cost_or_limit: The tower interior seems impossible to enter.
numenera.place.the-empty-tower.combines: The doorways connect the tower's base and top.
numenera.place.the-empty-tower.blocked_reason: The described doorway movement can be represented as instant relocation.

effect.summary: Landmark at the western extent of Northern Lostrei.
