numenera.place.vonnai.go_wrong: Entrants and occupants cannot enter or leave after the doors lock.
numenera.place.vonnai.combines: Its lunar-powered entry doors admit people by day and lock at night.

numenera.place.kinider.name: Kinider

effect.summary: A largely underground village at Darnali’s southern tip.

numenera.place.kinider.cost_or_limit: Housing is constrained by exactly one hundred sinkers.
numenera.place.kinider.go_wrong: The seasonal Hale destroys nearby makeshift housing and may kill residents.

effect.summary: A peninsula on Darnali where Kinider and the Terrible Exhale are found.

numenera.place.terrible-exhale.name: Terrible Exhale

effect.summary: Exploding bubbles blast shrapnel across Goryl’s Breath and injure those caught outside.

numenera.place.terrible-exhale.cost_or_limit: May occur up to two dozen times a year and last from an hour to weeks.
numenera.place.terrible-exhale.go_wrong: Victims may lose Might, be stunned, or drop a damage step.
numenera.place.terrible-exhale.combines: Bubbles carry water and debris before bursting.
numenera.place.terrible-exhale.blocked_reason: The phenomenon inflicts variable ongoing damage throughout an area.

effect.summary: A settlement on the northwestern shore of Dyn’s Scar, chiefly the habitation of Trau Yad’s household and force.

numenera.place.watcher-s-row.name: Watcher’s Row

effect.summary: A coastal line of tall, mysterious machines on Augh-Chass.

numenera.place.watcher-s-row.cost_or_limit: The machines’ purpose and origin are unknown.
numenera.place.watcher-s-row.go_wrong: Touching one produces a deafening mental tone.
numenera.place.watcher-s-row.mind: The defensive tone is heard inside the mind.
numenera.place.watcher-s-row.combines: An obsessed settlement has grown beneath one machine.

numenera.place.acknyt.name: Acknyt

effect.summary: A ruin inhabited by the Racknage order.

numenera.place.acknyt.cost_or_limit: Its ancient structures have unusual angles, sharp inlaid points, and low ceilings.
numenera.place.acknyt.go_wrong: Some parts are hazardous or used for discipline and training.
numenera.place.acknyt.where_from: A sprawling ruin believed by its scholars to have once been a renowned university.
numenera.place.acknyt.combines: Contains the Tomb of the World and Ephemeral Ward.

numenera.place.tomb-of-the-world.name: Tomb of the World

effect.summary: A deep pit in Acknyt containing a floating orange globe.

numenera.place.tomb-of-the-world.cost_or_limit: The daily projection begins when the first shadow falls on the globe.
numenera.place.tomb-of-the-world.go_wrong: The projection can cause madness in some viewers.
numenera.place.tomb-of-the-world.who_may: Living creatures within a half-mile can be affected by the projection.
numenera.place.tomb-of-the-world.combines: Its globe projects hieroglyphs onto nearby living creatures.

numenera.place.ephemeral-ward.name: Ephemeral Ward

effect.summary: A special building where people afflicted by the mimicking disease are housed.

numenera.place.ephemeral-ward.cost_or_limit: Houses afflicted people until a cure is found.

numenera.place.maer-outpost.name: Maer Outpost

effect.summary: A coastal town and trading post built in the remains of a nyek.

numenera.place.maer-outpost.where_from: Founded by wreck survivors Garene, Tiage, and Maer.
numenera.place.maer-outpost.combines: The store occupies the creature’s remains.

numenera.place.grask-s-hoops.name: Grask’s Hoops

effect.summary: Vast circular structures of shifting, unusual soil covering Edelmid.

numenera.place.grask-s-hoops.cost_or_limit: The largest ring is over 200 miles across and rises about a mile above sea level.
numenera.place.grask-s-hoops.go_wrong: The material is hard when wet and flows in rivers when dry.
numenera.place.grask-s-hoops.combines: Crowns of Kavess grow in their central areas.

numenera.place.iseath.name: Iseath

effect.summary: An orderly military-style settlement led by Damor the Cleansed.

numenera.place.iseath.cost_or_limit: Designed for up to 10,000 inhabitants; it currently has fewer.
numenera.place.iseath.go_wrong: Army members are not allowed to leave once they join.
numenera.place.iseath.where_from: At the meeting of two large hoops and Edelmid’s shore.
numenera.place.iseath.combines: Includes farms, a kitchen, and an odd device that supplies warm water.

numenera.place.vatic-woods.name: Vatic Woods

effect.summary: A dense jungle of biogenetically enhanced trees that test entrants.

numenera.place.vatic-woods.go_wrong: Trees can block passage and attack those who refuse to leave.
numenera.place.vatic-woods.who_may: Entrants judged acceptable by the trees.

numenera.place.complex-of-the-carious.name: Complex of the Carious

numenera.place.complex-of-the-carious.combines: Run by a cete of 101 kathons; its upper lab level is made of solid light.

numenera.place.vesym.name: Vesym

effect.summary: A town known as Dog City, now ruled by a pack of canines.

numenera.place.the-rysors.name: The Rysors

numenera.place.great-reach.name: Great Reach

numenera.place.great-reach.go_wrong: Neither side has managed to seal the passage.

numenera.place.great-reach.combines: Creates a metaphysical border between Thaemor and Corao.
numenera.place.great-reach.blocked_reason: Instant movement between fixed locations is representable.

numenera.place.republic-of-bruul.name: Republic of Bruul

effect.summary: One of the five major lands in the eastern region.

numenera.place.republic-of-bruul.combines: One of the region’s distinct lands.

numenera.place.kingdom-of-zare.name: Kingdom of Zare

effect.summary: One of the five major lands in the eastern region.

numenera.place.kingdom-of-zare.combines: One of the region’s distinct lands.

numenera.place.majehm.name: Majehm

effect.summary: An inhuman land among the five regions of the Lands of the Dawn.

numenera.place.majehm.combines: The uraeyl speak their own tongue there.

numenera.place.sor-rumnar.name: Sor Rumnar

effect.summary: A scarred wilderness where reality, terrain, and living things are warped.

numenera.place.sor-rumnar.cost_or_limit: Travel is threatened by dangerous terrain, creatures, weather, and disease.
numenera.place.sor-rumnar.go_wrong: Creatures and landscapes may be distorted or unusually dangerous.
numenera.place.sor-rumnar.combines: Its environment includes the Endless Mire and Tenebre.
numenera.place.sor-rumnar.blocked_reason: The region’s broad, varied distortions of reality and life exceed the basic effect grammar.

effect.summary: Another name for the structure called the Ghost Mountain.

numenera.place.inner-palace.name: Inner Palace

effect.summary: The queen’s chambers, whose flowering-vine walls grow without sunlight.

numenera.place.inner-palace.combines: Vines are cultivated by specialized nano-sorcerers.

numenera.place.vo.name: Vo

effect.summary: A farming town below the Ghost Mountain.

numenera.place.vo.where_from: At the foot of the Crested Mountain.
numenera.place.vo.combines: Supplies food to the mountain city.

numenera.place.noreu.name: Noreu

effect.summary: A town whose population swells with pilgrims to the nearby healing pool.

numenera.place.noreu.combines: Contains the Pool of Aasalmis and lies near Castle Asteele.

effect.summary: Drinking or bathing heals a user like a recovery roll and cures diseases and toxins below level 8.

numenera.place.pool-of-aasalmis.cost_or_limit: About ten percent of users experience a random secondary effect.

numenera.place.castle-asteele.name: Castle Asteele

numenera.place.castle-asteele.cost_or_limit: Four towers stand on unusual rock outcroppings.
numenera.place.castle-asteele.go_wrong: Its floors move and make inhuman sounds.
numenera.place.castle-asteele.who_may: The Raveral family and their household.
numenera.place.castle-asteele.combines: The family’s battles often occur on bridges between towers.

numenera.place.forest-of-the-north.name: Forest of the North

effect.summary: A long, cold forest inhabited by many creatures and braguon bands.

numenera.place.forest-of-the-north.combines: Home to choropi, nargs, ravage bears, seskii, and braguon.

numenera.place.welioc.name: Welioc

effect.summary: A port town where most residents are possessed by brillimathis.

numenera.place.welioc.cost_or_limit: About three quarters of residents are possessed.
numenera.place.welioc.go_wrong: The beings turn violent if their secret is threatened.
numenera.place.welioc.mind: Many residents’ minds are subsumed by their possessing beings.
numenera.place.welioc.combines: Possession began after a flask from an ancient vault arrived.

numenera.place.the-great-reach.name: The Great Reach

effect.summary: A vast region between the Lands of the Dawn and the Steadfast.

numenera.place.the-great-reach.cost_or_limit: Crossing is difficult and rarely attempted.
numenera.place.the-great-reach.combines: A portal or tunnel is guarded by a camp.

numenera.place.tolema.name: Tolema

effect.summary: A walled town of herders and hunters under Duke Gurnant.

numenera.place.tolema.where_from: Wooded foothills of the Hidden Mountains.
numenera.place.tolema.combines: Contains the Cathedral of the Transfiguration.

numenera.place.cathedral-of-the-transfig.name: Cathedral of the Transfiguration

effect.summary: A stone disk and glass-plinth circle used for a recurring religious ceremony.

numenera.place.cathedral-of-the-transfig.go_wrong: The chosen one may be eliminated by nobles who dislike her pronouncements.

numenera.place.cathedral-of-the-transfig.who_may: Followers of the Transfigured God hold the ceremony.
numenera.place.cathedral-of-the-transfig.combines: A chosen woman mates with an arriving angel or interfaces with a machine-like entity.

effect.summary: Open grasslands dotted with villages and nomadic bands.

numenera.place.phorthust.name: Phorthust

effect.summary: A major, welcoming port and shipping center in Corao.

numenera.place.phorthust.combines: Connects sea trade with the Torels River.

numenera.place.torels-river.name: Torels River

effect.summary: A broad river accessible from Phorthust for moving goods.

numenera.place.torels-river.combines: Provides a trade route to Phorthust.

numenera.place.storui.name: Storui

numenera.place.storui.cost_or_limit: About 40,000 residents; the pit is about 3,000 feet across and deep.
numenera.place.storui.go_wrong: Lower levels are increasingly squalid and congested.
numenera.place.storui.combines: Contains sea caves, piers, and ancient conduits.

numenera.place.bay-of-peyclin.name: Bay of Peyclin

numenera.place.bay-of-peyclin.who_may: Octopi and other sea life inhabit it.
numenera.place.bay-of-peyclin.combines: Contains octopi communities and underwater sites.

numenera.place.the-scuttling-city.name: The Scuttling City

effect.summary: Coral-and-synth spheres shift along the ocean floor on mechanical tentacles.

numenera.place.the-scuttling-city.where_from: Ocean floor in the Bay of Peyclin.
numenera.place.the-scuttling-city.combines: Serves as a research and craft center.
numenera.place.the-scuttling-city.blocked_reason: Movement of the city can be represented as a basic position effect.

numenera.place.the-crystal-garden.name: The Crystal Garden

effect.summary: A jumble of natural crystals and bioluminescent fish cared for by octopi.

numenera.place.the-crystal-garden.who_may: Octopi tend the fish; visitors may view them.
numenera.place.the-crystal-garden.combines: Octopi use special goggles to transform the lights and colors.

numenera.place.guhaquah.name: Guhaquah

effect.summary: Coral-and-stone city with a central metal sphere, ruled by octopi.

numenera.place.guhaquah.cost_or_limit: The sphere’s interior is air-filled and gravity-free.
numenera.place.guhaquah.combines: Its council of eight merges into a fugue entity.

numenera.place.bruul.name: BRUUL

effect.summary: A state governed by an elected Nominated and a council of the Selected.

numenera.place.bruul.cost_or_limit: Its government uses interlocking checks and balances.

numenera.place.challister.name: Challister

effect.summary: Bruul’s capital and largest city, with a towering crystal-bearing plant.

numenera.place.challister.combines: Contains the University of Mhorom and the Crystalas.

numenera.place.daeroch.name: Daeroch

effect.summary: Bruul’s main military fortress and a town supporting its forces.

numenera.place.daeroch.combines: Forces prepare for possible conflict with Corao.

numenera.place.xome.name: Xome

numenera.place.xome.combines: A nearby tower contains monitoring equipment for the sphere.

numenera.place.klain.name: Klain

numenera.place.klain.cost_or_limit: About one in three births are twins, half of them conjoined.
numenera.place.klain.combines: Its mayor’s office is jointly held by Tyth and Erall.

numenera.place.gorah.name: Gorah

numenera.place.gorah.go_wrong: The statue is guarded after an attempt to destroy its devices.
numenera.place.gorah.mind: Many residents live as stored minds in a virtual world.
numenera.place.gorah.combines: Its immortality depends on the Keeper of Spirits.

numenera.place.arkall.name: Arkall

numenera.place.forest-of-razors.name: Forest of Razors

numenera.place.zare.name: Zare

numenera.place.zare.cost_or_limit: Its long war has limited its prosperity.
numenera.place.zare.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is needed to represent the location.

numenera.place.myeun-palace.name: Myeun Palace

numenera.place.sevron.name: Sevron

effect.summary: A village where objects have begun turning into serpentine creatures.

numenera.place.sevron.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is needed to represent the location.

numenera.place.imriche.name: Imriche

effect.summary: A declining Zare city known for foundries, forges, and its former prominence.

numenera.place.imriche.cost_or_limit: Much of the city is abandoned or decayed.
numenera.place.imriche.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is needed to represent the location.

numenera.place.ulae.name: Ulae

effect.summary: A frontier town attracting explorers and fortune-seekers.

numenera.place.ulae.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is needed to represent the location.

numenera.place.jorthei.name: Jorthei

numenera.place.jorthei.cost_or_limit: Residents must first solve the guarded maze to qualify; hidden entrances are available afterward.
numenera.place.jorthei.who_may: A self-selected group of experienced explorers and specialists.
numenera.place.jorthei.where_from: Built on a lake shore that sometimes has no lake.
numenera.place.jorthei.combines: Its security is supported by a maze, defenders, and hidden entrances.
numenera.place.jorthei.blocked_reason: The described protection and concealment can be represented with basic effects.

numenera.place.chostal.name: Chostal

numenera.place.chostal.combines: The domes protect the population; Qualla implants connect their minds.

numenera.place.erenush.name: Erenush

numenera.place.erenush.cost_or_limit: No other creatures are known to have entered it.
numenera.place.erenush.who_may: The philethis are associated with it.
numenera.place.erenush.combines: May contain a vast store of knowledge, according to speculation.
numenera.place.erenush.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is needed to represent the location.

numenera.place.slath.name: Slath

effect.summary: A uraeyl town known for weapon and armor smiths.

numenera.place.slath.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is needed to represent the location.

numenera.place.ormanth.blocked_reason: No special game mechanism is needed to represent the location.

numenera.place.the-empty.combines: The surrounding area is barren and sometimes contains wandering automatons.

numenera.place.gyra.combines: Receives chemicals from the city’s underground machines.

effect.summary: Home of the Elychnious.
Another name for the land of Lostrei.
A language known by the Rayskelan character.
