numenera.rule.weapon-familiarity.name: Weapon familiarity

effect.summary: An unfamiliar weapon increases attack difficulty by one step.

numenera.rule.weapon-familiarity.cost_or_limit: Glaives know most weapon types; jacks prefer light or medium and nanos usually light weapons.

numenera.rule.light-weapons.name: Light weapons

effect.summary: Light weapons deal 2 damage and reduce attack difficulty by one step.

numenera.rule.light-weapons.blocked_reason: The rule specifies damage and attack difficulty.

effect.summary: Medium weapons deal 4 damage.

numenera.rule.heavy-weapons.name: Heavy weapons

effect.summary: Heavy weapons deal 6 damage and require two hands to use.

numenera.rule.heavy-weapons.blocked_reason: The rule specifies damage and a use restriction.

numenera.rule.natural-1-17-18-19-or-20-s.name: Natural 1, 17, 18, 19, or 20 special results

effect.summary: Certain natural d20 results trigger specified intrusions, damage bonuses, effects, or a free stat-point refund.

numenera.rule.natural-1-17-18-19-or-20-s.cost_or_limit: The outcomes depend on the natural die result and whether the roll is an attack.
numenera.rule.natural-1-17-18-19-or-20-s.go_wrong: A natural 1 prompts a GM intrusion and awards no XP for it.
numenera.rule.natural-1-17-18-19-or-20-s.who_may: Characters making rolls; the GM handles intrusions.
numenera.rule.natural-1-17-18-19-or-20-s.combines: A natural 20 refunds points spent from a stat Pool on that action.
numenera.rule.natural-1-17-18-19-or-20-s.blocked_reason: The outcomes are game procedures rather than effects needing an unsupported capability.

numenera.rule.retrying-a-failed-task.name: Retrying a failed task

effect.summary: A failed task can be attempted again by taking a new action and applying at least one level of Effort.

numenera.rule.retrying-a-failed-task.cost_or_limit: Some tasks cannot be retried; combat attacks are new situations rather than retries.
numenera.rule.retrying-a-failed-task.go_wrong: A retry takes the same amount of time as the original attempt.
numenera.rule.retrying-a-failed-task.mechanism: Retry restriction and added effort cost
numenera.rule.retrying-a-failed-task.blocked_reason: This is a procedural limit that can be applied directly.

numenera.rule.initial-cost.name: Initial cost

effect.summary: A task may require Pool points merely to attempt, in addition to any points spent on Effort.

numenera.rule.initial-cost.cost_or_limit: Edge reduces the initial cost once per action and cannot also reduce Effort costs on that action.
numenera.rule.initial-cost.who_may: The GM may assign an initial cost to a task.
numenera.rule.initial-cost.combines: Costs Pool points and interacts with Edge and Effort.
numenera.rule.initial-cost.blocked_reason: The cost and Edge limit can be applied directly.

numenera.rule.distance-categories.name: Distance categories

effect.summary: Distances are grouped as immediate, short, or long, with rough ranges and movement-action limits.

numenera.rule.distance-categories.cost_or_limit: Immediate is at most about 10 feet; short is under about 50 feet; long is under about 100 feet.
numenera.rule.distance-categories.go_wrong: Moving long distance in one action may require a roll.
numenera.rule.distance-categories.who_may: Applies to characters and special-ability ranges.
numenera.rule.distance-categories.combines: Movement and attack ranges use these categories.
numenera.rule.distance-categories.blocked_reason: Range bands and movement limits can be applied directly.

numenera.rule.ninth-world-days-and-years.name: Ninth World days and years

effect.summary: Days last 28 hours and years last 312 days.

numenera.rule.ninth-world-days-and-years.who_may: Applies to timekeeping in the Ninth World.
numenera.rule.ninth-world-days-and-years.blocked_reason: The calendar durations can be represented directly.

numenera.rule.rounds-and-turns.name: Rounds and turns

effect.summary: A round lasts roughly five to ten seconds, and each participant takes one action.

numenera.rule.rounds-and-turns.cost_or_limit: Turn order is determined by initiative, subject to the described procedure.
numenera.rule.rounds-and-turns.who_may: Characters and NPCs in an encounter.
numenera.rule.rounds-and-turns.combines: Initiative determines ordering; effects lasting a round end on the user's next turn.
numenera.rule.rounds-and-turns.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure, not an effect requiring an unsupported capability.

numenera.rule.damage-and-armor.name: Damage and Armor

effect.summary: Damage reduces a stat Pool or health, after applicable Armor is subtracted.

numenera.rule.damage-and-armor.cost_or_limit: Armor cannot reduce damage below zero; Speed and Intellect damage ignore Armor, as does usually ambient damage.
numenera.rule.damage-and-armor.who_may: Characters, NPCs, and objects can take damage.
numenera.rule.damage-and-armor.combines: Armor and damage type determine how much is lost.
numenera.rule.damage-and-armor.blocked_reason: Damage and Armor are direct numerical effects.

numenera.rule.damage-track-and-death.name: Damage track and death

effect.summary: When a PC's stat Pool reaches zero, the character moves down the track from hale toward death.

numenera.rule.damage-track-and-death.cost_or_limit: Further damage at zero is applied in Might, Speed, then Intellect order; the fourth track state is death.
numenera.rule.damage-track-and-death.go_wrong: A depleted Pool worsens the character's damage-track state.
numenera.rule.damage-track-and-death.who_may: Player characters; NPCs instead use health and may die or be incapacitated at zero.
numenera.rule.damage-track-and-death.combines: Special damage can also move a PC down the track.
numenera.rule.damage-track-and-death.blocked_reason: The track states and death transition can be implemented directly.

numenera.rule.recovery-rolls.name: Recovery rolls

effect.summary: A recovery roll restores points equal to a d6 result plus the character's tier, divided among stat Pools.

numenera.rule.recovery-rolls.cost_or_limit: The four daily rests take progressively longer: one action, ten minutes, one hour, then ten hours; recovery cannot exceed Pool maximums.
numenera.rule.recovery-rolls.go_wrong: Extra points beyond a Pool's maximum have no effect.
numenera.rule.recovery-rolls.combines: Restoring a Pool from zero also improves the damage track by one step; a roll may instead improve the track.
numenera.rule.recovery-rolls.blocked_reason: Recovery amounts, timing, and limits can be applied directly.

numenera.rule.dazed-and-stunned.name: Dazed and stunned

effect.summary: Dazing worsens task difficulty; stunning removes the target's next turn while leaving normal defenses available.

numenera.rule.dazed-and-stunned.cost_or_limit: Daze usually lasts one round; stun lasts for the specified effect duration.
numenera.rule.dazed-and-stunned.mind: Some mental attacks can cause these conditions.
numenera.rule.dazed-and-stunned.who_may: Characters affected by hard blows, loud sounds, or mental attacks.
numenera.rule.dazed-and-stunned.combines: Stun can be a more severe result than daze.
numenera.rule.dazed-and-stunned.blocked_reason: Temporary task penalties and lost actions can be represented directly.

numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.name: Poison and disease resistance

effect.summary: A Might defense roll resists poison, while disease typically calls for a new such roll each day.

numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.cost_or_limit: Failure may cause damage, track movement, paralysis, or other effects; some disease damage cannot be conventionally restored.
numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.go_wrong: Unresisted poison or disease applies its specified harmful effects.
numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.mind: Some numenera poisons can interfere with thought, speech, actions, or recovery.
numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.who_may: Characters exposed to poison or disease.
numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.combines: Different substances and diseases have different outcomes.
numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.mechanism: Defense check against recurring harmful conditions
numenera.rule.poison-and-disease-resista.blocked_reason: Defense checks and their stated consequences can be implemented directly.

numenera.rule.invisible-target-attacks.name: Invisible-target attacks

effect.summary: Attacks against an invisible target are exceptionally difficult if other senses locate it, and otherwise fail without a lucky shot or GM intrusion.

numenera.rule.invisible-target-attacks.cost_or_limit: A player may spend 1 XP to attempt an otherwise impossible lucky shot.
numenera.rule.invisible-target-attacks.go_wrong: Without a useful sense, an attack fails automatically unless the exception applies.
numenera.rule.invisible-target-attacks.combines: Other senses can reduce the difficulty penalty.
numenera.rule.invisible-target-attacks.blocked_reason: The described targeting restriction and exception can be applied directly.

numenera.rule.low-gravity.name: Low Gravity

effect.summary: Heavy weapons deal less damage, while weapon ranges extend; trained low-gravity maneuverers ignore the damage reduction.

numenera.rule.low-gravity.cost_or_limit: Heavy weapons lose 2 damage, to a minimum of 1; short range extends to long and long range to about 200 feet.
numenera.rule.low-gravity.who_may: Characters and weapons in low gravity.
numenera.rule.low-gravity.combines: Large amounts of metal can also be affected by fluctuating magnetism.
numenera.rule.low-gravity.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as changes to damage and range.

numenera.rule.high-gravity.name: High Gravity

effect.summary: Raises physical-action difficulty and shortens weapon ranges; trained maneuverers ignore the difficulty increase, not the range reduction.

numenera.rule.high-gravity.cost_or_limit: Difficulty rises one step; ranges fall one category.
numenera.rule.high-gravity.who_may: Characters and weapons in high gravity.
numenera.rule.high-gravity.combines: Large amounts of metal can also be affected by fluctuating magnetism.
numenera.rule.high-gravity.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as changes to difficulty and range.

numenera.rule.zero-gravity.name: Zero Gravity

effect.summary: Raises physical-action difficulty, extends weapon ranges, and causes movement to depend on pushing off a surface.

numenera.rule.zero-gravity.cost_or_limit: Without a surface to push from, a character cannot move; after a push, they drift half the initial distance each round unless they reach something stable.
numenera.rule.zero-gravity.go_wrong: A character may continue drifting without reaching a stable object.
numenera.rule.zero-gravity.combines: Trained zero-gravity maneuvering negates the difficulty increase for attacks and physical actions.
numenera.rule.zero-gravity.blocked_reason: The stated movement and difficulty changes can be represented as environmental rules.

numenera.rule.npcs-cannot-apply-effort.name: NPCs cannot apply Effort

effect.summary: Non-player characters do not use Effort.

numenera.rule.npcs-cannot-apply-effort.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward restriction on a game mechanic.

numenera.rule.area-attacks-resolve-separ.name: Area attacks resolve separately against PCs and NPCs

effect.summary: Each PC rolls a defense; one attack roll is compared with every NPC’s target number.

numenera.rule.area-attacks-resolve-separ.cost_or_limit: Some area attacks deal minimum damage even on a miss or successful defense.
numenera.rule.area-attacks-resolve-separ.go_wrong: Targets may still take minimum damage.
numenera.rule.area-attacks-resolve-separ.combines: Some attacks apply minimum damage despite a miss.
numenera.rule.area-attacks-resolve-separ.blocked_reason: The rule resolves one effect against multiple targets in an area.

numenera.rule.object-durability-and-armo.name: Object durability and Armor

effect.summary: Objects have levels that determine their target number and health; Armor reduces incoming damage.

numenera.rule.object-durability-and-armo.cost_or_limit: Stone has 1 Armor, metal 2, and diamond or advanced alloy 3.
numenera.rule.object-durability-and-armo.go_wrong: An object is destroyed when its health is exhausted.
numenera.rule.object-durability-and-armo.combines: Armor subtracts from each attack’s damage.
numenera.rule.object-durability-and-armo.blocked_reason: The rule specifies durability and damage reduction.

numenera.rule.npc-conflict-resolution-by.name: NPC conflict resolution by level

effect.summary: A higher-level opponent generally wins against a lower-level one; equal levels can produce an uncertain contest.

numenera.rule.npc-conflict-resolution-by.cost_or_limit: Used as a broad guide for conflicts not involving PCs.
numenera.rule.npc-conflict-resolution-by.go_wrong: Equal-level contests may remain unresolved for a long time.
numenera.rule.npc-conflict-resolution-by.who_may: NPCs, creatures, poisons, and numenera effects in opposition.
numenera.rule.npc-conflict-resolution-by.combines: The same comparison applies across different kinds of threats.
numenera.rule.npc-conflict-resolution-by.blocked_reason: Resolving conflict requires comparing the levels of interacting entities or effects.

numenera.rule.unwanted-special-abilities.name: Unwanted special abilities are attacks

effect.summary: A special ability affecting someone against their wishes is treated as an attack.

numenera.rule.unwanted-special-abilities.cost_or_limit: Applies when another character is affected unwillingly.
numenera.rule.unwanted-special-abilities.who_may: Characters using special abilities on others.
numenera.rule.unwanted-special-abilities.combines: Even healing becomes an attack if the recipient objects.
numenera.rule.unwanted-special-abilities.blocked_reason: This is a direct resolution rule.

numenera.rule.immediate-movement-as-part.name: Immediate movement as part of another action

effect.summary: A character may adjust position by an immediate distance during another action.

numenera.rule.immediate-movement-as-part.blocked_reason: Movement distance can be handled with the basic position effect.

numenera.rule.short-move.name: Short move

effect.summary: A character can move about 50 feet as an action without rolling in ordinary circumstances.

numenera.rule.short-move.cost_or_limit: Terrain and circumstances can change the distance.
numenera.rule.short-move.who_may: Characters taking an action to move.
numenera.rule.short-move.combines: Difficult terrain can halve the distance.
numenera.rule.short-move.blocked_reason: The rule specifies distance and when a roll is unnecessary.

numenera.rule.long-move.name: Long move

effect.summary: A character may attempt to move about 100 feet in a round with a Speed task.

numenera.rule.long-move.cost_or_limit: Base difficulty 4, modified by skill, assets, Effort, terrain, or obstacles.
numenera.rule.long-move.go_wrong: Failure stops or stumbles the character partway.
numenera.rule.long-move.blocked_reason: The rule is a movement task with a distance and difficulty.

numenera.rule.long-term-travel-rates.name: Long-term travel rates

effect.summary: Typical travelers cover about 20 miles per day by road or 12 miles overland; mounts double the distance.

numenera.rule.long-term-travel-rates.cost_or_limit: Rates include stops and vary by mode of travel.
numenera.rule.long-term-travel-rates.blocked_reason: The rule sets travel distances over time.

numenera.rule.rough-terrain.name: Rough Terrain

effect.summary: Raises move-roll difficulty one step and halves long-term travel.

numenera.rule.rough-terrain.cost_or_limit: It does not slow ordinary round-by-round movement.
numenera.rule.rough-terrain.combines: Difficult terrain also halves round-by-round movement.
numenera.rule.rough-terrain.blocked_reason: The rule specifies movement and difficulty modifiers.

numenera.rule.difficult-terrain.name: Difficult Terrain

effect.summary: Raises move-roll difficulty, halves round-by-round movement, and reduces long-term travel to one third.

numenera.rule.difficult-terrain.cost_or_limit: A short move is about 25 feet and a long move about 50 feet in such terrain.
numenera.rule.difficult-terrain.blocked_reason: The rule specifies movement and difficulty modifiers.

numenera.rule.deep-water.name: Deep Water

effect.summary: Deep water applies rough-terrain effects and quarters movement; swimming training halves that reduction.

numenera.rule.deep-water.cost_or_limit: A short move is about 12 feet and a long move about 25 feet, with swimming training doubling those distances.
numenera.rule.deep-water.combines: Swimming training reduces the movement penalty.
numenera.rule.deep-water.blocked_reason: The rule specifies movement rates in deep water.

numenera.rule.low-gravity-movement.name: Low-gravity movement

effect.summary: Lowers the difficulty of movement rolls by one step without greatly increasing speed.

numenera.rule.low-gravity-movement.combines: Low-gravity maneuvering is also mentioned for combat effects.

numenera.rule.high-gravity-movement.name: High-gravity movement

effect.summary: Treats movement as difficult terrain and reduces long-term travel to one third.

numenera.rule.high-gravity-movement.cost_or_limit: High-gravity maneuvering training cancels the movement penalty.
numenera.rule.high-gravity-movement.blocked_reason: The rule changes movement rates and difficulty.

numenera.rule.zero-gravity-movement.name: Zero-gravity movement

effect.summary: A character must push off a surface and pass a Might roll to move; afterward they drift unless stopped.

numenera.rule.zero-gravity-movement.cost_or_limit: Difficulty is one quarter of the distance in feet; no surface means no movement.
numenera.rule.zero-gravity-movement.go_wrong: Without a stable object to reach, the character continues drifting half the initial push distance each round.
numenera.rule.zero-gravity-movement.combines: Reaching a stable object lets the character grab or land against it.
numenera.rule.zero-gravity-movement.blocked_reason: The rule provides a movement procedure and ongoing drift.

numenera.rule.cooperative-actions-are-mu.name: Cooperative actions are mutually exclusive

effect.summary: The same characters cannot use multiple listed cooperation options simultaneously.

numenera.rule.cooperative-actions-are-mu.cost_or_limit: Applies to the same characters in a situation.
numenera.rule.cooperative-actions-are-mu.combines: Options include helping, complementary actions, distractions, and coordinated attacks.
numenera.rule.cooperative-actions-are-mu.blocked_reason: The rule explicitly limits simultaneous use of cooperation options.

numenera.rule.helping.name: Helping

effect.summary: A trained helper can improve an ally’s task; otherwise the helper may provide a +1 bonus.

numenera.rule.helping.cost_or_limit: The helper spends an action; an inability prevents help, and an equally or more trained actor gets only +1.
numenera.rule.helping.go_wrong: An inability means the helper provides no benefit.
numenera.rule.helping.combines: Cannot be combined with another listed cooperation option by the same characters.
numenera.rule.helping.blocked_reason: The rule provides a task modifier.

numenera.rule.complementary-actions.name: Complementary Actions

effect.summary: A skilled ally performing a different related action gives both rolls a +2 bonus.

numenera.rule.complementary-actions.cost_or_limit: The actions must complement one another.
numenera.rule.complementary-actions.combines: Can apply in combat as well as other tasks.
numenera.rule.complementary-actions.blocked_reason: The rule provides a straightforward roll modifier.

numenera.rule.distraction.name: Distraction

effect.summary: A distracted foe suffers a one-step penalty to attacks for one round.

numenera.rule.distraction.cost_or_limit: Multiple distractors do not increase the penalty.
numenera.rule.distraction.combines: Additional distractors have no greater effect.
numenera.rule.distraction.blocked_reason: The rule applies a defined modifier for a defined duration.

numenera.rule.draw-the-attack.name: Draw the Attack

effect.summary: A character may draw an NPC’s attack away from an ally, sometimes requiring an Intellect task.

numenera.rule.draw-the-attack.cost_or_limit: Two characters trying simultaneously cancel each other out.
numenera.rule.draw-the-attack.go_wrong: A failed task does not draw the attack.
numenera.rule.draw-the-attack.who_may: A PC trying to attract an NPC’s attack.
numenera.rule.draw-the-attack.combines: Success can make the character’s defense tasks one step harder.
numenera.rule.draw-the-attack.blocked_reason: The rule describes attack targeting and a task check.

numenera.rule.take-the-attack.name: Take the Attack

effect.summary: A character can intercept an attack meant for a nearby comrade.

numenera.rule.take-the-attack.cost_or_limit: The attack automatically hits and deals 1 additional damage; only one such attack may be taken each round.
numenera.rule.take-the-attack.go_wrong: The interceptor automatically suffers the attack.
numenera.rule.take-the-attack.who_may: A character protecting a nearby comrade.
numenera.rule.take-the-attack.blocked_reason: The rule directly redirects an attack and specifies its cost.

numenera.rule.the-old-one-two-three.name: The Old One-Two-Three

effect.summary: Each of three or more characters attacking one foe gets +1 to their attack.

numenera.rule.the-old-one-two-three.cost_or_limit: Requires at least three attackers against the same foe.
numenera.rule.the-old-one-two-three.blocked_reason: The rule provides an attack modifier.

numenera.rule.high-and-low.name: High and Low

effect.summary: If coordinated melee and ranged attacks both damage a foe, its next task becomes one step harder.

numenera.rule.high-and-low.cost_or_limit: Both attacks must damage the same foe.
numenera.rule.high-and-low.go_wrong: If either attack fails to damage, no penalty applies.
numenera.rule.high-and-low.who_may: Characters coordinating melee and ranged attacks.
numenera.rule.high-and-low.combines: Requires one melee and one ranged attack.
numenera.rule.high-and-low.blocked_reason: The rule applies a defined modifier when its trigger is met.

numenera.rule.covering-fire.name: Covering Fire

effect.summary: A successful deliberate near-miss deals no damage but makes the foe’s next attack one step harder.

numenera.rule.covering-fire.cost_or_limit: Requires a ranged attack or ability and a successful attack roll.
numenera.rule.covering-fire.go_wrong: The attack deals no damage by design.
numenera.rule.covering-fire.mind: The attack harasses and frightens the foe.
numenera.rule.covering-fire.who_may: A character using a ranged attack or ability.
numenera.rule.covering-fire.combines: Esoteries may be used for covering fire.
numenera.rule.covering-fire.blocked_reason: The rule specifies a targeted modifier and no damage.

numenera.rule.chase.name: Chase

effect.summary: A Speed task against the pursued NPC’s level determines whether the pursuer catches them or escapes.

numenera.rule.chase.cost_or_limit: A longer chase may require multiple rolls, commonly one per NPC level.
numenera.rule.chase.go_wrong: In the extended version, more failures than successes means the chase is lost.
numenera.rule.chase.who_may: A character chasing or fleeing an NPC.
numenera.rule.chase.combines: Can be resolved in one roll or as an extended sequence.
numenera.rule.chase.blocked_reason: The rule resolves pursuit through checks and success counts.

numenera.rule.waiting.name: Waiting

effect.summary: A character names a trigger and acts before the action that triggers it, when that makes sense.

numenera.rule.waiting.cost_or_limit: The stated action cannot precede an event that has not made it possible, such as attacking an unseen foe.
numenera.rule.waiting.blocked_reason: The rule adds a trigger-based action order.

numenera.rule.defending.name: Defending

effect.summary: A PC reacts to an attack with an appropriate defense roll.

numenera.rule.defending.cost_or_limit: Only PCs defend this way; the defense depends on the attack, and an unaware character cannot use normal modifiers, skills, or Effort.
numenera.rule.defending.go_wrong: A character may forgo defense and automatically be hit; surprise may also make an attack hit outright.
numenera.rule.defending.combines: Some attacks require separate defense rolls against different effects.
numenera.rule.defending.blocked_reason: The rule is a defense procedure using a roll.

numenera.rule.climbing.name: Climbing

effect.summary: A successful climb uses movement rules, but climbing raises move-roll difficulty and halves movement.

numenera.rule.climbing.cost_or_limit: Surface difficulty varies; additional circumstances can add penalties.
numenera.rule.climbing.go_wrong: Failure to climb is handled by the task result.
numenera.rule.climbing.combines: Climbing skill reduces the task difficulty.
numenera.rule.climbing.blocked_reason: The rule provides a task and movement penalties.

numenera.rule.guarding.name: Guarding

effect.summary: A guard improves their defenses and can attempt to prevent an NPC from passing or acting through their guarded position.

numenera.rule.guarding.cost_or_limit: The guarding character does not attack that turn; preventing an NPC requires a Speed task.
numenera.rule.guarding.go_wrong: A failed task does not stop the NPC.
numenera.rule.guarding.combines: NPC guards instead increase a PC’s difficulty to get past.
numenera.rule.guarding.blocked_reason: The rule controls passage and actions through a guarded position.

numenera.rule.healing.name: Healing

effect.summary: Bandaging and care restore points to a chosen stat Pool.

numenera.rule.healing.cost_or_limit: Each patient can receive this aid once per day; the healing amount sets the Intellect-task difficulty.
numenera.rule.healing.go_wrong: Failure does not restore the chosen points.
numenera.rule.healing.blocked_reason: The rule restores a specified amount of vitality.

numenera.rule.jumping.name: Jumping

effect.summary: Jump distance depends on a Might task, with a running start improving the task.

numenera.rule.jumping.cost_or_limit: Standing and running distances use different difficulty calculations; skill improves the result.
numenera.rule.jumping.go_wrong: A failed task does not achieve the intended jump.
numenera.rule.jumping.combines: Running provides an asset; skill advances the distance table.
numenera.rule.jumping.blocked_reason: The rule maps task difficulty to jumping distance.

numenera.rule.identifying-understanding-.name: Identifying, understanding, or remembering

effect.summary: An Intellect task determines whether a character understands a device or recalls knowledge.

numenera.rule.identifying-understanding-.cost_or_limit: Device level or the GM’s knowledge difficulty sets the task; relevant skill reduces difficulty.
numenera.rule.identifying-understanding-.go_wrong: Failure leaves the character without the sought knowledge or understanding.
numenera.rule.identifying-understanding-.combines: Skills in relevant fields reduce difficulty.
numenera.rule.identifying-understanding-.blocked_reason: The rule resolves information gathering with a task.

numenera.rule.looking-or-listening.name: Looking or Listening

effect.summary: An Intellect task detects hidden creatures, secret panels, or suspicious sounds.

numenera.rule.looking-or-listening.cost_or_limit: A creature’s level or the GM’s assessment sets the difficulty; perception skill reduces it.
numenera.rule.looking-or-listening.go_wrong: Failure does not reveal the hidden thing.
numenera.rule.looking-or-listening.blocked_reason: The rule resolves detection with a task.

numenera.rule.interacting-with-creatures.name: Interacting With Creatures

effect.summary: An Intellect task resolves persuasion, intimidation, bribery, calming, or similar interactions.

numenera.rule.interacting-with-creatures.cost_or_limit: The creature’s level sets the target number; suitable skills can reduce difficulty.
numenera.rule.interacting-with-creatures.go_wrong: Failure does not achieve the intended interaction.
numenera.rule.interacting-with-creatures.mind: May influence the creature’s response, depending on the attempt.
numenera.rule.interacting-with-creatures.combines: Relevant social or animal-handling skills may reduce difficulty.
numenera.rule.interacting-with-creatures.blocked_reason: The rule resolves interaction through a task.

numenera.rule.moving-a-heavy-object.name: Moving a Heavy Object

effect.summary: A Might task lets a character push or pull a heavy object an immediate distance.

numenera.rule.moving-a-heavy-object.cost_or_limit: Every 50 pounds raises difficulty one step; reducing difficulty to 0 allows a short move.
numenera.rule.moving-a-heavy-object.combines: Carrying or pushing skill reduces difficulty.
numenera.rule.moving-a-heavy-object.blocked_reason: The rule provides a weight-based task difficulty and distance.

numenera.rule.operating-or-disabling-a-d.name: Operating or Disabling a Device, or Picking a Lock

effect.summary: An Intellect task can identify, disable, or operate a device or pick a lock.

numenera.rule.operating-or-disabling-a-d.cost_or_limit: Device level usually sets difficulty; disabling and lockpicking usually require rolls and tools.
numenera.rule.operating-or-disabling-a-d.go_wrong: A failed task does not achieve the attempted operation.
numenera.rule.operating-or-disabling-a-d.who_may: Characters attempting to use or disable devices or open locks.
numenera.rule.operating-or-disabling-a-d.combines: Relevant skills reduce difficulty; destroying an object instead uses a Might task.
numenera.rule.operating-or-disabling-a-d.blocked_reason: The rule describes task-based device use and manipulation.

numenera.rule.riding.name: Riding

effect.summary: Routine travel on a trained mount needs no roll; difficult riding maneuvers use a Speed task.

numenera.rule.riding.cost_or_limit: A saddle or suitable gear is an asset; maneuver difficulty varies from routine riding to urging a mount to move unusually fast or far.
numenera.rule.riding.go_wrong: Failure may prevent the maneuver or staying mounted.
numenera.rule.riding.combines: Riding skill and appropriate gear reduce difficulty.
numenera.rule.riding.blocked_reason: The rule is a task check for mount control.

numenera.rule.sneaking.name: Sneaking

effect.summary: A Speed task lets a character move without being detected by a creature.

numenera.rule.sneaking.cost_or_limit: Difficulty is based on the creature’s level; moving at half speed reduces difficulty.
numenera.rule.sneaking.combines: Camouflage, dim light, cover, and skill can reduce difficulty.
numenera.rule.sneaking.blocked_reason: The rule resolves concealment through a task.

numenera.rule.swimming.name: Swimming

effect.summary: Ordinary swimming uses movement rules; unusual conditions may require a Might task.

numenera.rule.swimming.cost_or_limit: Deep water reduces movement; currents or whirlpools may require a task to make progress.
numenera.rule.swimming.go_wrong: Failure can prevent progress against a hazard.
numenera.rule.swimming.combines: Swimming skill reduces difficulty and changes the deep-water movement penalty.
numenera.rule.swimming.blocked_reason: The rule describes movement and checks against swimming hazards.

numenera.rule.crafting-and-repairing-dif.name: Crafting and repairing difficulty

effect.summary: An item’s level sets the difficulty and usual time to make or repair it; numenera items add five to the difficulty.

numenera.rule.crafting-and-repairing-dif.cost_or_limit: The GM may require appropriate skill, tools, and materials.
numenera.rule.crafting-and-repairing-dif.go_wrong: Failure means the item is not completed or repaired.
numenera.rule.crafting-and-repairing-dif.combines: Skill reduces difficulty, but usually not material or time requirements.
numenera.rule.crafting-and-repairing-dif.blocked_reason: The rule specifies task difficulty and crafting time.

numenera.rule.crafting-materials.name: Crafting materials

effect.summary: A crafted device generally needs materials at its own level and every lower level.

numenera.rule.crafting-materials.cost_or_limit: A level 5 device needs materials from levels 0 through 5.
numenera.rule.crafting-materials.combines: Skill may reduce material requirements with GM approval.
numenera.rule.crafting-materials.blocked_reason: The rule requires a range of materials by level.

numenera.rule.crafting-and-repair-time.name: Crafting and repair time

effect.summary: Creation time is set by the GM, while repairs usually take between half and all of the creation time.

numenera.rule.crafting-and-repair-time.cost_or_limit: A rush job may reduce time but affect quality; some tasks cannot be rushed.
numenera.rule.crafting-and-repair-time.go_wrong: A rushed item may be dangerous or limited to one use.
numenera.rule.crafting-and-repair-time.combines: Skill may reduce time with GM approval, separately from difficulty.
numenera.rule.crafting-and-repair-time.blocked_reason: The rule controls time and possible consequences of rushing.

numenera.rule.item-levels-and-mundane-cr.name: Item levels and mundane crafting

effect.summary: An item’s level reflects the difficulty of making it, from routine level 0 goods to increasingly difficult creations.

numenera.rule.item-levels-and-mundane-cr.cost_or_limit: Level 0 items require no skill; examples place simple tools and weapons at higher levels.
numenera.rule.item-levels-and-mundane-cr.combines: The level informs difficulty and materials.
numenera.rule.item-levels-and-mundane-cr.blocked_reason: The rule uses item level to determine crafting requirements.

numenera.rule.skill-trade-offs-in-crafti.name: Skill trade-offs in crafting

effect.summary: With GM approval, a crafter may trade higher task difficulty for reduced time or lower-grade materials.

numenera.rule.skill-trade-offs-in-crafti.cost_or_limit: The trade-off must make sense; some time reductions are impossible.
numenera.rule.skill-trade-offs-in-crafti.go_wrong: Using substandard materials may result in an inferior item.
numenera.rule.skill-trade-offs-in-crafti.combines: Skill normally reduces difficulty; approved alternatives change time or materials instead.
numenera.rule.skill-trade-offs-in-crafti.blocked_reason: The rule changes crafting difficulty, time, or materials.

numenera.rule.failed-crafting-checks.name: Failed crafting checks

effect.summary: A failed crafting or repair check leaves the item incomplete.

numenera.rule.failed-crafting-checks.cost_or_limit: Continuing requires more materials, generally the highest-level material, and the required time again.
numenera.rule.failed-crafting-checks.go_wrong: The attempted item is not completed or repaired.
numenera.rule.failed-crafting-checks.blocked_reason: The rule specifies consequences and resource costs for failure.

numenera.rule.xp-for-permanent-numenera-.name: XP for permanent numenera creations

effect.summary: Creating a permanent numenera or other nonstandard item requires spending XP.

numenera.rule.xp-for-permanent-numenera-.cost_or_limit: XP is spent only if the crafting check succeeds.
numenera.rule.xp-for-permanent-numenera-.go_wrong: A failed check spends no XP.
numenera.rule.xp-for-permanent-numenera-.combines: Long-term benefits from tinkering may also require XP.
numenera.rule.xp-for-permanent-numenera-.blocked_reason: The rule assigns an explicit resource cost to a successful creation.

numenera.rule.tinkering-with-numenera.name: Tinkering with numenera

effect.summary: A character may try to change a device’s intended function, with difficulty often starting at 7.

numenera.rule.tinkering-with-numenera.cost_or_limit: Tools and repair-like time are needed; the GM may declare an attempt impossible.
numenera.rule.tinkering-with-numenera.go_wrong: A successful permanent benefit may require XP.
numenera.rule.tinkering-with-numenera.combines: Creating an artifact-like long-term benefit may require XP.
numenera.rule.tinkering-with-numenera.blocked_reason: Changing a device’s intended function may require assigning a new power to an item.

numenera.rule.experience-point-awards.name: Experience-point awards

effect.summary: Characters earn XP through GM intrusions and discoveries, with typical session awards given as guidance.

numenera.rule.experience-point-awards.cost_or_limit: Typical awards are about 2–4 XP during a session and perhaps 2 between sessions.
numenera.rule.experience-point-awards.combines: XP can be spent on character benefits or permanent numenera creations.
numenera.rule.experience-point-awards.blocked_reason: The rule awards a game resource.

numenera.rule.gm-intrusion.name: GM intrusion

effect.summary: The GM introduces a complication and awards the affected player 2 XP; the player gives 1 XP to another player.

numenera.rule.gm-intrusion.cost_or_limit: A player may spend 1 XP to refuse and then receives none; a die result of 1 permits intrusion without XP.
numenera.rule.gm-intrusion.go_wrong: The complication changes the character’s situation.
numenera.rule.gm-intrusion.combines: An intrusion can turn an otherwise automatic success into a task.
numenera.rule.gm-intrusion.blocked_reason: The rule combines a narrative complication with a resource award.

numenera.rule.discovery-awards.name: Discovery awards

effect.summary: Discovering new or newly understood things can earn XP.

numenera.rule.discovery-awards.cost_or_limit: The GM decides whether the characters interacted with and learned enough about something for it to count.
numenera.rule.discovery-awards.go_wrong: No award is implied for something merely strange that the characters do not meaningfully engage with.
numenera.rule.discovery-awards.combines: Discoveries can include usable artifacts, procedures, or devices.
numenera.rule.discovery-awards.blocked_reason: The rule awards XP for qualifying discoveries.

numenera.rule.varjellen-reforging-limit.name: Varjellen reforging limit

effect.summary: A varjellen may reforge only once per day, and the process takes nearly an hour.

numenera.rule.varjellen-reforging-limit.cost_or_limit: Once daily; about an hour per use.
numenera.rule.varjellen-reforging-limit.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward usage limit.

numenera.rule.varjellen-reforging-trade-.name: Varjellen reforging trade-off

effect.summary: Improving one kind of capacity requires diminishing another.

numenera.rule.varjellen-reforging-trade-.cost_or_limit: Capacity gains must be offset by losses elsewhere.
numenera.rule.varjellen-reforging-trade-.blocked_reason: A basic alteration effect can represent gains and corresponding losses.

numenera.rule.ninth-world-day-and-year-l.name: Ninth World day and year lengths

effect.summary: A day lasts 28 hours and a year has 313 days.

numenera.rule.ninth-world-day-and-year-l.combines: The year’s length is unchanged from the familiar one
numenera.rule.ninth-world-day-and-year-l.blocked_reason: This is a fixed world-time rule.

numenera.rule.continued-life-despite-the.name: continued life despite the sun’s luminosity

effect.summary: An unknown past event prevents the brighter sun from making Earth uninhabitable.

numenera.rule.continued-life-despite-the.where_from: An event millions of years ago
numenera.rule.continued-life-despite-the.blocked_reason: The passage gives no mechanism for the protection that keeps life possible.

numenera.rule.lifespan-varies-with-longe.name: lifespan varies with longevity secrets

effect.summary: Access to Aeon Priest discoveries may let wealthy or fortunate people live twice as long or more.

numenera.rule.lifespan-varies-with-longe.cost_or_limit: Ordinary survival to age thirty often permits life to at least sixty
numenera.rule.lifespan-varies-with-longe.who_may: Those with wealth or access to local discoveries
numenera.rule.lifespan-varies-with-longe.combines: Some Beyond claves may halt aging nearly entirely

numenera.rule.shallamas-echoes.name: Shallamas echoes

effect.summary: Accurate, non-interactive apparitions replay recent past events.

numenera.rule.shallamas-echoes.cost_or_limit: They may show events from minutes to a year earlier
numenera.rule.shallamas-echoes.who_may: People in Shallamas may witness them
numenera.rule.shallamas-echoes.combines: Courts accept an echo as eyewitness confirmation
numenera.rule.shallamas-echoes.blocked_reason: The phenomenon reveals information about past events.

numenera.rule.iron-wind-transformation.name: Iron Wind transformation

effect.summary: A storm can reshape terrain and transform creatures and matter into bizarre forms or substances.

numenera.rule.iron-wind-transformation.go_wrong: Transformations are often lethal and may be painful
numenera.rule.iron-wind-transformation.who_may: The Iron Wind acts without ordinary control
numenera.rule.iron-wind-transformation.combines: Matter transmutation and creature transformation occur together
numenera.rule.iron-wind-transformation.blocked_reason: The effect radically changes creatures’ bodies as well as other matter.

numenera.rule.door-at-the-emperor-of-gre.name: door at the Emperor of Green

effect.summary: A door appears on the tree at irregular times and disappears after about an hour.

numenera.rule.door-at-the-emperor-of-gre.cost_or_limit: Its appearance is random and brief
numenera.rule.door-at-the-emperor-of-gre.go_wrong: Those who pass through have not returned to report
numenera.rule.door-at-the-emperor-of-gre.who_may: Anyone who reaches the tree can seek it
numenera.rule.door-at-the-emperor-of-gre.combines: A note suggests it may lead to the University of Doors
numenera.rule.door-at-the-emperor-of-gre.blocked_reason: The passage suggests a doorway to another place without specifying how it transports users.

numenera.rule.charmonde-standing-field.name: Charmonde standing field

effect.summary: Four ancient sonic devices produce a barrier that causes severe pain, convulsions, or death to those who cross it.

numenera.rule.charmonde-standing-field.cost_or_limit: Devices are nearly depleted and used sparingly
numenera.rule.charmonde-standing-field.go_wrong: Attempts to cross can be fatal
numenera.rule.charmonde-standing-field.combines: Four devices jointly create the standing field
numenera.rule.charmonde-standing-field.blocked_reason: The devices create a persistent large-area field with harmful effects.

numenera.rule.curtar-s-leaving-prohibiti.name: Curtar’s leaving prohibition

effect.summary: Curtaris doctrine says anyone who leaves the canyon will be plagued and unable to return.

numenera.rule.curtar-s-leaving-prohibiti.cost_or_limit: Applies to those who leave the canyon.
numenera.rule.curtar-s-leaving-prohibiti.go_wrong: A horrible plague is the claimed consequence.
numenera.rule.curtar-s-leaving-prohibiti.blocked_reason: The rule records the stated restriction and consequence.

numenera.rule.ausren-fruit-toxicity.name: Ausren fruit toxicity

effect.summary: Eating fruit from the purple trees causes a worsening illness with sores and burrowing growths.

numenera.rule.ausren-fruit-toxicity.cost_or_limit: The hazard follows consumption of the fruit.
numenera.rule.ausren-fruit-toxicity.go_wrong: Symptoms progress to severe weakness and immobility.
numenera.rule.ausren-fruit-toxicity.mechanism: Ingested toxin with progressive bodily effects
numenera.rule.ausren-fruit-toxicity.blocked_reason: The worsening course is described narratively rather than as a defined game effect.

numenera.rule.beanstalk-gravity-distorti.name: Beanstalk gravity distortion

effect.summary: A distortion near the Beanstalk suspends mountain-sized boulders and smaller stones in the air.

numenera.rule.beanstalk-gravity-distorti.cost_or_limit: The effect is limited to the area around the tower and lower stalk.
numenera.rule.beanstalk-gravity-distorti.go_wrong: Its purpose is unknown and it may be an unintended construction side effect.
numenera.rule.beanstalk-gravity-distorti.blocked_reason: The stated physical effect can be represented as an area effect.

numenera.rule.salachia-residence-and-rec.name: Salachia residence and recruitment law

effect.summary: Residents may not leave for more than two days, and Hiberz rewards each recruited new citizen with five shins.

numenera.rule.salachia-residence-and-rec.cost_or_limit: Leaving beyond two days violates the law; recruitment earns five shins.
numenera.rule.salachia-residence-and-rec.combines: The law responds to dwindling population and fewer chiffons.
numenera.rule.salachia-residence-and-rec.blocked_reason: This is a civic rule that can be applied directly.

numenera.rule.astaria-s-strait-membrane.name: Astaria’s strait membrane

effect.summary: A membrane passes water and salt but nothing else, supplying osmotic energy and opening to ships only once daily.

numenera.rule.astaria-s-strait-membrane.cost_or_limit: Only water and salt pass through; ships can pass once each day and may pay a fee.
numenera.rule.astaria-s-strait-membrane.who_may: Water transports and ships when the passage opens.
numenera.rule.astaria-s-strait-membrane.where_from: Across the Imoros Strait at Astaria.
numenera.rule.astaria-s-strait-membrane.blocked_reason: The restriction and energy source are direct world mechanisms.

numenera.rule.salt-corrosion-of-mechanic.name: salt corrosion of mechanical beings

effect.summary: Sere Marica’s salt corrodes mechanical beings and technologies unless they have protection.

numenera.rule.salt-corrosion-of-mechanic.go_wrong: Rust and corrosion damage internal and external elements.
numenera.rule.salt-corrosion-of-mechanic.who_may: Affects mechanical beings and machines in the area.
numenera.rule.salt-corrosion-of-mechanic.combines: Some machines develop protective methods that may be traded or bought.
numenera.rule.salt-corrosion-of-mechanic.blocked_reason: This is a direct equipment-hazard rule.

numenera.rule.addled-victims-behave-rand.name: Addled victims behave randomly

effect.summary: A table describes possible actions for a victim addled by ithsyn gas.

numenera.rule.addled-victims-behave-rand.cost_or_limit: The table gives different random actions for the victim’s next action.
numenera.rule.addled-victims-behave-rand.who_may: Applies to victims of the gas.
numenera.rule.addled-victims-behave-rand.where_from: The passage’s description of ithsyn gas.
numenera.rule.addled-victims-behave-rand.blocked_reason: The grammar cannot express the table of alternative involuntary actions.

numenera.rule.nevajin-health-transfer.name: Nevajin health transfer

effect.summary: A nevajin can move health between its head and body while they touch.

numenera.rule.nevajin-health-transfer.cost_or_limit: The two portions must be touching.
numenera.rule.nevajin-health-transfer.combines: The two portions have separately tracked health.
numenera.rule.nevajin-health-transfer.blocked_reason: The basic grammar does not define how vitality moves between separately tracked entities.

numenera.rule.oorgolian-weapon-ammunitio.name: Oorgolian weapon ammunition and depletion

effect.summary: Some Oorgolian weapons regenerate projectile ammunition until they run out of power.

numenera.rule.oorgolian-weapon-ammunitio.cost_or_limit: A slug thrower depletes on a 1-in-100 chance.
numenera.rule.oorgolian-weapon-ammunitio.go_wrong: The weapon permanently runs out of power when depletion occurs.
numenera.rule.oorgolian-weapon-ammunitio.who_may: Applies to the described Oorgolian artifact weapons.
numenera.rule.oorgolian-weapon-ammunitio.combines: Ammunition regenerates inside the weapon until depletion.
numenera.rule.oorgolian-weapon-ammunitio.blocked_reason: The basic grammar cannot track a weapon’s stored ammunition or depletion state.

numenera.rule.varakith-corpse-armor-dura.name: varakith corpse armor duration

effect.summary: Each corpse caught on a varakith’s back adds 1 Armor for 28 hours.

numenera.rule.varakith-corpse-armor-dura.cost_or_limit: The added Armor lasts 28 hours per corpse.
numenera.rule.varakith-corpse-armor-dura.where_from: Varakith use slain bodies as armor.
numenera.rule.varakith-corpse-armor-dura.combines: Each corpse contributes an additional point of Armor.
numenera.rule.varakith-corpse-armor-dura.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not model a creature’s armor statistic.

numenera.rule.xi-drake-rider-bond.name: xi-drake rider bond

effect.summary: A bound xi-drake and rider work in concert until one dies.

numenera.rule.xi-drake-rider-bond.cost_or_limit: The bond continues until death, usually the rider’s.
numenera.rule.xi-drake-rider-bond.where_from: A pact made more than a century ago established xi-drakes as Angulan Knight mounts.

numenera.rule.yellow-swarm-proximity.name: yellow swarm proximity

effect.summary: A yellow swarm must stay close together or it cannot remain in this reality.

numenera.rule.yellow-swarm-proximity.cost_or_limit: The swarm loses its ability to remain here if dispersed too far.
numenera.rule.yellow-swarm-proximity.go_wrong: It ceases to remain in this reality.
numenera.rule.yellow-swarm-proximity.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not model a creature’s continued existence in reality.

numenera.rule.npc-abilities.name: NPC abilities

effect.summary: NPCs need not follow player-character ability rules and may have abilities suited to an encounter.

numenera.rule.npc-abilities.cost_or_limit: The passage presents this as guidance for NPC design.
numenera.rule.npc-abilities.where_from: The game’s approach to non-player characters.
numenera.rule.npc-abilities.combines: NPC abilities can differ from player-character versions.

numenera.rule.cyphers-are-consumed-when-.name: Cyphers are consumed when used

effect.summary: Using a cypher consumes it, including when it makes an attack.

numenera.rule.cyphers-are-consumed-when-.combines: Cyphers are frequently found and replenished.
numenera.rule.cyphers-are-consumed-when-.blocked_reason: The rule is represented by consuming the item after use.

numenera.rule.occultic-cyphers-count-as-.name: Occultic cyphers count as two

effect.summary: A complicated occultic cypher occupies two places in the carrying limit.

numenera.rule.occultic-cyphers-count-as-.combines: Applies to the character's cypher limit.
numenera.rule.occultic-cyphers-count-as-.blocked_reason: This is a quantity adjustment to the carrying limit.

numenera.rule.artifact-depletion.name: Artifact depletion

effect.summary: An object with a depletion rate is used up after a designated die result, though it works on that final use; repairing it can restore use.

numenera.rule.artifact-depletion.cost_or_limit: A dash denotes no depletion; automatic or cypher depletion means a single use, and cypher depletion counts against the character’s cypher limit.
numenera.rule.artifact-depletion.go_wrong: The object may be depleted after activation.
numenera.rule.artifact-depletion.combines: Depletion is specified by an object's plan.
numenera.rule.artifact-depletion.blocked_reason: The grammar does not model an item's remaining uses or depletion state.

numenera.rule.artifact-recharge.name: Artifact recharge

effect.summary: Some depowered artifacts can be restored through repair or special abilities, often for only one use.

numenera.rule.artifact-recharge.who_may: Characters with applicable repair or repowering abilities.
numenera.rule.artifact-recharge.combines: Repair rules; Rides the Lightning and other abilities.
numenera.rule.artifact-recharge.blocked_reason: The rule permits an ability or repair process to repower an item.

numenera.rule.artifact-use-procedure.name: Artifact-use procedure

effect.summary: Using an artifact generally requires an Intellect action, especially for its first use.

numenera.rule.artifact-use-procedure.cost_or_limit: Difficulty is usually the artifact level; first identification and use can take substantial time.
numenera.rule.artifact-use-procedure.go_wrong: Misuse may prevent operation or produce an unintended result.
numenera.rule.artifact-use-procedure.combines: Knowledge of the numenera can modify identification tasks.
numenera.rule.artifact-use-procedure.blocked_reason: This is a procedure for resolving artifact use rather than a world effect.

numenera.rule.artifact-quirks.name: Artifact quirks

effect.summary: Artifacts may have activation requirements, recurring side effects, or occasional unexpected behavior.

numenera.rule.artifact-quirks.cost_or_limit: Quirks may occur continuously, on activation, or occasionally.
numenera.rule.artifact-quirks.go_wrong: Possible effects include damage, sickness, breakdown, unusual outputs, and brief mind control.
numenera.rule.artifact-quirks.mind: A rare quirk can take over a user’s mind for one round.
numenera.rule.artifact-quirks.combines: Can serve as a GM intrusion.
numenera.rule.artifact-quirks.blocked_reason: The rule attaches variable side effects and activation conditions to particular artifacts.

numenera.rule.artifact-depletion-chances.name: Artifact depletion chances

effect.summary: A depletion rating sets the chance that use consumes or disables an artifact.

numenera.rule.artifact-depletion-chances.cost_or_limit: Typical guidance: 1 in 1d6 for a few uses, 1 in 1d10 for six or seven, 1 in 1d20 for many, and 1 in 1d100 for potentially campaign-long use.
numenera.rule.artifact-depletion-chances.go_wrong: Depletion can end the item's usefulness or erase stored data where specified.
numenera.rule.artifact-depletion-chances.blocked_reason: A depletion roll is a conventional resource mechanism.

numenera.rule.cypher-use-and-balance.name: Cypher use and balance

effect.summary: Cyphers are one-use devices, so even extreme effects usually change only one encounter.

numenera.rule.cypher-use-and-balance.cost_or_limit: Their one-use nature limits repeated impact; modest effects encourage use rather than hoarding.
numenera.rule.cypher-use-and-balance.go_wrong: Overly powerful cyphers may encourage characters to save them.
numenera.rule.cypher-use-and-balance.combines: A cypher may sometimes affect all PCs rather than only its user.
numenera.rule.cypher-use-and-balance.blocked_reason: Single-use effects can be resolved by consuming the item.

numenera.rule.oddities-have-no-game-mech.name: Oddities have no game mechanics

effect.summary: An oddity should not require rules; an item needing a game effect is better treated as an artifact or cypher.

numenera.rule.oddities-have-no-game-mech.blocked_reason: This describes a design classification rather than an in-world effect.

numenera.rule.discoveries-are-adventure-.name: Discoveries are adventure-scale

effect.summary: Discoveries are generally too large to carry as gear and are treated as adventure locations or one-time opportunities.

numenera.rule.discoveries-are-adventure-.cost_or_limit: Usually cannot be taken along for later use; more powerful discoveries should be harder to reach.
numenera.rule.discoveries-are-adventure-.blocked_reason: This is guidance for classifying discoveries, not a world mechanism.

numenera.rule.stasis-preservation.name: Stasis preservation

effect.summary: Stasis fields can preserve ancient objects.

numenera.rule.stasis-preservation.blocked_reason: This is a simple preservation mechanism.

numenera.rule.self-repair-mechanisms.name: Self-repair mechanisms

effect.summary: Self-repair restores damaged objects.

numenera.rule.self-repair-mechanisms.blocked_reason: Repair can be represented as restoring an object.

numenera.rule.nanites.name: Nanites

effect.summary: Microscopic machines repair objects at a molecular scale.

numenera.rule.nanites.blocked_reason: The stated repair effect can be represented as a transformation.

numenera.rule.advanced-materials.name: Advanced materials

effect.summary: Some materials are effectively unaffected by time.

numenera.rule.advanced-materials.blocked_reason: This is a material property rather than an active effect.

numenera.rule.perfect-seals-or-protectiv.name: Perfect seals or protective fields

effect.summary: Seals or fields can protect a site and its contents indefinitely.

numenera.rule.perfect-seals-or-protectiv.combines: Can account for preservation within a location.
numenera.rule.perfect-seals-or-protectiv.blocked_reason: The protection applies to a site and its contents as a field.

numenera.rule.genetic-engineering.name: Genetic engineering

effect.summary: Advanced technology can redesign organisms, heal wounds, and create biological tools.

numenera.rule.genetic-engineering.go_wrong: Past engineering or environmental exposure may cause unintended mutations.
numenera.rule.genetic-engineering.mind: Brains can be rewritten with instincts, skills, knowledge, or memories.
numenera.rule.genetic-engineering.who_may: Organisms subject to advanced biological technology.
numenera.rule.genetic-engineering.combines: Includes cloning, implants, grafts, brain rewriting, and advanced drugs.
numenera.rule.genetic-engineering.blocked_reason: The passage includes extensive body redesign and brain rewriting beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.energy-manipulation.name: Energy manipulation

effect.summary: Technology can control electromagnetic energy and fundamental forces.

numenera.rule.energy-manipulation.mind: Can manipulate perception and produce telepathic or telekinetic effects.
numenera.rule.energy-manipulation.who_may: Users or devices able to command such technology.
numenera.rule.energy-manipulation.combines: Can affect matter, energy, molecular bonds, and atomic structure.
numenera.rule.energy-manipulation.blocked_reason: The category includes many distinct effects without enough detail to specify them individually.

numenera.rule.nanotechnology.name: Nanotechnology

effect.summary: Huge numbers of tiny machines reshape matter and manipulate energy.

numenera.rule.nanotechnology.cost_or_limit: Machines may exist in fantastically large numbers.
numenera.rule.nanotechnology.go_wrong: Past nanotechnology may have gone disastrously awry.
numenera.rule.nanotechnology.combines: Can build or repair organic and inorganic structures and create exotic materials.
numenera.rule.nanotechnology.blocked_reason: It can redesign both living organisms and inanimate matter in numerous ways.

numenera.rule.kardashev-scale.name: Kardashev scale

effect.summary: A scale classifies civilizations by their energy use and technological reach.

numenera.rule.kardashev-scale.cost_or_limit: The passage describes Types I through III and mentions extensions to Types IV and V.
numenera.rule.kardashev-scale.blocked_reason: This is a classification scheme, not a playable effect.

numenera.rule.transdimensional-technolog.name: Transdimensional technology

effect.summary: Advanced technology may alter physical laws, create space, or manipulate time.

numenera.rule.transdimensional-technolog.cost_or_limit: Associated with hypothetical Type IV or Type V civilizations.
numenera.rule.transdimensional-technolog.where_from: Civilizations able to affect universal scales or other universes.
numenera.rule.transdimensional-technolog.combines: Includes dimensional energy taps, teleportation, extradimensional spaces, and phase changes.
numenera.rule.transdimensional-technolog.blocked_reason: The described category explicitly includes stopping time and other temporal effects.

numenera.rule.aldeia.name: aldeia

effect.summary: Villages in the Beyond are usually called aldeia and often grow around Aeon Priest claves.

numenera.rule.aldeia.cost_or_limit: The local inhabitants may use another name for their community.
numenera.rule.aldeia.combines: Often associated with Aeon Priest claves.
numenera.rule.aldeia.blocked_reason: This is a naming convention, not a game effect.

numenera.rule.boregal-s-false-answers.name: Boregal’s false answers

effect.summary: A cadaver connected through Boregal always gives a lie in response.

numenera.rule.boregal-s-false-answers.cost_or_limit: Only one question can be asked during the brief connection.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-false-answers.go_wrong: False answers have led to unpredictable consequences.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-false-answers.mind: The machine can have mind-altering effects on users.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-false-answers.who_may: People using the machine to question the dead.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-false-answers.combines: Depends on Boregal’s brief connection to recently deceased brains.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-false-answers.blocked_reason: The rule relies on communication with the dead, which is not represented by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.healing-basins.name: Healing basins

effect.summary: Five colored basins contain a primordial mixture that helps heal minor physical ailments and illnesses.

numenera.rule.healing-basins.cost_or_limit: Their use is free; they heal only minor ailments and illnesses.
numenera.rule.healing-basins.go_wrong: The black basin can expose people to bugs that cause itchy bruises.
numenera.rule.healing-basins.who_may: Travelers and others using the basins.
numenera.rule.healing-basins.combines: The basins contain nanites, microscopic creatures, and other elements.

numenera.rule.boregal-s-regional-influen.name: Boregal's regional influence

effect.summary: Boregal's influence pushes people and creatures in the region toward fear and madness; freeing or destroying him ends it.

numenera.rule.boregal-s-regional-influen.cost_or_limit: The influence persists while Boregal remains active in the machine.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-regional-influen.go_wrong: People and creatures become fearful, paranoid, and violent.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-regional-influen.who_may: People and creatures in the surrounding region.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-regional-influen.combines: Ends when Boregal is freed or destroyed.
numenera.rule.boregal-s-regional-influen.blocked_reason: The effect reaches multiple people and creatures across a region, which requires an area-field capability.

numenera.rule.resurrection-machine.name: Resurrection machine

effect.summary: Briefly brings a dead person back to life so one question can be asked.

numenera.rule.resurrection-machine.cost_or_limit: It permits only one question; the dead always answer falsely.
numenera.rule.resurrection-machine.go_wrong: The revived dead person gives a lie.
numenera.rule.resurrection-machine.mind: The subject can speak to answer the question.
numenera.rule.resurrection-machine.who_may: A user of the machine may question the briefly revived dead.
numenera.rule.resurrection-machine.combines: The magistrate's questioning has involved the dead devoirs.
numenera.rule.resurrection-machine.blocked_reason: Temporarily reviving the dead and specifying their answer behavior require a soul-state capability.

numenera.rule.tank-fluid-toxicity.name: Tank fluid toxicity

effect.summary: Contact with the tank’s fluid poisons a victim and damages them each round until they resist.

numenera.rule.tank-fluid-toxicity.cost_or_limit: The poison is level 4 and deals 4 damage per round.
numenera.rule.tank-fluid-toxicity.go_wrong: A failed defense allows ongoing damage.
numenera.rule.tank-fluid-toxicity.combines: The molecular bonder can seal the tank.
numenera.rule.tank-fluid-toxicity.blocked_reason: A sustained damaging effect can be represented by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.name: Ultraterrestrial seed possession

effect.summary: A seed can implant a consciousness; repeated failed defenses progressively transfer control until the host is fully overridden.

numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.cost_or_limit: Resistance is tested every 28 hours; five failures give total control.
numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.go_wrong: The entity takes over the host’s body and disregards the host’s interests.
numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.mind: The host’s thoughts and bodily control are progressively overridden.
numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.who_may: A living creature that touches a seed and fails its defense.
numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.where_from: The consciousness is stored in a seed.
numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.combines: A specially constructed device may remove the consciousness.
numenera.rule.ultraterrestrial-seed-poss.blocked_reason: Progressive possession, memory-pattern implantation, and bodily control exceed the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.penumbra-fiend-corporeal-f.name: Penumbra Fiend corporeal form

effect.summary: The fiend requires solid matter to form a body; its insubstantial state prevents both affecting and being affected by corporeal creatures.

numenera.rule.penumbra-fiend-corporeal-f.cost_or_limit: After three rounds without regaining solidity, it cannot reform for 1d6+1 days.
numenera.rule.penumbra-fiend-corporeal-f.go_wrong: Destroying its solid form prevents reformation for the same interval; permanent destruction has special lighting and nearby-material conditions.
numenera.rule.penumbra-fiend-corporeal-f.combines: Light and shadow manipulation enables its body.
numenera.rule.penumbra-fiend-corporeal-f.blocked_reason: Changing between corporeal and insubstantial forms is beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.contained-singularity.name: Contained singularity

effect.summary: A vessel contains a singularity that absorbs matter and energy and supplies power.

numenera.rule.contained-singularity.cost_or_limit: Contained in a huge cylindrical vessel.
numenera.rule.contained-singularity.go_wrong: A creature once escaped from it and killed people in the sanctum.
numenera.rule.contained-singularity.who_may: The Convergence draws power from it.
numenera.rule.contained-singularity.combines: Power is sent through conduits linking the sanctums.
numenera.rule.contained-singularity.blocked_reason: The rule depends on a singularity’s containment and its absorption of matter and energy.

numenera.rule.human-brains-process-the-v.name: Human brains process the Venerator

effect.summary: The machine relies on human brain processing for its complex star-energy operation.

numenera.rule.human-brains-process-the-v.go_wrong: Victims may be incapacitated or harmed during disconnection.
numenera.rule.human-brains-process-the-v.mind: Victims are reduced to near-vegetative states.
numenera.rule.human-brains-process-the-v.combines: Processes power from the star-tapping device.
numenera.rule.human-brains-process-the-v.blocked_reason: The mechanism requires captive minds to be connected and used for processing.

numenera.rule.the-cube-cannot-be-damaged.name: The cube cannot be damaged or altered by known Ninth World forces

effect.summary: The black chamber can only be moved by very special transdimensional devices and cannot be damaged or altered by known forces.

numenera.rule.the-cube-cannot-be-damaged.cost_or_limit: Only special transdimensional devices can move it.
numenera.rule.the-cube-cannot-be-damaged.combines: Its interior is vastly larger than its exterior.
numenera.rule.the-cube-cannot-be-damaged.blocked_reason: The chamber has an extreme interior-to-exterior size difference and special spatial behavior.

numenera.rule.preservation-containers-do.name: preservation containers do not keep captives alive

effect.summary: The tower's containers preserve captured beings but are not intended to sustain them.

numenera.rule.preservation-containers-do.cost_or_limit: A captive may die while preserved.
numenera.rule.preservation-containers-do.go_wrong: Captives can decay or die inside.
numenera.rule.preservation-containers-do.who_may: Applies to beings held in the containers.
numenera.rule.preservation-containers-do.combines: Describes the function of the pellucid containers.
numenera.rule.preservation-containers-do.blocked_reason: The passage states the limitation but does not give the container's full operating rules.

numenera.rule.steadfast-seasons.name: Steadfast seasons

effect.summary: The Steadfast year has six seasons; four take roughly one-fifth of the year each, while sable and tempest are half-length seasons.

numenera.rule.steadfast-seasons.combines: Sable has short days and stable weather; tempest brings severe, unpredictable weather and more Iron Wind.
numenera.rule.steadfast-seasons.blocked_reason: This is a calendar mechanism that can be represented as a world rule.

numenera.rule.ninth-world-year.name: Ninth World year

effect.summary: The standard year lasts 313 days, divided into ten 31-day months and three intercalary days.

numenera.rule.ninth-world-year.cost_or_limit: Days last 28 hours; the year has 52 six-day weeks plus a day outside the weeks.
numenera.rule.ninth-world-year.where_from: The Aeon Priests’ widely adopted standard.
numenera.rule.ninth-world-year.combines: The moon’s orbit is said to affect Earth’s rotation.
numenera.rule.ninth-world-year.blocked_reason: The durations and divisions can be recorded as world rules.

numenera.rule.safe-haven.name: Safe Haven

effect.summary: On the final day of the year, debts, trespasses, and records are commonly wiped clean.

numenera.rule.safe-haven.cost_or_limit: A person seeking passage into the new year must place a piece of the past, typically numenera, at the grantor’s doorstep.
numenera.rule.safe-haven.go_wrong: The custom has diminished in some places because people used it to excuse theft.
numenera.rule.safe-haven.who_may: People seeking safe passage into the new year.
numenera.rule.safe-haven.combines: Associated with granting safe haven to another person.
numenera.rule.safe-haven.mechanism: Annual debt and trespass reset in exchange for a numenera offering
numenera.rule.safe-haven.blocked_reason: The custom’s reset and offering can be handled as a world rule.

numenera.rule.gender-alteration.name: gender alteration

effect.summary: Gender is considered fluid and may be altered with the aid of numenera.

numenera.rule.gender-alteration.who_may: People who choose to alter their gender.
numenera.rule.gender-alteration.where_from: The Ninth World’s use of numenera.
numenera.rule.gender-alteration.blocked_reason: The passage allows lasting bodily alteration, which requires transformation support beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.transmissions-control-powe.name: Transmissions control powered numenera

effect.summary: Signals from the Cloudbridge or Heart of Arun can take control of powered devices and change their behavior.

numenera.rule.transmissions-control-powe.where_from: Signals attributed to the Cloudbridge or Heart of Arun.
numenera.rule.transmissions-control-powe.combines: Can make devices act independently or produce different effects.
numenera.rule.transmissions-control-powe.blocked_reason: Taking control of powered devices and changing their effects requires interaction with and alteration of other powers.

numenera.rule.sinkstones-soften-under-pr.name: Sinkstones soften under pressure

effect.summary: Solid stone becomes liquid-like under pressure, then can harden around a trapped body part.

numenera.rule.sinkstones-soften-under-pr.cost_or_limit: A trapped body part is held for two rounds unless freed.
numenera.rule.sinkstones-soften-under-pr.go_wrong: A failed escape attempt leaves the affected part trapped.
numenera.rule.sinkstones-soften-under-pr.who_may: Anyone stepping on a sinkstone can trigger it.
numenera.rule.sinkstones-soften-under-pr.combines: A successful defense can prevent the foot or other part from sinking.
numenera.rule.sinkstones-soften-under-pr.blocked_reason: The passage describes a material changing state under pressure and hardening around a target.

effect.summary: The three Baliachs always act together; their time-altering power is combined.

numenera.rule.the-pit.name: The Pit

effect.summary: The pit protects travelers from reglae but imposes disturbing nightmares on nearby sleepers.

numenera.rule.the-pit.cost_or_limit: The dream effect applies to those sleeping near it.
numenera.rule.the-pit.mind: It controls dreams and can cause madness.
numenera.rule.the-pit.who_may: Travelers and sleepers near the pit
numenera.rule.the-pit.where_from: A location somewhere in the vale
numenera.rule.the-pit.combines: It both shields from reglae and alters nearby sleepers’ dreams.
numenera.rule.the-pit.blocked_reason: The pit combines an area-wide protection with effects on nearby sleepers.

numenera.rule.the-avalanche.name: The Avalanche

effect.summary: After a quake-triggered avalanche blocked the pass, the fallen rocks vanished by the next day.

numenera.rule.the-avalanche.combines: Seismic upheaval followed by disappearance of the avalanche debris.
numenera.rule.the-avalanche.blocked_reason: The passage describes large-scale disappearance of rock, outside the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.the-curse-today.name: The curse today

effect.summary: Infected residents’ bodies remain mobile after death, so locals confine corpses until they wither.

numenera.rule.the-curse-today.cost_or_limit: Confined corpses take months to lose mobility.
numenera.rule.the-curse-today.go_wrong: Unconfined corpses may act according to the nanites’ unknown agenda.
numenera.rule.the-curse-today.mind: The original personality and knowledge do not return.
numenera.rule.the-curse-today.who_may: Tevramere residents and visitors exposed to the curse
numenera.rule.the-curse-today.combines: Infection spreads like a moderately virulent contagion.
numenera.rule.the-curse-today.blocked_reason: The rule requires dead bodies to remain animated without their former selves.

numenera.rule.component-free-devices.name: Component-free devices

effect.summary: Devices without visible workings are harder to identify or modify, but usually easy to use.

numenera.rule.component-free-devices.cost_or_limit: Identification and modification tasks are one step more difficult.
numenera.rule.component-free-devices.who_may: Anyone attempting to identify or modify such devices
numenera.rule.component-free-devices.combines: Usually require no modification for ordinary use.

numenera.rule.energy-eating-slime.name: ENERGY-EATING SLIME

effect.summary: In the Black City, powered devices do not work; activated cyphers are consumed and artifacts still risk depletion.

numenera.rule.energy-eating-slime.cost_or_limit: Only chemical, biological, or otherwise nonpowered devices work.
numenera.rule.energy-eating-slime.go_wrong: Cyphers are lost; artifacts have no effect despite a depletion roll.
numenera.rule.energy-eating-slime.who_may: Anyone using numenera in the Black City
numenera.rule.energy-eating-slime.combines: Applies across several forms of powered energy.
numenera.rule.energy-eating-slime.blocked_reason: The rule imposes a broad location-based block on device effects.

numenera.rule.misplaced-stones.name: Misplaced Stones

effect.summary: Yrkallak stones appear six to ten inches away from their actual locations, regardless of perception method.

numenera.rule.misplaced-stones.cost_or_limit: Applies to rocks and pebbles found throughout Yrkallak.
numenera.rule.misplaced-stones.go_wrong: All tested perceptual and mechanical methods indicate the wrong location.
numenera.rule.misplaced-stones.who_may: Anyone trying to locate the stones
numenera.rule.misplaced-stones.combines: Defeats sight, echolocation, scent, and mechanical measurement.
numenera.rule.misplaced-stones.blocked_reason: The anomaly makes an object’s perceived and actual position disagree.

numenera.rule.gravity-twist.name: Gravity Twist

effect.summary: Gravity first nearly repels entrants, then pulls them down at triple strength, repeating in an irregularly bounded area.

numenera.rule.gravity-twist.cost_or_limit: Usually about ten feet across; partial entry can affect different body parts in opposing ways.
numenera.rule.gravity-twist.go_wrong: Victims may be slammed down repeatedly and injured; partial exposure can cause severe damage.
numenera.rule.gravity-twist.combines: Gravity and time behave as a coupled effect.
numenera.rule.gravity-twist.blocked_reason: It applies alternating, multi-phase force across a poorly bounded area.

numenera.rule.cold-exposure.name: Cold exposure

effect.summary: Unprotected people south of the Southern Wall take three ambient damage hourly; inadequate protection reduces this to one.

numenera.rule.cold-exposure.cost_or_limit: Applies in the extreme cold south of the Southern Wall.
numenera.rule.cold-exposure.go_wrong: Exposure can cause ambient damage each hour.
numenera.rule.cold-exposure.where_from: Climate south of the Southern Wall
numenera.rule.cold-exposure.combines: Proper warm clothing or a numenera device can protect against the cold.

numenera.rule.hidden-cavern-cold-damage.name: Hidden-cavern cold damage

effect.summary: In the hidden ice caves, unprotected creatures take ambient damage each hour.

numenera.rule.hidden-cavern-cold-damage.cost_or_limit: Protection or complete cold immunity avoids the stated danger.
numenera.rule.hidden-cavern-cold-damage.combines: Numenera devices may protect against cold.

numenera.rule.seraph-tempest-entry-hatch.name: Seraph tempest entry hatch

effect.summary: A naked human hand held against the hatch for one minute opens it; automata cannot trigger this.

numenera.rule.seraph-tempest-entry-hatch.cost_or_limit: Requires one minute of bare-hand contact by an eligible living creature.
numenera.rule.seraph-tempest-entry-hatch.go_wrong: No other opening method is stated.
numenera.rule.seraph-tempest-entry-hatch.who_may: Certain varieties of living creatures, including humans, but not automatons.
numenera.rule.seraph-tempest-entry-hatch.combines: Opens onto a climbable synth tunnel.

numenera.rule.urulivan-sphere-exposure.name: Urulivan sphere exposure

effect.summary: Effects generally begin within long range and may grow more severe with exposure time or sphere size.

numenera.rule.urulivan-sphere-exposure.cost_or_limit: Distance, sphere size, and exposure duration affect impact.
numenera.rule.urulivan-sphere-exposure.go_wrong: Long exposure may produce more drastic consequences.
numenera.rule.urulivan-sphere-exposure.who_may: Creatures and objects near a sphere.
numenera.rule.urulivan-sphere-exposure.combines: Applies to the anomalies of Urulivan spheres.
numenera.rule.urulivan-sphere-exposure.blocked_reason: The rule scales multiple unpredictable effects with duration and distance.

numenera.rule.cold-powered-numenera.name: Cold-powered numenera

effect.summary: Some Arxil devices draw energy from intense cold, much as a steam engine uses heat.

numenera.rule.cold-powered-numenera.where_from: Arxil; possibly related to Southern Wall machines.

numenera.rule.firemist-contact.name: Firemist contact

effect.summary: The firemist deals ambient damage to anyone touching it.

numenera.rule.firemist-contact.combines: Some inorganic objects may teleport instead of burning.

numenera.rule.crystal-bursts.name: Crystal bursts

effect.summary: Crystal shards erupt through the ice in dangerous bursts.

numenera.rule.crystal-bursts.cost_or_limit: A burst lasts about a minute; caught characters may need two to four Speed defense rolls.
numenera.rule.crystal-bursts.go_wrong: A burst inflicts damage equal to its level; level is 1d6 + 3.

numenera.rule.white-crater-birth-effect.name: White Crater birth effect

numenera.rule.white-crater-birth-effect.cost_or_limit: Applies to births within three miles of White Crater.
numenera.rule.white-crater-birth-effect.who_may: Organic creatures born in the affected area
numenera.rule.white-crater-birth-effect.blocked_reason: It imposes a lasting physical alteration on creatures.

numenera.rule.gaian-animism.name: Gaian animism
