numenera.rule.gaian-animism.combines: Rituals may commune with spirits for guidance or help.
numenera.rule.gaian-animism.blocked_reason: This is a setting belief, not a supernatural effect that needs implementation.

numenera.rule.iripendra-fertility-and-pr.name: Iripendra fertility and preservation

effect.summary: Intercourse in the clearing never causes pregnancy, and food there does not spoil.

numenera.rule.iripendra-fertility-and-pr.who_may: People and food within the clearing
numenera.rule.iripendra-fertility-and-pr.combines: Two distinct effects share the same location.
numenera.rule.iripendra-fertility-and-pr.blocked_reason: Both effects can be represented as direct restrictions.

numenera.rule.yuola-dispute-resolution.name: Yuola dispute resolution

effect.summary: A Yuola fight can settle an unresolved dispute, with the victor judged right and their demands met.

numenera.rule.yuola-dispute-resolution.cost_or_limit: Combatants may bring nothing besides temporary Yuola harnesses.
numenera.rule.yuola-dispute-resolution.go_wrong: The outcome can decide property, vengeance, or other serious disputes.
numenera.rule.yuola-dispute-resolution.who_may: Two people or two groups represented by individuals

numenera.rule.yuola-challenge.name: Yuola challenge

numenera.rule.yuola-challenge.cost_or_limit: Combatants may bring nothing besides temporary Yuola harnesses.
numenera.rule.yuola-challenge.who_may: A challenger and any willing opponent
numenera.rule.yuola-challenge.blocked_reason: The rule governs the social reward of a contest.

numenera.rule.blood-sacrifice-empowers-t.name: Blood sacrifice empowers the Red Gods

numenera.rule.bloodless-beings-are-not-t.name: Bloodless beings are not truly alive in Vralk

effect.summary: The Red Gods and Vralkan culture treat beings without blood as having no value and not truly living.

numenera.rule.need-based-distribution.cost_or_limit: Resources are scarce; goods are allocated by social rank and need
numenera.rule.need-based-distribution.go_wrong: Unnecessary accumulation leads to punishment and pain

numenera.rule.no-currency-system.name: No currency system

numenera.rule.hellsfont-exposure.name: Hellsfont exposure

numenera.rule.sacrifice-and-blood-meal.name: Sacrifice and blood meal

numenera.rule.sacrifice-and-blood-meal.cost_or_limit: Requires blood sacrifices and the temple's drains
numenera.rule.sacrifice-and-blood-meal.combines: Blood meal fertilizes crops around the city
numenera.rule.sacrifice-and-blood-meal.blocked_reason: The passage describes processing a substance into a different material.

numenera.rule.numenera-intolerance-of-mn.name: Numenera intolerance of mnethashi

effect.summary: Mnethashi cannot abide numenera devices and avoid sunlight.

numenera.rule.numenera-intolerance-of-mn.blocked_reason: The stated avoidance is usable as a constraint without a complex effect.

numenera.rule.the-floating-monolith-s-ac.name: The floating monolith's access platform

effect.summary: Only people using the concealed control platform are described as able to teleport inside Queen’s Spike.

numenera.rule.the-floating-monolith-s-ac.cost_or_limit: Requires reaching the hidden platform and using its controls
numenera.rule.the-floating-monolith-s-ac.blocked_reason: Teleporting people into an enclosed structure requires spatial transport beyond the basic grammar.

numenera.rule.demanisix-s-suspended-anim.name: Demanisix’s suspended animation

effect.summary: The sarcophagus keeps Demanisix in deep suspended animation until the control surface releases her.

numenera.rule.demanisix-s-suspended-anim.cost_or_limit: Release requires using the control surface.
numenera.rule.demanisix-s-suspended-anim.go_wrong: Release exposes her to the transformation and mental unraveling described.
numenera.rule.demanisix-s-suspended-anim.who_may: Anyone able to operate the control surface.
numenera.rule.demanisix-s-suspended-anim.where_from: The Tomb of Demanisix in Errow Cascade.
numenera.rule.demanisix-s-suspended-anim.combines: Her release results in her transformed state.
numenera.rule.demanisix-s-suspended-anim.blocked_reason: Suspended animation is a persistent life-state transition not represented by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.dried-living-airels-as-leg.name: Dried, living airels as legal tender

effect.summary: Only living airels dried and dyed through a month-long process count as official money.

numenera.rule.dried-living-airels-as-leg.cost_or_limit: Preparation is restricted to airelistas; dead airels are worth less than nothing.
numenera.rule.dried-living-airels-as-leg.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as an item-state and value restriction.

numenera.rule.airel-life-sustaining-requ.name: Airel life-sustaining requirement

effect.summary: Airels must be kept alive for their value to remain.

numenera.rule.airel-life-sustaining-requ.cost_or_limit: They are amphibious and long-lived, but must be sustained.
numenera.rule.airel-life-sustaining-requ.go_wrong: A dead airel is worth less than nothing.
numenera.rule.airel-life-sustaining-requ.mechanism: Ongoing preservation of a living asset
numenera.rule.airel-life-sustaining-requ.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward upkeep and item-state constraint.

numenera.rule.three-day-burial-at-sea.name: Three-day burial at sea

effect.summary: People believe a corpse must remain under the waves three days for the dead to enter the skysea.

numenera.rule.three-day-burial-at-sea.cost_or_limit: A drowned person not recovered, or not submerged for three days, is considered lost forever and is no longer named.
numenera.rule.three-day-burial-at-sea.go_wrong: The deceased is believed lost forever if the practice is not completed.
numenera.rule.three-day-burial-at-sea.combines: The body is later used for food, tools, fertilizer, or decoration.
numenera.rule.three-day-burial-at-sea.mechanism: Death and afterlife state determined by burial conditions
numenera.rule.three-day-burial-at-sea.blocked_reason: The passage describes a post-death soul transition and a condition-dependent afterlife.

numenera.rule.glaili-compression-outcome.name: Glaili compression outcomes

effect.summary: Sustained, forceful machine compression can turn glaili into a device, a power source, or useless stone.

numenera.rule.glaili-compression-outcome.cost_or_limit: The process is prolonged and unreliable.
numenera.rule.glaili-compression-outcome.combines: Requires machines applying great force over time.
numenera.rule.glaili-compression-outcome.blocked_reason: The outcome creates objects and power sources from processed material.

numenera.rule.blue-essence-powers-numene.name: Blue essence powers numenera devices

effect.summary: Blue essence extracted from underground can supply power to devices and machines.

numenera.rule.blue-essence-powers-numene.go_wrong: Its origin may be the souls of buried creatures, but this remains a rumor.
numenera.rule.blue-essence-powers-numene.who_may: Users of devices powered by the essence.
numenera.rule.blue-essence-powers-numene.combines: Stored and sold by Blue Datasphere.
numenera.rule.blue-essence-powers-numene.blocked_reason: The proposed soul origin is uncertain and involves a soul-state concept outside the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.gorah-mind-storage-and-rep.name: Gorah mind-storage and replacement rule

effect.summary: A stored resident’s mind returns to the cylinder after bodily injury or death and can receive a new grown body.

numenera.rule.gorah-mind-storage-and-rep.cost_or_limit: Replacement takes two to three months; new minds cannot be added.
numenera.rule.gorah-mind-storage-and-rep.go_wrong: The damaged or dead body is discarded.
numenera.rule.gorah-mind-storage-and-rep.who_may: Residents already stored in Gorah’s device.
numenera.rule.gorah-mind-storage-and-rep.combines: Requires the statue’s cylinder and body-growing pods.
numenera.rule.gorah-mind-storage-and-rep.blocked_reason: The rule depends on persistent mind backups and restoration after death.

numenera.rule.the-vanishing-lake.name: The Vanishing Lake

effect.summary: The whole lake, including its creatures, sometimes vanishes and later returns.

numenera.rule.the-vanishing-lake.cost_or_limit: It stays absent for one to six days.
numenera.rule.the-vanishing-lake.combines: The lake and its inhabitants vanish together.
numenera.rule.the-vanishing-lake.blocked_reason: The stated disappearance and return can be modeled as a delayed movement or removal effect.

numenera.rule.rotting-wood.name: Rotting Wood

effect.summary: A clearing rapidly degrades organic matter and ages or destroys creatures that approach its center.

numenera.rule.rotting-wood.cost_or_limit: The effect intensifies toward the clearing’s heart, where a creature can become dust in seconds.
numenera.rule.rotting-wood.who_may: Affects creatures and organic objects entering the area.
numenera.rule.rotting-wood.blocked_reason: The escalating area-based aging and disintegration are not captured by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.mirror-door.name: Mirror Door

effect.summary: A tailor-shop mirror briefly becomes a doorway to a distant place.

numenera.rule.mirror-door.cost_or_limit: It opens only on certain nights and only for a few moments; timing is unpredictable.
numenera.rule.mirror-door.who_may: Anyone able to pass through it.
numenera.rule.mirror-door.where_from: A tailor shop in Imriche; it leads to the northern Hidden Mountains.
numenera.rule.mirror-door.blocked_reason: A triggered, temporary movement effect can be represented by the basic grammar.

numenera.rule.the-exsiccation-pit.name: The Exsiccation Pit

effect.summary: The pit drains all water from anything inside it over three rounds.

numenera.rule.the-exsiccation-pit.cost_or_limit: Characters in the pit move one step down the damage track each round.
numenera.rule.the-exsiccation-pit.go_wrong: Organic intruders may also be attacked by a passing tentacle.
numenera.rule.the-exsiccation-pit.who_may: Anything in the pit is affected unless protected.
numenera.rule.the-exsiccation-pit.combines: A level 4 artifact can shield one living creature from its effects.
numenera.rule.the-exsiccation-pit.blocked_reason: The broad area hazard and its staged damage-track consequences are not represented by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.the-magnetic-gallery.name: The Magnetic Gallery

effect.summary: Activated magnetic waves arrange colored metal dust and can seize, twist, and destroy metal equipment.

numenera.rule.the-magnetic-gallery.cost_or_limit: Escaping the equipment-destroying effect requires a difficulty 6 Speed- or Might-based task.
numenera.rule.the-magnetic-gallery.go_wrong: A metal weapon or item may be destroyed.
numenera.rule.the-magnetic-gallery.who_may: Visitors in the gallery; the control panel can be activated by a visitor who deciphers it.
numenera.rule.the-magnetic-gallery.combines: The control panel also contains cyphers and oddities if dismantled.
numenera.rule.the-magnetic-gallery.blocked_reason: The gallery’s broad magnetic field and equipment interaction are not covered by a simple targeted effect.

numenera.rule.the-labyrinth-of-sound.name: The Labyrinth of Sound

effect.summary: The maze permits movement only when the traveler produces tones suited to the desired direction.

numenera.rule.the-labyrinth-of-sound.cost_or_limit: Normal movement is impossible; different directions require different tones.
numenera.rule.the-labyrinth-of-sound.who_may: Travelers able to produce the right sounds.
numenera.rule.the-labyrinth-of-sound.combines: The maze is dark and absorbs light.
numenera.rule.the-labyrinth-of-sound.blocked_reason: Sound-triggered movement can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.the-curving.name: The Curving

effect.summary: Within the affected area, straight paths and trajectories bend, and vision mislocates objects.

numenera.rule.the-curving.cost_or_limit: The anomaly covers roughly a mile and a half.
numenera.rule.the-curving.go_wrong: Movement and thrown objects may go off course.
numenera.rule.the-curving.mind: Perception of direction and position is distorted.
numenera.rule.the-curving.who_may: People and objects within the area.
numenera.rule.the-curving.combines: It affects crafted objects, movement, falling objects, and vision.
numenera.rule.the-curving.blocked_reason: The broad field alters trajectories and perception across an area.

numenera.rule.waterwielder-creation-limi.name: Waterwielder creation limits

effect.summary: Waterwielding cannot create complicated items, cyphers, artifacts, or special equipment.

numenera.rule.waterwielder-creation-limi.cost_or_limit: Creation is restricted by complexity, price, size, and duration.
numenera.rule.waterwielder-creation-limi.mechanism: Limits what the ability can create
numenera.rule.waterwielder-creation-limi.blocked_reason: The rule restricts item creation beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.breathing-switch-movement-.name: Breathing-switch movement restriction

effect.summary: After 28 hours without switching between water and air breathing, movement tasks become harder until the person switches environments for a few minutes.

numenera.rule.breathing-switch-movement-.cost_or_limit: The restriction begins after 28 hours without a switch.
numenera.rule.breathing-switch-movement-.who_may: The character described in the passage
numenera.rule.breathing-switch-movement-.combines: Switching between water and air breathing ends the limitation
numenera.rule.breathing-switch-movement-.blocked_reason: The limit can be represented as a timed condition.

numenera.rule.rayskelan-death-journey.name: Rayskelan death journey

effect.summary: After death, a Rayskelan is placed underwater for three days to travel from the body and become a luminous skysea creature.

numenera.rule.rayskelan-death-journey.cost_or_limit: Requires a close person to place the body underwater for three days.
numenera.rule.rayskelan-death-journey.mechanism: Death transition into a new form
numenera.rule.rayskelan-death-journey.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar cannot represent post-death travel from a body and a resulting afterlife state.

numenera.rule.humanoid-victims-of-a-vulu.name: Humanoid victims of a vulun can become new vuluns

effect.summary: Vulun crystallization can transform a victim from within; a new vulun emerges after death.

numenera.rule.humanoid-victims-of-a-vulu.cost_or_limit: The process can be halted by recovery or healing, or by a successful Might task.
numenera.rule.humanoid-victims-of-a-vulu.go_wrong: If the victim dies while crystallizing, a new vulun emerges from the corpse.
numenera.rule.humanoid-victims-of-a-vulu.mind: The new vulun shares its creator’s mind and personality.
numenera.rule.humanoid-victims-of-a-vulu.who_may: Humanoid victims exposed to vulun crystallization
numenera.rule.humanoid-victims-of-a-vulu.mechanism: Creature transformation and shared group mind
numenera.rule.humanoid-victims-of-a-vulu.blocked_reason: The rule concerns post-death emergence and the transmission of a creature’s mind and personality.

numenera.rule.metallic-ice-cyphers-melt-.name: Metallic-ice cyphers melt within a day if not kept chilled

effect.summary: Cyphers left by a defeated vulun function normally but melt within a day unless kept cold.

numenera.rule.metallic-ice-cyphers-melt-.cost_or_limit: Must be kept chilled to prevent melting.
numenera.rule.metallic-ice-cyphers-melt-.go_wrong: They melt if not kept chilled within a day.
numenera.rule.metallic-ice-cyphers-melt-.who_may: Applies to cyphers made of metallic ice
numenera.rule.metallic-ice-cyphers-melt-.combines: The items otherwise function like normal cyphers.
numenera.rule.metallic-ice-cyphers-melt-.blocked_reason: The rule requires an item to track a temperature-dependent state and timed melting.

numenera.rule.zarg-weapon-poison-deals-o.name: Zarg weapon poison deals ongoing Speed damage until resisted

effect.summary: The poison deals one Speed damage each round until the victim succeeds on a Might defense.

numenera.rule.zarg-weapon-poison-deals-o.who_may: Victims struck by poisoned zarg weapons
numenera.rule.zarg-weapon-poison-deals-o.combines: Mystics prepare it for their weapons.
numenera.rule.zarg-weapon-poison-deals-o.blocked_reason: Recurring damage that ends on a successful defense can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.name: paradox leaves a dimensional husk

effect.summary: A time-tripper who escapes chronal feeders may be pinched off into a burnt-out timeline, leaving a dimensional husk instead of a corpse.

numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.cost_or_limit: Risk follows tampering with cause and effect, time ripples, or creating a true paradox.
numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.go_wrong: The transgressor may be removed from the timeline and leave behind a husk.
numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.mind: The husk retains confused, vengeful echoes.
numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.who_may: Those who tamper with time or create paradoxes.
numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.where_from: The world’s apparent resistance to alterations of cause and effect.
numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.combines: Chronal feeders may pursue and dispatch transgressors first.
numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.mechanism: Temporal displacement into a burnt-out timeline.
numenera.rule.paradox-leaves-a-dimension.blocked_reason: It specifies a persistent husk left by temporal removal rather than ordinary death.

numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.name: dream sallow consciousness storage

effect.summary: A victim’s consciousness can survive after the body dies as a memory stored in the tree’s dream.

numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.cost_or_limit: The body commonly dies after about a week; releasing a victim requires the sallow’s consent or intervention.
numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.go_wrong: Removing a living victim improperly can cause death or a lasting Intellect loss.
numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.mind: Stored consciousness remains in a shared dream and may recognize its condition.
numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.who_may: Victims connected to a dream sallow’s roots.
numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.where_from: The sallow’s living psionic storage system.
numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.combines: Victims may negotiate through avatars in the consensual dream.
numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.mechanism: Consciousness persists independently of the dying body in a shared dream.
numenera.rule.dream-sallow-consciousness.blocked_reason: Persistent consciousness after bodily death and its later release require a soul-state mechanism.

numenera.rule.virus-infection-progressio.name: virus infection progression

effect.summary: Infection first exposes thoughts and sensory input, then may let the virus control actions.

numenera.rule.virus-infection-progressio.cost_or_limit: Information transfer starts after about 28 hours; control can begin after seven days, with resistance becoming harder daily.
numenera.rule.virus-infection-progressio.go_wrong: Infected characters may lose control of their actions.
numenera.rule.virus-infection-progressio.mind: Thoughts and sensory experience are transmitted to the Insidious Choir.
numenera.rule.virus-infection-progressio.combines: The same progression applies to the three engineered host types.
numenera.rule.virus-infection-progressio.mechanism: Timed infection, information transfer, and escalating control.
numenera.rule.virus-infection-progressio.blocked_reason: The rule requires a virus to bind to minds and progressively control behavior.

numenera.rule.energy-form-matter-interac.name: Energy-form matter interaction

effect.summary: Erulians in energy form pass through matter but cannot affect material objects.

numenera.rule.energy-form-matter-interac.cost_or_limit: They may be unable to perceive while passing through matter.
numenera.rule.energy-form-matter-interac.who_may: Applies to erulians in energy form.
numenera.rule.energy-form-matter-interac.combines: They take solid form to attack or manipulate objects.
numenera.rule.energy-form-matter-interac.blocked_reason: The rule depends on switching between insubstantial and solid forms.

numenera.rule.falling-maw-zero-gravity.name: Falling maw zero gravity

effect.summary: A falling maw creates a zone of zero gravity around itself.

numenera.rule.falling-maw-zero-gravity.cost_or_limit: The field extends to short range; creatures may drift out if they push off without something to grab.
numenera.rule.falling-maw-zero-gravity.go_wrong: A sealed enclosure can eventually lose all its air to the maw.
numenera.rule.falling-maw-zero-gravity.who_may: Applies to creatures and objects in the area.
numenera.rule.falling-maw-zero-gravity.combines: The maw can attack within its gravity-altered region.
numenera.rule.falling-maw-zero-gravity.blocked_reason: The rule creates a persistent area-wide change to gravity.

numenera.rule.ferno-walker-heat-attack-c.name: Ferno walker heat attack cost

effect.summary: A ferno walker spends its own health to produce superheated spew.

numenera.rule.ferno-walker-heat-attack-c.cost_or_limit: The area attack costs 1 health and the ranged attack costs 2.
numenera.rule.ferno-walker-heat-attack-c.combines: The attacks use the same superheated liquid.
numenera.rule.ferno-walker-heat-attack-c.blocked_reason: A health cost can be represented as a limit on an ordinary heat attack.

numenera.rule.flesh-pup-gestation.name: Flesh pup gestation

effect.summary: An unnoticed flesh pup develops in its host and produces young after a gestation period.

numenera.rule.flesh-pup-gestation.cost_or_limit: The young reach their parent’s size within a week; removing the litter requires restraint and serious injury to the host.
numenera.rule.flesh-pup-gestation.go_wrong: The host becomes impaired near the end and may die or be debilitated when the pups emerge.
numenera.rule.flesh-pup-gestation.mind: The host may refuse inspection or treatment due to altered brain chemistry.
numenera.rule.flesh-pup-gestation.who_may: A host infected by a flesh pup.
numenera.rule.flesh-pup-gestation.combines: The parent and litter can be surgically removed before hatching.
numenera.rule.flesh-pup-gestation.blocked_reason: The rule requires a creature to develop and reproduce inside a living host.

numenera.rule.gemorrn-datasphere-relocat.name: Gemorrn datasphere relocation

effect.summary: A gemorrn can upload to the datasphere, travel through its reach, and download into a new nanobot haze.

numenera.rule.gemorrn-datasphere-relocat.cost_or_limit: It can do so once per day and not in a round when damaged.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-datasphere-relocat.where_from: The datasphere and a fresh nanobot haze.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-datasphere-relocat.combines: The relocation moves the same entity to a new location.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-datasphere-relocat.blocked_reason: The rule requires persistence of an entity through upload and reconstruction.

numenera.rule.gemorrn-mind-absorption.name: Gemorrn mind absorption

effect.summary: A portion of a creature’s mind becomes part of a gemorrn when it kills that creature.

numenera.rule.gemorrn-mind-absorption.cost_or_limit: The gemorrn gains 5 health, even beyond its starting maximum.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-mind-absorption.go_wrong: The victim’s mental residue remains rageful and hungry.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-mind-absorption.mind: A part of the victim’s mind is incorporated into the gemorrn.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-mind-absorption.where_from: A victim killed by a gemorrn.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-mind-absorption.combines: The absorbed mind extends the gemorrn’s existence.
numenera.rule.gemorrn-mind-absorption.blocked_reason: The rule transfers a portion of a dead creature’s mind into another being.

numenera.rule.glacier-slime-egg-activati.name: Glacier slime egg activation

effect.summary: A struck egg can hatch a new slime or release stored cold as a cypher.

numenera.rule.glacier-slime-egg-activati.cost_or_limit: The egg is benign unless struck and shattered.
numenera.rule.glacier-slime-egg-activati.go_wrong: Striking it can expel the immediate area’s heat.
numenera.rule.glacier-slime-egg-activati.who_may: Anyone who strikes or shatters an egg can trigger it.
numenera.rule.glacier-slime-egg-activati.combines: Some eggs can be salvaged as heat-drain detonation cyphers.
numenera.rule.glacier-slime-egg-activati.blocked_reason: The egg’s state determines whether it hatches or functions as a heat-draining device.

numenera.rule.golthiar-sunlight-regenera.name: Golthiar sunlight regeneration

effect.summary: A golthiar regenerates health when exposed to direct sunlight.

numenera.rule.golthiar-sunlight-regenera.cost_or_limit: Restores 1 health per round while in direct sunlight.
numenera.rule.golthiar-sunlight-regenera.blocked_reason: The regeneration is a straightforward vitality-restoration effect.

numenera.rule.grush-survival.name: Grush survival

effect.summary: A grush can survive severe wounds, regenerate, and may recover hours after losing a limb or head.

numenera.rule.grush-survival.go_wrong: Severing its head or an arm may fail to kill it.
numenera.rule.grush-survival.blocked_reason: The creature’s continued life after normally fatal wounds requires a special death-state rule.

numenera.rule.latos-stored-location-pres.name: Latos stored-location preservation

effect.summary: A latos can contain a larger, permanently preserved place inside its head; destruction transplants that place into the surrounding world.

numenera.rule.latos-stored-location-pres.cost_or_limit: The transplanted place is empty of life except possibly machine entities or creatures in stasis.
numenera.rule.latos-stored-location-pres.combines: The location can be accessed by a willing target transported by the latos.
numenera.rule.latos-stored-location-pres.blocked_reason: The rule requires a contained location to persist and then be transplanted into the world.

numenera.rule.magmid-tunnel-geometry.name: Magmid tunnel geometry

effect.summary: Magmid tunnels follow a consistent, unusual geometry and do not track mineral veins, resources, or earlier tunnels.

numenera.rule.magmid-tunnel-geometry.cost_or_limit: Tunnels are generally circular, over 13 feet wide, and descend along long curved paths.
numenera.rule.magmid-tunnel-geometry.go_wrong: Nexus chambers can lack gravity and distort other physical laws.
numenera.rule.magmid-tunnel-geometry.combines: Tunnels meet in large nexus chambers.

numenera.rule.merkadian-soldier-regenera.name: Merkadian soldier regeneration

effect.summary: A defeated soldier restores itself to full health over one day unless beheaded and stripped of its devices.

numenera.rule.merkadian-soldier-regenera.cost_or_limit: Beheading and removing every numenera device prevents regeneration.
numenera.rule.merkadian-soldier-regenera.go_wrong: It returns in an increasingly corpse-like condition.
numenera.rule.merkadian-soldier-regenera.where_from: The soldier’s devices or nature; the source is uncertain.
numenera.rule.merkadian-soldier-regenera.combines: Requires both beheading and device removal to stop.

numenera.rule.minnern-cypher-use.name: minnern cypher use

effect.summary: Cyphers built into a minnern’s armor can be activated once each round rather than only once.

numenera.rule.minnern-cypher-use.cost_or_limit: The creature uses one cypher as an action each round.
numenera.rule.minnern-cypher-use.combines: The cyphers are part of the armor.
numenera.rule.minnern-cypher-use.blocked_reason: It changes the normal use limit for powers carried by an item.

numenera.rule.nagaina-egg-pod-developmen.name: nagaina egg-pod development

effect.summary: Nagaina material injected into a fresh or living body develops into egg pods over months, which may remain dormant for decades.

numenera.rule.nagaina-egg-pod-developmen.cost_or_limit: Pod development takes about three months; dormancy lasts at least a year and can last a century or longer.
numenera.rule.nagaina-egg-pod-developmen.where_from: Fibrous material injected into organic tissue.
numenera.rule.nagaina-egg-pod-developmen.combines: Each pod contains a sleeper and defender with one shared genetic directive.
numenera.rule.nagaina-egg-pod-developmen.blocked_reason: It creates egg pods and two creatures through prolonged biological transformation.

numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.name: nalurus facial infection

effect.summary: The nalurus’s facial pattern triggers a rapid brain-liquefying infection in exposed humans and related beings.

numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.cost_or_limit: Looking away avoids exposure but makes attacks and defenses harder; a victim may recover on a successful defense unless exposed again.
numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.go_wrong: The infection can progress to death if the victim reaches the bottom of the damage track.
numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.mind: The pattern imprints on the victim’s mind as part of the infection.
numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.who_may: Humans, abhumans, and related creatures who see the face.
numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.where_from: The ridged patterns on a nalurus’s face.
numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.combines: A corpse remains infectious by sight for about one day.
numenera.rule.nalurus-facial-infection.blocked_reason: The effect has progressive stages, can improve or worsen, and can be lethal.

numenera.rule.quotien-regeneration.name: Quotien regeneration

effect.summary: A slain quotien can return from its head after weeks unless all brain tissue is burned.

numenera.rule.quotien-regeneration.cost_or_limit: Every piece of brain tissue must be destroyed to prevent recovery.
numenera.rule.quotien-regeneration.go_wrong: The returned quotien remembers its past and seeks revenge on its killer.
numenera.rule.quotien-regeneration.mind: Identity and knowledge survive the death interval.
numenera.rule.quotien-regeneration.blocked_reason: The rule requires persistence of identity and memories through death and regeneration.

numenera.rule.rahenum-material-shaping.name: Rahenum material shaping

effect.summary: A concentrating rahenum shapes sand, drit, or silt into items or structures over several minutes.

numenera.rule.rahenum-material-shaping.cost_or_limit: Requires several minutes of concentration; complexity depends on the rahenum’s mastery.
numenera.rule.rahenum-material-shaping.combines: Skilled makers can create etched glass with special qualities, including illumination.
numenera.rule.rahenum-material-shaping.blocked_reason: The rule creates physical objects from raw material rather than applying a basic effect to an existing target.

numenera.rule.relentless-reaper-target-r.name: Relentless reaper target rule

effect.summary: A reaper pursues its marked target, switches to that person’s killer if the target dies first, and deactivates after the target dies naturally or is killed.

numenera.rule.relentless-reaper-target-r.cost_or_limit: Blocking datasphere access can prevent it from locating the target.
numenera.rule.relentless-reaper-target-r.go_wrong: Killing the marked person transfers the reaper’s target to the killer.
numenera.rule.relentless-reaper-target-r.who_may: Applies to relentless reapers and their targets.
numenera.rule.relentless-reaper-target-r.where_from: A datasphere connection links reaper and target.
numenera.rule.relentless-reaper-target-r.blocked_reason: The rule requires a persistent target link and conditional reassignment or deactivation.

numenera.rule.rurtalian-linked-aspects.name: Rurtalian linked aspects

effect.summary: The physical and mental aspects share a life state: if either dies, both die.

numenera.rule.rurtalian-linked-aspects.cost_or_limit: The mental aspect has its own 18 health and is a separate level 4 creature.
numenera.rule.rurtalian-linked-aspects.go_wrong: Death of either aspect kills both.
numenera.rule.rurtalian-linked-aspects.combines: The physical body keeps the mental aspect from discorporating.
numenera.rule.rurtalian-linked-aspects.blocked_reason: The rule links separate entities’ health and death states.

numenera.rule.silver-orphan-detached-par.name: Silver orphan detached parts

effect.summary: Detached portions normally flow back to the orphan; preventing reunion disables construct-making for an hour.

numenera.rule.silver-orphan-detached-par.cost_or_limit: The loss of construct-making lasts one hour.
numenera.rule.silver-orphan-detached-par.go_wrong: Prevented rejoining causes the temporary loss of that ability.
numenera.rule.silver-orphan-detached-par.combines: Detached bolts and other body parts share this property.
numenera.rule.silver-orphan-detached-par.blocked_reason: The rule relies on body parts separating, rejoining, and regenerating.

numenera.rule.spurn-cypher-absorption.name: Spurn cypher absorption

effect.summary: Absorbing a functioning cypher restores 1d6 health to a spurn.

numenera.rule.spurn-cypher-absorption.cost_or_limit: The cypher must be functioning and is absorbed into the spurn’s body.
numenera.rule.spurn-cypher-absorption.combines: A wounded spurn may try to take a character’s cypher.
numenera.rule.spurn-cypher-absorption.blocked_reason: A carried device is consumed to produce a healing effect.

numenera.rule.stellar-weaver-web-exile.name: Stellar weaver web exile

effect.summary: A creature trapped in a web for more than four rounds is sent to extradimensional space.

numenera.rule.stellar-weaver-web-exile.cost_or_limit: Escape requires getting free and then navigating the web’s nonsticky strands.
numenera.rule.stellar-weaver-web-exile.go_wrong: The trapped creature may remain confined and await the weaver.
numenera.rule.stellar-weaver-web-exile.combines: The venom does not kill victims sent there; they may remain alive.
numenera.rule.stellar-weaver-web-exile.blocked_reason: This rule requires an extradimensional holding space and a special escape mechanism.

numenera.rule.syzygy-ghoul-brain-knowled.name: Syzygy ghoul brain knowledge

effect.summary: Eating the brain of a creature dead for at most ten days transfers its conscious knowledge to the ghoul.

numenera.rule.syzygy-ghoul-brain-knowled.cost_or_limit: The deceased must have been dead no longer than ten days.
numenera.rule.syzygy-ghoul-brain-knowled.mind: The ghoul receives the deceased creature’s consciously held knowledge.
numenera.rule.syzygy-ghoul-brain-knowled.combines: The ghouls may offer this knowledge in exchange for other information.
numenera.rule.syzygy-ghoul-brain-knowled.blocked_reason: The rule accesses a deceased person’s knowledge through their remains.

numenera.rule.leverett-s-return.name: Leverett’s return

effect.summary: After Leverett dies, a fresh copy appears from a numenera column with memories up to his death.

numenera.rule.leverett-s-return.cost_or_limit: The copy appears after several hours somewhere in the Ninth World.
numenera.rule.leverett-s-return.mind: The new copy retains his memories up to death.
numenera.rule.leverett-s-return.combines: Possibly connected with the Twelfth Ode’s headquarters.
numenera.rule.leverett-s-return.blocked_reason: The passage specifies a post-death copy and memory continuity, which require a soul or backup-state mechanism.

numenera.rule.existence-scythe-depletion.name: existence scythe depletion

effect.summary: The scythe depletes on a roll of 1–4 on 1d20.

numenera.rule.existence-scythe-depletion.cost_or_limit: A depletion roll of 1–4 ends its use.

numenera.rule.creature-index.name: CREATURE INDEX

effect.summary: A game-book index listing creature names and page references.

numenera.rule.creature-index.blocked_reason: This is an index heading rather than a world mechanism.

numenera.rule.bioengineered-creatures-ca.name: Bioengineered creatures can reproduce and evolve

effect.summary: Some engineered creatures reproduce naturally, allowing evolution to reshape their descendants over time.

numenera.rule.bioengineered-creatures-ca.go_wrong: Descendants may diverge substantially from their designed ancestors.
numenera.rule.bioengineered-creatures-ca.combines: Natural selection can overtake original design.

numenera.rule.artificially-intelligent-c.name: Artificially intelligent characters’ recovery and vulnerabilities

effect.summary: Machine characters resist organic-system effects but are vulnerable to effects that disrupt machines.

numenera.rule.artificially-intelligent-c.cost_or_limit: Healing and drugs for organic bodies do not work; machine repair is needed for some recovery.
numenera.rule.artificially-intelligent-c.mind: Positive interaction with organic beings is harder.
numenera.rule.artificially-intelligent-c.combines: Pairs with artificial bodies and limited recovery.

numenera.rule.biotechnological-life-requ.name: Biotechnological life requires nutrients

effect.summary: Some biotech devices and organisms need nutrients instead of conventional power.

numenera.rule.biotechnological-life-requ.cost_or_limit: Nutrients may come from solutions, injections, or a host.
numenera.rule.biotechnological-life-requ.go_wrong: Failure to obtain nutrients can prevent operation or survival.
numenera.rule.biotechnological-life-requ.combines: May use tanks, tubes, or parasitic feeding.

numenera.rule.chemical-cyphers-do-not-re.name: Chemical cyphers do not require power

effect.summary: Chemical cyphers resist effects that drain or negate another item's power.

numenera.rule.chemical-cyphers-do-not-re.combines: They are immune to power-draining or power-negating effects.
numenera.rule.chemical-cyphers-do-not-re.blocked_reason: Immunity to other powers' effects requires a power-interaction rule.

numenera.rule.cypher-limit.name: Cypher limit

effect.summary: Pills and injectors may count toward a character's cypher carrying limit, at the GM's option.

numenera.rule.cypher-limit.cost_or_limit: The GM decides whether pills and injectors count toward the limit.
numenera.rule.cypher-limit.combines: Some advanced compounds might react to other devices' radiations.
numenera.rule.cypher-limit.blocked_reason: This is a game limit, not an effect needing additional mechanics.

numenera.rule.extradimensional-spaces-an.name: Extradimensional spaces and scans

effect.summary: Some pocket spaces resist scans, teleportation, and other effects.

numenera.rule.extradimensional-spaces-an.cost_or_limit: Whether a space resists them varies by space.
numenera.rule.extradimensional-spaces-an.combines: May interfere with scanning and teleportation.
numenera.rule.extradimensional-spaces-an.blocked_reason: The space can be inaccessible to scanning and teleportation.

numenera.rule.datasphere-damage-carries-.name: Datasphere damage carries over

effect.summary: Intellect damage suffered in the datasphere can affect other stat Pools and cause physical death.

numenera.rule.datasphere-damage-carries-.cost_or_limit: Damage may carry over to other Pools.
numenera.rule.datasphere-damage-carries-.go_wrong: Characters may die both virtually and physically.
numenera.rule.datasphere-damage-carries-.mind: Intellect damage is suffered in the datasphere.
numenera.rule.datasphere-damage-carries-.combines: Virtual damage can transfer to physical stat Pools.
numenera.rule.datasphere-damage-carries-.blocked_reason: The passage links virtual existence and physical death, which requires cross-state character modeling.

numenera.rule.occultic-cypher-carrying-c.name: Occultic cypher carrying count

effect.summary: An occultic cypher counts as two cyphers when determining how many a character can carry and use.

numenera.rule.occultic-cypher-carrying-c.cost_or_limit: Each occultic cypher uses two places in the limit.
numenera.rule.occultic-cypher-carrying-c.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward carrying limit.

numenera.rule.cypher-level-weapon-nodule.name: Cypher-level weapon nodule effect

effect.summary: Weapon-attached effects may trigger on strikes, with some capped at once per round.

numenera.rule.cypher-level-weapon-nodule.cost_or_limit: Certain attached effects specify a duration and trigger limit.
numenera.rule.cypher-level-weapon-nodule.combines: Nodules can sometimes function together on one weapon.
numenera.rule.cypher-level-weapon-nodule.blocked_reason: A basic effect model needs rules for powers carried by items and their trigger limits.

numenera.rule.fallback-clone-transfer-co.name: Fallback clone transfer condition

effect.summary: Consciousness transfers to the prepared clone on death only if the user is wearing the required headband.

numenera.rule.fallback-clone-transfer-co.cost_or_limit: The clone takes a month to grow; the headband must be worn at death.
numenera.rule.fallback-clone-transfer-co.go_wrong: Death without the headband prevents transfer.
numenera.rule.fallback-clone-transfer-co.mind: The transfer carries skills, abilities, and knowledge.
numenera.rule.fallback-clone-transfer-co.blocked_reason: It specifies persistence of consciousness and knowledge across death.

numenera.rule.head-transference-collar-b.name: Head Transference Collar body compatibility

effect.summary: A preserved head can control a recently deceased body, potentially changing physical Pools and other qualities.

numenera.rule.head-transference-collar-b.cost_or_limit: The body must have died less than an hour before grafting.
numenera.rule.head-transference-collar-b.go_wrong: Detached consciousness may suffer mental harm.
numenera.rule.head-transference-collar-b.mind: The head remains conscious and takes control of the new body.
numenera.rule.head-transference-collar-b.who_may: A creature whose head is preserved by the collar.
numenera.rule.head-transference-collar-b.blocked_reason: It transfers a head and mind into a different body.

numenera.rule.artifact-level-and-depleti.name: Artifact level and depletion

effect.summary: Artifacts have levels and usually deplete when a designated die shows a listed depletion result; a dash means never depletes and automatic means one use.

numenera.rule.artifact-level-and-depleti.cost_or_limit: Depletion depends on the artifact’s stated die and result.
numenera.rule.artifact-level-and-depleti.go_wrong: A depleted artifact may stop working.
numenera.rule.artifact-level-and-depleti.blocked_reason: This is a rule for how artifact use and depletion work.

numenera.rule.artifact-recharging.name: Artifact recharging

effect.summary: Some depleted artifacts can be recharged through repair rules or abilities that restore power, usually for one use.

numenera.rule.artifact-recharging.cost_or_limit: Repowering may yield only one use.
numenera.rule.artifact-recharging.who_may: Repair rules or suitable special abilities may repower items.
numenera.rule.artifact-recharging.combines: Rides the Lightning can repower an item.
numenera.rule.artifact-recharging.blocked_reason: The rule allows power to be restored to an expended item.

numenera.rule.artifact-rarity.name: Artifact rarity

effect.summary: A device may be unique, uncommon, or locally ubiquitous; the GM determines its availability and recognition.

numenera.rule.artifact-rarity.cost_or_limit: Rarity varies by region and device.
numenera.rule.artifact-rarity.who_may: The GM decides rarity and recognition.
numenera.rule.artifact-rarity.blocked_reason: This describes how device prevalence and familiarity vary in the setting.

numenera.rule.amalgam-items.name: Amalgam items

effect.summary: Some devices combine ancient numenera parts with newer construction; scavengers find the ancient parts and add the newer ones.

numenera.rule.amalgam-items.cost_or_limit: Newer components must be supplied or attached by craftspeople.
numenera.rule.amalgam-items.who_may: Scavengers or crafters add the newer parts.
numenera.rule.amalgam-items.combines: Ancient numenera components combine with newer-made portions.
numenera.rule.amalgam-items.blocked_reason: This is a rule about how composite devices are made and found.

numenera.rule.snail-shell-cypher-capacit.name: Snail-shell cypher capacity

effect.summary: A snail shell can hold up to two handheld-sized cyphers, which do not count toward the bearer’s cypher limit.

numenera.rule.snail-shell-cypher-capacit.cost_or_limit: Two cyphers, each no larger than a typical handheld device.
numenera.rule.snail-shell-cypher-capacit.blocked_reason: The rule defines item capacity and an exception to a character’s cypher limit.

numenera.rule.cypher-carrying-capacity.name: Cypher carrying capacity

effect.summary: An Arkus can bear two cyphers at first tier, three at third tier, and four at fifth tier.

numenera.rule.cypher-carrying-capacity.cost_or_limit: Capacity rises at the stated tiers.
numenera.rule.cypher-carrying-capacity.go_wrong: Exceeding the stated capacity is not described here.
numenera.rule.cypher-carrying-capacity.blocked_reason: A carrying limit for power-bearing cyphers is not represented by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.community-dependent-abilit.name: Community-dependent abilities

effect.summary: Certain Arkus abilities require an allied community or horde; a few may work with at least three allies who spend their actions helping.

numenera.rule.community-dependent-abilit.cost_or_limit: The required allied community, local knowledge, or assisting allies must be present as specified.
numenera.rule.community-dependent-abilit.go_wrong: Benefits may not function when those requirements are unmet.
numenera.rule.community-dependent-abilit.combines: Some allies can substitute for community support by giving up their actions each round.

numenera.rule.follower-level-progression.name: Follower level progression

effect.summary: A follower gains a level whenever its PC advances two tiers; the PC selects its new modification.

numenera.rule.follower-level-progression.cost_or_limit: Requires two PC tier advances after the follower is gained.

numenera.rule.exceptional-follower.name: Exceptional Follower

effect.summary: An exceptional follower has regular follower qualities but is one level higher.

numenera.rule.exceptional-follower.cost_or_limit: The GM determines when one is found.
numenera.rule.exceptional-follower.combines: May result from positive interaction or roleplaying.

numenera.rule.follower-modifications.name: Follower modifications

effect.summary: A follower grants assets only for its listed tasks; its level sets how many tasks it can support.

numenera.rule.follower-modifications.cost_or_limit: A follower cannot help with tasks lacking a modification; autonomously, each modification raises its effective level for that task by one.
numenera.rule.follower-modifications.combines: The PC generally rolls for the follower.
numenera.rule.follower-modifications.mechanism: Task assistance and modified NPC level

numenera.rule.follower-combat-and-defens.name: Follower combat and defense assistance

effect.summary: Followers can assist attacks or defense only from level 3 onward and with a matching modification.

numenera.rule.follower-combat-and-defens.cost_or_limit: Specific focus abilities may make an exception.
numenera.rule.follower-combat-and-defens.combines: Controls Beasts is cited as an exception.

numenera.rule.follower-replacement-after.name: Follower replacement after death

effect.summary: A character gets a replacement follower after at least two weeks and proper recruitment.

numenera.rule.follower-replacement-after.cost_or_limit: Two weeks and proper recruitment are required.

numenera.rule.cypher-and-artifact-deplet.name: Cypher and artifact depletion

effect.summary: Some drained or recharged devices become useless, depleted, broken, or make a depletion roll.

numenera.rule.cypher-and-artifact-deplet.cost_or_limit: Device type determines the outcome; a recharged unbroken device gets one extra use before depletion and breakage.
numenera.rule.cypher-and-artifact-deplet.go_wrong: Use can deplete or break a device.
numenera.rule.cypher-and-artifact-deplet.where_from: Item operations described for Energy Redirection
numenera.rule.cypher-and-artifact-deplet.combines: Cyphers, artifacts, installations, vehicles, and automatons.
numenera.rule.cypher-and-artifact-deplet.blocked_reason: The rule requires tracked depletion and broken states for items.

numenera.rule.iotum-destruction-and-pers.name: Iotum destruction and persistence

effect.summary: Some abilities consume or destroy iotum, while other temporary uses leave it intact until the effect expires or is used.

numenera.rule.iotum-destruction-and-pers.cost_or_limit: The specific ability determines whether iotum is consumed.
numenera.rule.iotum-destruction-and-pers.go_wrong: Consumed iotum is destroyed; some adapted iotum expires after about a minute.
numenera.rule.iotum-destruction-and-pers.combines: Impressive Device, Right Tool for the Job, Quick Armoring, Quick Mind Boost, and environmental adaptation.
numenera.rule.iotum-destruction-and-pers.blocked_reason: The rules distinguish iotum material use, consumption, and preservation.

numenera.rule.community-damage-from-jugg.name: Community damage from Juggernaut

effect.summary: Using Juggernaut in a community action reduces infrastructure by five until repairs are made and increases that action’s damage by six.

numenera.rule.community-damage-from-jugg.cost_or_limit: Applies only when Juggernaut is used during a community action.
numenera.rule.community-damage-from-jugg.blocked_reason: The numeric community adjustments can be handled directly.

numenera.rule.familiarity-retention.name: Familiarity retention

effect.summary: Learning a new familiarized area replaces the previous one unless experience is spent to preserve it.

numenera.rule.familiarity-retention.cost_or_limit: Spending 1 XP keeps prior familiarity permanently.
numenera.rule.familiarity-retention.go_wrong: Previous area familiarity is lost otherwise.
numenera.rule.familiarity-retention.mind: Removes the character’s mechanical familiarity with an earlier area.
numenera.rule.familiarity-retention.blocked_reason: Area familiarity and its replacement are simple tracked character states.

numenera.rule.environmental-adaptation-e.name: Environmental adaptation extreme-cost rule

effect.summary: In extreme conditions, protection may cost io and Intellect equal in split to the damage avoided each round.

numenera.rule.environmental-adaptation-e.cost_or_limit: The GM may set total cost equal to damage avoided, split between io and Intellect; each extra protected creature adds the same cost.
numenera.rule.environmental-adaptation-e.go_wrong: Extreme hazards can rapidly exhaust the required resources.
numenera.rule.environmental-adaptation-e.blocked_reason: A resource cost linked to prevented damage can be adjudicated directly.

numenera.rule.delve-s-fortitude-duration.name: Delve’s Fortitude duration

effect.summary: A condition can be ignored for an hour, or negated outright if its normal duration is shorter; a matching focus benefit extends the duration to five hours.

numenera.rule.delve-s-fortitude-duration.blocked_reason: This is a duration and scope rule for a power.

numenera.rule.experienced-finder-search-.name: Experienced Finder search limits

effect.summary: Finding requires active looking and possible perception; it replaces a roll only at difficulty 6 or below unless Effort raises the limit.

numenera.rule.experienced-finder-search-.cost_or_limit: The target must be within short range during the 28-hour duration.
numenera.rule.experienced-finder-search-.go_wrong: The ability fails when the character is occupied or unable to perceive the target.
numenera.rule.experienced-finder-search-.combines: Effort raises the maximum target level by one per level.
numenera.rule.experienced-finder-search-.blocked_reason: This is a direct limit on a search ability.

numenera.rule.trapfinder-level-limit.name: Trapfinder level limit

effect.summary: Trapfinder detects traps up to level 4, with each Effort level increasing the cap by two.

numenera.rule.trapfinder-level-limit.go_wrong: Traps above the raised level cap are not found.
numenera.rule.trapfinder-level-limit.blocked_reason: This is a numerical limit on a detection ability.

numenera.rule.wrest-from-chance-recovery.name: Wrest From Chance recovery limit

effect.summary: After a use, Wrest From Chance is unavailable until a ten-hour recovery roll.

numenera.rule.wrest-from-chance-recovery.cost_or_limit: A second natural 1 on the reroll still causes an intrusion.
numenera.rule.wrest-from-chance-recovery.go_wrong: A second 1 does not avoid the intrusion.
numenera.rule.wrest-from-chance-recovery.blocked_reason: This is a direct reuse and outcome rule.

numenera.rule.iotum-cache-result.name: Iotum Cache result

effect.summary: Finding or salvaging iotum grants an additional result on the Iotum Result Table.

numenera.rule.iotum-cache-result.blocked_reason: This is an additional result in a referenced procedure.

numenera.rule.adept-cypher-use-capacity.name: Adept Cypher Use capacity

effect.summary: A Delve with this ability may bear four cyphers at a time.

numenera.rule.adept-cypher-use-capacity.blocked_reason: The rule sets a character’s capacity for carrying power-bearing items.

numenera.rule.concussion-device-depletio.name: Concussion device depletion

effect.summary: The fashioned iotum explosive lasts about a minute or until detonated, and detonation destroys the iotum.

numenera.rule.concussion-device-depletio.cost_or_limit: Requires at least one unit of iotum.
numenera.rule.concussion-device-depletio.go_wrong: The resource is destroyed on use.
numenera.rule.concussion-device-depletio.combines: Can be thrown or set to a short timer.
numenera.rule.concussion-device-depletio.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an item carrying a delayed power and being consumed on use.

numenera.rule.not-dead-yet-final-death.name: Not Dead Yet final death

effect.summary: The ability prevents one death, but a further death before the ten-hour recovery is final.

numenera.rule.not-dead-yet-final-death.cost_or_limit: The user must complete a ten-hour recovery before the protection resets.
numenera.rule.not-dead-yet-final-death.go_wrong: Dying again before that recovery means true death.
numenera.rule.not-dead-yet-final-death.combines: Delve’s Fortitude can reduce the post-return condition severity.
numenera.rule.not-dead-yet-final-death.blocked_reason: It defines survival and final death across a recovery interval.

numenera.rule.risk-taking-luck-push.name: Risk-Taking luck push

effect.summary: Risk-Taking can push luck to succeed at a difficult task, but at the cost of a GM intrusion.

numenera.rule.risk-taking-luck-push.who_may: A character with the Risk-Taking descriptor
numenera.rule.risk-taking-luck-push.blocked_reason: The cost is an externally adjudicated narrative intrusion.

numenera.rule.community-ability-applicab.name: Community ability applicability

effect.summary: Characters using Glaive, Jack, or Nano from Numenera Discovery gain these community abilities at their appropriate tier when using Destiny community rules.

numenera.rule.community-ability-applicab.cost_or_limit: Benefits are added in addition to regular type benefits.
numenera.rule.community-ability-applicab.who_may: Discovery Glaives, Jacks, and Nanos using Destiny community rules
numenera.rule.community-ability-applicab.combines: Adds the listed community abilities at the corresponding tier.
numenera.rule.community-ability-applicab.blocked_reason: This is a character-build applicability rule.

numenera.rule.rampaging-beast-horde-dura.name: Rampaging Beast Horde duration extension

effect.summary: Each allied player character who stays with the Glaive and spends 12 Pool points adds an hour to the horde duration; damage drains Might and is split evenly if allies assist.

numenera.rule.rampaging-beast-horde-dura.cost_or_limit: Initial use costs 12 Might; each participating ally spends 12 Pool points.
numenera.rule.rampaging-beast-horde-dura.go_wrong: Damage reduces the participating characters’ Might Pools.
numenera.rule.rampaging-beast-horde-dura.who_may: A Glaive using Rampaging Beast Horde and assisting allies
numenera.rule.rampaging-beast-horde-dura.combines: Allies extend duration and share damage.
numenera.rule.rampaging-beast-horde-dura.blocked_reason: It distributes damage and duration across multiple allied characters.

numenera.rule.adaptable-pool-reassignmen.name: Adaptable Pool reassignment

effect.summary: The Adaptable descriptor’s two-point Pool bonus can be reassigned after each ten-hour recovery roll.

numenera.rule.adaptable-pool-reassignmen.cost_or_limit: Only one Pool is raised at a time.
numenera.rule.adaptable-pool-reassignmen.blocked_reason: This is a bounded character-stat reassignment rule.

numenera.rule.dedicated-task-asset-limit.name: Dedicated task asset limit

effect.summary: Committed grants its task asset once between ten-hour recovery rolls, and only for the same task.

numenera.rule.dedicated-task-asset-limit.cost_or_limit: It cannot transfer to a merely similar task.
numenera.rule.dedicated-task-asset-limit.blocked_reason: This is a direct restriction on an ability’s reuse and scope.

numenera.rule.cultured-learned-refresh.name: Cultured Learned refresh

effect.summary: Learned refreshes at every recovery roll, and unused applications do not accumulate.

numenera.rule.cultured-learned-refresh.blocked_reason: This is a direct limit on an ability’s use and refresh.

numenera.rule.confident-outlook-refresh.name: Confident Outlook refresh

effect.summary: Confident Outlook can be used once per rest and refreshes after a recovery roll.

numenera.rule.confident-outlook-refresh.cost_or_limit: Applies for ten minutes and cannot train attacks or defenses.
numenera.rule.confident-outlook-refresh.blocked_reason: This is a direct restriction on the ability’s duration, target tasks, and reuse.

numenera.rule.quick-study-response-limit.name: Quick Study response limitation

effect.summary: Empirical characters’ response action is hindered whenever a GM intrusion occurs if they have not had time to study the situation.

numenera.rule.quick-study-response-limit.cost_or_limit: Applies when there has been no time to study.
numenera.rule.quick-study-response-limit.blocked_reason: This is a direct condition-based task penalty.

numenera.rule.people-person-use-limit.name: People Person use limit

effect.summary: People Person eases one noncombat task when at least two allies are within immediate range, once until the next recovery roll.

numenera.rule.people-person-use-limit.cost_or_limit: Requires two or more nearby allies; refreshes after a recovery roll.
numenera.rule.people-person-use-limit.blocked_reason: This is a bounded task bonus with explicit proximity conditions.

numenera.rule.foci-optional-special-abil.name: Foci optional special abilities

effect.summary: Players can choose between tier abilities and later swap or select an earlier unchosen option instead of a later focus ability.

numenera.rule.foci-optional-special-abil.cost_or_limit: Choice options apply at tiers three and six; later advancement can eventually grant all focus abilities.
numenera.rule.foci-optional-special-abil.combines: Can replace a normally granted focus ability at a later tier.

numenera.rule.stored-kinetic-energy-capa.name: Stored kinetic energy capacity

effect.summary: At first, the absorber stores one damage point; improved ability raises storage to two, while release remains one point at a time.

numenera.rule.stored-kinetic-energy-capa.cost_or_limit: Storage capacity depends on the selected focus ability.
numenera.rule.stored-kinetic-energy-capa.go_wrong: At the initial capacity, extra absorbed damage bleeds away as harmless light.
numenera.rule.stored-kinetic-energy-capa.who_may: Characters with the Absorbs Energy focus
numenera.rule.stored-kinetic-energy-capa.combines: Pure-energy absorption does not itself increase storage capacity.

numenera.rule.energized-object-limit-and.name: Energized object limit and trigger

effect.summary: An energized object holds energy until touched by someone other than its user, and the user can carry only one such object.

numenera.rule.energized-object-limit-and.cost_or_limit: One energized object on the user at a time.
numenera.rule.energized-object-limit-and.combines: The stored burst adds damage to the touched creature beyond the weapon’s damage.
numenera.rule.energized-object-limit-and.mechanism: Item-bound stored power and carry limit
numenera.rule.energized-object-limit-and.blocked_reason: The rule binds an effect to an item with a contact trigger and a carry cap.

numenera.rule.energize-creature-transfer.name: Energize Creature transfer limit

effect.summary: Granted energy-absorption powers last an hour, but recipients cannot release excess energy as a blast.

numenera.rule.energize-creature-transfer.cost_or_limit: Affects one creature by default; Effort can add targets; costs at least six Might points.
numenera.rule.energize-creature-transfer.go_wrong: Recipients cannot perform the blast-release part.
numenera.rule.energize-creature-transfer.combines: Can also transfer the user’s pure-energy or improved kinetic absorption abilities.
numenera.rule.energize-creature-transfer.blocked_reason: The rule grants a character’s ability to other creatures for a set duration.

numenera.rule.energize-crowd-target-cap.name: Energize Crowd target cap

effect.summary: The crowd version grants energy absorption to as many as thirty nearby creatures for an hour, without granting blast release.

numenera.rule.energize-crowd-target-cap.cost_or_limit: Costs nine Might points; maximum thirty creatures; duration one hour.
numenera.rule.energize-crowd-target-cap.go_wrong: Recipients cannot release excess energy as a blast.
numenera.rule.energize-crowd-target-cap.combines: Recipients can use pure-energy or improved kinetic absorption if the user has those abilities.
numenera.rule.energize-crowd-target-cap.blocked_reason: The ability transfers powers temporarily to a group of creatures.

numenera.rule.grafted-cypher-capacity-an.name: Grafted cypher capacity and depletion

effect.summary: A grafted cypher still counts against the cypher limit and depletes on 1 in 1d10, but is not destroyed after one use.

numenera.rule.grafted-cypher-capacity-an.cost_or_limit: Grafts count toward the cypher limit and have 1-in-1d10 depletion.
numenera.rule.grafted-cypher-capacity-an.go_wrong: A depleted graft cannot be used until recharged or otherwise restored.
numenera.rule.grafted-cypher-capacity-an.combines: Creature-part grafts use the same limit and depletion rules.
numenera.rule.grafted-cypher-capacity-an.blocked_reason: The rule requires powers to remain bound to a graft with a capacity cost and depletion chance.

numenera.rule.grafting-creature-parts.name: Grafting creature parts

effect.summary: Grafting another creature’s part requires a surgery task whose difficulty rises with biological dissimilarity; failure ruins the part.

numenera.rule.grafting-creature-parts.cost_or_limit: Default difficulty equals creature level; dissimilar biology can add two or more hindering steps.
numenera.rule.grafting-creature-parts.go_wrong: On a failed roll, the body part is ruined and unusable.
numenera.rule.grafting-creature-parts.combines: Successful grafts act like comparable cyphers and follow graft limits and depletion.
numenera.rule.grafting-creature-parts.blocked_reason: The rule involves attaching foreign body parts and granting their biological abilities.

numenera.rule.artifact-fusion-level.name: Artifact fusion level

effect.summary: An artifact surgically grafted to the body functions as though it were one level higher.

numenera.rule.artifact-fusion-level.cost_or_limit: Requires an artifact graft and surgical procedure.
numenera.rule.artifact-fusion-level.combines: Changes the fused artifact’s effective level.
numenera.rule.artifact-fusion-level.blocked_reason: The rule binds an artifact to a character and modifies its operating level.

numenera.rule.object-damage-track.name: Object Damage Track

effect.summary: Objects progress from intact to minor damage, major damage, and destroyed, with function lost at major damage or worse.

numenera.rule.object-damage-track.cost_or_limit: Might damage rolls move an object down the track; hardness changes effective level.
numenera.rule.object-damage-track.go_wrong: Major damage breaks function; destruction makes an object irreparable by ordinary means.
numenera.rule.object-damage-track.combines: Breaker and Destroyer abilities use this track.
numenera.rule.object-damage-track.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as discrete object damage states.

numenera.rule.customization-limit-and-re.name: Customization limit and repair

effect.summary: Each customization option can be selected only once per installation; depleted customization effects can be repaired for 2 XP and days equal to object level.

numenera.rule.customization-limit-and-re.cost_or_limit: One selection of each option per installation; repair costs 2 XP and level-based days.
numenera.rule.customization-limit-and-re.go_wrong: Customization effects can deplete and stop functioning until repaired.
numenera.rule.customization-limit-and-re.combines: Repair applies to depleted customization effects.
numenera.rule.customization-limit-and-re.blocked_reason: The rule tracks a customized item’s distinct depleted state and repair procedure.

numenera.rule.separate-customization-dep.name: Separate customization depletion

effect.summary: A customization’s depletion chance is tracked separately from any other depletion effect on its item.

numenera.rule.separate-customization-dep.cost_or_limit: Each listed customization has its own depletion check.
numenera.rule.separate-customization-dep.go_wrong: A given customization may deplete independently of other item functions.
numenera.rule.separate-customization-dep.combines: Applies to Guarding, Acquisition, Healing, Alliance, and the listed deluxe options.
numenera.rule.separate-customization-dep.blocked_reason: The rule requires separate depletion states for multiple powers on one item.

numenera.rule.one-dark-matter-structure-.name: One Dark Matter Structure at a Time

effect.summary: Only one structure created with Dark Matter Structure can be solid at once.

numenera.rule.one-dark-matter-structure-.who_may: Applies to users of Dark Matter Structure.
numenera.rule.one-dark-matter-structure-.blocked_reason: A simple limit on simultaneous created structures is supported.

numenera.rule.crystal-entrapment-and-dam.name: Crystal Entrapment and Damage

effect.summary: A user inside a crystal must exit to meet ordinary needs; major damage or destruction forces an incapacitating exit and worsens their damage track.

numenera.rule.crystal-entrapment-and-dam.cost_or_limit: The user is not in stasis and must eat, drink, and sleep normally.
numenera.rule.crystal-entrapment-and-dam.go_wrong: Crystal damage causes immediate exit, three rounds without action, and two damage-track steps of worsening.
numenera.rule.crystal-entrapment-and-dam.mind: The user remains aware while inside the crystal.
numenera.rule.crystal-entrapment-and-dam.blocked_reason: This rule governs a character stored within an object and the consequences of that state.

numenera.rule.crystalline-recovery-limit.name: Crystalline Recovery Limit

effect.summary: Crystalline characters lack the ten-minute recovery roll, and abilities requiring it instead require an hour-long roll.

numenera.rule.crystalline-recovery-limit.cost_or_limit: Only one-round, one-hour, and ten-hour recovery rolls are available each day.
numenera.rule.crystalline-recovery-limit.combines: Changes recovery-roll requirements for other abilities.
numenera.rule.crystalline-recovery-limit.blocked_reason: This rule changes the timing and availability of recovery rolls.

numenera.rule.resonant-frequency-shatter.name: Resonant Frequency Shattering

effect.summary: An item enhanced by Resonant Frequency inevitably builds vibration until it shatters and damages nearby creatures.

numenera.rule.resonant-frequency-shatter.cost_or_limit: Enhanced function lasts one minute before the buildup culminates.
numenera.rule.resonant-frequency-shatter.go_wrong: The item shatters; nearby creatures take damage.
numenera.rule.resonant-frequency-shatter.who_may: Applies to items affected by Resonant Frequency.
numenera.rule.resonant-frequency-shatter.combines: The effect follows the temporary increase in item level.
numenera.rule.resonant-frequency-shatter.blocked_reason: The rule requires tracking a temporary item enhancement and its delayed destructive state.

numenera.rule.teamwork-requires-shared-t.name: Teamwork Requires Shared Time

effect.summary: Teamwork ends when the user leaves allies and requires renewed time together after an absence longer than 28 hours.

numenera.rule.teamwork-requires-shared-t.cost_or_limit: The group must spend 28 hours together to reactivate the benefit after a longer departure.
numenera.rule.teamwork-requires-shared-t.go_wrong: Leaving ends the bonus until the required shared time is completed.
numenera.rule.teamwork-requires-shared-t.who_may: The user of Teamwork and affected allies.
numenera.rule.teamwork-requires-shared-t.combines: The bonus applies only to allies who spent the preceding 28 hours with the user.
numenera.rule.teamwork-requires-shared-t.blocked_reason: The rule is a time-based condition on a group bonus.

numenera.rule.radiant-abilities.name: Radiant Abilities

effect.summary: Abilities that would use force or other energy instead produce light and heat.

numenera.rule.radiant-abilities.cost_or_limit: Applies to the user's esoteries or similar abilities.
numenera.rule.radiant-abilities.combines: Ward is given as an example of the conversion.
numenera.rule.radiant-abilities.blocked_reason: It changes the element and manifestation of other powers.

numenera.rule.shard-of-the-sun-color.name: Shard of the Sun Color

effect.summary: A chosen light color can change the effects of some light abilities.

numenera.rule.shard-of-the-sun-color.cost_or_limit: Requires GM agreement; listed colors modify Dazzling Sunburst or healing.
numenera.rule.shard-of-the-sun-color.go_wrong: Color variants may remove the normal damage or daze effect while substituting another result.
numenera.rule.shard-of-the-sun-color.mind: Some options frighten, dazzle, or cause loss of a turn.
numenera.rule.shard-of-the-sun-color.who_may: A character with the light-based focus, with GM approval.
numenera.rule.shard-of-the-sun-color.combines: Modifies Dazzling Sunburst and, for green, healing tasks.
numenera.rule.shard-of-the-sun-color.blocked_reason: The rule changes how other named powers operate.

numenera.rule.biomorphic-field-revival-c.name: Biomorphic field revival cost

effect.summary: A mostly intact user can return to life after violent death, but loses 2 Intellect Pool points permanently.

numenera.rule.biomorphic-field-revival-c.cost_or_limit: Revival occurs one minute after death and requires the body to remain mostly intact.
numenera.rule.biomorphic-field-revival-c.go_wrong: The permanent Intellect loss is the cost of returning to life.
numenera.rule.biomorphic-field-revival-c.who_may: A user with Regenerate; Regenerate Other may attempt to confer it on another.
numenera.rule.biomorphic-field-revival-c.combines: Perfect preservation removes the time limit for Regenerate Other.
numenera.rule.biomorphic-field-revival-c.mechanism: Death-state transition with a permanent resource cost.
numenera.rule.biomorphic-field-revival-c.blocked_reason: This rule governs death, return to life, and the condition of the body.

numenera.rule.phase-and-movement.name: Phase and movement

effect.summary: The user becomes partly phased while moving and is solid while still.

numenera.rule.phase-and-movement.cost_or_limit: Some abilities permit specific actions during movement; armor benefits may be lost while phased.
numenera.rule.phase-and-movement.go_wrong: Moving rapidly may lead to stumbles on exotic obstacles.
numenera.rule.phase-and-movement.who_may: A character with the Shreds the Walls of the World focus.
numenera.rule.phase-and-movement.combines: Enables Phase Sprint and other phase abilities.
numenera.rule.phase-and-movement.blocked_reason: The rule changes the body's interaction with ordinary reality.

numenera.rule.additive-enabler-costs.name: Additive enabler costs

effect.summary: Combining some abilities can require spending from two different Pools.

numenera.rule.additive-enabler-costs.cost_or_limit: The passage gives Phase Sprint combined with Disrupting Touch or Scratch Existence as examples.
numenera.rule.additive-enabler-costs.where_from: Rules for the Shreds the Walls of the World focus.
numenera.rule.additive-enabler-costs.combines: Applies when linked abilities are used together.
numenera.rule.additive-enabler-costs.mechanism: Additive resource expenditure for combined powers.
numenera.rule.additive-enabler-costs.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward additional cost.

numenera.rule.parts-from-salvaging.name: Parts from salvaging

effect.summary: Successful salvage yields parts alongside salvaged items, with quantities tied to item levels.

numenera.rule.parts-from-salvaging.cost_or_limit: Successful salvaging of iotum, cyphers, or artifacts yields units equal to their combined levels; salvaging shins or oddities yields one unit.
numenera.rule.parts-from-salvaging.go_wrong: A failed initial salvage can still yield one unit of parts.
numenera.rule.parts-from-salvaging.combines: Parts are abstract units used in crafting and tracked separately from iotum.
numenera.rule.parts-from-salvaging.blocked_reason: This is a salvage yield rule.

numenera.rule.salvage-source-level-limit.name: Salvage source level limit

effect.summary: A source cannot contain iotum higher in level than the source itself.

numenera.rule.salvage-source-level-limit.cost_or_limit: For cyphers, reroll if their level is below the minimum level of the iotum result.
numenera.rule.salvage-source-level-limit.combines: Restricts results from the iotum result table.
numenera.rule.salvage-source-level-limit.blocked_reason: This is a limit on possible salvage results.

numenera.rule.io-value-and-currency.name: Io value and currency

effect.summary: Io values other iotum but cannot be exchanged for shins or similar currencies.

numenera.rule.io-value-and-currency.cost_or_limit: Io is at least ten times more valuable than comparable ordinary currency.
numenera.rule.io-value-and-currency.go_wrong: Ordinary NPCs often lack the means to pay iotum's value.
numenera.rule.io-value-and-currency.who_may: Traders and communities dealing in iotum
numenera.rule.io-value-and-currency.combines: Some communities may accept io for cyphers or artifacts.
numenera.rule.io-value-and-currency.blocked_reason: This is an economic exchange rule.

numenera.rule.protomatter-salvage-size-r.name: Protomatter salvage size restriction

effect.summary: Protomatter cannot be salvaged from small sources unless extradimensional storage is involved.

numenera.rule.protomatter-salvage-size-r.cost_or_limit: The source must be at least 40 feet on a side because one unit is extremely massive.
numenera.rule.protomatter-salvage-size-r.go_wrong: A too-small-source result yields thaum dust instead.
numenera.rule.protomatter-salvage-size-r.combines: An extradimensional space can bypass the ordinary size restriction.
numenera.rule.protomatter-salvage-size-r.blocked_reason: The rule depends on extradimensional space to contain or house an oversized material unit.

numenera.rule.standard-depletion-ranges.name: Standard depletion ranges

effect.summary: Numenera objects can have depletion categories ranging from single-use to no depletion.

numenera.rule.standard-depletion-ranges.cost_or_limit: The listed sequence includes single-use cyphers, automatic use, progressively less likely depletion rolls, and no depletion.
numenera.rule.standard-depletion-ranges.go_wrong: A depleted device may stop functioning according to its depletion category.
numenera.rule.standard-depletion-ranges.combines: Monopoles can improve an object's expected depletion range.
numenera.rule.standard-depletion-ranges.blocked_reason: It requires tracking an item's changing depletion state.

numenera.rule.tamed-iron-substitution.name: Tamed iron substitution

effect.summary: One unit of tamed iron can replace one unit of another required iotum up to level 8.

numenera.rule.tamed-iron-substitution.cost_or_limit: The substitution is unit for unit and capped at level 8.
numenera.rule.tamed-iron-substitution.combines: Applies when crafting with other iotum.
numenera.rule.tamed-iron-substitution.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward crafting constraint.

numenera.rule.transporting-massive-iotum.name: Transporting massive iotum

effect.summary: Some salvaged materials are so large that transport may require several mounts, a wagon, or a custom vehicle.

numenera.rule.transporting-massive-iotum.cost_or_limit: Depends on the material’s size and weight.
numenera.rule.transporting-massive-iotum.combines: May require mounts, wagons, or a vehicle.

numenera.rule.midnight-stone-activation-.name: Midnight stone activation and consumption

effect.summary: A held stone requires concentration and a difficulty 4 activation; choosing an effect requires a second difficulty 8 task, and successful use consumes it.

numenera.rule.midnight-stone-activation-.cost_or_limit: One successful use destroys the stone; failed activation leaves it somnolent.
numenera.rule.midnight-stone-activation-.go_wrong: Failure to channel a chosen effect returns it to its somnolent state.
numenera.rule.midnight-stone-activation-.combines: Chosen effects require GM permission if not on the table.
numenera.rule.midnight-stone-activation-.blocked_reason: The rule depends on the stone’s somnolent, activated, and consumed states.

numenera.rule.plans-set-crafting-require.name: Plans set crafting requirements

effect.summary: Numenera plans specify required iotum quantities and types, and the project’s minimum crafting level.

numenera.rule.plans-set-crafting-require.cost_or_limit: The object cannot be crafted below its stated minimum crafting level.
numenera.rule.plans-set-crafting-require.go_wrong: A task assessed above difficulty 10 cannot proceed until reduced.
numenera.rule.plans-set-crafting-require.combines: Plans combine with iotum, parts, skills, and tools.
numenera.rule.plans-set-crafting-require.blocked_reason: The rule specifies ordinary crafting prerequisites and limits.

numenera.rule.numenera-crafting-difficul.name: Numenera crafting difficulty

effect.summary: Numenera crafting difficulty is higher than the finished object’s level, with category-specific modifiers.

numenera.rule.numenera-crafting-difficul.cost_or_limit: The assessed task must be reduced to difficulty 10 or less to proceed.
numenera.rule.numenera-crafting-difficul.go_wrong: A task remaining above 10 is impossible to craft for now.
numenera.rule.numenera-crafting-difficul.combines: Skills, tools, abilities, cyphers, and components can lower difficulty.
numenera.rule.numenera-crafting-difficul.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward task-difficulty rule.

numenera.rule.crafting-subtasks-and-mish.name: Crafting subtasks and mishaps

effect.summary: Crafting requires successes across rising-difficulty subtasks; repeated failure wastes time and destroys one unit of the highest-level iotum.

numenera.rule.crafting-subtasks-and-mish.cost_or_limit: Subtask count equals assessed difficulty; a second consecutive failure on one subtask destroys iotum.
