numenera.rule.crafting-subtasks-and-mish.go_wrong: Failure wastes the interval; repeated failure causes a material mishap.
numenera.rule.crafting-subtasks-and-mish.combines: Difficulty reductions lower time, subtask count, and final subtask difficulty.
numenera.rule.crafting-subtasks-and-mish.mechanism: Extended crafting test and resource loss
numenera.rule.crafting-subtasks-and-mish.blocked_reason: The procedure is a task and resource-loss rule.

numenera.rule.sustained-effort-limit.name: Sustained Effort limit

effect.summary: Effort cannot be applied to crafting tasks or subtasks lasting more than 28 hours.

numenera.rule.sustained-effort-limit.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward limit on applying Effort.

numenera.rule.crafting-time-and-pauses.name: Crafting time and pauses

effect.summary: Long projects assume about nine hours of active work each day; processes can continue while the crafter is away, but away time does not count as build time.

numenera.rule.crafting-time-and-pauses.cost_or_limit: A project still requires at least 28 hours to craft.
numenera.rule.crafting-time-and-pauses.combines: An appropriately trained ally may continue the work with GM permission.
numenera.rule.crafting-time-and-pauses.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward crafting-time rule.

numenera.rule.object-damage-states.name: Object damage states

effect.summary: Disabled objects are straightforward to repair; minor damage lowers effective level, major damage stops function, and destroyed objects cannot be repaired.

numenera.rule.object-damage-states.go_wrong: Major damage halts function; destruction prevents repair.
numenera.rule.object-damage-states.combines: Depleted objects count as major damage; automatons are treated as creatures with health.
numenera.rule.object-damage-states.blocked_reason: The rule requires tracking multiple object conditions and their functional states.

numenera.rule.automaton-damage-treatment.name: Automaton damage treatment

effect.summary: Automatons are treated as creatures with health rather than objects subject to minor and major damage.

numenera.rule.automaton-damage-treatment.cost_or_limit: The GM decides how special damage applies.
numenera.rule.automaton-damage-treatment.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward classification rule.

numenera.rule.iotum-substitution.name: Iotum substitution

effect.summary: A substitute iotum must meet or exceed the missing material’s level and be supplied in equal units; usually only one type may be substituted.

numenera.rule.iotum-substitution.cost_or_limit: Substitution hinders crafting unless the material has a special substitution quality.
numenera.rule.iotum-substitution.go_wrong: An unsuitable substitute hinders the task.
numenera.rule.iotum-substitution.combines: A special iotum quality can remove the hindrance.
numenera.rule.iotum-substitution.blocked_reason: This is a material and difficulty constraint.

numenera.rule.concurrent-crafting-projec.name: Concurrent crafting projects

effect.summary: A character can normally maintain a number of simultaneous projects equal to their tier.

numenera.rule.concurrent-crafting-projec.cost_or_limit: The limit can be increased by special abilities or equipment.
numenera.rule.concurrent-crafting-projec.combines: Special abilities or gear may raise the limit.
numenera.rule.concurrent-crafting-projec.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward numerical limit.

numenera.rule.modification-of-effects.name: Modification of effects

effect.summary: Small increases to targets, range, or duration are allowed; larger changes require a new plan.

numenera.rule.modification-of-effects.cost_or_limit: Small adjustments are typically one target, 50 feet of range, or one round or several hours of duration.
numenera.rule.modification-of-effects.combines: A modification beyond the small-change allowance becomes plan development.
numenera.rule.modification-of-effects.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward limit on crafting modifications.

numenera.rule.appearance-modifications.name: Appearance modifications

effect.summary: Aesthetic changes that do not alter effects require twice the usual parts contribution.

numenera.rule.appearance-modifications.go_wrong: Aesthetic changes cannot grant new or change existing effects.
numenera.rule.appearance-modifications.combines: May change appearance without changing function.
numenera.rule.appearance-modifications.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward cost and restriction.

numenera.rule.effect-modifications.name: Effect modifications

effect.summary: Changing an effect requires an additional unit of iotum at least as high-level as the finished object and adds at least one crafting difficulty step.

numenera.rule.effect-modifications.cost_or_limit: Requires the additional iotum and at least one difficulty step.
numenera.rule.effect-modifications.combines: Applies when altering an object’s or installation’s effect.
numenera.rule.effect-modifications.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward crafting cost rule.

numenera.rule.building-larger-structural.name: Building larger structural sections

effect.summary: Each added structural unit in a dimension doubles the components and construction time; unsupported bridges cannot extend indefinitely.

numenera.rule.building-larger-structural.cost_or_limit: Longer spans require supports or an installation.
numenera.rule.building-larger-structural.go_wrong: The structure cannot span unsupported distances indefinitely.
numenera.rule.building-larger-structural.combines: Applies to structures such as bridges.
numenera.rule.building-larger-structural.mechanism: Scaling construction cost and support constraint
numenera.rule.building-larger-structural.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward construction rule.

numenera.rule.defensive-construction-res.name: Defensive construction resistance

effect.summary: Unless a structure says otherwise, breaking through a defensive wall, tower, or gate, or collapsing a watchtower or bridge, is hindered.

numenera.rule.defensive-construction-res.cost_or_limit: Applies to the specified defensive structures.
numenera.rule.defensive-construction-res.who_may: Applies to attempts against defensive structures
numenera.rule.defensive-construction-res.combines: Battlements ease defense tasks against ranged attacks when used as cover.
numenera.rule.defensive-construction-res.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward difficulty adjustment.

numenera.rule.vehicle-difficulty-against.name: Vehicle difficulty against hazards

effect.summary: Compare vehicle level with hazard level; the excess hazard level determines task difficulty, while equal levels handle the obstacle easily.

numenera.rule.vehicle-difficulty-against.cost_or_limit: The GM determines difficulty; ordinary conditions are routine.

effect.summary: Numenera objects and structures require plans; commonplace constructions do not.

numenera.rule.minimum-crafting-level.name: Minimum crafting level

effect.summary: A plan’s finished creation cannot have a level below its minimum, though it may be crafted higher.

numenera.rule.minimum-crafting-level.cost_or_limit: Higher-level crafting increases difficulty and required iotum and parts.
numenera.rule.minimum-crafting-level.combines: Plan level determines assessed crafting task difficulty.

numenera.rule.plan-seeds-developed-into-.name: Plan seeds developed into plans

effect.summary: A numenera scholar can develop a discovered plan seed into a usable plan over several days.

numenera.rule.plan-seeds-developed-into-.cost_or_limit: Requires a few days of development.
numenera.rule.plan-seeds-developed-into-.where_from: Encoded, cached, or phased information, ruins, machines, artifacts, scholars, or datasphere requests.
numenera.rule.plan-seeds-developed-into-.combines: Plan seeds can be found alongside iotum or in various knowledge stores.

numenera.rule.integrated-machine-salvage.name: Integrated machine salvage

effect.summary: Salvaging an integrated machine yields shins, possibly cyphers and an artifact, but destroys it and prevents finding plans inside.

numenera.rule.integrated-machine-salvage.where_from: Integrated machines in ruins or prior-world vehicles.
numenera.rule.integrated-machine-salvage.combines: Possible yield is 2d20 shins, one or two cyphers, and perhaps an artifact.

numenera.rule.failed-integrated-machine-.name: Failed integrated-machine plan search

effect.summary: Searching an integrated machine for a plan seed is usually hindered by two steps unless it was designed to reveal knowledge; failure usually inflicts damage equal to machine level.

numenera.rule.failed-integrated-machine-.cost_or_limit: Search takes several minutes and difficulty depends on machine level.
numenera.rule.failed-integrated-machine-.where_from: Integrated machines containing a possible plan seed.

numenera.rule.failed-artifact-plan-searc.name: Failed artifact plan search

effect.summary: A failed attempt to find a plan seed in an artifact causes that artifact to deplete.

numenera.rule.failed-artifact-plan-searc.cost_or_limit: Search takes about a minute; difficulty depends on artifact level and is usually hindered by at least two steps.
numenera.rule.failed-artifact-plan-searc.where_from: Artifacts that may contain plan seeds.
numenera.rule.failed-artifact-plan-searc.combines: Further attempts are unavailable once the artifact has been checked, whether or not a seed was found.
numenera.rule.failed-artifact-plan-searc.blocked_reason: The grammar does not model depletion of an artifact when a search fails.

numenera.rule.borrowed-or-remembered-pla.name: Borrowed or remembered plans

effect.summary: A borrowed or briefly remembered plan may support crafting, but transcription or recall errors can raise the intrusion range on failed tasks.

numenera.rule.borrowed-or-remembered-pla.cost_or_limit: Suggested intrusion range changes from 1 to 1–4.
numenera.rule.borrowed-or-remembered-pla.go_wrong: Plan errors increase the chance of a GM intrusion.

numenera.rule.specific-cypher-and-artifa.name: Specific cypher and artifact plans

effect.summary: A plan is specific to the chosen cypher or artifact, though its creation may be made at different permitted levels with differing material requirements.

numenera.rule.specific-cypher-and-artifa.cost_or_limit: Minimum crafting levels prevent building some items at lower levels.
numenera.rule.specific-cypher-and-artifa.where_from: Plans acquired through character abilities or other means.
numenera.rule.specific-cypher-and-artifa.combines: Higher levels require more iotum and increase task difficulty.

numenera.rule.crafting-without-a-plan.name: Crafting without a plan

effect.summary: Crafting without a plan is hindered, and intrusions trigger on rolls of 1–2; success also grants a plan for repeating the work.

numenera.rule.crafting-without-a-plan.cost_or_limit: Higher difficulty and increased intrusion range apply only to the unplanned attempt.
numenera.rule.crafting-without-a-plan.who_may: A character attempting to craft without a plan
numenera.rule.crafting-without-a-plan.combines: A successful custom creation gives the crafter a plan for it.

numenera.rule.higher-level-crafting-mate.name: Higher-level crafting materials

effect.summary: Crafting above minimum level requires additional iotum and parts valued at the finished object's level.

numenera.rule.higher-level-crafting-mate.cost_or_limit: Greater level also increases task difficulty and crafting time.

numenera.rule.responsive-synth-for-sensi.name: Responsive synth for sensing

effect.summary: Responsive synth is needed for a creation to monitor its surroundings at even a basic level.

numenera.rule.responsive-synth-for-sensi.combines: Automation can also use responsive synth or apt clay.

numenera.rule.materials-for-automation.name: Materials for automation

effect.summary: Responsive synth or apt clay supports environment-sensitive behavior; oraculum and data orbs may be needed for true automatons.

numenera.rule.materials-for-automation.cost_or_limit: More apt clay improves adaptability but usually does not alone create a true automaton.
numenera.rule.materials-for-automation.combines: oraculum and data orbs enable more advanced autonomy.

numenera.rule.iotum-for-partly-living-cr.name: Iotum for partly living creations

effect.summary: Partly living creations should use bio-circuitry, with smart tissue as a possible supporting material.

numenera.rule.iotum-for-partly-living-cr.combines: Bio-circuitry and smart tissue can foster life.

effect.summary: Mind-to-mind contact in a creation calls for psiranium to support the connection.

numenera.rule.self-assembly-iotum.name: Self-assembly iotum

effect.summary: Plans at level 5 or above usually rely on specialized iotum to perform some construction work.

numenera.rule.self-assembly-iotum.cost_or_limit: Mimetic gel is common; quantium, smart tissue, virtuon particles, and tamed iron can serve similar roles.

effect.summary: Void matter in midnight stones can support effects without another clear counterpart and can serve as an energy source.

numenera.rule.minimum-level-iotum.name: Minimum-level iotum

effect.summary: A plan should include at least one iotum with a level matching the creation's minimum crafting level.

numenera.rule.minimum-level-iotum.cost_or_limit: Some effects may additionally require one or two particular iotum regardless of their level.
numenera.rule.minimum-level-iotum.combines: Effect-specific material requirements may exceed the level-based component.

numenera.rule.secondary-effects.name: Secondary effects

effect.summary: A crafting accident may add a secondary effect that occurs when the main effect is used.

numenera.rule.secondary-effects.cost_or_limit: Minor or major severity is chosen by the GM.
numenera.rule.secondary-effects.where_from: Crafting accidents, flawed components, failed subtasks, strange plans, or misfortune.
numenera.rule.secondary-effects.combines: Secondary effects operate alongside the primary effect.
numenera.rule.secondary-effects.blocked_reason: The rule describes an additional effect triggered by using an object.

numenera.rule.crafting-setbacks.name: Crafting setbacks

effect.summary: Severe crafting failures can cause a usually one-time setback.

numenera.rule.crafting-setbacks.cost_or_limit: Setbacks usually affect the crafter more than others.
numenera.rule.crafting-setbacks.go_wrong: Possible outcomes include lost materials, damage, theft, or a nonworking item.
numenera.rule.crafting-setbacks.where_from: Severe crafting failure or later damage to a crafted object.
numenera.rule.crafting-setbacks.combines: Unlike secondary effects, setbacks are usually one-time.
numenera.rule.crafting-setbacks.blocked_reason: This is a discrete consequence of crafting failure.

numenera.rule.artifact-plan-template.name: Artifact plan template

effect.summary: Sets the minimum crafting level, parts, depletion, and iotum requirements by completed artifact level.

numenera.rule.artifact-plan-template.cost_or_limit: Requires a plan for the specific artifact; GM may require extra iotum.
numenera.rule.artifact-plan-template.combines: A plan for one artifact cannot be used to craft another.
numenera.rule.artifact-plan-template.blocked_reason: The rule specifies crafting costs and requirements.

numenera.rule.limited-vs-true-automatons.name: Limited vs. true automatons

effect.summary: Limited automatons have narrow programmed tasks; true automatons learn and can develop individuality.

numenera.rule.limited-vs-true-automatons.cost_or_limit: Making a true automaton raises crafting difficulty by four steps; GM controls its actions.
numenera.rule.limited-vs-true-automatons.go_wrong: Some automatons may accidentally develop consciousness.
numenera.rule.limited-vs-true-automatons.mind: True automatons can learn and may become conscious; most limited ones cannot.
numenera.rule.limited-vs-true-automatons.combines: Companion and exploring aventron plans make true automatons and take months to develop self-awareness.
numenera.rule.limited-vs-true-automatons.blocked_reason: Learning, consciousness, and programmed directives exceed the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.cypher-plans-specify-a-sin.name: Cypher plans specify a single effect

effect.summary: A cypher plan identifies one specific effect, though the same plan can be crafted at any level.

numenera.rule.cypher-plans-specify-a-sin.cost_or_limit: Different randomized variants require separate plans; no separate plan is needed for each level.
numenera.rule.cypher-plans-specify-a-sin.who_may: Wrights who know the relevant plan.
numenera.rule.cypher-plans-specify-a-sin.combines: Different energy types or targets require their own plans.
numenera.rule.cypher-plans-specify-a-sin.blocked_reason: The rule constrains plan selection and level, not an in-game effect.

numenera.rule.moving-installations.name: MOVING INSTALLATIONS

effect.summary: Moving a fixed installation takes a task based on its level and substantial time; failure still moves it but may cause damage or depletion.

numenera.rule.moving-installations.cost_or_limit: At least an hour for small installations and potentially days, weeks, or months for large ones.
numenera.rule.moving-installations.go_wrong: A failed move may require repairs or deplete the installation.
numenera.rule.moving-installations.blocked_reason: This is a movement constraint and failure consequence, not an additional supernatural effect.

numenera.rule.portal-mouth-connection-li.name: Portal Mouth connection limits

effect.summary: Matching portal-mouth structures connect regardless of distance, but not across dimensions or time unless modified.

numenera.rule.portal-mouth-connection-li.cost_or_limit: The destination must first be reached to build its matching structure.
numenera.rule.portal-mouth-connection-li.combines: Cross-dimensional or temporal links require increased level and extra materials.
numenera.rule.portal-mouth-connection-li.blocked_reason: The rule governs access through spatial links, including optional dimensional or temporal connections.

numenera.rule.installation-depletion.name: Installation depletion

effect.summary: Each installation has its own stated depletion chance and checking interval, and depletion can end its operation.

numenera.rule.installation-depletion.cost_or_limit: The chance and interval vary by installation.
numenera.rule.installation-depletion.go_wrong: A depletion check can cause the installation to become depleted.
numenera.rule.installation-depletion.blocked_reason: The rule tracks an installation's depleted state and its loss of function.

numenera.rule.automated-friendly-fire.name: AUTOMATED FRIENDLY FIRE

effect.summary: none stated

numenera.rule.automated-friendly-fire.cost_or_limit: Installations and automatons may attack on their own after targets are identified; changing an enemy designation is a task at device level +2.
numenera.rule.automated-friendly-fire.go_wrong: Misidentification can cause an attack on an ally; a GM intrusion may introduce it.
numenera.rule.automated-friendly-fire.who_may: Users may designate targets; non-crafters can attempt to alter designations.
numenera.rule.automated-friendly-fire.combines: Applies to certain installations, mechanized turrets, and fighting automatons.
numenera.rule.automated-friendly-fire.mechanism: Stored target designation and autonomous attacks
numenera.rule.automated-friendly-fire.blocked_reason: The rule entails autonomous target selection and potentially changing stored target relations, which the basic effect grammar does not model.

numenera.rule.a-basic-turret-requires-a-.name: A basic turret requires a gunner or cannoneer to operate it.

effect.summary: none stated

numenera.rule.a-basic-turret-requires-a-.cost_or_limit: A basic turret cannot operate without a gunner or cannoneer.
numenera.rule.a-basic-turret-requires-a-.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward operating limit.

numenera.rule.chainpod-linked-power-rule.name: Chainpod linked-power rule

effect.summary: none stated

numenera.rule.chainpod-linked-power-rule.cost_or_limit: Linked chainpods move under the lead driver; only the lead consumes power, so others recharge while towed.
numenera.rule.chainpod-linked-power-rule.go_wrong: A pod unlinked from the lead becomes active and drivable immediately.
numenera.rule.chainpod-linked-power-rule.who_may: Any occupant can unlink their pod.
numenera.rule.chainpod-linked-power-rule.blocked_reason: The rule concerns power use and recharge state across linked artifacts.

numenera.rule.cypher-limit-danger.name: Cypher limit danger

effect.summary: Exceeding the cypher limit brings the same dangers described for other cyphers.

numenera.rule.cypher-limit-danger.cost_or_limit: Danger occurs when a character surpasses their cypher limit.
numenera.rule.cypher-limit-danger.go_wrong: The passage refers to cypher dangers elsewhere without specifying them here.
numenera.rule.cypher-limit-danger.blocked_reason: The referenced danger is not detailed here.

numenera.rule.raw-elixir-harms-on-contac.name: Raw elixir harms on contact

effect.summary: Raw elixir inflicts three Speed damage each round until a difficulty-three Might defense succeeds.

numenera.rule.raw-elixir-harms-on-contac.cost_or_limit: The damage ignores Armor and continues until the defense succeeds.
numenera.rule.raw-elixir-harms-on-contac.who_may: Anyone drinking or touching raw elixir.
numenera.rule.raw-elixir-harms-on-contac.where_from: Raw elixir from a dream titan.
numenera.rule.raw-elixir-harms-on-contac.combines: Distilling makes the substance safe to consume.
numenera.rule.raw-elixir-harms-on-contac.mechanism: Repeated poison damage with a resistance check.

numenera.rule.distilled-elixir-sustains-.name: Distilled elixir sustains a person

effect.summary: A cup of processed elixir provides a person's food and water needs for a day.

numenera.rule.distilled-elixir-sustains-.cost_or_limit: A cup provides one day's nourishment and removes hunger and thirst pangs.
numenera.rule.distilled-elixir-sustains-.mind: Distilled elixir can produce wondrous dreams.
numenera.rule.distilled-elixir-sustains-.combines: Different secret recipes may produce additional effects.

numenera.rule.the-eye-s-poisons-progress.name: The Eye's poisons progressively hinder defense

effect.summary: Each additional Enthait poison dose hinders the poison eater's Might defense by one more step.

numenera.rule.the-eye-s-poisons-progress.cost_or_limit: Poison levels vary from one to six; doses arrive in a random order.
numenera.rule.the-eye-s-poisons-progress.go_wrong: The accumulating penalty makes later poisonings increasingly dangerous.
numenera.rule.the-eye-s-poisons-progress.where_from: Poisons produced by the Eye of Enthait.

numenera.rule.aeon-priest-defenses-for-r.name: Aeon Priest defenses for Rachid

effect.summary: Priest-built mechanisms can add 3 Armor to Rachid for up to three days, then need replacement iotum.

numenera.rule.aeon-priest-defenses-for-r.cost_or_limit: Maximum duration is three days; replacement iotum is required afterward.
numenera.rule.aeon-priest-defenses-for-r.go_wrong: The devices are exhausted after their operating period.
numenera.rule.aeon-priest-defenses-for-r.who_may: The Aeon Priests can erect them.
numenera.rule.aeon-priest-defenses-for-r.mechanism: temporary area defense with depleted components
numenera.rule.aeon-priest-defenses-for-r.blocked_reason: The rule grants a timed defensive field to an entire community, which the basic effect grammar cannot represent.

numenera.rule.whisper-recall-and-transfe.name: Whisper recall and transfer

effect.summary: A walker remembers a whisper until speaking it to another person, who then receives it most clearly.

numenera.rule.whisper-recall-and-transfe.cost_or_limit: The transfer depends on another person clearly hearing the words.
numenera.rule.whisper-recall-and-transfe.go_wrong: The recipient may still not understand their meaning.
numenera.rule.whisper-recall-and-transfe.mind: The whisper leaves the speaker’s mind and is encoded in the listener.
numenera.rule.whisper-recall-and-transfe.who_may: A walker who hears a whisper and another who hears its retelling
numenera.rule.whisper-recall-and-transfe.combines: Whispers can be traded, sold, and stored by the Aeon Priests.
numenera.rule.whisper-recall-and-transfe.blocked_reason: This rule moves a stored memory between minds and removes it from the original holder.

numenera.rule.whisper-deciphering.name: Whisper deciphering

effect.summary: A hearer who makes sense of a whisper can turn it into a distinct piece of knowledge.

numenera.rule.whisper-deciphering.cost_or_limit: Only some hearers can extract meaning; deciphering is difficult.
numenera.rule.whisper-deciphering.go_wrong: The topic is usually random and most whispers remain unclear.
numenera.rule.whisper-deciphering.mind: The hearer may gain new knowledge.
numenera.rule.whisper-deciphering.who_may: A person able to interpret a whisper
numenera.rule.whisper-deciphering.combines: The result can resemble receiving a glimmer.
numenera.rule.whisper-deciphering.blocked_reason: The whisper can deliver meaningful, sometimes unusual knowledge that the basic effect grammar cannot generate.

numenera.rule.bonded-servitude.name: Bonded servitude

effect.summary: Certain offenders and arrivals with nothing to offer are bonded to labor for about five years.

numenera.rule.bonded-servitude.cost_or_limit: Bonds wear welded metal bracelets; refusal or failure to work can lead to expulsion under threat of death.
numenera.rule.bonded-servitude.who_may: People convicted of severe crimes or arriving without an offering may be bonded.
numenera.rule.bonded-servitude.combines: Joining the Canonicate can end the contract early.
numenera.rule.bonded-servitude.blocked_reason: The rule is a social constraint rather than an unsupported supernatural effect.

numenera.rule.changing-moon-shifts.name: Changing Moon shifts

effect.summary: The structure changes its configuration, routes, and contents during periodic shifts.

numenera.rule.changing-moon-shifts.cost_or_limit: Usually about once daily; sometimes hourly or every few minutes.
numenera.rule.changing-moon-shifts.go_wrong: Entrants can be shift-lost, displaced, or erased.
numenera.rule.changing-moon-shifts.mind: Creatures inside may believe they were always there.
numenera.rule.changing-moon-shifts.combines: Philethis persist between shifts; crimson cube is implicated in rearrangement.
numenera.rule.changing-moon-shifts.blocked_reason: The rule includes displacement into hidden realms and possible disappearance beyond ordinary space.

numenera.rule.crimson-cube-evaporates-ou.name: Crimson cube evaporates outside the Changing Moon

effect.summary: Salvaged crimson cube vanishes when removed from the structure.

numenera.rule.crimson-cube-evaporates-ou.cost_or_limit: It cannot be taken away for crafting.
numenera.rule.crimson-cube-evaporates-ou.combines: Prevents its use in crafting numenera.
numenera.rule.crimson-cube-evaporates-ou.blocked_reason: A material that ceases to exist outside a location needs a material-state rule.

numenera.rule.shift-lost-fate.name: Shift-lost fate

effect.summary: People caught by a shift may be erased from others’ reality and live in hidden realms, with a chance of later recovery.

numenera.rule.shift-lost-fate.cost_or_limit: The chance of return is uncertain; assistance from Delend may help.
numenera.rule.shift-lost-fate.go_wrong: Those not recovered may disappear permanently from ordinary reality.
numenera.rule.shift-lost-fate.mind: To the lost person, companions and surroundings may seem unchanged.
numenera.rule.shift-lost-fate.combines: A future shift or Halls of Change aid may recover someone.
numenera.rule.shift-lost-fate.mechanism: displacement and possible return across hidden spaces
numenera.rule.shift-lost-fate.blocked_reason: The rule requires hidden spatial realms and uncertain retrieval.

numenera.rule.red-rain-construction.name: Red rain construction

effect.summary: Animate crimson-cube insects dismantle material and build thin, west-facing slabs.

numenera.rule.red-rain-construction.cost_or_limit: Occurs during infrequent red rain events.
numenera.rule.red-rain-construction.go_wrong: Touched objects are destroyed or reworked.
numenera.rule.red-rain-construction.who_may: The rain’s tiny creatures enact the process.
numenera.rule.red-rain-construction.combines: Delend has limited protection against the event.
numenera.rule.red-rain-construction.blocked_reason: The rule turns existing material into newly arranged slabs.

numenera.rule.hildwin-s-ladder-salvage-p.name: Hildwin’s Ladder salvage payment

effect.summary: Returning ladder users must give the fee-taker about 30 percent of their salvage.

numenera.rule.hildwin-s-ladder-salvage-p.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward resource cost.

numenera.rule.blue-numb-frequent-use-eff.name: blue numb frequent-use effect

effect.summary: Frequent blue numb use causes lethargy.

numenera.rule.blue-numb-frequent-use-eff.go_wrong: Users may be unavailable for labor.
numenera.rule.blue-numb-frequent-use-eff.blocked_reason: A straightforward ongoing drug side effect.

numenera.rule.aquatic-empathy-death-cons.name: Aquatic Empathy death consequence

effect.summary: When one member of an Aquatic Empathy pair dies, the other usually dies from grief.

numenera.rule.aquatic-empathy-death-cons.cost_or_limit: The connection makes loss especially dangerous.
numenera.rule.aquatic-empathy-death-cons.combines: The bond links child and ray.
numenera.rule.aquatic-empathy-death-cons.blocked_reason: A persistent bond and its death consequence exceed the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.shared-time-skips.name: shared time skips

effect.summary: Everyone in the affected area experiences the same skip for the same duration.

numenera.rule.shared-time-skips.cost_or_limit: The altered area is irregular and localized.
numenera.rule.shared-time-skips.combines: Long skips can affect individuals separately.
numenera.rule.shared-time-skips.blocked_reason: The rule changes the timing and duration of events.

numenera.rule.metal-corrosion-near-sleep.name: metal corrosion near Sleeping Rock

effect.summary: Metal corrodes about five times faster near the village than usual.

numenera.rule.metal-corrosion-near-sleep.go_wrong: Metal tools and equipment rapidly degrade.
numenera.rule.metal-corrosion-near-sleep.who_may: Metal items in the village are affected.
numenera.rule.metal-corrosion-near-sleep.where_from: An unexplained local condition, perhaps linked to time skips.
numenera.rule.metal-corrosion-near-sleep.combines: Locals prefer wood, synth, and glass.
numenera.rule.metal-corrosion-near-sleep.blocked_reason: The persistent adverse effect is an unusual ongoing environmental degradation.

numenera.rule.long-skips.name: long skips

effect.summary: Some people vanish for a day or longer outside the usual shared skip pattern.

numenera.rule.long-skips.cost_or_limit: The phenomenon affects only some individuals and has no known link.
numenera.rule.long-skips.go_wrong: Affected people experience hallucinations of matter melting or smoking.
numenera.rule.long-skips.who_may: A few village residents have experienced them.
numenera.rule.long-skips.blocked_reason: The effect removes people from ordinary time for extended periods.

numenera.rule.healing-pilgrimage-limitat.name: healing pilgrimage limitation

effect.summary: The skips have cured only one particular illness, not every disease.

numenera.rule.healing-pilgrimage-limitat.cost_or_limit: Only the specific wasting disease has been cured.
numenera.rule.healing-pilgrimage-limitat.go_wrong: Visitors may wrongly expect a universal cure.
numenera.rule.healing-pilgrimage-limitat.who_may: People seeking healing through the skips.
numenera.rule.healing-pilgrimage-limitat.combines: The cure is associated with time skips.
numenera.rule.healing-pilgrimage-limitat.blocked_reason: This is a restriction on the scope of a healing effect.

numenera.rule.earth-tide.name: Earth Tide

effect.summary: Nearby ground can sink or rise by as much as ten feet in unpredictable episodes weeks or months apart.

numenera.rule.earth-tide.cost_or_limit: Occurs within half a mile of the pit; affected areas may be up to a mile apart.
numenera.rule.earth-tide.blocked_reason: The rule is representable as position changes to terrain.

numenera.rule.field-station-exchange-tra.name: Field-station exchange tradition

effect.summary: Gleaners who take something from a field station are expected to leave something of equal or greater value.

numenera.rule.field-station-exchange-tra.cost_or_limit: Replacement should match or exceed the taken item's value.
numenera.rule.field-station-exchange-tra.who_may: Amber Gleaners; described as an unspoken tradition.
numenera.rule.field-station-exchange-tra.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward exchange restriction.

numenera.rule.mendicant-reconstruction.name: Mendicant reconstruction

effect.summary: After a mendicant dies, the abbess’s caravan may rebuild their body and mind from traces in the datasphere.

numenera.rule.mendicant-reconstruction.cost_or_limit: For most mendicants, this benefit is available once; success is only described as likely.
numenera.rule.mendicant-reconstruction.mind: The mind is rebuilt from datasphere traces.
numenera.rule.mendicant-reconstruction.who_may: Mendicants of the Order of Healing.
numenera.rule.mendicant-reconstruction.where_from: The Order of Healing’s membership benefit.
numenera.rule.mendicant-reconstruction.combines: Requires traces left in the datasphere and the caravan’s intervention.
numenera.rule.mendicant-reconstruction.blocked_reason: Rebuilding a dead character’s body and mind from datasphere traces requires a death and identity-state system.

numenera.rule.cynoclepts-form-when-chara.name: Cynoclepts form when characters exceed their cypher limit

effect.summary: Exceeding the cypher limit can cause cynoclepts to form and steal the character’s belongings.

numenera.rule.cynoclepts-form-when-chara.cost_or_limit: Triggered by exceeding the cypher limit.
numenera.rule.cynoclepts-form-when-chara.go_wrong: The character loses belongings and faces a dangerous threat.
numenera.rule.cynoclepts-form-when-chara.who_may: Characters who exceed their cypher limit
numenera.rule.cynoclepts-form-when-chara.blocked_reason: This is a world trigger and consequence, not an effect requiring unsupported game mechanics.

numenera.rule.flesh-ghosts-are-produced-.name: Flesh ghosts are produced by machines

effect.summary: Some installations unexpectedly produce person-shaped copies of people who died long ago.

numenera.rule.flesh-ghosts-are-produced-.cost_or_limit: The cause and selection are unexplained.
numenera.rule.flesh-ghosts-are-produced-.go_wrong: The copies may be unwanted and dangerous.
numenera.rule.flesh-ghosts-are-produced-.mind: Copies can have gaps in their memories.
numenera.rule.flesh-ghosts-are-produced-.combines: A produced copy may resemble a deceased person.
numenera.rule.flesh-ghosts-are-produced-.blocked_reason: The rule concerns what happens to the identity and memories of deceased people.

numenera.rule.ryn-gains-health-from-iotu.name: Ryn gains health from iotum

effect.summary: Whenever a ryn gains iotum, its health increases by the iotum’s level, even beyond its usual maximum.

numenera.rule.ryn-gains-health-from-iotu.blocked_reason: This rule maps to adding vitality.

numenera.rule.revehent-destruction.name: Revehent destruction

effect.summary: Burning or similarly damaging a dead revehent or its gift permanently destroys it.

numenera.rule.revehent-destruction.cost_or_limit: Applies to a dead creature or its tissue gift.
numenera.rule.revehent-destruction.who_may: Anyone able to damage the remains or gift.
numenera.rule.revehent-destruction.combines: Prevents the gift from becoming a new revehent.
numenera.rule.revehent-destruction.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward end effect.

numenera.rule.thlipsid-time-theft.name: Thlipsid time theft

effect.summary: A thlipsid can steal time only from a conscious sapient creature, not from an arbitrary collapse of space-time.

numenera.rule.thlipsid-time-theft.cost_or_limit: The source must be conscious and sapient.
numenera.rule.thlipsid-time-theft.go_wrong: The stolen time is taken from someone else.
numenera.rule.thlipsid-time-theft.combines: Stolen time can be sold in tokens.
numenera.rule.thlipsid-time-theft.blocked_reason: The rule transfers time from one creature to another and stores it.

numenera.rule.warcore-host-dependence.name: Warcore host dependence

effect.summary: A manifested warcore regenerates until removed from the device or structure it inhabits.

numenera.rule.warcore-host-dependence.go_wrong: If left installed, it continues restoring health even from zero.
numenera.rule.warcore-host-dependence.combines: Links regeneration to its host device or structure.
numenera.rule.warcore-host-dependence.blocked_reason: The ongoing power is attached to an inhabited device and has a specific removal-based stop condition.

numenera.rule.prior-world-technology-can.name: Prior-world technology can kill through misunderstanding

effect.summary: Misunderstood technology can harm or kill its user.

numenera.rule.prior-world-technology-can.mind: Some truths or formulas exceed human understanding.
numenera.rule.prior-world-technology-can.blocked_reason: The hazard is a straightforward fatal consequence.

numenera.rule.human-bodies-may-not-suit-.name: Human bodies may not suit healing technology

effect.summary: Technology designed for nonhuman bodies may harm humans.

numenera.rule.human-bodies-may-not-suit-.go_wrong: A treatment intended for liquid- or metal-bodied beings may be dangerous to humans.
numenera.rule.human-bodies-may-not-suit-.blocked_reason: The described danger can be represented as harm from incompatible treatment.

numenera.rule.human-lifespan-limits-endu.name: Human lifespan limits endurance of aging processes

effect.summary: Unexpected aging can exceed a human lifespan measured in decades.

numenera.rule.human-lifespan-limits-endu.cost_or_limit: Humans generally live decades, not millennia.
numenera.rule.human-lifespan-limits-endu.blocked_reason: The passage describes a lifespan-changing hazard.

numenera.rule.long-term-cryogenic-preser.name: Long-term cryogenic preservation harms memories

effect.summary: Extended cryogenic preservation is damaging to memory.

numenera.rule.long-term-cryogenic-preser.cost_or_limit: Preservation may last thousands or millions of years.
numenera.rule.long-term-cryogenic-preser.who_may: People kept in long-term cryogenic preservation
numenera.rule.long-term-cryogenic-preser.blocked_reason: The stated consequence is a direct change to memory.

numenera.rule.horde-size-rank-and-army-t.name: Horde size, rank, and army threshold

effect.summary: A horde is usually about a hundred creatures and has the average creature level as rank; thousands count as an army.

numenera.rule.horde-size-rank-and-army-t.cost_or_limit: A thousand or more creatures without army organization gain one rank but no other army benefits.
numenera.rule.horde-size-rank-and-army-t.combines: Creature-specific modifiers can alter the usual rank or damage.
numenera.rule.horde-size-rank-and-army-t.mechanism: Group scale and average level determine rank.
numenera.rule.horde-size-rank-and-army-t.blocked_reason: This is a numerical group-ranking rule.

numenera.rule.horde-health-and-scatterin.name: Horde health and scattering

effect.summary: Damage reduces abstract horde health; when it runs out, morale breaks and the group scatters with over half casualties.

numenera.rule.horde-health-and-scatterin.cost_or_limit: Health is usually the horde’s target number; depleted hordes regain about one point per day unless fully depleted.
numenera.rule.horde-health-and-scatterin.go_wrong: A defeated horde may suffer more than 50 percent casualties or be eradicated.
numenera.rule.horde-health-and-scatterin.combines: Armor reduces damage before health is lost.
numenera.rule.horde-health-and-scatterin.mechanism: Abstract health, morale collapse, and recovery.
numenera.rule.horde-health-and-scatterin.blocked_reason: This is an ordinary health and morale rule.

numenera.rule.horde-damage-and-armor.name: Horde damage and armor

effect.summary: Hordes normally deal damage equal to rank, while armor subtracts from incoming damage.

numenera.rule.horde-damage-and-armor.cost_or_limit: Creature modifiers and special circumstances can change damage or armor.
numenera.rule.horde-damage-and-armor.combines: Horde damage abstracts the mass’s attacks and equipment.

numenera.rule.retreating-horde.name: Retreating horde

effect.summary: A stronger horde may withdraw without consequence; one withdrawing from an equal- or higher-rank community suffers an unanswered extra exchange of damage.

numenera.rule.retreating-horde.cost_or_limit: The rule also applies to horde-versus-horde retreats; a victor may pursue and risk a trap.
numenera.rule.retreating-horde.go_wrong: A retreating horde may take extra damage or be pursued into a trap.
numenera.rule.retreating-horde.combines: Fast and flying hordes have special retreat benefits.

numenera.rule.horde-configuration-overla.name: Horde configuration overlap

effect.summary: Creature modifiers may stack with a specialized configuration unless the creatures already function as that configuration.

numenera.rule.horde-configuration-overla.cost_or_limit: No cumulative benefit when a creature’s existing ability duplicates a configuration.
numenera.rule.horde-configuration-overla.combines: Determines whether creature and configuration bonuses stack.
numenera.rule.horde-configuration-overla.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward stacking rule.

numenera.rule.disrupting-specialized-hor.name: Disrupting specialized hordes

effect.summary: Removing specialized leadership can reduce a force to a basic horde or scatter its members.

numenera.rule.disrupting-specialized-hor.cost_or_limit: Requires identifying and taking out the leadership.
numenera.rule.disrupting-specialized-hor.go_wrong: The horde may disorganize and flee.
numenera.rule.disrupting-specialized-hor.who_may: PCs may attempt this against a specialized horde or army.
numenera.rule.disrupting-specialized-hor.combines: Can negate specialized training and tactics.
numenera.rule.disrupting-specialized-hor.blocked_reason: The result is a group-state change, not a special effect outside the grammar.

numenera.rule.creature-horde-level-range.name: Creature horde level range

effect.summary: Level 1–4 creatures commonly form hordes; higher-level hordes need adapted templates or qualities.

numenera.rule.creature-horde-level-range.cost_or_limit: Higher-level creatures are less likely to gather in sufficient numbers.
numenera.rule.creature-horde-level-range.combines: Creature abilities may justify a rank increase or another horde quality.
numenera.rule.creature-horde-level-range.mechanism: Guidance for creating higher-level horde profiles.

numenera.rule.reactive-fields.name: Reactive fields

effect.summary: Installations generate reactive fields that can cause negative effects when installations are sited too close together.

numenera.rule.reactive-fields.cost_or_limit: Installations must be far enough apart to avoid harmful field interactions.
numenera.rule.reactive-fields.go_wrong: Unexpectedly expanding fields can cause a reactive rip.
numenera.rule.reactive-fields.combines: Fields can expand after other events, including iotum salvaging.
numenera.rule.reactive-fields.blocked_reason: The fields’ interactions and collapse conditions are not covered by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.tenspire-crystal-depletion.name: Tenspire crystal depletion exemption

effect.summary: Installations and artifacts used within a very long range of Tenspire do not make depletion rolls.

numenera.rule.tenspire-crystal-depletion.cost_or_limit: The exemption applies within a very long range of the crystal.
numenera.rule.tenspire-crystal-depletion.who_may: Users of installations and artifacts in range.
numenera.rule.tenspire-crystal-depletion.blocked_reason: The rule suppresses an item’s depletion check, a state and use limit not represented by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.timeslips.name: Timeslips

effect.summary: People may lose time, repeat recent actions, or become caught in loops that reset until they move far enough from the effect’s center.

numenera.rule.timeslips.cost_or_limit: The loop may persist until someone gets far enough from its center.
numenera.rule.timeslips.go_wrong: It can harm community health and infrastructure.
numenera.rule.timeslips.mind: People experience lost time and repeated actions.
numenera.rule.timeslips.where_from: Possibly interacting installations or secret experiments.
numenera.rule.timeslips.combines: Several installations may interact to cause the effect.
numenera.rule.timeslips.blocked_reason: Resetting time and trapping people in a repeating interval requires temporal control beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.iotum-grades-and-crafting-.name: Iotum grades and crafting levels

effect.summary: Iotum ranges from level 1 to 10, and higher-level iotum permits attempts to craft higher-level objects and structures.

numenera.rule.iotum-grades-and-crafting-.cost_or_limit: High-level iotum is rarer to find, and specific kinds can be difficult to obtain.
numenera.rule.iotum-grades-and-crafting-.combines: Iotum is used as crafting material for objects and structures.
numenera.rule.iotum-grades-and-crafting-.blocked_reason: The material’s graded crafting capability and level limits are not expressible as a basic effect.

numenera.rule.wright-cypher-limit.name: Wright cypher limit

effect.summary: A Wright cannot stockpile cyphers beyond their tier-based limit.

numenera.rule.wright-cypher-limit.combines: Giving a crafted cypher away opens a space filled by a temperamental cypher.

numenera.rule.long-term-tasks.name: Long-term tasks

effect.summary: A character may pursue a number of long-term tasks at once equal to their tier.

numenera.rule.long-term-tasks.cost_or_limit: Simultaneous tasks are capped by tier.
numenera.rule.long-term-tasks.combines: A Wright may use this time to craft high-level devices.

numenera.rule.starting-wright-cypher-com.name: Starting Wright cypher complement

effect.summary: Starting crafted cyphers come from known plans within tier-plus-two minimum crafting level, subject to the Wright’s cypher limit.

numenera.rule.starting-wright-cypher-com.cost_or_limit: Giving cyphers to other PCs reduces the Wright’s crafted complement and allows temperamental replacements.
numenera.rule.starting-wright-cypher-com.combines: Tier tables set specific plan counts, levels, and limits.
numenera.rule.starting-wright-cypher-com.blocked_reason: This is a character equipment and eligibility rule.

numenera.rule.starting-artifact-level-li.name: Starting artifact level limit

effect.summary: A starting Wright’s personally crafted artifacts cannot exceed tier minus one in level.

numenera.rule.starting-artifact-level-li.cost_or_limit: The maximum artifact level is tier minus one.
numenera.rule.starting-artifact-level-li.combines: Optional artifact complements trade away crafted cyphers.

numenera.rule.ruin-illumination.name: Ruin illumination

effect.summary: Movement by human-sized or larger creatures wakes dim wall and ceiling lights, which fade about ten minutes after movement stops.

numenera.rule.ruin-illumination.cost_or_limit: Light is dim and lasts roughly ten minutes after movement ceases.
numenera.rule.ruin-illumination.go_wrong: The threads usually burn away when exposed to direct air.
numenera.rule.ruin-illumination.who_may: Triggered by creatures moving in the ruin.
numenera.rule.ruin-illumination.where_from: Threads embedded in the ruin's metallic walls and ceiling.

numenera.rule.underfloor-storage-membran.name: Underfloor storage membrane

effect.summary: Standing on or beside the floor membrane triggers a gravitation beam that pulls a creature through into preservative fluid.

numenera.rule.underfloor-storage-membran.cost_or_limit: A caught creature takes 4 Speed damage each round; resisting or climbing back out requires defense and Might tasks.
numenera.rule.underfloor-storage-membran.go_wrong: The target can be trapped and damaged in preservative fluid.
numenera.rule.underfloor-storage-membran.who_may: A creature near or on the membrane.
numenera.rule.underfloor-storage-membran.where_from: A circular floor membrane in the ruin.
numenera.rule.underfloor-storage-membran.combines: The membrane leads into a preservative vat.
numenera.rule.underfloor-storage-membran.blocked_reason: The effect transfers a creature into a contained interior space.

numenera.rule.waterlock-membrane.name: Waterlock membrane

effect.summary: Creatures can push through the permeable membrane in either direction if they spend a couple of rounds doing only that.

numenera.rule.waterlock-membrane.cost_or_limit: Passage requires focused effort for a couple of rounds.
numenera.rule.waterlock-membrane.who_may: Creatures able to push through it.
numenera.rule.waterlock-membrane.where_from: The waterlock at the top of the transport tube.
numenera.rule.waterlock-membrane.combines: A dial and pipes can bring water into the chamber without disrupting the membrane.

numenera.rule.vapor-feeder-conversion.name: Vapor feeder conversion

effect.summary: The acid turns contacted flesh and other nonmetallic material from solid into rising gas that feeds the growth.

numenera.rule.vapor-feeder-conversion.cost_or_limit: Applies to flesh and other nonmetallic substances touched by the acid.
numenera.rule.vapor-feeder-conversion.go_wrong: Victims may be paralyzed and their material form destroyed.
numenera.rule.vapor-feeder-conversion.who_may: Material struck by a vapor feeder's acid.
numenera.rule.vapor-feeder-conversion.where_from: Vapor feeder clusters in the ruin.
numenera.rule.vapor-feeder-conversion.blocked_reason: The rule requires transforming solid matter into gas.

numenera.rule.eversion.name: Eversion

effect.summary: The Trefoil periodically turns inside out, making its exterior surface become its interior.

numenera.rule.eversion.cost_or_limit: Explorers must wait for it to enter the structure; it occurs after three exterior encounters or five hours, and again shortly after a thread device is used or dismantled.
numenera.rule.eversion.go_wrong: Movement during the event risks being flung about, injured, or stunned.
numenera.rule.eversion.mind: The event can cause mental harm.
numenera.rule.eversion.combines: A character who stays still avoids physical harm; the structure’s gravity orientation reverses.
numenera.rule.eversion.blocked_reason: The rule changes the structure’s spatial topology and gravity orientation, beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.third-thread-reconstructio.name: Third-thread reconstruction

effect.summary: The device makes a newly constructed duplicate of a remembered object or creature, including a whole version of one destroyed or dead.

numenera.rule.third-thread-reconstructio.cost_or_limit: It can be used once; the reconstruction is based on the activator’s memory.
numenera.rule.third-thread-reconstructio.go_wrong: The recreated person may be confused and may not match expectations over time.
numenera.rule.third-thread-reconstructio.mind: A recreated person’s memories and awareness are not guaranteed to match the original; the example is a confused Narra.
numenera.rule.third-thread-reconstructio.who_may: A user of the Device of the Third Thread
numenera.rule.third-thread-reconstructio.combines: Salvaging the device makes it unavailable for reconstruction.
numenera.rule.third-thread-reconstructio.blocked_reason: Recreating the dead raises a question of whether the result is the original soul or only a constructed duplicate, which the passage leaves unresolved.

numenera.rule.red-cough-transmission.name: Red cough transmission

effect.summary: Close proximity to an infected person can expose someone to the disease, requiring a Might defense roll to avoid infection.

numenera.rule.red-cough-transmission.cost_or_limit: A defense roll is required for each exposure.
numenera.rule.red-cough-transmission.who_may: Anyone close to an infected person.
numenera.rule.red-cough-transmission.blocked_reason: The exposure and defense check can be handled as a basic rule.

numenera.rule.red-cough-recovery.name: Red cough recovery

effect.summary: Two successful daily Might defenses in a row stop progression; later successes move the victim back through earlier stages until healthy and immune.

numenera.rule.red-cough-recovery.go_wrong: Failed defenses no longer advance the disease once recovery has begun.
numenera.rule.red-cough-recovery.who_may: Infected people who make the required defenses.
numenera.rule.red-cough-recovery.blocked_reason: Recovery depends on a multi-stage sequence of repeated checks and state changes.

numenera.rule.red-cough-community-damage.name: Red cough community damage

effect.summary: The disease reduces the village’s health by two points once per day without damaging its infrastructure.

numenera.rule.red-cough-community-damage.cost_or_limit: Threat is rank 2 against Glawv’s rank 1 community.
numenera.rule.red-cough-community-damage.go_wrong: The village is eventually destroyed if the damage continues.
numenera.rule.red-cough-community-damage.combines: Community tasks can add health and delay destruction.
numenera.rule.red-cough-community-damage.blocked_reason: A daily reduction to community health can be tracked as a basic effect.

numenera.rule.automender-treatment-capac.name: Automender treatment capacity

effect.summary: The enhanced automender can treat as many as one hundred people in ten hours.

numenera.rule.automender-treatment-capac.cost_or_limit: Treatment requires bringing people to the installation; cured villagers need separation from untreated people to avoid reinfection.
numenera.rule.automender-treatment-capac.combines: Cure and isolation are needed to end the outbreak.
numenera.rule.automender-treatment-capac.blocked_reason: Capacity and isolation can be tracked as game rules.

numenera.rule.installation-crafting-diff.name: Installation crafting difficulty and time

effect.summary: An enhanced automender is a level 5 installation with assessed crafting difficulty 7; the final difficulty determines the number of crafting subtasks.

numenera.rule.installation-crafting-diff.cost_or_limit: Training, type abilities, the existing automender as an asset, and one helper can ease the difficulty; each subtask takes a share of the installation’s build time.
numenera.rule.installation-crafting-diff.go_wrong: Tasks or subtasks longer than 28 hours cannot receive Effort.
numenera.rule.installation-crafting-diff.combines: The original automender can serve as the upgrade baseline.
numenera.rule.installation-crafting-diff.blocked_reason: This is game procedure rather than a world mechanism.

numenera.rule.dobworm-life-cycle.name: Dobworm life cycle

effect.summary: After one or two years, a dobworm metamorphoses into a mosquito-like flying form that drinks blood, mates, lays eggs, and dies within days.

numenera.rule.dobworm-life-cycle.cost_or_limit: The worm phase typically lasts one or two years; the flying phase lasts only a few days.
numenera.rule.dobworm-life-cycle.combines: Flying dobworms can transmit red cough if infected.
numenera.rule.dobworm-life-cycle.blocked_reason: The rule requires an automatic delayed transformation between creature forms.

numenera.rule.anhedons-are-not-driven-by.name: Anhedons are not driven by biological needs

effect.summary: Anhedons do not depend on biological needs.

numenera.rule.anhedons-are-not-driven-by.blocked_reason: This is a setting constraint, not an unmodeled action effect.

numenera.rule.terminus-will-strike-earth.name: Terminus will strike Earth in about a year if not stopped

effect.summary: The object’s inward trajectory leads to a lethal impact unless changed.

numenera.rule.terminus-will-strike-earth.cost_or_limit: The stated warning gives about a year.
numenera.rule.terminus-will-strike-earth.go_wrong: Impact could crack the planet apart.
numenera.rule.terminus-will-strike-earth.combines: Course changes or destruction can avert the impact.
numenera.rule.terminus-will-strike-earth.blocked_reason: The rule describes ordinary physical consequences.

numenera.rule.extreme-cyphers.name: Extreme cyphers

effect.summary: These cyphers have effects larger than their level suggests and are not usually found by routine salvage.

numenera.rule.extreme-cyphers.blocked_reason: This describes a category and acquisition limit, not an unmodeled effect.

numenera.rule.gravity-on-terminus-varies.name: Gravity on Terminus varies with location

effect.summary: Terminus’s spin produces zero, low, normal, or high gravity in different areas.

numenera.rule.gravity-on-terminus-varies.cost_or_limit: Gravity depends on where one is on the object.
numenera.rule.gravity-on-terminus-varies.go_wrong: Faulty access tubes can cause dangerous falls, especially in high gravity.
numenera.rule.gravity-on-terminus-varies.who_may: Applies to creatures and objects on Terminus.
numenera.rule.gravity-on-terminus-varies.combines: Access tubes move travelers between areas with different gravity.
numenera.rule.gravity-on-terminus-varies.blocked_reason: Spatially varying gravity is an area field.

numenera.rule.access-tubes-transport-tra.name: Access tubes transport travelers between nodes

effect.summary: Powered tubes carry travelers to the next node in a few minutes.

numenera.rule.access-tubes-transport-tra.cost_or_limit: Controls must be figured out; faulty tubes may fail or cause a fall.
numenera.rule.access-tubes-transport-tra.go_wrong: A failed attempt in a faulty tube can drop passengers.
numenera.rule.access-tubes-transport-tra.combines: Gravity in the destination affects travel hazards.
numenera.rule.access-tubes-transport-tra.blocked_reason: The described transport is a position change.

numenera.rule.clue-discovery-about-termi.name: Clue discovery about Terminus

effect.summary: Successful difficulty 6 inquiries reveal one clue at a time, in order, with at most one per location.

numenera.rule.clue-discovery-about-termi.cost_or_limit: One clue per location; clues are gained in order.
numenera.rule.clue-discovery-about-termi.where_from: Machines and creatures away from the Control Nexus may hold partial or degraded knowledge.
numenera.rule.clue-discovery-about-termi.combines: Clues reveal the Meeting, the failing key function, and the control location.
numenera.rule.clue-discovery-about-termi.blocked_reason: This is an investigation limit, not a missing effect capability.

numenera.rule.repository-defenses-and-co.name: Repository defenses and contents

effect.summary: A failed attempt to bypass a repository seal shocks nearby creatures; removed white mineral chunks ignite in air.

numenera.rule.repository-defenses-and-co.cost_or_limit: The seal remains intact after a failed bypass; burning chunks continue for minutes and harm nearby targets each round.
numenera.rule.repository-defenses-and-co.go_wrong: A failed bypass may summon an anhedon nest; releasing chunks risks fire damage.
numenera.rule.repository-defenses-and-co.who_may: Applies to intruders and anyone removing the chunks.
numenera.rule.repository-defenses-and-co.combines: Repository contents include white mineral chunks suspended in fluid.
numenera.rule.repository-defenses-and-co.blocked_reason: The chunk’s air-triggered, sustained burning needs a material reaction not covered by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.name: Terminus’s key function requires repair and alignment

effect.summary: Repairing the disabled key function and restoring the correct trajectory can enable the cosmic door.

numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.cost_or_limit: The key function is disabled; steering and repair require successful tasks.
numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.go_wrong: A misaligned key cannot produce the Meeting or open the door.
numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.who_may: Characters who can repair and steer Terminus.
numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.where_from: A chance gamma-particle-flux encounter damaged it long ago; Moonwrecker course changes further misalign it.
numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.combines: The key function, trajectory, and Meeting of All Things are linked.
numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.mechanism: Repairable ancient machine and alignment condition
numenera.rule.terminus-s-key-function-re.blocked_reason: The rule depends on the interaction of machine repair, trajectory, and a cosmic effect.

numenera.rule.detonations-must-be-simult.name: Detonations must be simultaneous

effect.summary: Ramoth’s destruction plan succeeds only if all three charges detonate at once.

numenera.rule.detonations-must-be-simult.cost_or_limit: All three specified sites must be used.
numenera.rule.detonations-must-be-simult.go_wrong: Non-simultaneous explosions may fail to destroy Terminus safely.
numenera.rule.detonations-must-be-simult.combines: Requires three massive-destruction cyphers at their marked locations.
numenera.rule.detonations-must-be-simult.blocked_reason: This is a timing constraint on effects.

numenera.rule.transcendence-can-change-a.name: Transcendence can change a user’s existence

effect.summary: The most extreme cosmic-door result turns users into higher-dimensional or otherwise nonhuman entities.

numenera.rule.transcendence-can-change-a.cost_or_limit: The result may effectively end a campaign’s ordinary play.
numenera.rule.transcendence-can-change-a.go_wrong: The resulting beings may not be modelable in ordinary play.
numenera.rule.transcendence-can-change-a.mind: Users may become superintelligences or forms beyond human understanding.
numenera.rule.transcendence-can-change-a.who_may: Those who choose to pass through the cosmic door.
numenera.rule.transcendence-can-change-a.combines: Requires opening the transcendent cosmic door.
numenera.rule.transcendence-can-change-a.blocked_reason: It changes a person into an entirely different state of existence beyond a basic body-form change.

numenera.rule.reactive-field.name: Reactive field

effect.summary: An installation's surrounding area interferes with other installations that are too close.

numenera.rule.reactive-field.cost_or_limit: Applies around an installation and to installations too near it.
numenera.rule.reactive-field.combines: Interacts with other installations in range.
numenera.rule.reactive-field.blocked_reason: The rule depends on an area around an installation and proximity-based interference.

numenera.rule.temperamental-cypher.name: Temperamental cypher

effect.summary: A quickly built cypher works only for the Wright who made it.

numenera.rule.temperamental-cypher.cost_or_limit: Usable only by its crafting Wright.
numenera.rule.temperamental-cypher.go_wrong: It fails to work for other users.
numenera.rule.temperamental-cypher.blocked_reason: The restriction binds a cypher's function to its creator.

numenera.rule.datasphere-laws-of-reality.name: Datasphere laws of reality

effect.summary: Local regions can switch physical laws on or off; information travels rapidly and perception is transmitted into minds.

numenera.rule.datasphere-laws-of-reality.mind: Perception is transmitted directly into the explorer’s mind.
numenera.rule.datasphere-laws-of-reality.blocked_reason: The rule lets regions change or disable physical laws, which requires a local field of altered rules.

numenera.rule.transcribing.name: Transcribing

effect.summary: Moves a creature or object between physical and digital forms by translating its matter and energy.

numenera.rule.transcribing.cost_or_limit: Requires a vertice; the process takes seconds to an hour and prevents actions while underway.
numenera.rule.transcribing.go_wrong: Disruption can cause errors at the destination.
numenera.rule.transcribing.mind: The whole creature is translated, not just its mind.
numenera.rule.transcribing.who_may: Creatures or objects at a vertice
numenera.rule.transcribing.combines: Datascribing and realscribing are opposite parts of the process.
numenera.rule.transcribing.blocked_reason: Changing a creature or object between physical and digital forms requires form transformation.

numenera.rule.transcribing-carries-every.name: Transcribing carries everything

effect.summary: The creature and everything it carries are transcribed together.

numenera.rule.transcribing-carries-every.go_wrong: Disruption can cause errors at the destination.
numenera.rule.transcribing-carries-every.combines: Applies to carried objects as part of transcription.
numenera.rule.transcribing-carries-every.blocked_reason: The rule describes transfer alongside the subject and needs no unsupported capability.

numenera.rule.mundane-equipment-in-the-d.name: Mundane equipment in the datasphere

effect.summary: Ordinary physical gear is cosmetic and cannot affect dataforms or virtual barriers.

numenera.rule.mundane-equipment-in-the-d.cost_or_limit: Numenera objects are exceptions; modeled real-world environments may also make props work normally.
numenera.rule.mundane-equipment-in-the-d.combines: Innate abilities may temporarily make appropriate mundane gear functional.
numenera.rule.mundane-equipment-in-the-d.blocked_reason: The restriction is a straightforward rule that ordinary gear has no effect.

numenera.rule.soulcore-pool.name: Soulcore Pool

effect.summary: A datascribed PC combines Might, Speed, and Intellect into one pool used for costs and damage.

numenera.rule.soulcore-pool.cost_or_limit: Maximum Soulcore equals the sum of maximum stat Pools; Edges still reduce costs.
numenera.rule.soulcore-pool.go_wrong: Damage to the shared pool does not normally move a character down the damage track.
numenera.rule.soulcore-pool.mind: No spiritual soul is involved; it represents the creature’s self.
numenera.rule.soulcore-pool.combines: Recovery restores it; realscribing distributes current points among the original Pools, with excess lost.
numenera.rule.soulcore-pool.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as one shared resource pool.

numenera.rule.realscribing-pool-allocati.name: Realscribing Pool allocation

effect.summary: A PC distributes current Soulcore points among their three stat Pools when returning to the real.

numenera.rule.realscribing-pool-allocati.cost_or_limit: Each Pool is capped at its original maximum; excess points are lost.
numenera.rule.realscribing-pool-allocati.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward redistribution of a resource.

numenera.rule.numenera-objects-in-the-da.name: Numenera objects in the datasphere

effect.summary: Numenera objects retain their abilities when transcribed, with effects adapted to the digital realm.

numenera.rule.numenera-objects-in-the-da.go_wrong: Breaking the cypher limit may have a more immediate effect.
numenera.rule.numenera-objects-in-the-da.combines: Abilities are translated into forms appropriate to the datasphere.
numenera.rule.numenera-objects-in-the-da.blocked_reason: The rule gives items continuing powers in another realm but does not specify a general carrying or depletion system.

numenera.rule.ideates.name: Ideates

effect.summary: A creature’s abilities appear as representative visual or sensory forms when used.

numenera.rule.ideates.cost_or_limit: The manifestations are cosmetic and appear only as needed.
numenera.rule.ideates.mind: The creature perceives familiar abilities as working much like in the real.
numenera.rule.ideates.combines: Manifestations can depict type, focus, or other abilities.
numenera.rule.ideates.blocked_reason: The stated manifestations are cosmetic and do not require a mechanical effect.

numenera.rule.dataform-appearance.name: Dataform appearance

effect.summary: Dataforms generally resemble their real counterparts but appear heightened or stylized.

numenera.rule.dataform-appearance.cost_or_limit: Appearance can vary between visits and may be changed by local conditions or morphology abilities.
numenera.rule.dataform-appearance.mind: Appearance may reflect emotion and health.
numenera.rule.dataform-appearance.combines: Nodes, frames, ideates, and morphology abilities can change appearance.
numenera.rule.dataform-appearance.blocked_reason: The described appearance changes are cosmetic.

numenera.rule.datasphere-appearance-repr.name: Datasphere appearance represents meaning

effect.summary: A visitor’s mind interprets dataforms and transcribed objects according to what they represent, so viewers may see different appearances.

numenera.rule.datasphere-appearance-repr.cost_or_limit: These appearance differences are generally cosmetic; morphology can let a character control them.
numenera.rule.datasphere-appearance-repr.go_wrong: Different viewers may interpret the same dataform differently.
numenera.rule.datasphere-appearance-repr.mind: Information is conveyed directly into a visitor’s mind and visually interpreted through experience.
numenera.rule.datasphere-appearance-repr.combines: Morphology can control personal and nearby appearances.
numenera.rule.datasphere-appearance-repr.blocked_reason: This rule describes cosmetic information presentation.

numenera.rule.datasphere-movement-within.name: Datasphere movement within a frame

effect.summary: A dataform can move anywhere in its current frame as part of an action or as its action.

numenera.rule.datasphere-movement-within.cost_or_limit: Crossing barriers still requires an action.
numenera.rule.datasphere-movement-within.go_wrong: No momentum means a traveler does not overshoot or fall from the movement itself.
numenera.rule.datasphere-movement-within.combines: Movement can accompany another action or constitute the whole action.
numenera.rule.datasphere-movement-within.blocked_reason: Movement within the frame is directly represented by the basic movement effect.

numenera.rule.no-momentum-in-datasphere-.name: No momentum in datasphere movement

effect.summary: Movement stops immediately at the chosen destination, without momentum or overshooting.

numenera.rule.no-momentum-in-datasphere-.cost_or_limit: Momentum-dependent abilities can still be accommodated as an ideate.
numenera.rule.no-momentum-in-datasphere-.combines: The environment can still accommodate attacks whose abilities rely on movement.
numenera.rule.no-momentum-in-datasphere-.blocked_reason: This is a movement constraint, not an additional effect.

numenera.rule.attacks-within-a-frame-ign.name: Attacks within a frame ignore distance

effect.summary: Melee and ranged attacks can reach any creature in the same frame without distance-based range modifiers.

numenera.rule.attacks-within-a-frame-ign.cost_or_limit: The rule applies within the same frame.
numenera.rule.attacks-within-a-frame-ign.combines: Applies to melee and ranged attacks.
numenera.rule.attacks-within-a-frame-ign.blocked_reason: The rule changes target reach without requiring an unlisted effect.

numenera.rule.area-effects-affect-up-to-.name: Area effects affect up to four targets

effect.summary: An area effect user may choose up to four targets in the same frame.

numenera.rule.area-effects-affect-up-to-.cost_or_limit: Effects explicitly affecting everything in a frame ignore the limit.
numenera.rule.area-effects-affect-up-to-.who_may: Users of character abilities or devices that create area effects.
numenera.rule.area-effects-affect-up-to-.combines: Applies to area effects from abilities and devices.
numenera.rule.area-effects-affect-up-to-.blocked_reason: The area-target selection and exception for whole-frame effects need an area-targeting capability.

numenera.rule.barriers-restrict-datasphe.name: Barriers restrict datasphere travel

effect.summary: Databarriers restrict travel between frames, nodes, and conduits; passing through one takes an action.

numenera.rule.barriers-restrict-datasphe.cost_or_limit: Even an opened barrier requires a passing dataform to spend an action to cross.
numenera.rule.barriers-restrict-datasphe.go_wrong: Damaged barriers may glitch; destroyed ones stop functioning and cannot be repaired.
numenera.rule.barriers-restrict-datasphe.combines: Barriers can be opened by input, keys, codebreaking, or kicking.
numenera.rule.barriers-restrict-datasphe.blocked_reason: The barrier’s persistent passage restriction and state need a containment or access-control mechanism.

numenera.rule.barrier-level-and-opening-.name: Barrier level and opening input

effect.summary: A barrier’s level measures opening difficulty; barriers above level zero require an input, which may take varying amounts of time.

numenera.rule.barrier-level-and-opening-.cost_or_limit: Opening time is not determined by barrier level; some barriers require a specific key.
numenera.rule.barrier-level-and-opening-.go_wrong: Incorrect inputs may trigger a hazardous effect.
numenera.rule.barrier-level-and-opening-.who_may: Creatures attempting to open a barrier.
numenera.rule.barrier-level-and-opening-.combines: Inputs can range from buttons and passwords to puzzles or challenges.
numenera.rule.barrier-level-and-opening-.blocked_reason: The access challenge and its variable completion conditions are not captured by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.barrier-opening-duration.name: Barrier opening duration

effect.summary: An opened barrier usually remains open for one round or until a specified number of dataforms pass.

numenera.rule.barrier-opening-duration.who_may: Dataforms on either side of an opened barrier.
numenera.rule.barrier-opening-duration.combines: May allow any number of dataforms during a one-round opening.
numenera.rule.barrier-opening-duration.blocked_reason: The timed or count-limited access state requires a barrier-state mechanism.

numenera.rule.barrier-clue-and-inspectio.name: Barrier clue and inspection

effect.summary: A character can spend an action using a relevant skill to glean clues about an adjacent frame through a barrier.

numenera.rule.barrier-clue-and-inspectio.cost_or_limit: Difficulty equals the frame level, or the lower barrier level when applicable.
numenera.rule.barrier-clue-and-inspectio.who_may: Characters using perception, understanding numenera, or datasphere knowledge.
numenera.rule.barrier-clue-and-inspectio.combines: Success may reveal environmental qualities and nearby creatures.
numenera.rule.barrier-clue-and-inspectio.blocked_reason: The passage describes an information-sensing task.

numenera.rule.damaged-and-destroyed-barr.name: Damaged and destroyed barriers

effect.summary: Barriers can be damaged or destroyed; damaged ones may glitch and can be repaired, while destroyed ones cannot.

numenera.rule.damaged-and-destroyed-barr.cost_or_limit: Damage or destruction usually requires specialized abilities, cyphers, or artifacts; repair uses craft numenera at a difficulty tied to barrier level.
numenera.rule.damaged-and-destroyed-barr.go_wrong: Glitches may affect the barrier, its key, users, passers-through, or others in its node.
numenera.rule.damaged-and-destroyed-barr.who_may: Those with suitable capabilities or devices.
numenera.rule.damaged-and-destroyed-barr.combines: A destroyed barrier may cut off access to its dataspace.
numenera.rule.damaged-and-destroyed-barr.mechanism: Barrier damage, glitch, and repair states.
numenera.rule.damaged-and-destroyed-barr.blocked_reason: The distinct damaged, destroyed, and repairable states require barrier-state tracking.

numenera.rule.barrier-keys-match-barrier.name: Barrier keys match barrier level

effect.summary: A barrier key has the same level as the barrier it opens and usually opens it automatically when activated adjacent to it.

numenera.rule.barrier-keys-match-barrier.cost_or_limit: Keys can be damaged; a damaged key may provide assets rather than automatically opening the barrier.
numenera.rule.barrier-keys-match-barrier.go_wrong: A damaged key may not unlock its barrier outright.
numenera.rule.barrier-keys-match-barrier.who_may: A creature adjacent to the barrier that activates the key.
numenera.rule.barrier-keys-match-barrier.combines: Keys may encode complex passwords, cypher types, recordings, soulcore patterns, or unique dataforms.
numenera.rule.barrier-keys-match-barrier.blocked_reason: A key’s correspondence to a specific barrier and its damage state require access-control rules.

numenera.rule.barrier-keys-are-reusable.name: Barrier keys are reusable

effect.summary: Keys can be reused unless a barrier is designed to claim, move, or destroy them.

numenera.rule.barrier-keys-are-reusable.cost_or_limit: Some hostile machine intelligences intentionally prevent repeat use by removing or destroying a key.
numenera.rule.barrier-keys-are-reusable.go_wrong: A one-use barrier may consume or relocate its key.
numenera.rule.barrier-keys-are-reusable.combines: Some barriers are intentionally designed to stop repeat traffic.
numenera.rule.barrier-keys-are-reusable.blocked_reason: The exception depends on persistent item and barrier state.

numenera.rule.soulstealing-barrier-cost.name: Soulstealing barrier cost

effect.summary: A barrier can use one traveler’s soulcore energy as its key, inflicting damage usually equal to three times the barrier level.

numenera.rule.soulstealing-barrier-cost.cost_or_limit: All damage must come from one creature and cannot be absorbed, deflected, or negated; it can later be healed.
numenera.rule.soulstealing-barrier-cost.go_wrong: The required energy loss damages the traveler.
numenera.rule.soulstealing-barrier-cost.who_may: One creature supplying the barrier’s required soulcore portion.
numenera.rule.soulstealing-barrier-cost.where_from: A locked barrier whose key is personal energy.
numenera.rule.soulstealing-barrier-cost.combines: The key’s nature can be investigated with understanding numenera.
numenera.rule.soulstealing-barrier-cost.blocked_reason: The cost is explicitly paid from soulcore, a soul-state resource not represented in the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.codebreaking-barriers.name: Codebreaking barriers

effect.summary: Opening a locked barrier without its key requires a number of successful codebreaking subtasks equal to its level.

numenera.rule.codebreaking-barriers.cost_or_limit: Subtask difficulty rises from one to the barrier level, attempts take scheduled intervals, and sustained Effort cannot apply beyond 28 hours.
numenera.rule.codebreaking-barriers.go_wrong: A failed subtask wastes its interval; two consecutive failures can prompt an intrusion, and final failure triggers any hazard and a lockout.
numenera.rule.codebreaking-barriers.who_may: Characters attempting the process with understanding numenera.
numenera.rule.codebreaking-barriers.combines: Relevant skills may ease some subtasks.
numenera.rule.codebreaking-barriers.blocked_reason: Progress, elapsed intervals, escalating difficulty, and failure states exceed the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.kicking-barriers.name: Kicking barriers

effect.summary: A brute-force attempt opens a barrier with one task, usually at barrier level plus two difficulty.

numenera.rule.kicking-barriers.cost_or_limit: It is faster than codebreaking; barriers requiring difficulty above ten cannot be kicked, and Effort is limited to tasks no longer than 28 hours.
numenera.rule.kicking-barriers.go_wrong: Failure triggers any hazard, locks out further attempts, and hinders opening attempts for a while; the attempt can damage the barrier.
