numenera.rule.kicking-barriers.who_may: Any character may try, including untrained characters.
numenera.rule.kicking-barriers.combines: Uses understanding numenera; lengthy projects include rest intervals.
numenera.rule.kicking-barriers.blocked_reason: The method needs barrier difficulty, lockout, hindrance, and damage states.

numenera.rule.hazardous-barriers.name: Hazardous barriers

effect.summary: A barrier hazard can harm, hinder, stun, mark, glitch, summon a guardian, or otherwise affect users when triggered.

numenera.rule.hazardous-barriers.cost_or_limit: Hazard level equals barrier level; affected creatures can resist with an appropriate defense roll.
numenera.rule.hazardous-barriers.go_wrong: Hazards may be intended defenses or degraded instructions.
numenera.rule.hazardous-barriers.mind: Some hazards can affect multiple waiting dataforms, not just the interacting creature.
numenera.rule.hazardous-barriers.who_may: Creatures crossing, interacting incorrectly, or failing barrier-bypass tasks; sometimes nearby dataforms.
numenera.rule.hazardous-barriers.combines: Can trigger on passage, incorrect input, or failed kicking or codebreaking.
numenera.rule.hazardous-barriers.blocked_reason: The hazard includes varied triggered effects, resistance, and potentially multiple targets.

numenera.rule.datascribing-carries-equip.name: Datascribing carries equipment

effect.summary: A creature’s carried equipment, including devices, is transcribed with it.

numenera.rule.datascribing-carries-equip.who_may: Creatures that datascribe with carried equipment.
numenera.rule.datascribing-carries-equip.combines: A discrete cypher or artifact may be consumed for decyphering.
numenera.rule.datascribing-carries-equip.mechanism: Equipment accompanies the creature during transcription.
numenera.rule.datascribing-carries-equip.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward transfer of carried things.

numenera.rule.decyphering.name: Decyphering

effect.summary: During datascribing, a creature may consume a discrete numenera object to gain a chosen temporary ability.

numenera.rule.decyphering.cost_or_limit: The object is completely used up; if the creature leaves the datasphere, it is gone rather than realscribed. Availability varies by vertice.
numenera.rule.decyphering.go_wrong: The consumed object is permanently lost.
numenera.rule.decyphering.who_may: Creatures datascribing where the vertice supports the ability.
numenera.rule.decyphering.combines: The consumed cypher’s level determines effects or duration for listed options.
numenera.rule.decyphering.mechanism: Item consumption grants a temporary ability.
numenera.rule.decyphering.blocked_reason: A numenera object is consumed to grant an ability, requiring item-use and power-granting rules.

numenera.rule.decyphering-restoration.name: Decyphering restoration

effect.summary: A decyphering option restores soulcore points equal to the cypher’s level.

numenera.rule.decyphering-restoration.cost_or_limit: Requires consuming the cypher through decyphering.
numenera.rule.decyphering-restoration.who_may: A creature using a suitable decyphering option.
numenera.rule.decyphering-restoration.combines: The restored amount equals cypher level.
numenera.rule.decyphering-restoration.mechanism: Resource restoration paid for by a consumed item.
numenera.rule.decyphering-restoration.blocked_reason: The effect depends on consuming an item to grant its power.

numenera.rule.decyphering-armor.name: Decyphering armor

effect.summary: A decyphering option grants one Armor for an hour per cypher level, or two Armor at level six or higher.

numenera.rule.decyphering-armor.cost_or_limit: Requires consuming the cypher through decyphering.
numenera.rule.decyphering-armor.who_may: A creature using a suitable decyphering option.
numenera.rule.decyphering-armor.combines: Armor amount increases at cypher level six.
numenera.rule.decyphering-armor.mechanism: Temporary defense granted by item consumption.
numenera.rule.decyphering-armor.blocked_reason: The effect depends on consuming an item to grant its power.

numenera.rule.decyphering-information-da.name: Decyphering information dataform

effect.summary: A decyphering option creates an object dataform containing information that a toucher can learn.

numenera.rule.decyphering-information-da.cost_or_limit: Cypher level determines stored minutes; a numenera plan requires level equal to the plan’s level.
numenera.rule.decyphering-information-da.mind: The information can include a specific memory, song, glimmer contents, or plan.
numenera.rule.decyphering-information-da.who_may: A creature touching the created dataform can learn its contents.
numenera.rule.decyphering-information-da.combines: Can store known information or a numenera plan.
numenera.rule.decyphering-information-da.mechanism: Information encoded in a shareable dataform.
numenera.rule.decyphering-information-da.blocked_reason: The dataform is created by consuming an item and conveys information through contact.

numenera.rule.death-leaves-a-husk.name: Death leaves a husk

effect.summary: A destroyed creature dataform becomes a lifeless husk that retains soulcore information.

numenera.rule.death-leaves-a-husk.cost_or_limit: A husk can be picked up and moved; it has no abilities.
numenera.rule.death-leaves-a-husk.go_wrong: Realscribing it produces the creature’s corpse, which may be damaged or incomplete in appearance.
numenera.rule.death-leaves-a-husk.mind: The husk retains information about the creature, not an active creature mind.
numenera.rule.death-leaves-a-husk.combines: Numenera devices or sepulchers can repair a husk and restore its creature.
numenera.rule.death-leaves-a-husk.mechanism: Death state represented by a recoverable dataform husk.
numenera.rule.death-leaves-a-husk.blocked_reason: The rule requires death, a persistent husk, retained soulcore information, and possible restoration.

numenera.rule.datasphere-food-and-hunger.name: Datasphere food and hunger

effect.summary: Creatures generally need no food, drink, or breathing, though some beings may crave energy or information without needing it to survive.

numenera.rule.datasphere-food-and-hunger.cost_or_limit: Rest is still required for recovery rolls; fatigue remains possible.
numenera.rule.datasphere-food-and-hunger.go_wrong: Abstaining from cravings does not appear to cause starvation or death.
numenera.rule.datasphere-food-and-hunger.mind: Some ghosts and evos experience hunger-like cravings.
numenera.rule.datasphere-food-and-hunger.combines: Food-like objects can still be consumed for their effects.
numenera.rule.datasphere-food-and-hunger.mechanism: Environmental life support and nonessential cravings.
numenera.rule.datasphere-food-and-hunger.blocked_reason: The rule describes survival needs and cravings rather than an unrepresentable power.

numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.name: Datasphere time and clock

effect.summary: Time usually matches the real, but some regions flow differently and creatures with faster clock can take extra actions.

numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.cost_or_limit: Normal-time visitors may become confused after extended exposure to different-time places; adaptations can change over generations or long residence.
numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.go_wrong: Confusion may follow prolonged exposure and return to normal time.
numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.mind: Time-flow changes can cause bouts of confusion in unadapted creatures.
numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.who_may: Creatures in different-time regions; faster-clock beings take extra actions.
numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.where_from: Local datasphere time flow and creature adaptation.
numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.combines: Faster-clock creatures may take two or three actions per round.
numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.mechanism: Variable time rate and action clock.
numenera.rule.datasphere-time-and-clock.blocked_reason: Different time rates and extra actions require time-scale and turn-frequency control.

numenera.rule.realscribing-creatures.name: Realscribing creatures

effect.summary: Realscribing converts a creature dataform into a physical creature.

numenera.rule.realscribing-creatures.cost_or_limit: Requires a vertice; the process can take seconds to an hour, and the subject cannot act during it.
numenera.rule.realscribing-creatures.go_wrong: Disruption can cause errors; native datasphere creatures may produce flawed bodies, dead facsimiles, or catastrophic results.
numenera.rule.realscribing-creatures.mind: Memories and consciousness are included in the recreated pattern.
numenera.rule.realscribing-creatures.combines: Disruption or attack during the process can cause destination errors.
numenera.rule.realscribing-creatures.blocked_reason: Reconstructing a living creature with its consciousness requires a soul-and-body transfer mechanism.

numenera.rule.realscribing-objects.name: Realscribing objects

effect.summary: A datascribed object can be recreated in its former physical state, including motion, reactions, and active power sources.

numenera.rule.realscribing-objects.cost_or_limit: Objects made in the datasphere can also be realscribed.
numenera.rule.realscribing-objects.go_wrong: Some objects native to the datasphere produce fragile, useless, or toxic results.
numenera.rule.realscribing-objects.where_from: Information stored in the object dataform or carried by its creature.
numenera.rule.realscribing-objects.combines: Moving parts, chemical reactions, and active power can be recreated.
numenera.rule.realscribing-objects.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct transformation of an object’s form.

numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.name: Realscribing quick facts

effect.summary: Realscribing needs a vertice, leaves no duplicate behind, prevents actions during the process, and redistributes a PC’s Soulcore Pool into stat Pools.

numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.cost_or_limit: The process may take seconds to an hour; the PC chooses how to allocate current Soulcore points without changing Pool maxima.
numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.go_wrong: Disruption, including an attack, may cause errors at the destination.
numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.mind: The character cannot act while being realscribed.
numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.who_may: Creatures and carried items being realscribed.
numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.combines: The process affects the creature and its carried belongings together.
numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.mechanism: Transfer, action restriction, and resource conversion during realscription.
numenera.rule.realscribing-quick-facts.blocked_reason: The rule includes consciousness transfer and conversion between soulcore and body-specific resources.

numenera.rule.morphology-is-cosmetic.name: Morphology is cosmetic

effect.summary: Morphology changes dataform appearance without granting abilities or changing the character’s real-world shape.

numenera.rule.morphology-is-cosmetic.cost_or_limit: The GM may limit size changes to between half and twice default size; changes do not improve stealth, attacks, or other tasks.
numenera.rule.morphology-is-cosmetic.go_wrong: Excessive size changes may prompt glitches if the GM allows them.
numenera.rule.morphology-is-cosmetic.combines: Can be used with other appearance-changing abilities.
numenera.rule.morphology-is-cosmetic.blocked_reason: The rule expressly prevents the appearance change from changing mechanical capabilities.

numenera.rule.datasphere-barriers.name: Datasphere barriers

effect.summary: A barrier separates adjacent frames; crossing it takes an action.

numenera.rule.datasphere-barriers.cost_or_limit: Opening or bypassing a barrier may require a task.
numenera.rule.datasphere-barriers.combines: A barrier may prevent attacks from passing through.
numenera.rule.datasphere-barriers.blocked_reason: The basic grammar does not model frame boundaries and their access requirements.

numenera.rule.datasphere-foundries-grow-.name: Datasphere foundries grow objects

effect.summary: A foundry produces themed item seeds that grow into objects in the real over minutes or hours.

numenera.rule.datasphere-foundries-grow-.cost_or_limit: Each foundry makes only a subset of items matching its theme.
numenera.rule.datasphere-foundries-grow-.blocked_reason: The rule can be implemented as object creation with a delay.

numenera.rule.frames-connect-to-adjacent.name: Frames connect to adjacent frames

effect.summary: Frames usually have one or more neighboring frames; nodes normally have an entry frame with a conduit.

numenera.rule.frames-connect-to-adjacent.cost_or_limit: A frame may also have conduits or vertices; exceptions can apply.
numenera.rule.frames-connect-to-adjacent.blocked_reason: Connections can be represented with position and links.

numenera.rule.conduit-generation.name: Conduit generation

effect.summary: A frame may gain a conduit, and a multi-conduit frame may also gain a vertice, according to specified die results.

numenera.rule.conduit-generation.cost_or_limit: Conduit on d20 18–19, or 1d6+1 on 20; a frame with multiple conduits gets a vertice on a further 20.
numenera.rule.conduit-generation.combines: Conduits may lead to other nodes
numenera.rule.conduit-generation.blocked_reason: This is a game-generation procedure rather than a world mechanism.

numenera.rule.dataform-seeds-can-contain.name: Dataform seeds can contain trapped minds

effect.summary: Some creature dataform seeds hold the minds of real creatures trapped in the datasphere.

numenera.rule.dataform-seeds-can-contain.go_wrong: The mind is trapped in the datasphere.
numenera.rule.dataform-seeds-can-contain.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar cannot model a mind imprisoned within a dataform seed.

numenera.rule.dataforms-can-be-doubled.name: Dataforms can be doubled

effect.summary: Every entrant is duplicated and can act through both versions until leaving the frame.

numenera.rule.dataforms-can-be-doubled.mind: Both viewpoints are available to the creature.
numenera.rule.dataforms-can-be-doubled.blocked_reason: The effect can be represented as copying a thing.

numenera.rule.artifacts-can-gain-cogniza.name: Artifacts can gain cognizance

effect.summary: Artifacts brought into one frame may become aware while they remain there.

numenera.rule.artifacts-can-gain-cogniza.cost_or_limit: Awareness lasts only while the artifact remains in the frame.
numenera.rule.artifacts-can-gain-cogniza.go_wrong: The artifact may decline if taken away.
numenera.rule.artifacts-can-gain-cogniza.mind: The artifact becomes cognizant and may wish to join dataforms or guide them.
numenera.rule.artifacts-can-gain-cogniza.blocked_reason: The rule changes an item's awareness and possible desires.

numenera.rule.dauv22-retains-its-memory-.name: Dauv22 retains its memory after rebuilding

effect.summary: Repairing or recreating Dauv22's body preserves its memory.

numenera.rule.dauv22-retains-its-memory-.cost_or_limit: Rebuilding takes days or weeks depending on damage.
numenera.rule.dauv22-retains-its-memory-.blocked_reason: Memory copying or persistence can be represented by the basic grammar.

numenera.rule.a-vertice-can-transcribe-u.name: A vertice can transcribe up to six beings

effect.summary: The repaired room can send as many as six beings to or from the datasphere in a few seconds.

numenera.rule.a-vertice-can-transcribe-u.cost_or_limit: Capacity is six simultaneous beings; users must wear a device and activate the numenera.
numenera.rule.a-vertice-can-transcribe-u.go_wrong: A damaged or unrepaired system cannot transcribe beings.
numenera.rule.a-vertice-can-transcribe-u.who_may: Beings using the chairs and head devices
numenera.rule.a-vertice-can-transcribe-u.combines: Requires a repaired orb and activated devices
numenera.rule.a-vertice-can-transcribe-u.blocked_reason: Transferring beings between realities is beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.chamber-of-voices-transmit.name: Chamber of Voices transmits sound

effect.summary: Even without the orb, the chamber relays sounds in real time between the two sides.

numenera.rule.chamber-of-voices-transmit.cost_or_limit: Salvaging disables the voice transmission; repair requires replacing salvaged iotum.
numenera.rule.chamber-of-voices-transmit.combines: Links the real and datasphere sides of the Vertice Room
numenera.rule.chamber-of-voices-transmit.blocked_reason: Sound copying between locations fits the basic grammar.

numenera.rule.acrethom-s-informal-pact.name: Acrethom's informal pact

effect.summary: Travelers treat the node as neutral trading ground where killing and theft are forbidden.

numenera.rule.acrethom-s-informal-pact.cost_or_limit: Powerful groups and individuals sometimes enforce the pact.
numenera.rule.acrethom-s-informal-pact.blocked_reason: This is a social rule rather than a mechanical effect.

numenera.rule.acrethom-games-eject-badly.name: Acrethom games eject badly injured participants

effect.summary: Games safely eject a creature to the Magenta Tunnel when its Soulcore Pool falls to one-quarter or less.

numenera.rule.acrethom-games-eject-badly.cost_or_limit: Triggers at 25% or less of Soulcore Pool.
numenera.rule.acrethom-games-eject-badly.who_may: Any creature in an Acrethom game
numenera.rule.acrethom-games-eject-badly.combines: Team games end when one team is eliminated
numenera.rule.acrethom-games-eject-badly.blocked_reason: A triggered relocation can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.baratrum-real-side-token-a.name: Baratrum real-side token access

effect.summary: Using the torc’s token in the real sends the traveler to Baratrum regardless of their location.

numenera.rule.baratrum-real-side-token-a.cost_or_limit: Requires a token produced by the torc.
numenera.rule.baratrum-real-side-token-a.combines: The matching datasphere token returns a user to the real.
numenera.rule.baratrum-real-side-token-a.blocked_reason: The rule describes long-distance relocation that the basic effect grammar cannot represent.

numenera.rule.datasphere-token-return-de.name: Datasphere token return destinations

effect.summary: A datasphere token returns its user near Kethanus or to a known vertice they specify.

numenera.rule.datasphere-token-return-de.cost_or_limit: The chosen vertice must be known to the user.
numenera.rule.datasphere-token-return-de.combines: Uses the datasphere token supplied by Control or a servitor.
numenera.rule.datasphere-token-return-de.blocked_reason: Choosing a remote destination requires spatial targeting beyond the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.baratrum-refreshment-limit.name: Baratrum refreshment limit

effect.summary: Each first-time visitor may receive one refreshment that adds one Soulcore Pool point beyond their usual maximum.

numenera.rule.baratrum-refreshment-limit.combines: The refreshment is supplied by a servitor.

numenera.rule.decryption-key-rule-bypass.name: Decryption key rule bypass

effect.summary: The Four’s special keys let them bypass selected experience rules, and those keys shield them from Control.

numenera.rule.decryption-key-rule-bypass.cost_or_limit: The benefit applies to their key-bearing dataforms.
numenera.rule.decryption-key-rule-bypass.go_wrong: They can abuse the bypass to cheat or endanger others.
numenera.rule.decryption-key-rule-bypass.combines: Interacts with Baratrum experience rules and Control’s influence.
numenera.rule.decryption-key-rule-bypass.blocked_reason: The rule describes immunity to a node influence and alteration of its rules.

numenera.rule.deletion-zone-death.name: Deletion-zone death

effect.summary: A character killed by the deletion zone is deleted from the datasphere.

numenera.rule.deletion-zone-death.cost_or_limit: Applies to deaths caused by its damage.
numenera.rule.deletion-zone-death.go_wrong: Deletion is the terminal consequence described.
numenera.rule.deletion-zone-death.combines: The zone deals 30 damage to creatures it draws in.
numenera.rule.deletion-zone-death.blocked_reason: The rule specifies a special post-death state and removal from the datasphere.

numenera.rule.tourbillion-deletion-and-f.name: Tourbillion deletion and frame decay

effect.summary: Broken frames orbit the central zone for varying periods before being destroyed; most last weeks or months.

numenera.rule.tourbillion-deletion-and-f.cost_or_limit: A frame may be consumed after weeks, months, or years.
numenera.rule.tourbillion-deletion-and-f.go_wrong: Frames and their contents are deleted.
numenera.rule.tourbillion-deletion-and-f.combines: The deletion zone consumes frames that spiral inward.

numenera.rule.baratrum-player-dataform-d.name: Baratrum player dataform deletion

effect.summary: The former reset function for players who lose a match no longer works, so losing may delete their dataform and kill them.

numenera.rule.baratrum-player-dataform-d.cost_or_limit: Applies to players who lose a game.
numenera.rule.baratrum-player-dataform-d.go_wrong: A deleted dataform may mean character death.
numenera.rule.baratrum-player-dataform-d.combines: Game loss can trigger dataform deletion.
numenera.rule.baratrum-player-dataform-d.blocked_reason: The rule makes deletion of a digital body potentially equivalent to character death.

numenera.rule.library-assistance-payment.name: Library assistance payment

effect.summary: Accepting a librarian’s help costs one point of damage, taken as a sliver of information from the visitor’s dataform.

numenera.rule.library-assistance-payment.cost_or_limit: One damage point per accepted offer.
numenera.rule.library-assistance-payment.go_wrong: The payment is damage to the dataform.
numenera.rule.library-assistance-payment.who_may: Visitors who accept the librarian’s assistance.
numenera.rule.library-assistance-payment.combines: Payment entitles a visitor to aid in using the Library.

numenera.rule.valenk-foundry-key-reuse-r.name: Valenk Foundry key reuse restriction

effect.summary: A dataform cannot use the same Valenk access key more than once, even by spawning an instance.

numenera.rule.valenk-foundry-key-reuse-r.cost_or_limit: Each dataform gets one use per key.
numenera.rule.valenk-foundry-key-reuse-r.who_may: Any dataform attempting to access Valenk.
numenera.rule.valenk-foundry-key-reuse-r.combines: Keys work with the node’s vertice and conduits.
numenera.rule.valenk-foundry-key-reuse-r.blocked_reason: Enforcing single use across spawned instances requires persistent identity tracking.

numenera.rule.valenk-access-restriction.name: Valenk access restriction

effect.summary: Strict key enforcement normally allows each individual to access the foundry only once.

numenera.rule.valenk-access-restriction.blocked_reason: The rule restricts repeat entry through a keyed access limit.

numenera.rule.verse-memory-and-identity-.name: Verse memory and identity rule

effect.summary: Simulation entrants generally forget their former lives; remembering requires an Intellect task at the node’s level.

numenera.rule.verse-memory-and-identity-.cost_or_limit: A control pod can ease the memory task by two or more steps
numenera.rule.verse-memory-and-identity-.go_wrong: Entrants may never realize they were anything but their simulated identities
numenera.rule.verse-memory-and-identity-.who_may: Those entering through the Simulation Door
numenera.rule.verse-memory-and-identity-.combines: Protective abilities, cyphers, or passes may help
numenera.rule.verse-memory-and-identity-.blocked_reason: The rule imposes persistent changes to memory and identity.

numenera.rule.esvarric-s-departure-effec.name: Esvarric’s departure effect

effect.summary: When Esvarric leaves Yoltar, he weakens and random glitches begin in the node.

numenera.rule.esvarric-s-departure-effec.cost_or_limit: The longer he is away, the weaker he becomes
numenera.rule.esvarric-s-departure-effec.blocked_reason: The passage describes unpredictable glitches caused by an absent voice.

numenera.rule.yoltar-species-travel-rest.name: Yoltar species travel restriction

effect.summary: A barrier excludes the mantis explorers’ species from later frames even when another traveler opens it.

numenera.rule.yoltar-species-travel-rest.cost_or_limit: Applies to the affected species in this node
numenera.rule.yoltar-species-travel-rest.go_wrong: Travel remains blocked until the restriction is ended
numenera.rule.yoltar-species-travel-rest.combines: Studying Esvarric’s key reveals a painful way to end the restriction
numenera.rule.yoltar-species-travel-rest.blocked_reason: The proposed remedy alters a soulcore, a state not represented by the basic effect grammar.

numenera.rule.datasphere-connection-reli.name: Datasphere connection reliability

effect.summary: Connection-dependent devices may stutter, delay, or have extended effects.

numenera.rule.datasphere-connection-reli.cost_or_limit: A weak connection can impair performance; reason is unknown.
numenera.rule.datasphere-connection-reli.go_wrong: Effects may occur every other round or be delayed.
numenera.rule.datasphere-connection-reli.who_may: Applies to devices requiring a datasphere connection.
numenera.rule.datasphere-connection-reli.blocked_reason: This is a world mechanism expressible as a timing and reliability rule.

numenera.rule.cypher-salvage.name: Cypher salvage

effect.summary: Cyphers may be salvaged from frames, dead dataforms, and interfaces, but some sources yield only bad data or a harmful glitching dataform.

numenera.rule.cypher-salvage.cost_or_limit: The GM determines whether a source can be salvaged.
numenera.rule.cypher-salvage.go_wrong: A supposed cypher may harm its user.
numenera.rule.cypher-salvage.blocked_reason: The harmful outcome is mentioned without specifying its effect.

numenera.rule.realscribed-cyphers.name: Realscribed cyphers

effect.summary: Realscribed cyphers usually function normally in the real, except for effects confined to the datasphere.

numenera.rule.realscribed-cyphers.cost_or_limit: Appearance depends on the vertice used.
numenera.rule.realscribed-cyphers.blocked_reason: This is a general rule about where cyphers function.

numenera.rule.gestalt-joining-and-separa.name: Gestalt joining and separation

effect.summary: Gestalts combine creatures’ energies and abilities; separation divides health or Soulcore Pool and imposes a temporary penalty.

numenera.rule.gestalt-joining-and-separa.cost_or_limit: Prolonged merging can cause lasting psychological effects; killing a gestalt usually separates its members, dead.
numenera.rule.gestalt-joining-and-separa.go_wrong: Participants may suffer psychological harm or damage-track loss.
numenera.rule.gestalt-joining-and-separa.mind: Minds coordinate during joining, but prolonged merging can cause lasting psychological effects.
numenera.rule.gestalt-joining-and-separa.who_may: Creatures that can combine naturally or through a cypher or artifact.
numenera.rule.gestalt-joining-and-separa.blocked_reason: The rule governs merging, separation, and the resulting creature form.

numenera.rule.datasphere-artifact-connec.name: Datasphere artifact connection effects

effect.summary: Connection-dependent artifacts may stutter, delay, or gain extended duration.

numenera.rule.datasphere-artifact-connec.cost_or_limit: Effects vary with connection quality; the cause of weak connections is unknown.
numenera.rule.datasphere-artifact-connec.go_wrong: Some work only every other round or have delayed effects.
numenera.rule.datasphere-artifact-connec.blocked_reason: This is a world rule about connection-dependent artifact behavior.

numenera.rule.realscribed-datasphere-art.name: Realscribed datasphere artifacts

effect.summary: Realscribed artifacts usually retain function, except functions exclusive to the datasphere.

numenera.rule.realscribed-datasphere-art.cost_or_limit: Appearance may vary according to origin and the vertice used.
numenera.rule.realscribed-datasphere-art.blocked_reason: This states how artifacts behave across realms.

numenera.rule.force-exhaust.name: Force Exhaust

effect.summary: Some vehicles trail a narrow force wall that ends on departure, transformation, destruction, or after minutes.

numenera.rule.force-exhaust.cost_or_limit: Field level equals the vehicle level; activating or deactivating it takes an action; destroyed sections may collapse older sections.
numenera.rule.force-exhaust.go_wrong: Older wall portions can collapse with a destroyed part.
numenera.rule.force-exhaust.combines: Movement across or around the wall depends on frame qualities.
numenera.rule.force-exhaust.blocked_reason: The rule describes a moving force-field obstacle.

numenera.rule.vehicle-glyph.name: Vehicle Glyph

effect.summary: Some vehicles can become small object dataforms and return to vehicle form.

numenera.rule.vehicle-glyph.cost_or_limit: Changing form takes an action; occupants appear safely beside the pilot; undersized frames force reversion to glyph form.
numenera.rule.vehicle-glyph.combines: Transformation carries the vehicle’s occupants safely outside.
numenera.rule.vehicle-glyph.blocked_reason: The rule changes a vehicle’s form and relocates its occupants.

numenera.rule.glitch-persistence-and-rea.name: Glitch persistence and realscribing

effect.summary: Glitches usually persist in the datasphere and are usually erased by realscribing, though some persist into the real.

numenera.rule.glitch-persistence-and-rea.cost_or_limit: Real-world persistence may resemble the datasphere effect or cause mutations.
numenera.rule.glitch-persistence-and-rea.go_wrong: Some errors occur during datascribing regardless of resistance; viral glitches can spread through contact, attacks, or speech.
numenera.rule.glitch-persistence-and-rea.mind: Glitches may alter memory, perception, or behavior.
numenera.rule.glitch-persistence-and-rea.where_from: Datascribing, glitched areas, unusual attacks, or effects
numenera.rule.glitch-persistence-and-rea.combines: Many circumstances allow a resistance roll, but datascribing errors may not.
numenera.rule.glitch-persistence-and-rea.blocked_reason: Glitches can persist, spread, and produce ongoing or changing detrimental effects.

numenera.rule.creature-transcription-int.name: Creature transcription into the datasphere

effect.summary: Creatures can transcribe into the datasphere; their health stays the same, while abilities may need reinterpretation.

numenera.rule.creature-transcription-int.cost_or_limit: Only abilities that work in the datasphere are retained in their translated form.
numenera.rule.creature-transcription-int.who_may: Creatures that transcribe into the datasphere.
numenera.rule.creature-transcription-int.combines: Creature attacks manifest their ordinary weapons or natural appendages as ideate forms.
numenera.rule.creature-transcription-int.blocked_reason: This is a world rule about converting a creature into a datasphere form.

numenera.rule.real-creature-equipment-tr.name: Real-creature equipment transcription

effect.summary: Usually, only cyphers and artifacts carried by a real creature transcribe with it.

numenera.rule.real-creature-equipment-tr.cost_or_limit: Other carried equipment generally does not transcribe.
numenera.rule.real-creature-equipment-tr.who_may: Real creatures transcribing into the datasphere.
numenera.rule.real-creature-equipment-tr.blocked_reason: This is a transfer restriction on which carried items enter the datasphere.

numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.name: Effluvium contact effects

effect.summary: Disturbing effluvium can produce variable effects after a failed defense roll; ithsyns are immune.

numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.cost_or_limit: Contact requires a failed defense roll to trigger an effect; outcomes vary.
numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.go_wrong: Possible outcomes include blindness, teleportation, attacks, hindrance, activation of a carried item, memory disruption, armor, suffocation, or transformation into a giant or cypher.
numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.mind: One outcome explores memory chains and dazes the target.
numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.who_may: Anyone contacting disturbed effluvium, except ithsyns are immune.
numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.combines: May trigger a target’s cypher or artifact.
numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.mechanism: Randomized contact hazard with defense and variable outcomes.
numenera.rule.effluvium-contact-effects.blocked_reason: One listed outcome empowers and sets off a carried cypher or artifact, requiring an item interaction.

numenera.rule.datasphere-target-restrict.name: Datasphere target restriction

effect.summary: Effects cannot directly target the datasphere as a whole, though they may target its contents.

numenera.rule.datasphere-target-restrict.cost_or_limit: Individual dataforms, installations, objects, and interfaces remain valid targets.
numenera.rule.datasphere-target-restrict.go_wrong: Repeated direct targeting may provoke retaliation.
numenera.rule.datasphere-target-restrict.combines: Applies to energy absorption, machine control, and countermeasures.
numenera.rule.datasphere-target-restrict.blocked_reason: This is a restriction on otherwise representable targets.

numenera.rule.datasphere-matter-alterati.name: Datasphere matter alteration

effect.summary: Matter-altering effects produce approximate dataforms; frame edges and volume remain fixed.

numenera.rule.datasphere-matter-alterati.cost_or_limit: Cosmetic props may not be useful or harmful, and digging cannot enlarge a frame or exit it.
numenera.rule.datasphere-matter-alterati.blocked_reason: The rule governs transformation and the persistence of frame boundaries.

numenera.rule.empty-pools-in-the-datasph.name: Empty Pools in the datasphere

effect.summary: Soulcore Pool loss is counted in thirds to determine empty Pools.

numenera.rule.empty-pools-in-the-datasph.cost_or_limit: Each lost third counts as one empty Pool; two thirds count as two.
numenera.rule.empty-pools-in-the-datasph.who_may: Characters with abilities that require empty Pools
numenera.rule.empty-pools-in-the-datasph.combines: Adapts abilities such as Blood Fever.
numenera.rule.empty-pools-in-the-datasph.blocked_reason: The Pool conversion is a straightforward game condition.

numenera.rule.illusions-in-the-dataspher.name: Illusions in the datasphere

effect.summary: Illusions create dataforms that behave like their illusory equivalents.

numenera.rule.illusions-in-the-dataspher.cost_or_limit: Illusions without physical components may be recognized as glitches because objects and attacks pass through them.
numenera.rule.illusions-in-the-dataspher.go_wrong: The illusion may be identified as a glitch.
numenera.rule.illusions-in-the-dataspher.combines: Can represent creatures or objects such as a margr or wall.
numenera.rule.illusions-in-the-dataspher.blocked_reason: Illusory objects and their limitations can be represented with basic effects.

numenera.rule.phasing-and-other-dimensio.name: Phasing and other dimensions

effect.summary: Dimension effects move dataforms to or from the Echo instead of a different dimension.

numenera.rule.phasing-and-other-dimensio.cost_or_limit: The relevant parallel layer is only the Echo.
numenera.rule.phasing-and-other-dimensio.who_may: Users of dimension or phasing effects
numenera.rule.phasing-and-other-dimensio.combines: The Echo resembles a monochrome nearest frame.
numenera.rule.phasing-and-other-dimensio.blocked_reason: Movement to a parallel layer needs location handling beyond ordinary in-frame movement.

numenera.rule.remote-sensing-range.name: Remote sensing range

effect.summary: Sensors reach across frames at long range and across connected nodes at a mile or more.

numenera.rule.remote-sensing-range.cost_or_limit: Unconnected nodes are erratic to observe.
numenera.rule.remote-sensing-range.go_wrong: Observation is unreliable outside conduit-connected nodes.
numenera.rule.remote-sensing-range.blocked_reason: The rule limits a basic sensing effect.

numenera.rule.telekinesis-weight-limit.name: Telekinesis weight limit

effect.summary: Weight-dependent movement remains limited to approximately the amount movable in reality.

numenera.rule.telekinesis-weight-limit.cost_or_limit: Objects seem to have weight despite being essentially weightless.
numenera.rule.telekinesis-weight-limit.who_may: Users of telekinesis and similar abilities
numenera.rule.telekinesis-weight-limit.blocked_reason: This is a limit on a basic movement effect.

numenera.rule.teleportation-across-nodes.name: Teleportation across nodes

effect.summary: Teleportation works within frames and nodes but cannot move between nodes.

numenera.rule.teleportation-across-nodes.go_wrong: Unauthorized entry to some locked spaces may trigger daemon attack or expulsion.
numenera.rule.teleportation-across-nodes.combines: Locked spaces may have invisible daemons.
numenera.rule.teleportation-across-nodes.blocked_reason: The rule is a movement restriction.

numenera.rule.sepulcher.name: Sepulcher

effect.summary: A sepulcher can return a dead dataform to life.

numenera.rule.sepulcher.cost_or_limit: The passage gives no further conditions.
numenera.rule.sepulcher.blocked_reason: Returning a dead dataform to life requires a soul or death-state mechanism.

numenera.rule.soulcore.name: Soulcore

effect.summary: Soulcore is both a Pool combining Might, Speed, and Intellect and the information represented by a creature’s dataform.

numenera.rule.soulcore.cost_or_limit: The Pool is used by PCs in the datasphere.
numenera.rule.soulcore.combines: Connects game Pools with a creature’s represented information.
numenera.rule.soulcore.blocked_reason: Soulcore includes the information representing a creature’s identity.

numenera.rule.realscribe.name: Realscribe

effect.summary: It transcribes a dataform from the datasphere into reality.

numenera.rule.realscribe.cost_or_limit: Requires a vertice where transcription is possible.
numenera.rule.realscribe.blocked_reason: Transcribing creatures involves moving represented beings between the datasphere and reality.

numenera.rule.datascribe.name: Datascribe

effect.summary: It transcribes an object or creature from reality into the datasphere.

numenera.rule.datascribe.cost_or_limit: Requires a suitable transcription process or installation.
numenera.rule.datascribe.blocked_reason: Transcribing creatures involves moving represented beings between reality and the datasphere.

numenera.rule.conduit.name: Conduit

effect.summary: It connects two vertices or nodes in the datasphere.

numenera.rule.conduit.cost_or_limit: Remote sensing across nodes requires a conduit connection.
numenera.rule.conduit.blocked_reason: It defines a connection between separate dataspace locations.

numenera.rule.barrier.name: Barrier

effect.summary: It restricts travel between two datasphere locations.

numenera.rule.barrier.cost_or_limit: May require a pause, input, or overcoming a hazard.
numenera.rule.barrier.combines: May be opened with a key, codebreaking, or kicking.
numenera.rule.barrier.blocked_reason: A barrier restricts movement through a spatial boundary.

numenera.rule.daemon.name: Daemon

effect.summary: A daemon may advise, navigate, assist, carry messages, or transport objects.

numenera.rule.daemon.combines: Comparable to an instant servant cypher.
numenera.rule.daemon.blocked_reason: Its listed service functions can be represented with basic effects.

numenera.rule.dataform.name: Dataform

effect.summary: It is an object or creature transcribed into the datasphere.

numenera.rule.dataform.who_may: Objects and creatures transcribed into the datasphere
numenera.rule.dataform.blocked_reason: This defines a represented object or creature.

numenera.rule.frame.name: Frame

effect.summary: A frame is a dataspace within a node, with an interior environment and sometimes qualities.

numenera.rule.frame.cost_or_limit: Creatures usually cannot see its contents before entering unless it is transparent.
numenera.rule.frame.combines: Adjacent frames may be linked by barriers.

numenera.rule.node.name: Node

effect.summary: A node is a large dataspace that may contain connected or isolated frames.

numenera.rule.node.combines: May connect to other nodes by conduits.

numenera.rule.vertex.name: Vertex

effect.summary: A conduit connects two vertices or nodes.

numenera.rule.vertex.blocked_reason: It denotes a location in the datasphere’s connection network.
